spells.name: Deathbringer Stance
spells.summary: Periodically, Aatrox's next basic attack deals bonus magic damage and heals him, based on the target's max health.
spells.text: Aatrox's Attacks deal an additional (4% ~ 10%) max Health magic damage and restore 100% of damage dealt as Health, reduced to 25% against minions. This effect has a (22 ~ 10) second cooldown. Attack and Ability hits against champions and large jungle monsters reduce this effect's cooldown by 2 seconds. Hits with the edge of The Darkin Blade reduce it by 4 seconds instead.

spells.name: The Darkin Blade
spells.summary: Aatrox slams his greatsword down, dealing physical damage. He can swing three times, each with a different area of effect.
spells.text: Aatrox slams his greatsword, dealing (10/25/40/55/70 + (60/67.5/75/82.5/90% Attack Damage)) physical damage. If they are hit on the edge, they are briefly Knocked Up and they take (17.5/43.75/70/96.25/122.5 + (105/118.125/131.25/144.375/157.5% Attack Damage)) instead. This Ability can be Recast twice, each one changing shape and dealing 25% more damage than the previous one. Deals 70% damage to minions. Knock Up duration against monsters is doubled and it deals 25 bonus damage.

spells.name: Infernal Chains
spells.summary: Aatrox smashes the ground, dealing damage to the first enemy hit. Champions and large monsters have to leave the impact area quickly or they will be dragged to the center and take the damage again.
spells.text: Aatrox fires a chain, Slowing the first enemy hit by 25/27.5/30/32.5/35% for 1.5 seconds and dealing (30/40/50/60/70 + (40% Attack Damage)) physical damage. Champions and large jungle monsters have 1.5 seconds to leave the impact area or be Pulled back to the center and damaged again for the same amount. Deals double damage to minions.

spells.name: Umbral Dash
spells.summary: Passively, Aatrox heals when damaging enemy champions. On activation, he dashes in a direction.
spells.text: Passive: Aatrox heals for (16% + (1.3% per 100 bonus Health)) of the damage he deals to Champions. Active: Aatrox dashes. He can use this Ability while winding up his other Abilities.

spells.name: World Ender
spells.summary: Aatrox unleashes his demonic form, fearing nearby enemy minions and gaining attack damage, increased healing, and Move Speed. If he gets a takedown, this effect is extended.
spells.text: Aatrox reveals his true demonic form, Fearing nearby minions for 3 seconds and gaining 60/80/100% Move Speed decaying over 10 seconds. He also gains 20/30/40% Attack Damage and increases self-healing by 50/75/100% for the duration. Champion takedowns extend the duration of this effect by 5 seconds and refresh the Move Speed effect. Duration cannot be increased past 10 seconds.

spells.name: Essence Theft
spells.summary: After killing 9 minions or monsters, Ahri heals. After taking down an enemy champion, Ahri heals for a greater amount.
spells.text: Killing minions or monsters grants Ahri an Essence Fragment. After obtaining 9 Fragments, Ahri consumes them to restore ((35 ~ 95) + (20% Ability Power)) Health. When Ahri scores a takedown against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them, she feasts upon their Essence, restoring ((75 ~ 165) + (30% Ability Power)) Health.

spells.name: Orb of Deception
spells.summary: Ahri sends out and pulls back her orb, dealing magic damage on the way out and true damage on the way back.
spells.text: Ahri throws then pulls back her orb, dealing (35/60/85/110/135 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage on the way out and (35/60/85/110/135 + (50% Ability Power)) true damage on the way back.

spells.name: Fox-Fire
spells.summary: Ahri gains a brief burst of Move Speed and releases three fox-fires, that lock onto and attack nearby enemies.
spells.text: Ahri releases 3 fox-fires that seek nearby enemies and deal (40/60/80/100/120 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage, reduced to (16/24/32/40/48 + (16% Ability Power)) damage beyond the first. She also gains 40% Move Speed decaying over 2 seconds. Fox-fires prioritize champions hit by Charm, enemies Ahri has attacked, then other champions. Minions below 20% Health take 200% damage.

spells.name: Charm
spells.summary: Ahri blows a kiss that damages and charms an enemy it encounters, instantly stopping movement abilities and causing them to walk harmlessly towards her.
spells.text: Ahri blows a kiss that Charms the first enemy hit for 1.2/1.35/1.5/1.65/1.8 seconds and deals (80/120/160/200/240 + (85% Ability Power)) magic damage. This Ability Knocks Down enemies.

spells.name: Spirit Rush
spells.summary: Ahri dashes forward and fires essence bolts, damaging nearby enemies. Spirit Rush can be cast up to three times before going on cooldown, and gains additional recasts when taking down enemy champions.
spells.text: Ahri nimbly dashes, firing 3 essence bolts at nearby enemies, prioritizing champions. These bolts deal (75/125/175 + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage each. Spirit Rush can be Recast up to 2 more times within 15 seconds. Consuming a champion's Essence with Essence Theft during this period extends the recast window by up to 10 seconds and grants an additional recast of Spirit Rush (up to 3 stored).

spells.name: Assassin's Mark
spells.summary: Dealing spell damage to a champion creates a ring of energy around them. Exiting that ring empowers Akali's next Attack with bonus range and damage.
spells.text: When Akali hits an enemy champion with an Ability, she reveals a ring around them for 4 seconds and gains (30% ~ 60%) Move Speed towards the ring. Crossing the ring causes Akali's next Attack to have doubled range and deal an additional ((35 ~ 164) + (60% bonus Attack Damage) + (55% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Five Point Strike
spells.summary: Akali throws out five kunai, dealing damage based on her bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power and slowing.
spells.text: Akali slings kunai in an arc, dealing (45/70/95/120/145 + (65% Attack Damage) + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing enemies at the tip by 50% for 0.5 seconds.

spells.name: Twilight Shroud
spells.summary: Akali drops a cover of smoke and briefly gains Move Speed. While inside the shroud, Akali becomes invisible and unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks. Attacking or using abilities will briefly reveal her.
spells.text: Akali drops a smoke bomb, unleashing a spreading cover of smoke lasting 5/5.5/6/6.5/7 seconds and granting herself 30/35/40/45/50% Move Speed decaying over 2 seconds. Akali increases her max Energy by 100 while the shroud is active. While inside the smoke, Akali is Invisible. Invisible units cannot be revealed except by turrets or True Sight.

spells.name: Shuriken Flip
spells.summary: Flip backward and fire a shuriken forward, dealing magic damage. The first enemy or smoke cloud hit is marked. Re-cast to dash to the marked target, dealing additional damage.
spells.text: Akali flips backwards as she throws a shuriken, dealing (21/42/63/84/105 + (30% Attack Damage) + (33% Ability Power)) magic damage and marking the first enemy or smoke cloud hit. Akali can Recast this once to dash to the marked target, dealing (49/98/147/196/245 + (70% Attack Damage) + (77% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Perfect Execution
spells.summary: Akali leaps in a direction, damaging enemies she strikes. Re-cast: Akali dashes in a direction, executing all enemies she strikes.
spells.text: Akali vaults over an enemy champion, dealing (110/220/330 + (50% bonus Attack Damage) + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage to all enemies in her path. Akali can Recast after 2.5 seconds to execute a piercing thrust, dashing and dealing (70/140/210 + (30% Ability Power)) to (210/420/630 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage based on missing Health. Deals max damage to targets below 30% Health.

spells.name: Dirty Fighting
spells.summary: Every three hits from Akshan's Attacks and Abilities deals bonus damage and grants him a Shield if the target was a champion. When Akshan Attacks, he fires an additional Attack for reduced damage. If he cancels the additional Attack, he instead gains Move Speed.
spells.text: After launching an Attack, Akshan will fire an additional shot for (50% Attack Damage) physical damage. He can cancel this shot to instead gain (20 ~ 75) × (1 + 100% bonus Attack Speed) Move Speed decaying over 1 second. Every three hits from Attacks or Abilities deals an additional (150 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. Against champions, Akshan also gains ((40 ~ 280) + (35% bonus Attack Damage)) Shield for 2 seconds (4 second Cooldown).

spells.name: Avengerang
spells.summary: Akshan throws a boomerang that deals damage going out and coming back, extending its range each time it hits an enemy.
spells.text: Akshan throws a boomerang that deals (45/75/105/135/165 + (70% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage, extending the range each time an enemy is hit. Champion hits grant Akshan (20% + (5% per 100 Ability Power)) Move Speed decaying over 1 second. Deals 40/50/60/70/80% damage to non-champions. Enemies hit are briefly revealed.

spells.name: Going Rogue
spells.summary: Akshan passively marks enemy champions as Scoundrels when they kill his ally champions. If Akshan kills a Scoundrel, he resurrects the allies they killed, gains bonus gold, and clears all marks. When activated, Akshan enters camouflage and gains Move Speed and Mana Regen while moving towards Scoundrels. Akshan loses the camouflage quickly while he is not in brush or near terrain.
spells.text: Passive: Enemy champions that kill Akshan's allies become Scoundrels for 60 seconds. Takedowns on a Scoundrel within 3 seconds of being damaged by Akshan grant him 100 Gold, resurrects the slain allies, and removes all other Scoundrels. Active: Akshan becomes Camouflaged for 2 seconds or indefinitely while he is near a wall or in brush. While Camouflaged in this way, Akshan also gains 80/90/100/110/120 Move Speed and 12% missing Mana regen while moving towards Scoundrels. Passive: Enemy champions that kill Akshan's allies become Scoundrels for 60 seconds. Takedowns on a Scoundrel within 3 seconds of being damaged by Akshan grant him and his partner 100 Gold and removes all other Scoundrels. Active: Akshan becomes Camouflaged for 2 seconds or indefinitely while he is near a wall or in brush. While Camouflaged in this way, Akshan also gains 80/90/100/110/120 Move Speed and 12% missing Mana regen while moving towards Scoundrels. Camouflaged units cannot be seen unless an enemy champion is inside their detection radius. While active, Akshan also sees trails leading to Scoundrels. Akshan can only claim Scoundrels when he is alive.

spells.name: Heroic Swing
spells.summary: Akshan fires a grappling hook into terrain then swings around it, repeatedly firing at the nearest enemy while swinging. He can jump off early or gets knocked off when colliding with champions or terrain.
spells.text: First Cast: Akshan fires a grappling hook, attaching to the first terrain hit. Second Cast: Akshan swings around the terrain, repeatedly firing at the nearest enemy for (8/16/24/32/40 + (25% Attack Damage)) × (1 + 30% bonus Attack Speed) physical damage per shot. Third Cast: Akshan dives off the rope, firing a final shot. Colliding with an enemy Champion or terrain ends the swing early. Champion takedowns refresh this Ability's Cooldown. Akshan prioritizes shooting champions marked by Dirty Fighting. On-hits while swinging are 25% effective. Damage is increased by 30% of bonus Attack Speed. Attacks can critically strike for (8/16/24/32/40 + (25% Attack Damage)) × (1 + 30% bonus Attack Speed) physical damage.

spells.name: Comeuppance
spells.summary: Akshan locks onto an enemy champion and starts storing bullets. When released, he fires all stored bullets, dealing damage based on missing health to the first champion, minion, or structure hit.
spells.text: Akshan locks onto a champion and begins overcharging his gun for up to 2.5 seconds, storing up to 5/6/7 bullets. Recast: Akshan unleashes the stored bullets, each dealing at least (25/35/45 + (15% Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first enemy or structure hit, increased up to (75/105/135 + (45% Attack Damage)) physical damage based on missing Health. Bullets execute minions and apply Lifesteal. Bullet damage scales with Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage at 30% effectiveness.

spells.name: Triumphant Roar
spells.summary: Alistar charges his roar by stunning or displacing enemy champions or when nearby enemies die. When fully charged he heals himself all nearby allied champions.
spells.text: Alistar gains a stack whenever he Stuns or Knocks an enemy champion, or whenever an enemy dies. At 7 stacks, Alistar roars, restoring (5% Health) Health to himself and (7% Health) Health to nearby allied champions. Enemy champion and epic jungle monster deaths fully charge this Ability.

spells.name: Pulverize
spells.summary: Alistar smashes the ground, dealing damage to nearby enemies and tossing them into the air.
spells.text: Alistar smashes the ground, Knocking Up enemies for 1 second and dealing (60/100/140/180/220 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Headbutt
spells.summary: Alistar rams a target with his head, dealing damage and knocking the target back.
spells.text: Alistar rams into an enemy, Knocking them Back and dealing (55/110/165/220/275 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Trample
spells.summary: Alistar tramples nearby enemy units, ignoring unit collision and gaining stacks if he damages an enemy champion. At full stacks Alistar's next basic attack against an enemy champion deals additional magic damage and stuns them.
spells.text: Alistar begins trampling the ground, becoming Ghosted and dealing (80/110/140/170/200 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage over 5 seconds to nearby enemies. Each pulse that damages a champion grants a stack. At 5 stacks, Alistar's next Attack against champions Stuns for 1 second and deals an additional (20 ~ 20) magic damage. Ghosted units ignore collision with other units.

spells.name: Unbreakable Will
spells.summary: Alistar lets out a wild roar, removing all crowd control effects on himself, and reducing incoming physical and magical damage for the duration.
spells.text: Alistar immediately cleanses all Disabling effects and takes 55/65/75% reduced damage for 7 seconds.

spells.name: Drakehound's Step
spells.summary: Entering an attack or movement command while casting an ability will cause Ambessa to dash a short distance once the ability is cast, granting her next attack bonus range, damage, and attack speed, and refunding energy.
spells.text: When Ambessa is casting an Ability, issuing a Move or Attack order will cause her to dash in that direction after the Ability finishes. Each cast initiation grants her a charge for 4 seconds (max: 3). While Ambessa has a charge, she gains 75 Attack Range and 50% Attack Speed. Attacks consume a charge to deal ((5 ~ 30) + (25% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and restore 70 Energy.

spells.name: Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam
spells.summary: Ambessa sweeps her twin drakehounds in a semicircle in front of her, dealing bonus damage to enemies hit by the blades. Striking an enemy will transform the next cast of this ability for a short period of time, causing her to slam her twin drakehounds down in a line in front of her, dealing bonus damage to the first enemy hit.
spells.text: Cunning Sweep: Ambessa sweeps her blades forward, dealing (40/60/80/100/120 + (60% bonus Attack Damage)) + (4/4.5/5/5.5/6% + (3% per 100 bonus Attack Damage)) max Health physical damage to enemies at the edge of the strike. All other enemies take 50% damage. Striking an enemy readies a Sundering Slam. Sundering Slam: Ambessa slams her blades down, dealing (50/75/100/125/150 + (90% bonus Attack Damage)) + (4/4.5/5/5.5/6% + (4% per 100 bonus Attack Damage)) max Health physical damage against the first enemy hit. All other enemies take 50% damage. Deals an additional 75 physical damage to monsters. The percent of max Health damage to monsters is capped at (100 ~ 300).

spells.name: Repudiation
spells.summary: Ambessa gains a shield, briefly braces herself, and then slams the ground to damage nearby enemies. If she blocked any non-minion damage while bracing herself, this ability will deal increased damage.
spells.text: Ambessa gains ((50 ~ 320) + (150% bonus Attack Damage)) Shield for 1.5 seconds and braces herself for 0.5 seconds. She then slams the ground, dealing (50/75/100/125/150 + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to nearby enemies, which increases to (75/112.5/150/187.5/225 + (75% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage if she braced herself from damage from an enemy champion, large monster, or structure.

spells.name: Lacerate
spells.summary: Ambessa whips her twin drakehounds around herself, damaging and slowing nearby enemies. Initiating Drakehound's Step from this ability causes her to strike a second time at the end of its dash.
spells.text: Ambessa whips her chains around, dealing (40/60/80/100/120 + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and Slowing enemies by 99%, which decays over 1 second. Initiating Drakehound's Step from this Ability will trigger an additional strike.

spells.name: Public Execution
spells.summary: Ambessa blinks to the farthest enemy champion in a line of her choosing and suppresses them upon her arrival. She then slams the enemy into the ground where they take damage and are stunned.
spells.text: Passive: Ambessa gains 10/20/30% Armor Penetration and her Abilities heal her for (15/17.5/20% + (50% Lifesteal)) of the damage she dealt. Active: Ambessa becomes Unstoppable and blinks to the farthest enemy champion in a line, Suppressing the target for 0.75 seconds and then slamming them into the ground, dealing (150/250/350 + (80% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and Stunning them for 0.4 seconds. Healing is 25% effective against minions and 25% effective against monsters.

spells.name: Cursed Touch
spells.summary: Amumu's basic attacks Curse his enemies, causing them to take bonus true damage from incoming magic damage.
spells.text: Amumu's Attacks Curse his enemies for 3 seconds, causing them to take an additional 10% true damage from all magic damage they take.

spells.name: Bandage Toss
spells.summary: Amumu tosses a sticky bandage at a target, stunning and damaging the target while he pulls himself to them.
spells.text: Amumu launches a bandage, pulling himself to the first enemy hit, Stunning them for 1 second, and dealing (70/95/120/145/170 + (85% Ability Power)) magic damage. This Ability has 2 charges.

spells.name: Despair
spells.summary: Overcome by anguish, nearby enemies lose a percentage of their maximum Health each second and have their Curses refreshed.
spells.text: Toggle: Amumu begins crying, dealing 10 plus (1/1.25/1.5/1.75/2 + (0.5% Ability Power))max Health magic damage to nearby enemies every second and refreshing Curse.

spells.name: Tantrum
spells.summary: Permanently reduces the physical damage Amumu would take. Amumu can unleash his rage, dealing damage to surrounding enemies. Each time Amumu is hit, the cooldown on Tantrum is reduced.
spells.text: Passive: Amumu takes (5/7/9/11/13 + (3% bonus Armor) + (3% bonus Magic Resist)) reduced physical damage. Additionally, when Amumu is hit by an Attack, this Ability's Cooldown is reduced by 0.75 seconds. Active: Amumu throws a tantrum, dealing (65/95/125/155/185 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage to nearby enemies. Damage reduction effect can't reduce the damage below 50%.

spells.name: Curse of the Sad Mummy
spells.summary: Amumu entangles surrounding enemy units in bandages, applying his Curse, damaging and stunning them.
spells.text: Amumu flares out his bandages, Stunning for 1.5 seconds, dealing (200/300/400 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage and applying Curse. This Ability Knocks Down enemies.

spells.name: Rebirth
spells.summary: Upon taking fatal damage, Anivia reverts to an egg and is reborn with full health.
spells.text: Upon taking fatal damage, Anivia reverts to an egg, healing to full Health and receiving 20 Armor and Magic Resist. If she survives for 6 seconds, she is reborn.

spells.name: Flash Frost
spells.summary: Anivia brings her wings together and summons a sphere of ice that flies towards her opponents, chilling and damaging anyone in its path. When the sphere explodes it does moderate damage in a radius, stunning anyone in the area.
spells.text: Anivia fires a massive chunk of ice, dealing (50/70/90/110/130 + (25% Ability Power)) magic damage and Chilling enemies for 3 seconds, Slowing them by 20/30/40/50/60%. At the end of its range, the ice detonates, Stunning enemies for 1.1/1.2/1.3/1.4/1.5 seconds and dealing (60/95/130/165/200 + (45% Ability Power)) magic damage. Anivia can Recast this ability while the ice flies to detonate it early.

spells.name: Crystallize
spells.summary: Anivia condenses the moisture in the air into an impassable wall of ice to block all movement. The wall only lasts a short duration before it melts.
spells.text: Anivia summons a wall of ice 400/500/600/700/800 units wide. The wall lasts for 5 seconds before it melts.

spells.name: Frostbite
spells.summary: With a flap of her wings, Anivia blasts a freezing gust of wind at her target, dealing damage. If the target was recently hit by Flash Frost or damaged by a fully formed Glacial Storm, the damage they take is doubled.
spells.text: Anivia blasts an enemy with a freezing wind, dealing (55/80/105/130/155 + (55% Ability Power)) magic damage. Against Chilled enemies, Anivia deals (110/160/210/260/310 + (110% Ability Power)) magic damage instead.

spells.name: Glacial Storm
spells.summary: Anivia summons a driving rain of ice and hail to damage her enemies and slow their advance.
spells.text: Toggle: Anivia calls forth a driving rain of ice and hail that Slows enemies by 20/30/40% and deals (30/45/60 + (12.5% Ability Power)) magic damage per second. The storm increases in size over 1.5 seconds. When the storm is fully formed, it Chills, Slows by 30/45/60%, and does (90/135/180 + (37.5% Ability Power)) magic damage per second instead. The storm ends if Anivia is too far away.

spells.name: Pyromania
spells.summary: After casting 4 spells, Annie's next offensive spell will stun the target. Annie begins the game and respawns with Pyromania available.
spells.text: After using 4 Abilities, Annie's next damaging Ability Stuns for 1.75 seconds. Annie begins the game and respawns with Pyromania available.

spells.name: Disintegrate
spells.summary: Annie hurls a Mana infused fireball, dealing damage and refunding the Mana cost if it destroys the target.
spells.text: Annie hurls a fireball, dealing (80/125/170/215/260 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage. If the target dies, Annie refunds the Mana cost and reduces the Cooldown by 50%.

spells.name: Incinerate
spells.summary: Annie casts a blazing cone of fire, dealing damage to all enemies in the area.
spells.text: Annie projects a wave of fire, dealing (70/110/150/190/230 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Molten Shield
spells.summary: Grants Annie or an ally a shield, a burst of Move Speed, and damages enemies who strike her with attacks or spells.
spells.text: Annie grants an ally champion (60/95/130/165/200 + (40% Ability Power)) Shield for 3 seconds and (20% ~ 50%) Decaying Move Speed for 1.5 seconds. While the shield holds, enemies who hit the shielded ally with an Attack or Ability receive (25/35/45/55/65 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage once per shield. Tibbers always gains the effects of Molten Shield when summoned.

spells.name: Summon: Tibbers
spells.summary: Annie wills her bear Tibbers to life, dealing damage to units in the area. Tibbers can attack and also burns enemies that stand near him.
spells.text: Passive: Annie gains 10/15/20% Magic Penetration. Annie summons her bear Tibbers, dealing (150/275/400 + (75% Ability Power)) magic damage. For the next 45 seconds, Tibbers burns nearby enemies for (8/12/16 + (4% Ability Power)) magic damage per second. Tibbers becomes enraged when summoned, if Annie stuns an enemy champion, and if Annie dies. When enraged, Tibbers gains 275% Attack Speed and 100% Move Speed decaying over 3 seconds. Recast: Manually issue orders to Tibbers. Tibbers has: (1150/3500 + (50% Ability Power)) Health (30 ~ 90) Armor (30 ~ 90) Magic Resist (30/45/60 + (10% Ability Power)) Attack Damage

spells.name: The Hitman and the Seer
spells.summary: Aphelios wields 5 Lunari Weapons made by his sister Alune. He has access to two at a time: one main-hand and one off-hand. Each weapon has a unique Basic Attack and Ability. Attacks and abilities consume a weapon's ammo. When out of ammo, Aphelios discards the weapon and Alune summons the next of the 5.
spells.text: Aphelios wields 5 Lunari Weapons made by his sister, Alune. He has access to two at a time: one main-hand and one off-hand. Each weapon has a unique Attack and Ability [Q]. Attacks and Abilities consume a weapon's ammo. When out of ammo, Aphelios discards the weapon and Alune summons the next one. Aphelios unlocks his weapon's Ability [Q] at level 2 and his Ultimate at level 6. Instead of powering up his Abilities, Aphelios' rank-ups grant him permanent stats. Lunari Weapon Order:Calibrum (Rifle): Long range Attacks. Severum (Scythe Pistol): Life Steal and Move Speed. Infernum (Flamethrower): Area of effect damage. Crescendum (Chakram): High damage at close range. Gravitum (Cannon): Slowing + Immobilizing effects.Calibrum (Rifle): Long range Attacks. Severum (Scythe Pistol): Life Steal and Move Speed. Infernum (Flamethrower): Area of effect damage. Crescendum (Chakram): High damage at close range. Gravitum (Cannon): Slowing + Immobilizing effects.

spells.name: Weapon Abilites
spells.summary: Aphelios has 5 different activated abilities, based on his main-hand weapon: Calibrum (Rifle): Long range shot that marks its target for a long-range follow-up attack. Severum (Scythe Pistol): Run fast while attacking nearby enemies with both weapons. Gravitum (Cannon): Root all enemies slowed by this weapon. Infernum (Flamethrower): Blast enemies in a cone and attack them with your off-hand weapon. Crescendum (Chakram): Deploy a sentry that shoots your off-hand weapon.
spells.text: Calibrum Active: Aphelios fires a long range shot, dealing (170 + (60% bonus Attack Damage) + (100% Ability Power)) physical damage to the first enemy hit and marking them. Severum Active: Aphelios gains (25% + (0.1% Ability Power)) Move Speed and fires both weapons at the nearest enemy for the next 1.75 seconds. Deals (6 + (200.004% bonus Attack Speed)) × (40% Attack Damage) physical damage over (6 + (200.004% bonus Attack Speed)) shots, prioritizing champions. Infernum Active: Aphelios spouts a wave of flame, dealing (110 + (21% bonus Attack Damage) + (70% Ability Power)) physical damage. Then he Attacks each enemy hit with his off-hand weapon. Crescendum Active: Aphelios deploys a lunar sentry equipped with Aphelios' off-hand weapon that lasts 20 seconds. Sentries activate when an enemy approaches and fire at them for (125 + (52% bonus Attack Damage) + (50% Ability Power)) physical damage per shot over 4 seconds. Gravitum Active: Aphelios triggers a gravity field on enemies he has Slowed with Gravitum, Rooting for 1 second and dealing (140 + (50% bonus Attack Damage) + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Phase
spells.summary: Aphelios swaps his main-hand gun with his off-hand gun, replacing his basic attack and activated ability.
spells.text: Swap main-hand and off-hand weapons, equipping Calibrum Severum Infernum Crescendum Gravitum.

spells.name: Weapon Queue System
spells.summary: Aphelios has no third ability. This slot shows the next weapon Alune will give him. Weapon order begins fixed but may change over game time -- when a weapon is out of ammo it goes to the end of the order.
spells.text: Calibrum Severum Infernum Crescendum Gravitum: Increased Attack Range. Abilities that deal damage with this weapon mark the victim, granting Aphelios a bonus long-range Attack against them. Attacks and Abilities using this weapon restore Health and can overheal you. Attacks with this weapon deal 110% damage and explode behind the target. Aphelios Attacks faster with this weapon the closer he is to his target and gains bonus damage on Ability hits. Attacks with this weapon apply a decaying Slow. Calibrum Severum Infernum Crescendum Gravitum Active:: Fire a long range shot, damaging the first enemy. Move fast and continuously fire both weapons at closest enemy over 1.75 seconds. Blast flames in the target direction and Attack all enemies hit with your off-hand weapon. Deploy a sentry equipped with a copy of Aphelios' off-hand weapon that Attacks nearby enemies. Root all enemies currently Slowed by Gravitum.

spells.name: Moonlight Vigil
spells.summary: Fire a concentrated blast of moonlight that explodes on enemy champions. Applies the unique effect of Aphelios' main-hand gun.
spells.text: Aphelios fires a concentrated blast of moonlight that explodes when it hits a champion, dealing (125/175/225 + (20% bonus Attack Damage) + (100% Ability Power)) physical damage to surrounding enemies. Then, Aphelios attacks all champions hit with his main-hand weapon. Calibrum Bonus: Marks added this way deal an additional 50/80/110 physical damage each when consumed. Severum Bonus: Aphelios restores 250/350/450 Health. Infernum Bonus: The moonlight blast deals an additional (50/100/150 + (25% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage, and the subsequent Attacks explode, each dealing 90% of their damage to surrounding targets. Crescendum Bonus: Summons an additional 5 mirror Chakram. Gravitum Bonus: Slow strength increased to 99%. Binding Eclipse's Root effect is increased to 1.35 seconds against these targets. The Attacks apply on-hits. Critical strikes deal 100% of normal damage instead.

spells.name: Frost Shot
spells.summary: Ashe's attacks slow their target, causing her to deal increased damage to these targets. Ashe's critical strikes deal no bonus damage but apply an empowered slow to the target.
spells.text: Ashe's Attacks and Abilities Slow by (20% ~ 30%) for 2 seconds. Attacks deal (100% + (100% Critical Strike Chance)) damage. Ashe's critical strikes deal no extra damage, instead increasing the Slow to (40% ~ 60%) decaying.

spells.name: Ranger's Focus
spells.summary: Ashe builds up Focus by attacking. At maximum Focus, Ashe can cast Ranger's Focus to consume all stacks of Focus, temporarily increasing her Attack Speed and transforming her basic attack into a powerful flurry attack for the duration.
spells.text: Passive: Ashe's Attacks grant a stack for 4 seconds. At 4 stacks, she may activate this Ability. Active: Ashe gains 20/30/40/50/60% Attack Speed and her Attacks deal (110/115/120/125/130% Attack Damage) damage instead for 6 seconds. The empowered Attacks are comprised of a flurry of 5 small strikes. They only apply on-hit effects once per Attack.

spells.name: Volley
spells.summary: Ashe fires arrows in a cone for increased damage. Also applies Frost Shot.
spells.text: Ashe fires a volley of 7/8/9/10/11 arrows, each dealing (60/95/130/165/200 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. Enemies can be hit by multiple arrows, but only take damage from the first. Champion hits count as critical strikes for the purposes of Frost Shot.

spells.name: Hawkshot
spells.summary: Ashe sends her Hawk Spirit on a scouting mission anywhere on the map.
spells.text: Ashe sends forth a hawk to grant vision for 5 seconds anywhere on the map. It also reveals the area around it as it flies. This Ability has 2 charges (90/80/70/60/50 second recharge).

spells.name: Enchanted Crystal Arrow
spells.summary: Ashe fires a missile of ice in a straight line. If the arrow collides with an enemy Champion, it deals damage and stuns the Champion, stunning for longer the farther arrow has traveled. In addition, surrounding enemy units take damage and are slowed.
spells.text: Ashe launches a crystal arrow of ice that Stuns the first champion hit and deals (200/400/600 + (120% Ability Power)) magic damage. The Stun duration increases with distance travelled, up to 3.5 seconds. Surrounding enemies are Slowed by Frost Shot. Minimum Stun duration is 1 second.

spells.name: Cosmic Creator
spells.summary: Aurelion Sol's damaging Abilities break down enemies into stacks of Stardust, which permanently improves each of his abilities.
spells.text: Cosmic CreatorAurelion Sol has acquired ? Stardust

spells.name: Breath of Light
spells.summary: Aurelion Sol channels his dragon breath for a few seconds, damaging the first enemy hit and splashing reduced damage onto nearby enemies. Each second the breath is channeled directly at an enemy will deal bonus damage, which is improved by the amount of Stardust that's been collected. This ability collects Stardust if the target is a champion.
spells.text: Aurelion Sol breathes starfire for up to 3.25/3.25/3.25/3.25/9999 seconds, dealing (45/60/75/90/105 + (55% Ability Power)) magic damage per second to the first enemy hit and 50% of the damage to surrounding enemies. Each full second of breath on the same enemy deals a burst of (60/70/80/90/100 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage plus 0.03% max Health magic damage and absorbs 2 Stardust if they are a champion. This Ability's range is 750. Canceling this Ability within 0.25 seconds of casting it will lock the Ability for 1 second. Minimum mana cost of 30/35/40/45/50 per cast. Percent damage deals a max of 300 magic damage against jungle monsters.

spells.name: Astral Flight
spells.summary: Aurelion Sol flies over terrain in a targeted direction. While in this state, he can cast other abilities. Breath of Light no longer has a cooldown or maximum channel duration and deals increased damage while flying. Astral Flight's remaining cooldown is reduced whenever an enemy champion dies after being recently damaged by Aurelion Sol. Stardust increases Astral Flight's maximum range.
spells.text: Aurelion Sol flies in a direction. While flying, Breath of Light has no Cooldown, no max channel duration, and its flat damage is increased by 8/9/10/11/12%. Takedowns on champions within 3 seconds of damaging them refunds 90% of this Ability's Cooldown. Recast: End flight early. Casting Breath of Light while flying reduces flight speed by 50%. Flight speed is (340 + (100% Movement Speed)).

spells.name: Singularity
spells.summary: Aurelion Sol summons a black hole, damaging enemies and slowly pulling them toward its center. This ability grants Stardust each time an enemy dies within the black hole and for each second an enemy champion is caught inside it. The center of the black hole executes enemies who are below a certain percentage of their maximum health. Stardust increases Singularity's area as well as the execution threshold.
spells.text: Aurelion Sol summons a black hole, dealing (10/15/20/25/30 + (12% Ability Power)) magic damage per second and Dragging enemies towards the center for 5 seconds. Enemies in the center below 5.03% max Health die instantly. The black hole absorbs Stardust when enemies die within it and each second an enemy champion is inside. This Ability's cast range is 750. Lane minions and jungle monsters inside have 0 Movement Speed. Epic monsters cannot be executed. Absorbs 1 Stardust per second from Champions. Absorbs Stardust from units that die in the black hole:Champions: 2 StardustEpic monsters: 2 StardustLarge monsters: 2 StardustSiege minions: 2 StardustMinions and small monsters: 1 Stardust

spells.name: Falling Star / The Skies Descend
spells.summary: Falling Star: Aurelion Sol crashes a star into the earth. This impact deals magic damage and stuns enemies while also granting Stardust for each enemy champion it hits. Gathering enough Stardust transforms Aurelion Sol's next Falling Star into The Skies Descend. The Skies Descend: Aurelion Sol drags a giant star down from the heavens with an increased impact zone and increased damage, knocking up enemies rather than stunning them. A shockwave then spreads from the edge of the impact zone, which damages and slows the enemies it hits. Stardust increases the impact area of both Falling Star and The Skies Descend.
spells.text: Aurelion Sol plucks a star from the heavens and crashes it into the earth, dealing (150/250/350 + (75% Ability Power)) magic damage, Stunning enemies 1 second, and absorbing 5 Stardust for each champion hit. Gathering 75 Stardust transforms the next Falling Star into The Skies Descend. The Skies Descend: Aurelion Sol drags a constellation's worth of fury down from the cosmos, dealing (187.5/312.5/437.5 + (93.75% Ability Power)) magic damage in a larger area, Knocking Up enemies hit for 1 second, and unleashing a massive shockwave that deals (135/225/315 + (67.5% Ability Power)) magic damage to champions and Epic Monsters and Slows all enemies hit by 50% for 1 second. Stardust collected towards The Skies Descend: ?/75.

spells.name: Spirit Abjuration
spells.summary: Aurora's spells and attacks exorcise spirits from the enemies she damages. Exorcised spirits follow Aurora around and heal her.
spells.text: Damaging an enemy 3 times with Abilities or Attacks exorcises them, dealing (1% + (2.7% per 100 Ability Power)) max Health magic damage and, if the enemy is a champion, frees a spirit that follows Aurora for 4 seconds, restoring her Health for ((3 ~ 20) + (2% Ability Power)) every second.

spells.name: Twofold Hex
spells.summary: Aurora sends out a missile that curses any enemies it hits. She can then recast the ability to draw active curses back toward herself, damaging foes who are hit along the way.
spells.text: Fire cursed energy in a direction, dealing (45/70/95/120/145 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies and cursing them for 3.5 seconds. Recast: End the curse, drawing back part of the enemy's spirit to Aurora, dealing up to (67.5/105/142.5/180/217.5 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies passed through based on their missing Health. Damage beyond the first hit is reduced to 20%. If the duration runs out, Aurora will automatically Recast the Ability. Recast deals 40% damage to minions and monsters.

spells.name: Across the Veil
spells.summary: Aurora leaps in a direction of her choosing, entering the spirit realm upon landing, becoming invisible, and gaining Move Speed for a short duration of time.
spells.text: Hop in a direction. Upon landing, enter the spirit realm, becoming Invisible for 1/1.15/1.3/1.45/1.6 seconds and entering Realm Hopper, gaining 20/25/30/35/40% Move Speed. Scoring a takedown on an enemy champion resets this Ability's Cooldown.

spells.name: The Weirding
spells.summary: Aurora converges the realms, sending out a blast of spirit magic that damages and slows enemies before Aurora hops backward to safety.
spells.text: Converge the realms, sending out a blast of spirit magic dealing (80/120/160/200/240 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies in the area and Slowing them by 80% decaying over 1 second. Aurora hops backwards a short distance after casting.

spells.name: Between Worlds
spells.summary: Aurora leaps in a direction of her choosing, releasing a shockwave that damages and slows any enemies it hits. Afterward, she creates an area that slows enemies within it and allows Aurora to teleport from one side of the area to the other.
spells.text: Leap in a direction. Upon landing, Aurora converges the realms, sending out a pulse of spirit energy that deals (175/275/375 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slows enemies hit by 30% for 2 seconds. The area of convergence stays active for 3/3.5/4 seconds, granting Aurora Realm Hopper for 3.5/4.25/5 seconds, allowing her to jump from one edge of the area to another. Enemies attempting to enter or leave the area are Slowed by 50% for 1.5/1.75/2 seconds. Aurora can Recast this Ability to end the effect early.

spells.name: Shurima's Legacy
spells.summary: Azir can summon the Disc of the Sun from the ruins of allied or enemy turrets.
spells.text: Azir can summon the Sun Disc from the rubble of a turret. The Sun Disc deals ((230 ~ 410) + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage and has (30 ~ 90) Armor and Magic Resist but disintegrates over 45 seconds.

spells.name: Conquering Sands
spells.summary: Azir sends all Sand Soldiers towards a location. Sand Soldiers deal magic damage to enemies they pass through and apply a slow for 1 second.
spells.text: Azir orders all Sand Soldiers to an area, dealing (75/95/115/135/155 + (35/40/45/50/55% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies they pass through and Slowing them by 25% for 1 second. Enemies hit by multiple Sand Soldiers will not take additional damage.

spells.name: Arise!
spells.summary: Azir summons a Sand Soldier to attack nearby targets for him, replacing his basic attack against targets within the soldier's range. Their attacks deal magic damage to enemies in a line.
spells.text: Azir summons a Sand Soldier for 10 seconds. When Azir Attacks an enemy near a Sand Soldier, he instead orders the soldiers to stab, dealing (50/65/80/95/110 + (0 ~ 72) + (35/42.5/50/57.5/65% Ability Power)) magic damage in their direction. This Ability has 2 charges. Sand Soldiers apply On-hits at 50% damage once per attack to Azir's primary target. Sand Soldiers that strike the same targets deal 25% damage after the first. Sand Soldiers deal (20% ~ 100%)damage to enemies that are not Azir's Attack target. Sand Soldiers expire twice as fast when near an enemy turret.

spells.name: Shifting Sands
spells.summary: Azir shields himself briefly and dashes to one of his Sand Soldiers, damaging enemies. If he hits an enemy champion, he instantly readies a new Sand Soldier for deployment and halts his dash.
spells.text: Azir grants himself (70/110/150/190/230 + (60% Ability Power)) Shield for 1.5 seconds and dashes to one of his Sand Soldiers, dealing (70/110/150/190/230 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies he passes through. If Azir hits an enemy champion, he stops and gains a Sand Soldier charge.

spells.name: Emperor's Divide
spells.summary: Azir summons a wall of soldiers which charge forward, knocking back and damaging enemies.
spells.text: Azir summons a wall of armored soldiers that charges forward, Knocking Back enemies and dealing (200/400/600 + (75% Ability Power)) magic damage. The soldiers remain, blocking enemy paths for 5 seconds.

spells.name: Traveler's Call
spells.summary: Meeps: Bard attracts lesser spirits that assist with his basic attacks to deal extra magic damage. When Bard has collected enough Chimes, his meeps will also deal damage in an area and slow enemies hit. Chimes: Ancient chimes randomly appear for Bard to collect. These grant experience, restore mana, and provide out of combat Move Speed.
spells.text: Bard attracts Chimes randomly around the map. When Bard moves near a Chime he collects it, gaining 24% Move Speed (stacking up to 10 times) while out of combat for 20 seconds, ? Experience, and restoring 12% max Mana. Bard attracts a Meep every ? seconds (max: ?). Bard's Attacks consume a Meep to deal an additional (30 + (40% Ability Power)) plus 6 per 5 Chimes magic damage, plus additional effects based on Chimes collected.

spells.name: Cosmic Binding
spells.summary: Bard fires a missile which will slow the first enemy struck, and continue onward. If it strikes a wall, it will stun the initial target; if it strikes another enemy, it will stun them both.
spells.text: Bard fires an energy bolt, dealing (80/120/160/200/240 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage to the first two enemies hit. The first target hit is Slowed by 60% for 1/1.2/1.4/1.6/1.8s. If the bolt hits a second enemy or a wall, any enemies hit are Stunned for 1/1.2/1.4/1.6/1.8s.

spells.name: Caretaker's Shrine
spells.summary: Reveals a Health shrine which powers up over a short time, disappearing after healing and speeding up the first ally that touches it.
spells.text: Bard creates a Health shrine that grants (20/22.5/25/27.5/30% + (6% per 100 Ability Power)) Move Speed decaying over 1.5 seconds and restores at least (25/50/75/100/125 + (40% Ability Power)) Health to the first ally to enter. The shrine grows to restore (50/87.5/125/162.5/200 + (70% Ability Power)) Health after existing for 5 seconds. Bard can have up to 3 shrines at once. If an enemy champion enters a shrine, it is destroyed. This ability has 2 charges.

spells.name: Magical Journey
spells.summary: Bard opens a portal in nearby terrain. Allies and enemies alike can take a one-way trip through that terrain by moving into the portal.
spells.text: Bard opens a one-way portal through Terrain for 10 seconds. Any champion can enter the portal by moving onto it while near the entrance. Allies travel 33% faster than enemies.

spells.name: Tempered Fate
spells.summary: Bard sends spirit energy arcing to a location, putting all champions, minions, monsters, and turrets hit into stasis for a brief time.
spells.text: Bard hurls magical protective energy to an area, placing all units and structures hit into Stasis for 2.5 seconds. Units in Stasis cannot move or act, and are invulnerable and Untargetable.

spells.name: Death in Lavender
spells.summary: Bel'Veth gains permanent attack speed stacks after taking down large minions and monsters and champions. She also gains temporary bonus attack speed after using an ability.
spells.text: After using an Ability, Bel'Veth becomes Ghosted and gains (20% ~ 20%) Attack Speed for 3 seconds. Bel'veth gains 1 Lavender stack for large minion and monster takedowns and 2 Lavender stacks for champion and epic monster takedowns. Each stack permanently grants (0.1 ~ 1.8)Attack Speed. Total bonus Attack Speed: (0.1 ~ 1.8)

spells.name: Void Surge
spells.summary: Bel'Veth dashes in a chosen direction and damages all enemies she passes through.
spells.text: Bel'Veth dashes, dealing (12/14/16/18/20 + (105% Attack Damage)) physical damage to enemies she passes through. Each direction has an unique Cooldown of 16/15/14/13/12 seconds that scales down based on her Attack Speed. Applies On-Hit Effects to the first target hit. Each 1% Attack Speed is equivalent to 0.2 Ability Haste for this Ability's per-direction Cooldown. Bel'Veth does an additional 70 physical damage to monsters.

spells.name: Above and Below
spells.summary: Bel'Veth slams her tail to the ground, damaging, knocking up, and slowing her enemies.
spells.text: Bel'Veth slams her tail, dealing (80/140/200/260/320 + (150% bonus Ability Power)) magic damage, Knocking Up foes for 0.6/0.7/0.8/0.9/1 seconds, and Slowing them by 30% for 2 seconds. If a champion is hit, this refreshes the Cooldown of Void Surge in that direction.

spells.name: Royal Maelstrom
spells.summary: Bel'Veth roots herself in place, channeling a storm of slashes around her that targets the lowest-health enemy and grants her lifesteal and damage reduction.
spells.text: Bel'Veth channels and slashes around herself, gaining 20/30/40/50/60% Damage Reduction, 20/25/30/35/40% Life Steal, and Attacking (6 + (240% bonus Attack Speed)) times over 1.5 seconds with the number of Attacks increasing based on her Attack Speed. Each Attack strikes the lowest-health enemy, dealing (10/12/14/16/18 + (12% Attack Damage)) to (20/24/28/32/36 + (24% Attack Damage)) physical damage based on the target's missing Health. Using another Ability or Recasting ends this Ability early. Attacks from this Ability deal 200% damage to monsters and apply On-Hit Effects at 12% to 24% effectiveness based on the target's missing Health.

spells.name: Endless Banquet
spells.summary: Bel'Veth consumes Void coral remnants, transforming into her true form and increasing her max health, attack range, and attack speed. Consuming the Void coral remnants of a Void epic monster will grant her the power to summon Void remora.
spells.text: Passive: Attacks deal an additional (2/4/6 + (3% bonus Attack Damage)) true damage, stacking infinitely. Takedowns against champions and epic monsters leave behind a piece of Void Coral. Active: Bel'Veth consumes a Void Coral, gaining 1 Lavender stack and activating her true form. Void Coral from void epic monsters causes minions that die nearby to become Void Remora. While casting, Bel'Veth Slows nearby enemies before exploding, dealing (150/200/250 + (150% Ability Power)) + 20% missing-Health true damage. In her true form, Bel'Veth gains (100/250/400 + (150% bonus Attack Damage) + (150% Ability Power)) max Health, 25/75/125 Attack range, 6/13/20% Total Attack Speed, and Void Surge can pass through walls. True form lasts 45 seconds, increased to 90 seconds at 40 Lavender stacks. At 80 Lavender stacks, true form lasts until death. Void Remora count as lane minions with 20/45/70% Health and 110% Attack Damage. The applied Slow ramps up to 99% while Bel'Veth consumes Void Coral. The passive deals a maximum of (16/32/48 + (24% bonus Attack Damage)) true damage to epic monsters. While in true form, consuming Void Coral renews the form's duration and restores 100/250/400 Health.

spells.name: Mana Barrier
spells.summary: Blitzcrank gains a shield based on their mana when dropping to low health.
spells.text: When Blitzcrank falls below 30% Health, they gain (35% Mana) Shield for 10 seconds.

spells.name: Rocket Grab
spells.summary: Blitzcrank fires their right hand to grab an opponent on its path, dealing damage and dragging it back to them.
spells.text: Blitzcrank fires their right hand, Pulling the first enemy hit towards them and dealing (110/160/210/260/310 + (120% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Overdrive
spells.summary: Blitzcrank super charges themself to get dramatically increased Move and Attack Speed. They are temporarily slowed after the effect ends.
spells.text: Blitzcrank supercharges themself, gaining 60/65/70/75/80% decaying Move Speed and 30/40/50/60/70% Attack Speed for 5 seconds. Afterwards, Blitzcrank is Slowed by 30% for 1.5 seconds. Move Speed decays to 10% over 2.5 seconds

spells.name: Power Fist
spells.summary: Blitzcrank charges up their fist to make the next attack deal double damage and pop their target up in the air.
spells.text: Blitzcrank charges up their fist, causing their next Attack to Knock Up for 1 second(s) and deal ((200% Attack Damage) + (25% Ability Power)) physical damage.

spells.name: Static Field
spells.summary: Enemies attacked by Blitzcrank are marked and take lightning damage after 1 second. Additionally, Blitzcrank can activate this ability to remove nearby enemies' shields, damage them, and silence them briefly.
spells.text: Passive: While this ability is available, lightning charges Blitzcrank's fists, marking those Attacked. After 1 second, they are shocked for (50/100/150 + (30/40/50% Ability Power) + (2% Mana)) magic damage. Active: Blitzcrank overcharges, dealing (275/400/525 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage and Silencing nearby enemies for 0.5 seconds. Their shields are also destroyed. Does not break shields on monsters.

spells.name: Blaze
spells.summary: Brand's spells light his targets ablaze, dealing damage over 4 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. If Brand kills an enemy while it is ablaze he regains mana. When Blaze reaches max stacks on a Champion or large monster, it becomes unstable. It detonates in 2 seconds, applying spell effects and dealing massive damage in an area around the victim.
spells.text: Brand's Abilities light his targets Ablaze, dealing 2% max Health magic damage over 4 seconds. If Brand kills a unit that is Ablaze, he regains 39.983 mana. Blaze can stack up to 3 times. When a champion or large jungle monster reaches 3 stacks, the Blaze will detonate after 2 seconds, dealing ((6% ~ 12%) + (2% per 100 Ability Power)) max Health magic damage to surrounding enemies.

spells.name: Sear
spells.summary: Brand launches a ball of fire forward that deals magic damage. If the target is ablaze, Sear will stun the target.
spells.text: Brand launches a fireball that deals (70/100/130/160/190 + (65% Ability Power)) magic damage to the first enemy hit. If the target is Ablaze, they will be Stunned for 1.75 seconds.

spells.name: Pillar of Flame
spells.summary: After a short delay, Brand creates a Pillar of Flame at a target area, dealing magic damage to enemy units within the area. Units that are ablaze take an additional 25% damage.
spells.text: Brand creates a pillar of pure fire, dealing (75/120/165/210/255 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage. Units that are Ablaze take (93.75/150/206.25/262.5/318.75 + (87.5% Ability Power)) damage instead.

spells.name: Conflagration
spells.summary: Brand conjures a powerful blast at his target that spreads to nearby enemies, dealing magic damage. If the target is ablaze, Conflagration's spread is doubled.
spells.text: Brand conjures a powerful blast at his target, dealing (55/80/105/130/155 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage to surrounding units. If the target is Ablaze, the spread range is doubled.

spells.name: Pyroclasm
spells.summary: Brand unleashes a devastating torrent of fire that bounces up to 5 times off of Brand and nearby enemies, dealing magic damage to enemies each time bounce. Bounces prioritize stacking Blaze to max on Champions. If a target is ablaze, Pyroclasm will briefly slow them.
spells.text: Brand unleashes a devastating torrent of fire that can bounce to Brand or another enemy up to 5 times, dealing (100/175/250 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies each bounce. Bounces prioritize stacking Blaze to max on champions. If the target is Ablaze, they are briefly Slowed by 30/45/60%.

spells.name: Concussive Blows
spells.summary: Braum's basic attacks apply Concussive Blows. Once the first stack is applied, ally basic attacks also stack Concussive Blows. Upon reaching 4 stacks, the target is stunned and takes magic damage. For the next few seconds they cannot receive new stacks, but take bonus magic damage from Braum's attacks.
spells.text: Braum's Attacks apply Concussive Blows for 4 seconds. Enemies with Concussive Blows gain additional stacks from any ally's Attacks. At 4 stacks, the target is Stunned for 1.75 seconds and takes (16 ~ 186) magic damage. For the next 4 seconds they don't receive stacks, but take an additional (6.4 ~ 74.4) magic damage from Braum's Attacks.

spells.name: Winter's Bite
spells.summary: Braum propels freezing ice from his shield, slowing and dealing magic damage. Applies a stack of Concussive Blows.
spells.text: Braum propels freezing ice from his shield, dealing (75/120/165/210/255 + (2.5% Health)) magic damage to the first enemy hit and Slowing them by 70% decaying over 2 seconds. Applies a stack of Concussive Blows.

spells.name: Stand Behind Me
spells.summary: Braum leaps to a target allied champion or minion. On arrival, Braum and the ally gain Armor and Magic Resist for a few seconds.
spells.text: Braum leaps to an allied champion or minion. On arrival, Braum grants the target (20/25/30/35/40 + (12% bonus Armor)) Armor and (20/25/30/35/40 + (12% bonus Magic Resist)) Magic Resist for 3 seconds. Braum grants himself (20/25/30/35/40 + (36% bonus Armor)) Armor and (20/25/30/35/40 + (36% bonus Magic Resist)) Magic Resist for the same duration.

spells.name: Unbreakable
spells.summary: Braum raises his shield in a direction for several seconds, intercepting all projectiles causing them to hit him and be destroyed. He negates the damage of the first attack completely and reduces the damage of all subsequent attacks from this direction.
spells.text: Braum raises his shield for 3/3.25/3.5/3.75/4 seconds, intercepting enemy missiles from the chosen direction, causing them to hit Braum and then be destroyed. The first missile Braum blocks deals no damage, and subsequent projectiles deal 35/40/45/50/55% reduced damage. Braum gains 10% Move Speed while his shield is raised.

spells.name: Glacial Fissure
spells.summary: Braum slams the ground, knocking up enemies nearby and in a line in front of him. A fissure is left along the line that slows enemies.
spells.text: Braum slams the ground sending forth a fissure that Knocks Up enemies in its path and nearby Braum, and deals (150/250/350 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. The first target hit is Knocked Up for between 0.6 and 1/1.5/2 seconds, increasing with distance from Braum. All others hit are Knocked Up for 0.6 seconds. The fissure also creates a zone for 4 seconds, that Slows by 40/50/60%.

spells.name: Crimson Curse
spells.summary: Briar's attacks and abilities apply a stacking bleed that heals her for a portion of the damage it deals. Perpetually hungry, she gains increased healing based on her missing Health, but lacks innate Health Regeneration.
spells.text: Briar's Attacks and Abilities apply a bleed for 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. The bleed deals ((10 ~ 50) + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) to ((20 ~ 100) + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage based on stacks, and Heals Briar for 25% of the pre-mitigation damage. Briar gains up to (40 + (2.5% bonus Health)) increased Healing based on her missing Health. She has no Base Health Regeneration and her Abilities cost 5% current Health to cast.

spells.name: Head Rush
spells.summary: Briar leaps to a unit and hits enemies with The Heel Wheel (of Pain), stunning them and breaking their Armor.
spells.text: Briar leaps to a target, Stunning it for 0.85 seconds, dealing (60/85/110/135/160 + (60% Ability Power) + (80% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and reducing 10/12.5/15/17.5/20% Armor and Magic Resist for 5 seconds. Briar will stop prioritizing champions if she casts this Ability on a minion or monster during Blood Frenzy. This Ability applies On-Hit effects.

spells.name: Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack
spells.summary: Briar leaps forward and shatters her pillory, entering a Blood Frenzy that causes her to relentlessly pursue the nearest enemy (prioritizing champions). While frenzied, she gains increased Attack Speed and Move Speed, and her attacks deal damage in an area around her target. Briar can reactivate this ability while frenzied to take a CHOMP out of her target on her next attack, dealing additional damage based on their missing Health, and healing Briar based on the damage she deals.
spells.text: Briar leaps and enters a Blood Frenzy, self-taunting to the nearest enemy for 5 seconds, prioritizing Champions. While in Blood Frenzy she gains 55/65/75/85/95% Attack Speed and 24/33/42/51/60% Move Speed, and her Attacks deal (60/70/80/90/100% Attack Damage) physical damage to enemies surrounding her target. Briar can Recast this Ability to empower her next Attack. It deals (5/20/35/50/65 + (105% Attack Damage)) + (9 + (2.5% bonus Attack Damage))missing Health physical damage and heals Briar for (5% Health) + 24/28/32/36/40% of the damage dealt. The bite deals 10% increased damage to minions and monsters (Max 400 missing health damage). This ability does not remove or replace Certain Death's empowered Blood Frenzy.

spells.name: Chilling Scream
spells.summary: Briar refocuses her mind, removing Blood Frenzy and channeling energy into a powerful scream that damages and slows enemies. While charging, she takes reduced damage and heals for a portion of her max Health. A fully charged scream knocks foes back, dealing additional damage and stunning those who collide with a wall.
spells.text: Begin Charging: Briar removes Blood Frenzy and gathers energy, gaining 35% damage reduction and restoring (10/11.5/13/14.5/16% Health) Health over 1 second. Release: Briar unleashes a scream that deals up to (80/115/150/185/220 + (100% bonus Attack Damage) + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage based on time charged, and Slows by 80% for 0.5 seconds. When fully charged, the scream Knocks Back enemies, dealing (140/215/290/365/440 + (240% bonus Attack Damage) + (240% Ability Power)) magic damage to those who hit a wall and Stunning them for 1.5 seconds.

spells.name: Certain Death
spells.summary: Briar kicks her pillory's hemolith gemstone, marking the first champion it hits as her prey. She then beelines straight to them, fearing other surrounding enemies upon arriving at her target, and enters a state of complete hemomania. She will pursue her prey until death, gaining the benefits of Blood Frenzy as well as additional Armor, Magic Resistance, Life Steal, and Move Speed.
spells.text: Briar kicks her pillory's hemolith gemstone and flies to the location of the first champion it hits, marking them as her prey. On landing, she deals (150/250/350 + (130% Ability Power)) magic damage to everything nearby and causes enemies who are not her prey to Flee for 1.5 seconds. She then enters an empowered Blood Frenzy and will pursue her prey until death. During this time, she gains (20% Attack Damage) Armor and Magic Resist, 10/15/20% Lifesteal, and an additional 10/20/30% Move Speed. When the hemolith hits it interrupts channeled Abilities. Briar has True Sight of her prey.

spells.name: Headshot
spells.summary: Every few basic attacks, or against a target she has trapped or netted, Caitlyn will fire a headshot dealing bonus damage that scales with her critical strike chance. On trapped or netted targets, Caitlyn's Headshot attack range is doubled.
spells.text: Every 5 Attacks, Caitlyn fires a Headshot. Attacks while in brush count as 2 for building towards a Headshot. Headshots deal an additional (100% Attack Damage) physical damage. They have double range against enemies affected by 90 Caliber Net and Yordle Snap Trap. Headshots against enemies hit by Yordle Snap Trap deal a further (35 + (30% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage.

spells.name: Piltover Peacemaker
spells.summary: Caitlyn revs up her rifle for 1 second to unleash a penetrating shot that deals physical damage (deals less damage to subsequent targets).
spells.text: Caitlyn revs her rifle to fire a piercing shot dealing (50/90/130/170/210 + (125/145/165/185/205% Attack Damage)) physical damage. After the bolt strikes the first target, it opens into a wider shot that deals (30/54/78/102/126 + (75/87/99/111/123% Attack Damage)) physical damage. Enemies revealed by Yordle Snap Trap always take full damage.

spells.name: Yordle Snap Trap
spells.summary: Caitlyn sets a trap that, when sprung, reveals and immobilizes the enemy champion for 1.5 seconds, granting Caitlyn an empowered Headshot.
spells.text: Caitlyn sets a trap that Roots the first champion that steps on it for 1.5 seconds and granting True Sight of them for 3 seconds. Traps last for 30/35/40/45/50 seconds, and 3/3/4/4/5 traps may be active at once. This Ability has 3/3/4/4/5 charges (26/22/18/14/10 second refresh). Targets rooted by this Ability take an additional (35/80/125/170/215 + (30% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage from Headshot.

spells.name: 90 Caliber Net
spells.summary: Caitlyn fires a heavy net to slow her target. The recoil knocks Caitlyn back.
spells.text: Caitlyn fires a net, pushing her backwards. The net Slows the first target hit by 50% for 1 second and deals (80/130/180/230/280 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Ace in the Hole
spells.summary: Caitlyn takes time to line up the perfect shot, dealing massive damage to a single target at a huge range. Enemy champions can intercept the bullet for their ally.
spells.text: Caitlyn takes a moment to channel and line up the perfect shot, then she fires, dealing (300/475/650 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage, but other enemy champions can intercept it. This Ability grants True Sight of the target during the channel. Damage scales with Caitlyn's Critical Strike chance and Critical Strike Damage.

spells.name: Adaptive Defenses
spells.summary: Basic attacks on champions grant a shield equal to a percentage of Camille's maximum health against their damage type (Physical or Magic) for a brief duration.
spells.text: Camille's Attacks on champions grant (20% Health) Shield against their damage type (Physical or Magic) for 2 seconds. This effect has a 8 second Cooldown.

spells.name: Precision Protocol
spells.summary: Camille's next attack deals bonus damage and grants bonus Move Speed. This spell can be recast for a short period of time, doing significantly increased bonus damage if Camille delays a period of time between the two attacks.
spells.text: Camille's next Attack deals an additional (20/25/30/35/40% Attack Damage) physical damage and grants her 25/30/35/40/45% Move Speed for 1 second. This ability can be Recast in the next 3.5 seconds. If the Recast Attack hits at least 1.5 seconds after the first, the bonus damage is increased to (40/50/60/70/80% Attack Damage) and (40% ~ 100%) of the Attack's damage is converted into true damage. This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.

spells.name: Tactical Sweep
spells.summary: Camille blasts in a cone after a delay, dealing damage. Enemies in the outer half are slowed and take extra damage, while also healing Camille.
spells.text: Camille winds up and slices, dealing (60/85/110/135/160 + (60% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. Enemies hit by the outer half are Slowed by 80% decaying over 2 seconds, and they take an additional (7/7.5/8/8.5/9% + (2.5% per 100 bonus Attack Damage)) max Health physical damage. Camille restores 100% of the bonus damage dealt to champions as Health. This Ability does 50% less damage to non-epic jungle monsters. Max health damage is capped at 300 against jungle monsters.

spells.name: Hookshot
spells.summary: Camille pulls herself to a wall, leaping off and knocking up enemy champions upon landing.
spells.text: Camille fires a hookshot that attaches to terrain, pulling her to it for 1 second and allowing this Ability to be Recast. Recast: Camille dashes from the wall, colliding with the first enemy champion hit. Upon landing, she gains 40/45/50/55/60% Attack Speed for 5 seconds, deals (60/90/120/150/180 + (75% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to nearby enemies, and Stuns enemy champions for 0.75 seconds. Dashes towards enemy champions travel twice as far.

spells.name: The Hextech Ultimatum
spells.summary: Camille dashes to target champion, anchoring them to the area. She also deals bonus magic damage to the target with her basic attacks.
spells.text: Camille briefly becomes Untargetable and leaps onto an enemy champion, interrupting channels and locking them into an area they cannot escape by any means for 2.5/3.25/4 seconds. Other nearby enemies are Knocked Away. Her Attacks against the trapped enemy deal an additional 4/6/8% current Health magic damage. This Ability ends if Camille leaves the area.

spells.name: Serpentine Grace
spells.summary: All Move Speed bonuses are more effective on Cassiopeia.
spells.text: Cassiopeia increases the effectiveness of all Move Speed bonuses by 5%.

spells.name: Noxious Blast
spells.summary: Cassiopeia blasts an area with Poison after a brief delay, granting her increased Move Speed if she hits an enemy champion.
spells.text: Cassiopeia blasts noxious gas, Poisoning enemies and dealing (65/100/135/170/205 + (75% Ability Power)) magic damage over 3 seconds. Hitting a champion grants Cassiopeia 30/35/40/45/50% Move Speed decaying over 3 seconds.

spells.name: Miasma
spells.summary: Cassiopeia releases several clouds of poison, slowing, grounding, and lightly damaging enemies that pass through them. Grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities.
spells.text: Cassiopeia spews venom, leaving toxic clouds for 5 seconds. Enemies in the clouds take (20/25/30/35/40 + (10% Ability Power)) magic damage per second, are Poisoned, Grounded, and Slowed by 40/50/60/70/80%.

spells.name: Twin Fang
spells.summary: Cassiopeia lets loose an attack that deals increased damage to Poisoned targets and heals her for a percentage of the damage dealt. If the target dies from this attack, Cassiopeia regains Mana.
spells.text: Cassiopeia launches deadly fangs, dealing (50 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage. If the enemy is Poisoned, they take an additional (20/45/70/95/120 + (45% Ability Power)) magic damage and Cassiopeia restores (10/11.5/13/14.5/16% Ability Power) Health, reduced to (2.5/2.875/3.25/3.625/4% Ability Power) Health against lane minions and small monsters. If this kills the target, Cassiopeia restores 40 Mana.

spells.name: Petrifying Gaze
spells.summary: Cassiopeia releases a swirl of magical energy from her eyes, stunning any enemies in front of her that are facing her and slowing any others with their back turned.
spells.text: Cassiopeia unleashes a petrifying gaze, dealing (125/225/325 + (75% Ability Power)) magic damage and Stunning enemies facing her for 2 seconds. Enemies facing away are Slowed by 40% decaying over the same duration instead.

spells.name: Carnivore
spells.summary: Whenever Cho'Gath kills a unit, he recovers Health and Mana. The values restored increase with Cho'Gath's level.
spells.text: Killing an enemy restores 18 Health and 4.72 Mana.

spells.name: Rupture
spells.summary: Ruptures the ground at target location, popping enemy units into the air, dealing damage and slowing them.
spells.text: Cho'Gath ruptures the ground, Knocking Up enemies for 1 second, dealing (80/135/190/245/300 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage, and Slowing them by 60% for 1.5 seconds.

spells.name: Feral Scream
spells.summary: Cho'Gath unleashes a terrible scream at enemies in a cone, dealing magic damage and Silencing enemies for a few seconds.
spells.text: Cho'Gath roars, Silencing enemies for 1.6/1.7/1.8/1.9/2 seconds and dealing (80/130/180/230/280 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Vorpal Spikes
spells.summary: Cho'Gath's attacks release deadly spikes, dealing damage and slowing all enemy units in front of him.
spells.text: Cho'Gath's next 3 Attacks launch spikes that deal (30/50/70/90/110 + (30% Ability Power)) plus 3/3.35/3.7/4.05/4.4% of the target's max Health magic damage and Slow by 30/35/40/45/50%, decaying over 1.5 seconds. Feast stacks increase the width of the spikes and the max Health damage by 0.5% per stack. Percent Health damage against monsters is replaced with 80/110/140/170/200.

spells.name: Feast
spells.summary: Devours an enemy unit, dealing a high amount of true damage. If the target is killed, Cho'Gath grows, gaining maximum Health.
spells.text: Cho'Gath ravenously feeds on an enemy, dealing (300/475/650 + (50% Ability Power) + (10% bonus Health)) true damage to champions or (1200 + (50% Ability Power) + (10% bonus Health)) to minions or jungle monsters. If this kills the target, Cho'Gath gains a stack, which causes him to grow in size and gain 80/120/160 max Health. Only 6 stacks can be gained from minions and non-epic jungle monsters. Current minion and non-epic jungle monster stacks: ?/6 Cho'Gath gains bonus attack and Feast cast range based upon his stacks: 4.7/6.2/7.7 Attack Range per stack (max 75). 2.5 Cast Range per stack (max 25).

spells.name: Hextech Munitions
spells.summary: A percentage of Corki's basic attack damage is dealt as bonus true damage.
spells.text: Corki's Attacks and Spellblades deal 20% bonus true damage. Attacks: (20% Attack Damage). Critical Strikes: (20% Attack Damage) × (100% Critical Strike Damage).

spells.name: Phosphorus Bomb
spells.summary: Corki fires a flash bomb at a target location, dealing magic damage to enemies in the area. This attack additionally reveals units in the area for a duration.
spells.text: Corki lobs a bomb, dealing (60/105/150/195/240 + (125% bonus Attack Damage) + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage. The area and champions hit are revealed for 6 seconds.

spells.name: Valkyrie
spells.summary: Corki flies a short distance, dropping bombs that create a trail of fire that damages opponents who remain in it.
spells.text: Corki flies over and scorches a path, burning it for 2.5 seconds. Enemies in the fire take up to (150/225/300/375/450 + (150% Ability Power) + (200% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage over the duration.

spells.name: Gatling Gun
spells.summary: Corki's gatling gun rapidly fires in a cone in front of him, dealing damage and reducing enemy Armor and Magic Resist.
spells.text: Corki fires a gatling gun in front of him, dealing (80/130/180/230/280 + (240% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage over 4 seconds and shredding up to 12/14/16/18/20 Armor and Magic Resist. The shred lingers for 2 seconds after being hit.

spells.name: Missile Barrage
spells.summary: Corki fires a missile toward his target location that explodes on impact, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Corki stores missiles over time, up to a maximum. Every 3rd missile fired will be a Big One, dealing extra damage.
spells.text: Corki fires a missile that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing (90/170/250 + (85% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to surrounding enemies. Every third missile instead deals (180/340/500 + (170% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. This Ability has up to 4 charges. Basic attacks against champions reduce the time between charges by (2 + (400% Critical Strike Chance)) seconds on hit.

spells.name: Hemorrhage
spells.summary: Darius' attacks and damaging abilities cause enemies to bleed for physical damage over 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Darius enrages and gains massive Attack Damage when his target reaches max stacks.
spells.text: Darius' Attacks and damaging Abilities cause the target to Hemorrhage, dealing ((13 ~ 30) + (30% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage over 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. When an enemy reaches max stacks or is killed by Noxian Guillotine, Darius gains an additional (30 ~ 185) Attack Damage and applies 5 Hemorrhage stacks on all Attack or damaging Ability hits for 5 seconds.

spells.name: Decimate
spells.summary: Darius winds up and swings his axe in a wide circle. Enemies struck by the blade take more damage than those struck by the handle. Darius heals based on enemy champions and large monsters hit by the blade.
spells.text: Darius hefts his axe then swings it around, dealing (50/80/110/140/170 + (100/110/120/130/140% Attack Damage)) physical damage with the edge and (17.5/28/38.5/49/59.5 + (35/38.5/42/45.5/49% Attack Damage)) damage with the handle. Enemies hit with the handle do not take a Hemorrhage stack. Darius restores 17% missing Health per enemy champion and large jungle monster hit with the edge, up to a max of 51%.

spells.name: Crippling Strike
spells.summary: Darius's next attack strikes an enemy's crucial artery. As they bleed out, their Move Speed is slowed.
spells.text: Darius' next Attack deals (140/145/150/155/160% Attack Damage) physical damage and Slows by 90% for 1 second. This Ability refunds its Mana cost and reduces its Cooldown by 50% if it kills the target. This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.

spells.name: Apprehend
spells.summary: Darius hones his axe, passively causing his physical damage to ignore a percentage of his target's Armor. When activated, Darius sweeps up his enemies with his axe's hook and pulls them to him.
spells.text: Passive: Darius gains 20/25/30/35/40% Armor Penetration. Active: Darius hooks with his axe, Pulling, and Knocking Up and Slowing by 40% for 1 second.

spells.name: Noxian Guillotine
spells.summary: Darius leaps to an enemy champion and strikes a lethal blow, dealing true damage. This damage is increased for each stack of Hemorrhage on the target. If Noxian Guillotine is a killing blow, its cooldown is refreshed for a brief duration.
spells.text: Darius leaps to an enemy and strikes a lethal blow, dealing (125/250/375 + (75% bonus Attack Damage)) true damage. For each Hemorrhage on the target, this Ability deals an additional 20% damage, up to a max of (250/500/750 + (150% bonus Attack Damage)) damage. If this kills the target, Darius may Recast this Ability once within 20 seconds. At rank 3, this Ability has no Mana cost and kills refresh the Cooldown completely.

spells.name: Moonsilver Blade
spells.summary: Every third strike cleaves nearby enemies for an additional magic damage. After casting a spell, Diana gains Attack Speed for 5 seconds.
spells.text: Diana gains (15% ~ 35%) Attack Speed, increased to (45% ~ 105%) for 5 seconds after using an Ability. Every third Attack cleaves nearby enemies for an additional ((20 ~ 195) + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Crescent Strike
spells.summary: Unleashes a bolt of lunar energy in an arc dealing magic damage. Afflicts enemies struck with Moonlight, revealing them if they are not stealthed for 3 seconds.
spells.text: Diana unleashes an arc of lunar energy, dealing (70/105/140/175/210 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage and marking with Moonlight for 3 seconds. Moonlight reveals enemies that are not stealthed.

spells.name: Pale Cascade
spells.summary: Diana creates three orbiting spheres that detonate on contact with enemies to deal damage in an area. She also gains a temporary shield that absorbs damage. If her third sphere detonates, the shield gains additional strength.
spells.text: Diana creates three orbiting spheres for 5 seconds that explode on contact, each dealing (20/32/44/56/68 + (18% Ability Power)) magic damage, up to a max of (60/96/132/168/204 + (54% Ability Power)) damage. Diana also gains (45/60/75/90/105 + (30% Ability Power) + (11% bonus Health)) Shield for the same duration. When the last sphere detonates, she gains an additional (45/60/75/90/105 + (30% Ability Power) + (11% bonus Health)) Shield and refreshes the duration.

spells.name: Lunar Rush
spells.summary: Becomes the living embodiment of the vengeful moon, dashing to an enemy and dealing magic damage. Lunar Rush has no cooldown when used to dash to an enemy afflicted with Moonlight. All other enemies will have the Moonlight debuff removed regardless of whether they were the target of Lunar Rush.
spells.text: Diana becomes as the vengeful moon, dashing to an enemy and dealing (50/70/90/110/130 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. If the target is afflicted with Moonlight, this Ability's Cooldown is refreshed.

spells.name: Moonfall
spells.summary: Diana reveals and draws in all nearby enemies and slows them. If Diana pulls in one or more enemy champions, the moonlight crashes down onto her after a short delay, dealing magic damage in an area around her, increased for each target beyond the first pulled.
spells.text: Diana Pulls In, Slows by 40/50/60%, and reveals nearby enemies for 2 seconds. If Diana hits at least one enemy champion, she calls to the moon, dealing (200/300/400 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage plus (35/60/85 + (15% Ability Power)) for each champion pulled beyond the first, up to a max of an additional (175/300/425 + (75% Ability Power)) damage.

spells.name: Goes Where He Pleases
spells.summary: Dr. Mundo resists the first Immobilizing effect that hits him, instead losing Health and dropping a chemical cannister nearby. Dr. Mundo can pick it up by walking over it, restoring Health and reducing this Ability's Cooldown. Dr. Mundo also has significantly increased Health regeneration.
spells.text: Dr. Mundo resists the first Immobilizing effect that hits him, instead losing 4% current Health and dropping a chemical cannister nearby for 7 seconds. Moving over it reduces this Ability's Cooldown by 15 seconds and restores 4% max Health. Enemy champions moving over the cannister destroy it. Dr. Mundo regenerates (0.4% ~ 0.65%) max Health every 5 seconds.

spells.name: Infected Bonesaw
spells.summary: Dr. Mundo throws an infected bonesaw, dealing damage to the first enemy hit based on their current health and slowing them.
spells.text: Dr. Mundo hurls his bonesaw, dealing 20/22.5/25/27.5/30% current Health magic damage to the first enemy hit and Slowing them by 40% for 2 seconds.
