If the bonesaw hits a champion or monster, Dr. Mundo restores 50/60/70/80/90 Health. If it hits a non-champion or non-monster, Dr. Mundo instead restores 25/30/35/40/45 Health. Deals a minimum of 80/130/180/230/280 magic damage, and a maximum of 250/325/400/475/550 magic damage to jungle monsters.

spells.name: Heart Zapper
spells.summary: Dr. Mundo electrocutes himself, dealing persistent damage to nearby enemies and storing a portion of damage he takes. At the end of the duration or on Recast, Dr. Mundo deals a burst of damage to nearby enemies. If the burst hit an enemy, he heals a percentage of the stored damage.
spells.text: Dr. Mundo charges up a defibrilator, dealing 20/35/50/65/80 magic damage each second for up to 3 seconds to nearby enemies. Additionally he stores (80% ~ 95%) of damage taken for the first 0.75 seconds and 25% for the remaining duration as gray health and can Recast. Recast: Detonate the defibrilator, dealing (20/35/50/65/80 + (7% bonus Health)) magic damage to nearby enemies. If this hits at least one champion, Dr. Mundo restores 100% of gray health, otherwise he instead restores 50% of gray health.

spells.name: Blunt Force Trauma
spells.summary: Passive - Dr. Mundo gains bonus Attack Damage, increasing based on his max Health. Active - Dr. Mundo slams his “medical” bag into an enemy, dealing additional damage based on his missing Health. If the enemy dies they are swatted away, dealing damage to enemies they pass through.
spells.text: Passive: Dr Mundo gains (2/2.3/2.6/2.9/3.2% Health) Attack Damage. Active: Dr Mundo violently swings his "medical" bag, causing his next Attack to deal an additional (5/15/25/35/45 + (5% bonus Health)) physical damage, increased by up to 40% based on his missing Health. If the enemy is killed, Mundo swats them away, dealing (5/15/25/35/45 + (5% bonus Health)) physical damage to enemies they pass through. The bonuses from the passive reach their maximum at 70% missing Health. Deals 140% damage to minions. Deals 140% damage to jungle monsters.

spells.name: Maximum Dosage
spells.summary: Dr. Mundo pumps himself with chemicals, instantly healing a percent of his missing Health. He then gains Move Speed and regenerates a portion of his maximum Health over a long duration.
spells.text: Dr. Mundo pumps himself with chemicals, gaining 15/20/25% of his missing Health as max Health, 15/25/35% Move Speed, and regenerating 20/40/60% max Health over 10 seconds. At Rank 3, both healing effects are increased by an additional 5% per nearby enemy champion.

spells.name: League of Draven
spells.summary: Draven gains his fans' Adoration when he catches a Spinning Axe or kills a minion, monster, or tower. Killing enemy champions grants Draven bonus gold based on how much Adoration he has.
spells.text: Draven gains 1 stack whenever he kills a non-champion unit or turret, catches a Spinning Axe. Draven gains 25 gold plus 2 additional gold per stack upon killing a champion. Draven loses 50% of stacks upon death. Total Gold Earned: 1 Highest Reward: 1

spells.name: Spinning Axe
spells.summary: Draven's next attack will deal bonus physical damage. This axe will ricochet off the target high up into the air. If Draven catches it, he automatically readies another Spinning Axe. Draven can have two Spinning Axes at once.
spells.text: Draven readies a Spinning Axe, causing his next Attack to deal an additional (40/45/50/55/60 + (75/85/95/105/115% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and ricochet into the air. If Draven catches it, he readies another Spinning Axe. Draven can hold two Spinning Axes at once. Draven will drop any Spinning Axes if he does not attack for 6 seconds. Attacking a turret or structure will not cause Draven's Spinning Axes to richochet.

spells.name: Blood Rush
spells.summary: Draven gains increased Move Speed and Attack Speed. The Move Speed bonus decreases rapidly over its duration. Catching a Spinning Axe will refresh the cooldown of Blood Rush.
spells.text: Draven becomes Ghosted, gains 50/55/60/65/70% Move Speed decaying over 1.5 seconds and 20/25/30/35/40% Attack Speed for 3 seconds. When Draven catches a Spinning Axe, this Ability's Cooldown is refreshed. Ghosted units can pass through other units.

spells.name: Stand Aside
spells.summary: Draven throws his axes, dealing physical damage to targets hit and knocking them aside. Targets hit are slowed.
spells.text: Draven chucks a sideways axe that deals (75/110/145/180/215 + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage, Knocks Back, and Slows by 20/25/30/35/40% for 2 seconds.

spells.name: Whirling Death
spells.summary: Draven hurls two massive axes to deal physical damage to each unit struck. Whirling Death slowly reverses direction and returns to Draven after striking an enemy champion. Draven may also activate this ability while the axes are in flight to cause it to return early. Deals less damage for each unit hit and resets when the axes reverse direction. Executes enemies who have less health than Draven's number of Adoration stacks.
spells.text: Draven hurls two massive axes that deal (200/300/400 + (110/130/150% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. Upon hitting a champion or Recasting, they reverse direction and return to Draven. The axes deal 5% less damage for each enemy hit, down to a minimum of 50%. If Whirling Death would leave an enemy champion with less health than 100% of Draven's current League of Draven stacks (1), he will execute them. Damage falloff resets after reversing direction.

spells.name: Z-Drive Resonance
spells.summary: Every third attack or damaging spell on the same target deals bonus magic damage, and grants Ekko a burst of speed if the target is a champion.
spells.text: Every third Attack or damaging Ability on the same target deals an additional ((30 ~ 90) + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage. If the target is a champion, Ekko gains 80% Move Speed for 3 seconds. This effect can't trigger on the same enemy more than once every 4 seconds.

spells.name: Timewinder
spells.summary: Ekko throws a temporal grenade that expands into a time-distortion field upon hitting an enemy champion, slowing and damaging anyone caught inside. After a delay, the grenade rewinds back to Ekko, dealing damage on its return.
spells.text: Ekko throws a device dealing (80/95/110/125/140 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage. On hitting a champion or reaching the end of its range, it expands into a field that Slows enemies inside by 40/45/50/55/60%. After it expands, Ekko recalls it, dealing (40/65/90/115/140 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Parallel Convergence
spells.summary: Ekko's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage to low health enemies. He can cast Parallel Convergence to split the timeline, creating an anomaly after a few seconds that slows enemies caught inside. If Ekko enters the anomaly, he gains shielding and stuns enemies by suspending them in time.
spells.text: Passive: Ekko's Attacks against enemies below 30% Health deal (3% + (3% per 100 Ability Power)) missing Health magic damage. Active: Ekko launches a chronosphere lasting 1.5 seconds after a delay that Slows enemies inside by 40%. If Ekko enters the sphere, he detonates it, Stunning for 2.25 seconds and gaining (100/120/140/160/180 + (150% Ability Power)) Shield. Bonus Attack damage deals a min of 15 and a max of 150 damage against minions and monsters.

spells.name: Phase Dive
spells.summary: Ekko rolls evasively while charging up his Z-Drive. His next attack deals bonus damage and warps reality, teleporting him to his target.
spells.text: Ekko dashes and empowers his next Attack to have bonus range, teleport him to his target, and deal an additional (50/75/100/125/150 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage. Ekko can use any of his other Abilities during the dash.

spells.name: Chronobreak
spells.summary: Ekko shatters his timeline, becoming untargetable and rewinding to a more favorable point in time. He returns to whenever he was a few seconds ago, and heals for a percentage of the damage received in that duration. Enemies near his arrival zone take massive damage.
spells.text: Ekko turns back time, entering Stasis while teleporting to where he was 4 seconds ago and dealing (200/350/500 + (175% Ability Power)) magic damage to nearby enemies. In addition, Ekko restores (100/150/200 + (60% Ability Power)) Health, increased by 3% for each 1% Health he lost in last 4 seconds. Will detonate the chronosphere from Parallel Convergence [W] if Ekko passed through it. Units in Stasis cannot move or act, and are Invulnerable and Untargetable.

spells.name: Spider Queen
spells.summary: Human Form: When Elise's abilities hit an enemy, she gains a dormant Spiderling. Spider Form: Basic attacks deal bonus magic damage and restore health to Elise.
spells.text: Elise begins the game with a point in her Ultimate, allowing her to shapeshift between Human Form and Spider Form. Human Form: Elise's Ability hits grant her a dormant Spiderling, up to 2. Spider Form: Attacks deal an additional (14 + (15% Ability Power)) magic damage and restore (6 + (8% Ability Power)) Health.

spells.name: Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite
spells.summary: Human Form: Deals damage based upon how high the target's Health is. Spider Form: Lunges at an enemy and deals damage based upon how low their Health is.
spells.text: Human Form: Elise injects neurotoxin, dealing 40/70/100/130/160 plus (4% + (3% per 100 Ability Power)) current Health magic damage. Human Form and Spider Form percent Health damage is capped at (65/85/105/125/145 + (90% Ability Power)) against monsters.

spells.name: Volatile Spiderling / Skittering Frenzy
spells.summary: Human Form: Releases a venom-gorged Spiderling that explodes when it nears a target. Spider Form: Elise and her Spiderlings gain Attack Speed.
spells.text: Human Form: Elise summons an explosive spider that moves to a location and explodes when it nears an enemy or after 3 seconds. The spider deals (60/100/140/180/220 + (75% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Cocoon / Rappel
spells.summary: Human Form: Stuns the first enemy unit hit and reveals them if they are not stealthed. Spider Form: Elise and her Spiderlings ascend into the air and then descend upon target enemy. After descending on an enemy target, Elise's bonus damage and healing from Spider Queen is increased.
spells.text: Human Form: Elise fires a cocoon, Stunning and revealing the first enemy hit for 1.6/1.8/2/2.2/2.4 seconds.

spells.name: Spider Form
spells.summary: Transforms into a menacing spider, reducing her attack range in exchange for Move Speed, new abilities, and a Spiderling swarm that will attack her foes.
spells.text: Human Form: Elise transforms into a menacing spider, becoming melee, gaining access to Spider Form Abilities and summons all dormant Spiderlings.

spells.name: Demon Shade
spells.summary: When out of combat, Evelynn enters Demon Shade. Demon Shade heals Evelynn when she is low on health and grants Camouflage after level 6.
spells.text: Evelynn enshrouds herself in her Demon Shade after 4 seconds of not Attacking or using Abilities. Demon Shade restores (15 ~ 150) Health per second while below (250 + (250% Ability Power)) Health. From level 6 onward, it also grants Camouflage. Taking damage from champions or towers removes Demon Shade for 1.5 seconds.

spells.name: Hate Spike
spells.summary: Evelynn strikes out with her Lasher, dealing damage to the first unit hit. Then, Evelynn can shoot a line of spikes at nearby foes a few times.
spells.text: Evelynn strikes with her Lasher, dealing (25/30/35/40/45 + (25% Ability Power)) magic damage to the first enemy hit and causing Evelynn's next 3 Attacks or Abilities on that unit to deal an additional (15/25/35/45/55 + (25% Ability Power)) magic damage. Evelynn can Recast this Ability up to 3 times. Recast: Evelynn fires spikes through the nearest enemy, dealing (25/30/35/40/45 + (25% Ability Power)) magic damage to all enemies hit. The spikes prioritizes the target Evelynn is attacking.

spells.name: Allure
spells.summary: Evelynn curses her target, causing her next attack or spell after a delay to charm her target and reduce their magic resist.
spells.text: Evelynn marks a champion or monster for 5 seconds. If Evelynn hits the target with an Attack or Ability, she will expunge the mark, refund its cost, and Slow the target by 45% for 0.75 seconds. If the mark lasts at least 2.5 seconds, expunging it has extra effects:Against champions: Charms them for 1.25/1.5/1.75/2/2.25 second(s) and removes 35/37.5/40/42.5/45% Magic Resist for 4 seconds.Against monsters: Charms them for 3/3.25/3.5/3.75/4 seconds and deals (250/300/350/400/450 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. Using this Ability does not remove Evelynn from Demon Shade.

spells.name: Whiplash
spells.summary: Evelynn whips her target with her Lasher, dealing damage. She then gains Move Speed for a short duration.
spells.text: Evelynn whips an enemy, dealing 60/90/120/150/180 plus (3% + (1.5% per 100 Ability Power)) max Health magic damage. Evelynn gains 30/35/40/45/50% Move Speed for 2 seconds. Entering Demon Shade refreshes this Ability's cooldown and empowers it. When this Ability is empowered, Evelynn dashes to the target and deals 80/120/160/200/240 plus (4% + (2.5% per 100 Ability Power)) max Health magic damage to her target and everyone she passes through instead. This Ability applies On-Hit Effects to the targeted enemy.

spells.name: Last Caress
spells.summary: Evelynn briefly goes untargetable and decimates the area in front of her before warping backwards a long distance.
spells.text: Evelynn unleashes her demonic energy, dealing heavy damage, becoming Untargetable and teleporting backwards. She deals (125/250/375 + (75% Ability Power)) magic damage, increased to (300/600/900 + (180% Ability Power)) against enemies below 30% Health. Upon cast, set Demon Shade to a 1.25 second cooldown. Untargetable units won't be affected by enemy Attacks or Abilities unless they've already been hit by them.

spells.name: Rising Spell Force
spells.summary: Ezreal gains increasing Attack Speed each time he successfully hits a spell, stacking up to 5 times.
spells.text: Ezreal's Ability hits grant him 10% Attack Speed for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.

spells.name: Mystic Shot
spells.summary: Ezreal fires a damaging bolt of energy which reduces all of his cooldowns slightly if it strikes an enemy unit.
spells.text: Ezreal fires a bolt of energy, dealing (20/45/70/95/120 + (130% Attack Damage) + (40% Ability Power)) physical damage to the first enemy hit and reducing his Ability Cooldowns by 1.5 seconds. This Ability applies On-Hit effects.

spells.name: Essence Flux
spells.summary: Ezreal fires an orb that sticks to the first champion or objective hit. If Ezreal hits an enemy with the orb, it detonates and deals damage.
spells.text: Ezreal fires a magical orb that sticks to the first champion, structure, or epic jungle monster hit for 4 seconds. If Ezreal hits that target with an Attack or Ability, it detonates, dealing (80/135/190/245/300 + (100% bonus Attack Damage) + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage. Detonating with an Ability refunds the Mana cost of that Ability plus 60 Mana.

spells.name: Arcane Shift
spells.summary: Ezreal teleports to a target nearby location and fires a homing bolt which strikes the nearest enemy unit. Prioritizes enemies stuck with Essence Flux.
spells.text: Ezreal teleports then fires a bolt at the nearest enemy, dealing (80/130/180/230/280 + (60% bonus Attack Damage) + (75% Ability Power)) magic damage. The bolt prioritizes enemies affected by Essence Flux.

spells.name: Trueshot Barrage
spells.summary: Ezreal winds up before firing a powerful barrage of energy that deals massive damage to each unit it passes through (damage is reduced for minions and non-epic monsters).
spells.text: Ezreal fires a massive energy arc that deals (350/550/750 + (100% bonus Attack Damage) + (110% Ability Power)) magic damage. Damage to minions and non-epic jungle monsters is reduced to (150/225/300 + (100% bonus Attack Damage) + (110% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: A Harmless Scarecrow
spells.summary: Fiddlesticks' trinket is replaced by scarecrow effigies.
spells.text: Fiddlesticks' trinket is replaced by Scarecrow Effigies. When discovered by enemies, Effigies briefly impersonate Fiddlesticks. If Fiddlesticks does not move for 2 seconds, he will impersonate an Effigy. At level six Effigies reveal nearby wards for 6 seconds.

spells.name: Terrify
spells.summary: Fiddlesticks damaging enemies with spells while unseen or targeting an enemy with Terrify's activation strikes a target unit with fear, causing it to flee in terror for a duration.
spells.text: Passive: While unseen and out of combat or impersonating an Effigy, damaging an enemy with an ability Fears them for 1.2/1.4/1.6/1.8/2 second(s). Active: Fear an enemy for 1.2/1.4/1.6/1.8/2 second(s) and deal (4/4.5/5/5.5/6% + (3% per 100 Ability Power)) current Health magic damage. If the target has recently been Feared by Fiddlesticks, instead deal (8/9/10/11/12% + (6% per 100 Ability Power)) current Health magic damage. Deals a minimum of 40/60/80/100/120 magic damage, or 80/120/160/200/240 magic damage if the target has been recently Feared by Fiddlesticks. Deals a maximum of 400 magic damage to minions and jungle monsters.

spells.name: Bountiful Harvest
spells.summary: Fiddlesticks drains health from nearby enemies, dealing bonus execute damage at the end of the duration.
spells.text: Fiddlesticks channels and drains the souls of nearby enemies, dealing (60/90/120/150/180 + (45% Ability Power)) magic damage per second for 2 seconds, plus 12/14.5/17/19.5/22% missing Health magic damage at the end. Fiddlesticks restores 25/32.5/40/47.5/55% of damage as Health. If Fiddlesticks ends the channel without interruption, the remaining Cooldown is reduced by 60%. Healing based on pre-mitigation damage. Against monsters, this Ability deals 135% damage and heals 45% of damage done. Against minions, this Ability deals 50% damage and heals 15% of damage done.

spells.name: Reap
spells.summary: Fiddlesticks slashes an area with its scythe, slowing all enemies hit and silencing enemies hit in the center of the slash.
spells.text: Fiddlesticks unleashes dark magic, dealing (70/105/140/175/210 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing by 30/35/40/45/50% for 1.25 seconds. Enemies in the center are also Silenced for the duration.

spells.name: Crowstorm
spells.summary: A murder of crows flock wildly around Fiddlesticks, dealing damage per second to all enemy units in the area.
spells.text: Fiddlesticks channels for 1.5 seconds, then teleports and unleashes a murder of crows, dealing (750/1250/1750 + (250% Ability Power)) magic damage over 5 seconds.

spells.name: Duelist's Dance
spells.summary: Fiora has revealed a Vital on this Champion. If she hits the Vital, she restores Health and gains Move Speed.
spells.text: Fiora identifies Vitals on enemy champions. Hitting this Vital with an Attack or Ability deals an additional (3% + (4% per 100 bonus Attack Damage)) max Health true damage, grants Fiora 30% Move Speed decaying over 2 seconds, and restores (35 ~ 100) Health. Fiora reveals a new Vital after 15 seconds or after striking one.

spells.name: Lunge
spells.summary: Fiora lunges in a direction and stabs a nearby enemy, dealing physical damage and applying on-hit effects.
spells.text: Fiora lunges in a direction and stabs the closest enemy, ward, or structure, dealing (70/80/90/100/110 + (90/95/100/105/110% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. The strike will prioritize Vitals and enemies it will kill. If Fiora strikes an enemy, this Ability's Cooldown is reduced by 50%. The strike applies On-Hit Effects.

spells.name: Riposte
spells.summary: Fiora parries all incoming damage and disables for a short time, then stabs in a direction. This stab slows the first enemy champion hit, or stuns them if Fiora blocked an immobilizing effect with this ability.
spells.text: Fiora parries all incoming damage, disables, and negative effects for 0.75 seconds, then stabs. The stab deals (110/150/190/230/270 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage to the first champion hit and Slows Move Speed by 50% and Attack Speed by 25% for 2 seconds. If Fiora parries an Immobilizing effect, the stabbed enemy is Stunned rather than Slowed.

spells.name: Bladework
spells.summary: Fiora has increased attack speed for the next two attacks. The first attack slows the target, and the second attack will critically strike.
spells.text: Fiora gains 50/60/70/80/90% Attack Speed for her next two Attacks. The first Attack Slows by 30% for 1 second. The second Attack always critically strikes for 160/170/180/190/200% damage.

spells.name: Grand Challenge
spells.summary: Fiora reveals all four Vitals on an enemy champion and gains Move Speed while near them. If Fiora hits all four Vitals or if the target dies after she has hit at least one, Fiora and her allies in the area are healed over the next few seconds.
spells.text: Passive: Duelist's Dance Move Speed bonus is increased to 30/40/50%. Active: Fiora reveals all four Vitals on a champion for a max of (12% + (0.16% bonus Attack Damage)) max Health true damage and gains Duelist's Dance's Move Speed bonus while near the target. If Fiora strikes all four Vitals within 8 seconds or if the target dies after she has hit at least one, Fiora restores (80/105/130 + (70% bonus Attack Damage)) Health per second to surrounding allied champions for 5 seconds.

spells.name: Nimble Fighter
spells.summary: Fizz can move through units and takes a flat amount of reduced damage from all sources
spells.text: Fizz is Ghosted and takes (4 + (1% Ability Power)) reduced damage from all sources.

spells.name: Urchin Strike
spells.summary: Fizz dashes through his target, dealing magic damage and applying on hit effects.
spells.text: Fizz dashes through an enemy, dealing (100% Attack Damage) physical damage plus (10/25/40/55/70 + (55% Ability Power)) magic damage. This Ability applies On-Hit effects.

spells.name: Seastone Trident
spells.summary: Fizz's attacks bleed his enemies, dealing magic damage over several seconds. Fizz can empower his next attack to deal bonus damage and empower his further attacks for a short time.
spells.text: Passive: Fizz's Attacks cause his enemies to bleed, dealing (30/45/60/75/90 + (25% Ability Power)) magic damage over 3 seconds. Active: Fizz's next Attack deals an additional (50/75/100/125/150 + (45% Ability Power)) magic damage. If this Attack kills its target, Fizz refunds 30/40/50/60/70 Mana and reduces the cooldown of this Ability to 1 second. If it does not kill, Fizz's Attacks deal an additional (20/25/30/35/40 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage for 5 seconds. Attacks deal 90 bonus damage to jungle monsters. Attacks deal 50% damage to structures.

spells.name: Playful / Trickster
spells.summary: Fizz hops into the air, landing gracefully upon his spear and becoming untargetable. From this position, Fizz can either slam the ground or choose to jump again before smashing back down.
spells.text: Fizz hops onto his trident, becoming Untargetable for 0.75 seconds, after which he deals (80/130/180/230/280 + (95% Ability Power)) magic damage to nearby enemies and Slows them by 40/45/50/55/60% for 2 seconds. Fizz can Recast this Ability while Untargetable to dash again, which ends the effect early, deals damage in a smaller area, and doesn't Slow.

spells.name: Chum the Waters
spells.summary: Fizz tosses a fish in a direction that attaches to any champion that touches it, slowing the target. After a short delay, a shark erupts from the ground, knocking up the target and knocking any nearby enemies aside. All enemies hit are dealt magic damage and slowed.
spells.text: Fizz launches a fish that attaches to the first champion hit. The victim is afflicted with True Sight and Slowed by between 40% to 80% based on how far the fish travelled before attaching. After 2 seconds a shark erupts on the target, Knocking Up the target with the fish for 1 second, Knocking Back everything else, and dealing between (180/300/420 + (60% Ability Power)) to (270/450/630 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage based on how far the fish travelled before attaching.

spells.name: Colossal Smash
spells.summary: Every few seconds, Galio's next basic attack deals bonus magic damage in an area.
spells.text: Galio's Attacks have increased attack speed and deal ((15 ~ 115) + (100% Attack Damage) + (40% Ability Power) + (60% bonus Magic Resist)) magic damage to surrounding enemies. This effect's cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds when Galio hits an enemy champion or epic monster with an ability, once per cast.

spells.name: Winds of War
spells.summary: Galio fires two windblasts that converge into a large tornado that deals damage over time.
spells.text: Galio fires two windblasts that deal (70/105/140/175/210 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage each. When the windblasts meet, they combine into a tornado that deals (8 + (4% Ability Power))max Health magic damage over 2 seconds. Percent Health damage deals a max of 200 damage to jungle monsters.

spells.name: Shield of Durand
spells.summary: Galio charges a defensive stance, moving slowly. Upon releasing the charge, Galio will taunt and damage nearby enemies.
spells.text: Passive: Galio gains a (7.5/9/10.5/12/13.5% Health) Magic Shield after not taking damage for (12 ~ 8) seconds. Begin Charging: Galio reduces incoming magic damage by (25/30/35/40/45% + (4% per 100 Ability Power) + (8% per 100 bonus Magic Resist) + (1% per 100 bonus Health)) and incoming physical damage by (12.5/15/17.5/20/22.5% + (2% per 100 Ability Power) + (4% per 100 bonus Magic Resist) + (0.5% per 100 bonus Health)) and Slows himself by 15%. Release: Galio Taunts enemy champions for between 0.5 to 1.5 seconds, deals between (20/30/40/50/60 + (30% Ability Power)) and (60/90/120/150/180 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage, and refreshes the damage reduction for 2 seconds. Taunt duration, damage, and range increase with charge time.

spells.name: Justice Punch
spells.summary: Galio will briefly step back and charge, knocking up the first enemy champion he encounters.
spells.text: Galio lunges forward with a mighty blow, Knocking Up for 0.75 seconds and dealing (100/135/170/205/240 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage to the first champion hit. Other enemies in the way take (80/108/136/164/192 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage. Galio's dash stops on hitting terrain.

spells.name: Hero's Entrance
spells.summary: Galio designates an ally's position as his landing spot, granting all allies in the area a magic shield. After a delay Galio smashes down location, knocking up nearby enemies.
spells.text: Galio designates an allied champion's position as his landing spot, granting all allied champions in the area Shield of Durand's passive Shield for 5 seconds. Galio then flies to his landing zone. When Galio lands, he Knocks Up for 0.75 seconds and deals (150/250/350 + (70% Ability Power) + (100% bonus Magic Resist)) magic damage.

spells.name: Trial by Fire
spells.summary: Every few seconds, Gangplank's melee strike will set his opponent on fire.
spells.text: Gangplank's melee Attacks ignite the target, dealing an additional ((50 ~ 250) + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) true damage over 2.5 seconds and granting Gangplank (15% ~ 30%) Move Speed for 2 seconds. Destroying a Powder Keg refreshes this Cooldown and grants Gangplank the same Move Speed.

spells.name: Parrrley
spells.summary: Shoots target, plundering Gold for each enemy unit killed.
spells.text: Gangplank fires a bullet dealing (10/40/70/100/130 + (100% Attack Damage)) physical damage. If this kills the target, Gangplank gains an additional 3/4/5/6/7 Gold and 4/5/6/7/8 Silver Serpents. Gangplank can spend Silver Serpents in the shop to upgrade Cannon Barrage. Gangplank fires a bullet dealing (10/40/70/100/130 + (100% Attack Damage)) physical damage. Against Champions, Gangplank earns 7% of the damage dealt as Gold and Silver Serpents. If this kills the target, Gangplank gains an additional 3/4/5/6/7 Gold and 4/5/6/7/8 Silver Serpents. Gangplank can spend Silver Serpents in the shop to upgrade Cannon Barrage. The shot applies On-Hit effects (other than Trial by Fire) and can critically strike for (10/40/70/100/130 + (100% Attack Damage)) × (100% Critical Strike Damage) physical damage.

spells.name: Remove Scurvy
spells.summary: Eats citrus to cure crowd control effects and restore Health.
spells.text: Gangplank consumes a large amount of citrus fruit, removing all Disabling effects and restoring (45/70/95/120/145 + (90% Ability Power)) plus 13% missing Health.

spells.name: Powder Keg
spells.summary: Gangplank uncovers a powder keg at target location. If he attacks it, it explodes, spreading the attack's damage to enemies in the area, slowing them.
spells.text: Gangplank places a powder keg that can be attacked by Gangplank and enemy champions for 25 seconds. When an enemy destroys it, the keg is defused. When Gangplank destroys it, it explodes, Slowing by 40/50/60/70/80% for 2 seconds and dealing the Attack's damage, ignoring 40% Armor. Champions take an additional 75/95/115/135/155 physical damage. Keg health decays every 0.5 seconds. Keg explosions detonate other kegs with overlapping blast zones, but don't deal damage to the same target more than once. Keg explosions triggered by Parrrley will grant the bonus gold for targets killed. Keg decay rate increases at level 7 and 13.

spells.name: Cannon Barrage
spells.summary: Gangplank signals his ship to bombard an area, slowing and damaging enemies.
spells.text: Gangplank signals his ship to fire 12 waves of cannonballs anywhere on the map over 8 seconds. Each wave Slows by 30% for 0.5 seconds and deals (40/70/100 + (10% Ability Power)) magic damage. Maximum damage: (480/840/1200 + (120% Ability Power)) This Ability can be upgraded in the shop via Parrrley. Fire at Will: Fires 6 additional waves of cannonballs. Death's Daughter: Fires a Mega-Cannonball that deals (120/210/300 + (30% Ability Power)) true damage and Slows by 75% for 1 second. Raise Morale: Allies inside Cannon Barrage gain 40% Move Speed for 2 seconds.

spells.name: Perseverance
spells.summary: If Garen has not recently been struck by damage or enemy abilities, he regenerates a percentage of his total health each second.
spells.text: Garen regenerates (150% ~ 250%) max Health every 5 seconds if he has not been damaged or hit with enemy Abilities in the last 8 seconds.

spells.name: Decisive Strike
spells.summary: Garen gains a burst of Move Speed, breaking free of all slows affecting him. His next attack strikes a vital area of his foe, dealing bonus damage and silencing them.
spells.text: Garen removes all Slowing effects on him and gains 35% Move Speed for 1.4/1.95/2.5/3.05/3.6 second(s). His next Attack Silences for 1.5 seconds and does (30/60/90/120/150 + (150% Attack Damage)) physical damage. The empowered Attack expires after 4.5 seconds. This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.

spells.name: Courage
spells.summary: Garen passively increases his Armor and Magic Resist by killing enemies. He may also activate this ability to give him a shield and tenacity for a brief moment followed by a lesser amount of damage reduction for a longer duration.
spells.text: Passive: Garen has 0.2 bonus Armor and 0.2 bonus Magic Resist. Killing units permanently grants 0.2 resists, up to a max of 30. Active: Garen steels his courage for 4 seconds, reducing incoming damage by 25/29/33/37/41%. He also gains (65/85/105/125/145 + (18% bonus Health)) Shield and 60% Tenacity for 0.75 seconds.

spells.name: Judgment
spells.summary: Garen rapidly spins his sword around his body, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies.
spells.text: Garen rapidly spins his sword for 3 seconds, dealing (4/7/10/13/16 + (40/43/46/49/52% Attack Damage)) physical damage 7 times over the duration. The nearest enemy takes 25% increased damage. Champions hit by 6 strikes lose 25% Armor for 6 seconds. Recast: Garen ends this Ability early. Gains one strike from every 25% Attack Speed from items and levels. Can critically strike for (4/7/10/13/16 + (40/43/46/49/52% Attack Damage)) × (0.7 + 30% Critical Strike Damage) physical damage.

spells.name: Demacian Justice
spells.summary: Garen calls upon the might of Demacia to attempt to execute an enemy champion.
spells.text: Garen calls upon the might of Demacia to slay his enemy, dealing 125/200/275 plus 25/30/35% missing Health true damage.

spells.name: Rage Gene
spells.summary: While in combat Gnar generates Rage. At maximum Rage his next ability will transform him into Mega Gnar, granting increased survivability and access to new spells.
spells.text: Gnar generates Rage by dealing and receiving damage. At max Rage his next Ability transforms him into Mega Gnar for 15 seconds. Mini Gnar: Gain (0 ~ 6) Move Speed, (5.5% ~ 99%) Attack Speed, and (0 ~ 100) Attack Range. Mega Gnar: Gain (100 ~ 831) max Health, (3.5 ~ 54.5) Armor, (3.5 ~ 63) Magic Resist, and (6 ~ 48.5) Attack Damage.

spells.name: Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss
spells.summary: Gnar throws a boomerang that damages and slows enemies it hits before returning to him. If he catches the boomerang its cooldown is reduced. Mega Gnar instead throws a boulder that stops on the first unit hit, damaging and slowing everything nearby. It can then be picked up to reduce the cooldown.
spells.text: Mini Gnar: Gnar throws a boomerang that deals (5/45/85/125/165 + (125% Attack Damage)) physical damage and Slows by 15/20/25/30/35% for 2 seconds. The boomerang returns after hitting an enemy, dealing reduced damage to subsequent targets. Each enemy can only be hit once. Catching the boomerang reduces its Cooldown by 40%. Deals 50% damage to enemies beyond the first.

spells.name: Hyper / Wallop
spells.summary: Gnar's attacks and spells hype him up, dealing bonus damage and granting him Move Speed. Mega Gnar is too enraged to be hyper and instead can rear up on his hind legs and smash down on the area in front of him, stunning enemies in an area.
spells.text: Mini Gnar Passive: Every third Attack or Ability on the same enemy deals an additional (0/10/20/30/40 + (100% Ability Power)) plus 6/8/10/12/14% max Health magic damage and grants 40/60/80/100/120% Move Speed decaying over 3 seconds. Gnar also gains the Move Speed when he leaves Mega Gnar form. Deals a max of 300 magic damage against jungle monsters.

spells.name: Hop / Crunch
spells.summary: Gnar leaps to a location and bounces off the head of any unit he lands on, traveling further. Mega Gnar is too large to bounce and instead lands with earth-shattering force, dealing damage in an area around him.
spells.text: Mini Gnar: Gnar leaps, gaining 40/45/50/55/60% Attack Speed for 6 seconds. If Gnar lands on a unit he will bounce off it, traveling further. Bouncing off an enemy deals (50/85/120/155/190 + (6% Health)) physical damage and briefly Slows by 80%.

spells.name: GNAR!
spells.summary: Mega Gnar throws everything around him in a chosen direction, dealing damage and slowing them. Any enemy that hits a wall is stunned and takes bonus damage.
spells.text: Mini Gnar Passive: Increase Hyper's Move Speed. Mega Gnar: Gnar tosses nearby enemies, dealing (200/300/400 + (100% Ability Power) + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage, Knocking Back, and Slowing them by 45% for 1.25/1.5/1.75 seconds. Enemies that hit a wall instead take (300/450/600 + (150% Ability Power) + (75% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and are Stunned. After transforming to Mini Gnar, Gnar cannot gain Rage for 15 seconds.

spells.name: Happy Hour
spells.summary: Gragas periodically heals upon using a skill.
spells.text: When Gragas uses an Ability, Gragas takes a drink, restoring (5.5% Health) Health.

spells.name: Barrel Roll
spells.summary: Gragas rolls his cask to a location, which can be activated to explode or will explode on its own after 4 seconds. The potency of the explosion increases over time. Enemies struck by the blast have their Move Speed slowed.
spells.text: Gragas rolls a cask that explodes after 4 seconds, dealing between (80/120/160/200/240 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage and (120/180/240/300/360 + (120% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing for between 40/45/50/55/60 and 60/67.5/75/82.5/90% for 2 seconds. The damage and Slow increase with time the cask spent before exploding. Gragas can Recast to detonate the cask early. Deals 70% damage to minions.

spells.name: Drunken Rage
spells.summary: Gragas samples his latest brew for 1 second. After finishing, he becomes boisterous and belligerent, dealing magic damage to all nearby enemies on his next basic attack and reducing damage received.
spells.text: Gragas samples his brew, reducing incoming damage by (10/14/18/22/26% + (4% per 100 Ability Power)) for 2.5 seconds and empowering his next Attack to deal an additional (20/50/80/110/140 + (70% Ability Power)) plus 7% max Health magic damage to the target and surrounding enemies. Max Health damage is capped at 300 versus jungle monsters. Deals 50% damage to structures.

spells.name: Body Slam
spells.summary: Gragas charges to a location and collides with the first enemy unit he comes across, dealing damage to all nearby enemy units and stunning them.
spells.text: Gragas charges forward, colliding with the first enemy, Knocking Up nearby enemies for 1 second and dealing (80/125/170/215/260 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage to them. This Ability's Cooldown is reduced by 40% if Gragas collides with an enemy.

spells.name: Explosive Cask
spells.summary: Gragas hurls his cask to a location, dealing damage and knocking back enemies caught in the blast radius.
spells.text: Gragas hurls his cask, dealing (200/300/400 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage and Knocking Away enemies from the impact zone. Enemies cannot be Knocked over walls with this Ability.

spells.name: New Destiny
spells.summary: Graves' shotgun has some unique properties. He must reload when he runs out of ammo. Attacks fire 4 bullets, which cannot pass through units. Non-champions struck by multiple bullets are knocked back.
spells.text: Graves' Attacks have unique properties: It can only fire two Shells before he must reload. Attack Speed reduces reload time slightly, but reduces time between shots dramatically.Each Attack fires 4 bullets. The first bullet on a target deals (0/97.605% Attack Damage) physical damage, and subsequent bullets deal (0/32.502% Attack Damage) each. Instead of normal Critical effects, Critical strikes fire 6 bullets and deal (-50% + (50% Critical Strike Damage)) more damage. Structures take 25% reduced damage.Bullets stop on the first unit hit. Non-champions struck by multiple bullets are Knocked Back.

spells.name: End of the Line
spells.summary: Graves fires an explosive shell that detonates after 1 second, or after colliding with terrain.
spells.text: Graves fires a powder round dealing (50/75/100/125/150 + (55% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. After 1 second or after colliding with terrain, it detonates, dealing (80/125/170/215/260 + (45/60/75/90/105% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage along the travel path again and to enemies near the blast.

spells.name: Smoke Screen
spells.summary: Graves fires a smoke canister at the target area creating a cloud of smoke that reduces sight range. Enemies caught in the initial impact are dealt magic damage and have their Move Speed reduced briefly.
spells.text: Graves creates a cloud of black smoke for 4 seconds, Slowing enemies inside by 50% and blocking their vision outside the area. The initial impact deals (60/110/160/210/260 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Quickdraw
spells.summary: Graves dashes forward gaining an Armor and Magic Resist boost for several seconds. If Graves dashes towards an enemy champion, gain two stacks of True Grit instead. Hitting enemies with basic attacks lowers the cooldown of this skill and refreshes the resistance boost.
spells.text: Graves dashes and reloads one Shell into his shotgun. He also gains a stack for 4 seconds (max 8 stacks) or two stacks if he dashes towards an enemy champion. Stacks grant him 7/10/13/16/19 Armor and 3.5/5/6.5/8/9.5 Magic Resist. Stacks are refreshed when damaging a non-minion. Each bullet hit from Graves' Attacks reduces this Ability's Cooldown by 0.5 seconds.

spells.name: Collateral Damage
spells.summary: Graves fires an explosive shell dealing heavy damage to the first champion it hits. After hitting a champion or reaching the end of its range, the shell explodes dealing damage in a cone.
spells.text: Graves fires an explosive cartridge, blasting himself backwards. The cartridge deals (275/425/575 + (150% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first enemy hit. After hitting an enemy champion or reaching the end of its range, the cartridge explodes outward, dealing (200/320/440 + (120% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage.

spells.name: A Thousand Cuts
spells.summary: Gwen's attacks deal bonus magic damage based on the targets health. She heals for a portion of the damage dealt to champions by this effect.
spells.text: Gwen's Attacks deal an additional (1% + (0.6% per 100 Ability Power)) Max Health magic damage on hit. Gwen recovers Health equal to 67% of the damage this Ability deals to champions, up to a maximum of ((12 ~ 40) + (7% Ability Power)).

spells.name: Snip Snip!
spells.summary: Gwen snips her scissors in a cone up to 6 times dealing magic damage. Gwen deals true damage to units in the center and applies her passive to them on each snip.
spells.text: Passive: Gwen gains 1 stack when she hits an enemy with an attack (max 4, lasts 6 seconds). Active: Consumes stacks. Gwen snips once for (10/14/18/22/26 + (5% Ability Power)) magic damage, snips again for each ammo consumed, and then snips a final time for (60/85/110/135/160 + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage. The center of each strikes converts 50% of the damage into true damage instead and applies A Thousand Cuts to enemies hit. Deals 80% damage to minions. Minions below 20% health take 1000% bonus damage instead of reduced damage. Max damage: (110/155/200/245/290 + (60% Ability Power)), plus (6% + (3.6% per 100 Ability Power)) percent health from A Thousand Cuts.

spells.name: Hallowed Mist
spells.summary: Gwen summons mist that protects her from enemies outside of it. She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.
spells.text: Gwen summons the Hallowed Mist, making her Untargetable to all enemies (except towers) outside the zone for 4 seconds or until she leaves it. While in the Mist, Gwen gains (22/24/26/28/30 + (7% Ability Power)) Armor and Magic Resist. Gwen can Recast this Ability once to call the Mist to her. This will automatically Recast the first time Gwen attempts to leave the zone.

spells.name: Skip 'n Slash
spells.summary: Gwen dashes a short distance then gains Attack Speed, attack range, and magic damage On-Hit for a few seconds. If she hits an enemy during that time, this Ability's cooldown is partially refunded.
spells.text: Gwen dashes and empowers her Attacks for 4 seconds. Empowered Attacks gain 30/42.5/55/67.5/80% Attack Speed, (15 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage On-Hit, 75 range, and the first one to hit an enemy refunds 25/35/45/55/65% of this Ability's Cooldown.

spells.name: Needlework
spells.summary: Gwen hurls a needle that slows enemies hit, deals magic damage, and applies A Thousand Cuts to champions hit. This ability can be cast up to two more times, with each cast throwing additional needles and dealing more damage.
spells.text: First Cast: Hurl a needle that deals (30/50/70 + (10% Ability Power)) magic damage, Slows by 40/50/60% for 1.5 seconds, and applies A Thousand Cuts to all enemies hit. Gwen can Recast this ability up to 2 additional times within 6 seconds (1s cooldown between casts). Second Cast: Fire three needles to deal (90/150/210 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage Third Cast: Fire five needles to deal (150/250/350 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage Subsequent needle hits on the same unit Slow by 15/20/25% instead. Max damage: (270/450/630 + (90% Ability Power)), plus (9% + (5.4% per 100 Ability Power)) max health damage from A Thousand Cuts.

spells.name: Warpath
spells.summary: Hecarim gains Attack Damage equal to a percentage of his bonus Move Speed.
spells.text: Hecarim gains (24% bonus Movement Speed) Attack Damage, increasing based on level.

spells.name: Rampage
spells.summary: Hecarim cleaves nearby enemies dealing physical damage. If Hecarim damages at least one enemy, he increases the damage and lowers the cooldown of subsequent Rampages.
spells.text: Hecarim cleaves nearby enemies for (60/90/120/150/180 + (90% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. If this Ability hits, he gains a stack that decreases its Cooldown by 0.75 seconds and increases its damage by (3 + (3% bonus Attack Damage))for 8 seconds. Stacks up to 3 times. Deals a base of (36/54/72/90/108 + (54% bonus Attack Damage)) damage to minions.

spells.name: Spirit of Dread
spells.summary: Hecarim gains Armor and Magic Resist. Hecarim deals magic damage to nearby enemies, and gains Health equal to a percentage of any damage those enemies suffer.
spells.text: Hecarim deals (80/120/160/200/240 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage over 4 seconds to nearby enemies. Hecarim gains 5/10/15/20/25 Armor and Magic Resist and heals for 25% of damage nearby enemies take from Hecarim and 12.5% of damage taken from his allies. Hecarim cannot heal more than 120/150/180/210/240 Health from minions or jungle monsters.

spells.name: Devastating Charge
spells.summary: Hecarim gains increasing Move Speed and can move through units for a short duration. His next attack knocks the target back and deals additional physical damage based on the distance he has traveled since activating the ability.
spells.text: Hecarim becomes Ghosted and gains 25% Move Speed increasing to 65% over 4 seconds. His next Attack Knocks Back and deals between (30/45/60/75/90 + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) and (60/90/120/150/180 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. Knock Back distance and damage scales with distance travelled during this Ability. Ghosted units ignore collision with other units. The remaining duration of this Ability is paused during Onslaught of Shadows. This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.

spells.name: Onslaught of Shadows
spells.summary: Hecarim summons spectral riders and charges forward, dealing magic damage in a line. Hecarim creates a shockwave when he finishes his charge, causing nearby enemies to flee in terror.
spells.text: Hecarim summons spectral riders and charges forward, dealing (150/250/350 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage. Hecarim unleashes a shockwave at the end of the charge that Fears for between 0.75 to 1.5 seconds, increased by charge distance. Hecarim will move to the targeted location, but the riders always move the full distance.

spells.name: Hextech Affinity
spells.summary: Gain Move Speed while near allied towers and turrets deployed by Heimerdinger.
spells.text: Heimerdinger gains 20% Move Speed near his Turrets and ally towers.

spells.name: H-28 G Evolution Turret
spells.summary: Heimerdinger lays down a rapid-fire cannon turret equipped with a secondary pass-through beam attack (turrets deal half damage to towers).
spells.text: Heimerdinger constructs a Turret that attacks nearby enemies. Heimerdinger can have 3 turrets active at once. Turrets slowly build up charge. At max charge, they fire a stronger attack. If Heimerdinger gets too far away, his Turrets will deactivate after 8 seconds. This Ability has 3 charges. Turrets prioritize attacking enemies Heimerdinger has recently damaged and enemies attacking Heimerdinger. Turret Stats: ((130 ~ 640) + (5/41% Ability Power)) Health (7/11/15/19/23 + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage per regular shot (40/60/80/100/120 + (55% Ability Power)) magic damage per charged shot

spells.name: Hextech Micro-Rockets
spells.summary: Heimerdinger fires long-range rockets that converge on his cursor.
spells.text: Heimerdinger unleashes a barrage of 5 rockets that deal (50/75/100/125/150 + (55% Ability Power)) magic damage to the first enemy hit. Additional rocket hits deal reduced damage. Max Damage: (90/135/180/225/270 + (103% Ability Power)) magic damage. Nearby Turrets gain 20% charge per rocket that hits a champion. Enemies hit by multiple rockets take (10/15/20/25/30 + (12% Ability Power)) magic damage beyond the first. Minions instead take (30/45/60/75/90 + (36% Ability Power)) magic damage beyond the first

spells.name: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade
spells.summary: Heimerdinger lobs a grenade at a location, dealing damage to enemy units, as well as stunning anyone directly hit and slowing surrounding units.
spells.text: Heimerdinger hurls a grenade that deals (60/100/140/180/220 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage in an area and Slows by 35% for 2 seconds. Enemies in the center are also Stunned for 1.5 seconds. Hitting a champion fully charges nearby Turrets.

spells.name: UPGRADE!!!
spells.summary: Heimerdinger invents an upgrade, causing his next spell to have increased effects.
spells.text: Heimerdinger upgrades his next non-ultimate Ability. H-28Q Apex Turret: Place an upgraded Turret for 8 seconds that doesn't count towards Heimerdinger's max turrets, deals (80/100/120 + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage per shot and (100/140/180 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage per charged shot. Its attacks deal damage in an area, Slow by 25% for 2 seconds, and it is immune to crowd control. Hextech Rocket Swarm: Fires 4 waves of rockets that each deal (135/180/225 + (45% Ability Power)) magic damage. Champions and jungle monsters hit by additional rockets take reduced damage, and minions take increased damage. Max Damage: (503/697.5/892 + (183% Ability Power)) magic damage. CH-3X Lightning Grenade: Throws a bouncing grenade that discharges three times, dealing (100/200/300 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. The Stun and Slow areas are larger. Recast: Cancel this Ability. The upgraded Ability has no cost. Upgraded rockets deal 2000% damage to minions. Apex Turret Stats: ((725 ~ 1525) + (50% Ability Power)) Health (30 ~ 90) Armor (30 ~ 90) Magic Resist (80/100/120 + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage per regular shot (100/140/180 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage per charged shot

spells.name: Signature of the Visionary
spells.summary: Hwei primes enemy champions he damages with his abilities for his signature finishing touch. Hitting an enemy with a second damaging spell completes his signature, leaving it beneath them. The signature detonates after a short delay, dealing magic damage to all enemies in range.
spells.text: Hwei's damaging Abilities against enemy champions mark them for 4 seconds. Hitting marked enemies with a second damaging Ability creates an explosion underneath them dealing ((40 ~ 285) + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage to all enemies in range.

spells.name: Subject: Disaster
spells.summary: Hwei envisions a series of disasters, allowing him to paint a devastating blow. This ability replaces Hwei's abilities with damaging abilities: Devastating Fire, Severing Bolt, and Molten Fissure.
spells.text: Hwei paints visions of disaster that deal large damage to enemies. Devastating Fire Hwei launches a blazing fast fireball that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing (50/80/110/140/170 + (80% Ability Power)) plus 3/4/5/6/7% max health magic damage. Severing Bolt Hwei strikes over far distances with a delayed lightning bolt, dealing (60/85/110/135/160 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage. Hitting an Isolated or Immobilized target increases the damage up to (120/201.875/302.5/421.875/560 + (60/71.25/82.5/93.75/105% Ability Power)) magic damage, based on the target's missing health. Molten Fissure Hwei unleashes a path of eruptions, dealing (20/35/50/65/80 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage in an area and leaving behind pools of lava that Slow enemies by 35% and deal (20/35/50/65/80 + (24% Ability Power)) magic damage per second for 2.5 seconds.

spells.name: Subject: Serenity
spells.summary: Hwei envisions a series of serenities, allowing him to paint invigorating settings. This ability replaces Hwei's abilities with utility abilities: Fleeting Current, Pool of Reflection, and Stirring Lights.
spells.text: Hwei paints visions of serenity that provide utility for himself and allied champions. Fleeting Current Hwei launches a current of swift waters in a line that grants allies (30/32.5/35/37.5/40% + (3% per 100 Ability Power)) Move Speed. Pool of Reflection Hwei forms a protective pool that grants (100/140/180/220/260 + (60% Ability Power)) Shields over time to allied champions inside reduced by 15% for allies. Stirring Lights Hwei creates three swirling lights that empower his next three Abilities or Attacks to deal an additional (20/30/40/50/60 + (15% Ability Power)) magic damage and restore 45/50/55/60/65 Mana each.

spells.name: Subject: Torment
spells.summary: Hwei envisions a series of torments, allowing him to paint controlling visages. This ability replaces Hwei's abilities with crowd control abilities: Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss, and Crushing Maw.
spells.text: Hwei paints visions of torment that control enemies. Grim Visage Hwei launches a terrifying face that causes the first enemy hit to Flee for 1/1.125/1.25/1.375/1.5 second(s) and take (70/110/150/190/230 + (65% Ability Power)) magic damage. Gaze of the Abyss Hwei forms an eye that lingers and provides vision locking onto the first enemy champion that enters and launching a homing missile that Roots the first enemy hit for 1.2/1.4/1.6/1.8/2 seconds dealing (70/110/150/190/230 + (65% Ability Power)) magic damage. Crushing Maw Hwei paints a set of jaws at a target location that Drags enemies to the center dealing (70/110/150/190/230 + (65% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing enemies caught by 40/47.5/55/62.5/70% decaying over 1.25 seconds.

spells.name: Spiraling Despair
spells.summary: Hwei paints a vision of pure despair. The first enemy champion struck becomes the center of an expanding painting that slows and damages nearby enemies. The vision explodes after reaching its maximum size or when the champion dies.
spells.text: Hwei launches a vision of pure despair that sticks to an enemy champion for 3 seconds. The vision expands over time applying a Slow to enemies for 10% stacking every 0.25 seconds, and dealing (10/20/30 + (5% Ability Power)) magic damage per second. Upon completion, the vision shatters, dealing (200/325/450 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage. Maximum damage possible is (230/385/540 + (95% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Prophet of an Elder God
spells.summary: Illaoi and the Vessels she creates spawn Tentacles on nearby impassible terrain. Tentacles swing at spirits, Vessels, and victims of Illaoi's Harsh lesson. Tentacles deal physical damage to enemies hit, and will heal Illaoi if they damage a champion.
spells.text: Illaoi draws the presence of her god, spawning a Tentacle on nearby terrain if no other Tentacles are nearby ((18 ~ 7) second cooldown). Tentacles will not attack on their own, but can be made to Slam by Illaoi's Abilities. Slam deals ((9.9 ~ 198) + (121% Attack Damage) + (44% Ability Power)) physical damage. Hitting at least one enemy champion restores 5% missing Health to Illaoi.

spells.name: Tentacle Smash
spells.summary: Increases the damage dealt by Tentacles. When activated, Illaoi smashes down a Tentacle that deals physical damage.
spells.text: Passive: Slam damage is increased by 10/15/20/25/30% (currently ((9 ~ 180) + (110% Attack Damage) + (40% Ability Power)) physical damage). Active: Illaoi swings her idol, causing a Tentacle to Slam forward.

spells.name: Harsh Lesson
spells.summary: Illaoi leaps to her target, dealing physical damage and causing nearby Tentacles to also swing at the target.
spells.text: Illaoi's next Attack causes her to leap at the target, dealing an additional (3/3.5/4/4.5/5% + (3.5% per 100 Attack Damage)) max Health physical damage. When she strikes, nearby Tentacles will Slam at the target. The percent Health damage does a minimum of 20/30/40/50/60. Against jungle monsters the damage is capped at 300. This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.

spells.name: Test of Spirit
spells.summary: Illaoi rips the spirit from a foe's body, forcing it to stand before her. Spirits echo a percentage of the damage they take to the original target. If killed, or if the target gets too far from the spirit, the target will become a Vessel and begin spawning Tentacles.
spells.text: Illaoi pulls the spirit from an enemy champion for 7 seconds. The spirit can be damaged like a champion, with (25/30/35/40/45% + (8% per 100 Attack Damage)) of that damage echoing to its owner. If the spirit dies or the target leaves its range, the target becomes marked for 4 seconds and is Slowed by 80% for 1.5 seconds. Marked enemies spawn Tentacles if possible. Tentacles will automatically Slam at spirits and marked enemies once every 3 seconds. Marked enemies are revealed for a short time.

spells.name: Leap of Faith
spells.summary: Illaoi smashes her idol into the ground, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies. A Tentacle spawns for each enemy champion hit.
spells.text: Illaoi smashes her idol into the ground, dealing (150/250/350 + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to nearby enemies and spawning a Tentacle for each enemy champion hit. For the next 8 seconds, Tentacles are untargetable and Slam 50% faster, and Harsh Lesson has a 2 second cooldown. Spirits from Test Of Spirit also generate a Tentacle if hit by this ability.

spells.name: Ionian Fervor
spells.summary: When Irelia strikes enemies with spells she gains stacking bonus Attack Speed. At maximum stacks she also gains bonus damage on hit.
spells.text: Irelia gains a stack for 6 seconds when she hits an enemy with an Ability (max 4). She gains (10 ~ 25)Attack Speed per stack, and at max stacks her Attacks deal an additional ((10 ~ 3) + (20% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage. Attacking a champion, structure, or large monster refreshes the duration of the stacks. Irelia gains a stack for each champion hit, or if she hits at least one non-champion enemy.

spells.name: Bladesurge
spells.summary: Irelia dashes forward to strike her target, healing herself. If the target is Marked or dies to Bladesurge, its cooldown refreshes.
spells.text: Irelia dashes to an enemy, dealing (5/25/45/65/85 + (80% Attack Damage)) physical damage and restoring (9/10/11/12/13% Attack Damage) Health to herself. If the enemy dies or was Unsteady, the Cooldown is refreshed. Deals (55/75/95/115/135 + (80% Attack Damage)) damage to minions. This ability applies On-Hit Effects.

spells.name: Defiant Dance
spells.summary: Irelia charges a strike that deals more damage as she charges. She takes reduced physical damage during the charge.
spells.text: Begin Charging: Irelia enters a defensive stance for up to 1.5 seconds, becoming unable to act but reducing physical damage taken by ((40 ~ 70) + (8% Ability Power))and magic damage taken by ((20 ~ 35) + (4% Ability Power)). Release: Irelia lashes out with her blades, dealing (10/20/30/40/50 + (40% Attack Damage) + (50% Ability Power)) physical damage increased up to (30/60/90/120/150 + (120% Attack Damage) + (150% Ability Power)) based on charge time. The Release will happen automatically at the end of the Charge and cannot be interrupted. Reaches max damage increase after 0.75 seconds.

spells.name: Flawless Duet
spells.summary: Irelia sends out two blades which converge on each other. Enemies caught in between are damaged, stunned and Marked.
spells.text: Irelia throws a blade into the ground and can Recast for up to 3.5 seconds. Recast: Irelia throws a second blade, then they fly towards each other Stunning for 0.75 seconds and dealing (70/110/150/190/230 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage. Champions and large jungle monsters become Unsteady for 5 seconds. Irelia will automatically Recast at her location after 3.5 seconds.

spells.name: Vanguard's Edge
spells.summary: Irelia fires a massive number of blades that explode outward upon hitting an enemy champion. Enemies hit by the blades are damaged and Marked. Afterwards the blades form a wall that will damage and slow enemies that walk through it.
spells.text: Irelia launches a barrage of blades, dealing (125/200/275 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage and making champions and large jungle monsters Unsteady for 5 seconds. The barrage explodes into a cage around the first champion hit for 2.5 seconds. The cage deals (125/200/275 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slows by 90% for 1.5 seconds. When the barrage explodes, surrounding enemies are also hit.

spells.name: Friend of the Forest
spells.summary: Ivern cannot attack or be attacked by non-epic monsters. Ivern can create magical groves on jungle camps which grow over time. When the grove is fully grown, Ivern may free the monsters to receive gold and experience.
spells.text: Ivern will not hurt non-epic monsters. Instead, Ivern can right click a monster to grow a Grove that costs 15 × (1% Health) Health and 20 × (1% Mana) Mana. Groves: Grow over (40 ~ 11) second(s) Once fully grown, Ivern can harvest them, freeing the camp and earning gold and experience Ivern can also Smite the Groves to instantly grow and free the camp, earning gold and experience

spells.name: Rootcaller
spells.summary: Ivern conjures a vine, dealing damage and rooting enemy targets hit. Ivern's allies can dash to the rooted target.
spells.text: Ivern conjures a vine dealing (80/125/170/215/260 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage and Rooting the first enemy hit for 1.6/1.7/1.8/1.9/2 seconds. Allies that Attack a Rooted enemy dash into Attack Range. Recast: Ivern dashes directly onto the Rooted enemy. Hitting non-epic monsters reduces Rootcaller's cooldown by 50%.

spells.name: Brushmaker
spells.summary: In brush, Ivern and his nearby allies attacks deal bonus magic damage. Ivern can activate this ability to create a patch of brush.
spells.text: Passive: While in brush and for 3 seconds after leaving, Ivern's Attacks deal an additional (20/27.5/35/42.5/50 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage. Nearby allies will gain this effect for 1.5 seconds and deal (10/15/20/25/30 + (10% Ability Power)) magic damage. Active: Ivern grows a patch of Brush, revealing the area for 8 seconds. The Brush persists until Ivern's team loses vision within it, or up to 45 seconds.

spells.name: Triggerseed
spells.summary: Ivern places a shield on an ally which explodes after a short duration slowing and damaging enemies. The shield refreshes if it hits no enemies.
spells.text: Ivern grants (75/115/155/195/235 + (50% Ability Power)) Shield to an ally champion or Daisy. After 2 seconds, it bursts, dealing (70/90/110/130/150 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing enemies by 40/45/50/55/60% for 2 seconds. If Triggerseed detonates and no enemy champions are hit while the shield still persists, the ally will be shielded for (75/115/155/195/235 + (50% Ability Power)) for 2 seconds. Can also be used on Daisy.

spells.name: Daisy!
spells.summary: Ivern summons his Sentinel friend Daisy to fight with him. Re-cast command Daisy to attack or move.
spells.text: Ivern summons his sentinel friend Daisy to leap into the fray for 45 seconds. Daisy, Slam!: Daisy's 3rd consecutive Attack on the same champion or epic monster will launch a shockwave, dealing (90/140/190 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage to all enemies hit as well as Knocking Up for 1 second. This effect can only occur once every 3 seconds. Recast: Instruct Daisy to Attack or move. Daisy has: ((1000 ~ 4400) + (50% Ability Power)) Health (30 ~ 90) Armor (30 ~ 90) Magic Resist (70/100/130 + (15% Ability Power)) Attack Damage

spells.name: Tailwind
spells.summary: Janna's allies gain Move Speed moving towards her. Janna deals a portion of bonus Move Speed as bonus magic damage on hit and with Zephyr.
spells.text: Ally champions gain 6% Move Speed moving towards Janna. Janna deals (30% bonus Movement Speed) bonus magic damage On-Hit and with Zephyr.

spells.name: Howling Gale
spells.summary: By creating a localized change in pressure and temperature, Janna is able to create a small storm that grows in size with time. She can activate the spell again to release the storm. On release this storm will fly towards the direction it was cast in, dealing damage and knocking away any enemies in its path.
spells.text: Janna summons a tornado that grows stronger over 3 seconds then blows along its path. It deals (55/90/125/160/195 + (50% Ability Power)) - (85/135/185/235/285 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage and Knocks Up for 0.5 - 1.25 seconds. The distance, damage, and Knock Up duration increase based on how much the tornado grew. Janna can Recast to send the tornado early. Deals an additional (10/15/20/25/30 + (10% Ability Power)) magic damage, Knocks Up for an additional 0.25 seconds, and travels 20% farther for each second it grew, and always reaches its destination in 1.25 seconds.

spells.name: Zephyr
spells.summary: Janna summons an air elemental that passively increases her Move Speed and enables her to pass through units. She may also activate this ability to deal damage and slow an enemy's Move Speed.
spells.text: Passive: Janna gains (6/7/8/9/10% + (2% per 100 Ability Power)) Move Speed and is Ghosted. Active: Janna's elemental strikes an enemy, Slowing them by (20/24/28/32/36% + (6% per 100 Ability Power)) for 2 seconds, and dealing (55/85/115/145/175 + (50% Ability Power)) + (30% bonus Movement Speed) magic damage. Ghosted units ignore collision with other units.

spells.name: Eye Of The Storm
spells.summary: Janna conjures a defensive gale that shields an ally champion or turret from incoming damage and increases their Attack Damage.
spells.text: Janna grants an ally champion or turret (80/120/160/200/240 + (55% Ability Power)) Shield for 4 seconds. While shielded, they gain (10/15/20/25/30 + (10% Ability Power)) Attack Damage. Janna refunds 20% of the cooldown whenever she impairs an enemy champion's movement with an Ability.

spells.name: Monsoon
spells.summary: Janna surrounds herself in a magical storm, throwing enemies back. After the storm has settled, soothing winds heal nearby allies while the ability is active.
spells.text: Janna summons a magical monsoon, Knocking Back nearby enemies then healing nearby allies for (300/450/600 + (150% Ability Power)) Health over 3 seconds. Moving or using an Ability ends the monsoon early. The Knock Back cannot push enemies over walls.

spells.name: Martial Cadence
spells.summary: Jarvan's first basic attack on an enemy deals bonus physical damage based on their current Health. This effect cannot occur again on the same enemy for a few seconds.
spells.text: Jarvan's Attacks deal an additional 8% current Health physical damage. This effect has a 3 second Cooldown per target.

spells.name: Dragon Strike
spells.summary: Jarvan IV extends his lance, dealing physical damage and lowering the Armor of enemies in its path. Additionally, this will pull Jarvan to his Demacian Standard, knocking up enemies in his path.
spells.text: Jarvan extends his lance, dealing (90/130/170/210/250 + (145% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and removing 10/14/18/22/26% Armor for 3 seconds. If the lance connects with Demacian Standard, Jarvan will pull himself to it, Knocking Up those in his path for 0.75 seconds. Jarvan can pull himself even while Immobilized.

spells.name: Golden Aegis
spells.summary: Jarvan IV calls upon the ancient kings of Demacia to shield him from harm and slow surrounding enemies.
spells.text: Jarvan summons an aegis, Slowing nearby enemies by 15/20/25/30/35% for 2 seconds and granting him a (60/80/100/120/140 + (70% bonus Attack Damage)) Shield, increased by (1.3% Health) for each enemy champion hit.

spells.name: Demacian Standard
spells.summary: Jarvan IV carries the pride of Demacia, passively granting him bonus Attack Speed. Activating Demacian Standard allows Jarvan IV to place a Demacian flag that deals magic damage on impact and grants Attack Speed to nearby allied champions.
spells.text: Passive: Jarvan gains 20/22.5/25/27.5/30% Attack Speed. Active: Jarvan throws a standard into the ground, dealing (80/120/160/200/240 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage and granting allies near the standard 20/22.5/25/27.5/30% Attack Speed for 8 seconds.

spells.name: Cataclysm
spells.summary: Jarvan IV heroically leaps into battle at a target with such force that he terraforms the surrounding area to create an arena around them. Nearby enemies are damaged at the moment of impact.
spells.text: Jarvan heroically leaps to an enemy Champion, dealing (200/325/450 + (180% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to them and surrounding enemies and creating an arena of impassable terrain around them for 3.5 seconds. Jarvan can Recast to collapse the terrain.

spells.name: Relentless Assault
spells.summary: Jax's consecutive basic attacks continuously increase his Attack Speed.
spells.text: Jax's Attacks grant a stack for 2.5 seconds that gives him 12.5% Attack Speed (max 100% Attack Speed).

spells.name: Leap Strike
spells.summary: Jax leaps toward a unit. If they are an enemy, he strikes them with his weapon.
spells.text: Jax leaps to a friendly or enemy unit or ward, dealing (65/105/145/185/225 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage if it is an enemy.

spells.name: Empower
spells.summary: Jax charges his weapon with energy, causing his next attack to deal additional damage.
spells.text: Jax charges his weapon with energy, causing his next Attack or Leap Strike to deal an additional (50/85/120/155/190 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage. Deals 50% damage to structures.

spells.name: Counter Strike
spells.summary: Jax's combat prowess allows him to dodge all incoming attacks for a short duration and then quickly counterattack, stunning all surrounding enemies.
spells.text: Jax enters a defensive stance for up to 2 seconds, dodging incoming Attacks and taking 25% less damage from area of effect Abilities. After 2 seconds or Recasting, Jax deals (40/70/100/130/160 + (70% bonus Ability Power)) + 4% max Health magic damage and Stuns nearby enemies for 1 second. The damage is increased by 20% per Attack dodged, up to a maximum of (80/140/200/260/320 + (140% bonus Ability Power)) + 8% max Health.

spells.name: Grandmaster-at-Arms
spells.summary: Every third consecutive attack deals additional Magic Damage. Additionally, Jax can activate this ability to deal damage around himself and strengthen his resolve, increasing his Armor and Magic Resist for a short duration.
spells.text: Passive: Every third Attack within 2.5 seconds deals an additional (75/130/185 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. Active: Jax slams his lantern down, dealing (100/175/250 + (100% bonus Ability Power)) magic damage to nearby enemies. If he hits a champion he gains (45/60/75 + (40% bonus Attack Damage)) Armor and (27/36/45 + (24% bonus Attack Damage)) Magic Resist plus (20/25/30 + (10% bonus Attack Damage)) Armor and (12/15/18 + (6% bonus Attack Damage)) Magic Resist per additional champion hit for 8 seconds. During this time every second Attack deals additional magic damage instead of every third. Deals 50% damage to structures.

spells.name: Hextech Capacitor
spells.summary: When Jayce swaps weapons he gains Move Speed for a short duration.
spells.text: Jayce can swap between melee and ranged weapons using Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer starting from level 1. Swapping weapons also swaps all his Abilities and grants him 30 Move Speed for 0.75 seconds.

spells.name: To the Skies! / Shock Blast
spells.summary: Hammer Stance: Leaps to an enemy dealing physical damage and slowing enemies. Cannon Stance: Fires an orb of electricity that detonates upon hitting an enemy (or reaching the end of its path) dealing physical damage to all enemies hit.
spells.text: Mercury Hammer: Jayce leaps to an enemy, dealing (60/110/160/210/260/310 + (135% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to surrounding enemies and Slowing them by 35/40/45/50/55/60% for 2 seconds. Deals 10 bonus damage to jungle monsters.

spells.name: Lightning Field / Hyper Charge
spells.summary: Hammer Stance: Passive: Restores Mana per strike. Active: Creates a field of lightning damaging nearby enemies for several seconds. Cannon Stance: Gains a burst of energy, increasing Attack Speed to maximum for several attacks.
spells.text: Mercury Hammer - Passive: Jayce's Hammer Attacks grant 15/17/19/21/23/25 Mana. Mercury Hammer - Active: Jayce creates an electric aura dealing (140/200/260/320/380/440 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage over 4 seconds.

spells.name: Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate
spells.summary: Hammer Stance: Deals magic damage to an enemy and knocks them back a short distance. Cannon Stance: Deploys an Acceleration Gate increasing the Move Speed of all allied champions who pass through it. If Shock Blast is fired through the gate the missile speed, range, and damage will increase.
spells.text: Hammer Form: Jayce swings his hammer, Knocking Back his target and dealing (100% bonus Attack Damage) plus 8/10.8/13.6/16.4/19.2/22% max Health magic damage. Hammer swing does a max of 200/300/400/500/600/700 magic damage against jungle monsters.

spells.name: Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer
spells.summary: Hammer Stance: Transforms the Mercury Hammer into the Mercury Cannon gaining new abilities and increased range. The first attack in this form reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist. Cannon Stance: Transforms the Mercury Cannon into the Mercury Hammer gaining new abilities and increasing Armor and Magic Resist. The first attack in this form deals additional magic damage.
spells.text: Mercury Hammer: Jayce transforms his weapon into the Mercury Cannon, gaining Attack Range and new Abilities. Jayce's next Attack removes 35% Armor and Magic Resist for 5 seconds.

spells.name: Whisper
spells.summary: Jhin's hand cannon, Whisper, is a precise instrument designed to deal superior damage. It fires at a fixed rate and carries only four shots. Jhin imbues the final bullet with dark magics to critically strike and deal bonus execute damage. Whenever Whisper crits, it inspires Jhin with a burst of Move Speed.
spells.text: Jhin's hand cannon has a fixed Attack Speed and can be fired 4 times before needing to be reloaded. The 4th shot always critically strikes, and deals an additional (15% ~ 25%) missing health physical damage. In addition:Jhin gains ((4% ~ 36%) + (35% Critical Strike Chance) + (30% bonus Attack Speed)) bonus Attack DamageJhin's critical strikes deal 25% less damage but grant him (14% + (44% bonus Attack Speed)) Move Speed for 2 seconds.

spells.name: Dancing Grenade
spells.summary: Jhin launches a magical cartridge at an enemy. It can hit up to four targets and gains damage each time it kills.
spells.text: Jhin launches a cartridge that deals (44/69/94/119/144 + (44/51.5/59/66.5/74% Attack Damage) + (60% Ability Power)) physical damage before bouncing to a nearby enemy that has not been hit yet. The cartridge can hit a maximum of 4 times. Enemies that die shortly after being hit increase the damage of subsequent hits by 35%.

spells.name: Deadly Flourish
spells.summary: Jhin brandishes his cane, firing a single shot with incredible range. It pierces through minions and monsters, but stops on the first champion hit. If the target was recently struck by Jhin's allies, lotus traps, or damaged by Jhin, they are rooted.
spells.text: Jhin fires a long range shot dealing (70/105/140/175/210 + (50% Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first champion hit and other enemies along the way. If this skill strikes a champion that has been damaged by an allied champion within the last 4 seconds, it will Root them for 1.25/1.5/1.75/2/2.25 seconds and grant Jhin Whisper's Move Speed. This ability deals 75% damage to minions. Champions that step on a trap from Captive Audience can also be rooted.

spells.name: Captive Audience
spells.summary: Jhin places an invisible lotus trap that blooms when walked over. It slows nearby enemies before dealing damage with an explosion of serrated petals. Beauty in Death - When Jhin kills an enemy champion, a lotus trap will bloom near their corpse.
spells.text: Passive: Champions Jhin kills will create and detonate a Lotus Trap at their location. Active: Jhin places an invisible Lotus Trap for 3 minutes that creates a zone that Slows by 35% when stepped on by an enemy. After 2 seconds, the trap detonates, dealing (20/80/140/200/260 + (120% Attack Damage) + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage. This ability has 2 charges (24/21.5/19/16.5/14 second refresh). Lotus Trap hits deal 65% damage to minions, and enemies recently hit by another Lotus Trap.

spells.name: Curtain Call
spells.summary: Jhin channels, transforming Whisper into a shoulder-mounted mega-cannon. It is able to fire 4 super shots at extreme range that pierce through minions and monsters, but stop on the first champion impacted. Whisper cripples enemies hit, which slows them and deals execute damage. The 4th shot is perfectly crafted, epically powerful, and guaranteed to critically strike.
spells.text: Jhin sets up and channels, enabling him to fire 4 super shots, each dealing between (64/128/192 + (25% Attack Damage)) and (256/512/768 + (100% Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first champion hit based on their percentage missing health and Slowing them by 80% for 0.5 seconds. The fourth shot critically strikes for 200% damage.

spells.name: Get Excited!
spells.summary: Jinx receives massively increased Move Speed and Attack Speed whenever she helps kill or destroy an enemy champions epic jungle monster, or structure.
spells.text: Whenever a champion, epic monster, or structure that Jinx has dealt damage to within the last 3 seconds is killed or destroyed, she gains 175% decaying Move Speed and 25% Attack Speed for 6 seconds. Champion takedowns stack the Attack Speed up to 5 times.

spells.name: Switcheroo!
spells.summary: Jinx modifies her basic attacks by swapping between Pow-Pow, her minigun and Fishbones, her rocket launcher. Attacks with Pow-Pow grant Attack Speed, while attacks with Fishbones deal area of effect damage, gain increased range, but drain Mana and attack slower.
spells.text: Jinx swaps weapons between Fishbones the rocket launcher and Pow-Pow the minigun. While using the rocket launcher, Jinx's Attacks deal (110% Attack Damage) physical damage to the target and nearby enemies, gain 100/125/150/175/200 range, cost Mana, and scale 10% less with bonus Attack Speed. While using the minigun, Jinx's Attacks grant Attack Speed for 2.5 seconds, stacking up to 3 times ( + 30/55/80/105/130% max). Minigun stacks fall off one at a time and only benefit Jinx's first Attack after switching to the rocket launcher.

spells.name: Zap!
spells.summary: Jinx uses Zapper, her shock pistol, to fire a blast that deals damage to the first enemy hit, slowing and revealing it.
spells.text: Jinx fires a shock blast that deals (10/60/110/160/210 + (140% Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first enemy hit, Slows them by 40/50/60/70/80%, and reveals them for 2 seconds. Zap!'s cast time decreases as Jinx gains Attack Speed.

spells.name: Flame Chompers!
