spells.summary: Jinx throws out a line of snare grenades that explode after 5 seconds, lighting enemies on fire. Flame Chompers will bite enemy champions who walk over them, rooting them in place.
spells.text: Jinx tosses out 3 chompers that last for 5 seconds. They explode on contact with enemy champions, Rooting them for 1.5 seconds and dealing (90/140/190/240/290 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage to nearby enemies. This Ability Knocks Down enemies.

spells.name: Super Mega Death Rocket!
spells.summary: Jinx fires a super rocket across the map that gains damage as it travels. The rocket will explode upon colliding with an enemy champion, dealing damage to it and surrounding enemies based on their missing Health.
spells.text: Jinx fires a rocket that explodes on the first enemy champion hit, dealing (20/35/50 + (12% bonus Attack Damage)) to (200/350/500 + (120% bonus Attack Damage)) + 25/30/35% missing Health physical damage, gaining damage over the first second of travel time. Nearby enemies take 80% Damage. Missing Health damage cannot exceed 1200 against Monsters.

spells.name: Dauntless Instinct
spells.summary: K'Sante's Abilities mark targets to take more damage on his next Attack. When All Out, K'Sante deals more damage with all Attacks and Abilities.
spells.text: K'Sante's damaging Abilities mark enemies hit. Attacking a marked enemy deals 12 plus (1% ~ 2%) max Health physical damage and consumes the mark. All Out: K'Sante's Attacks, Abilities and Passive deal an additional (1% + (1% per 100 bonus Armor) + (1% per 100 bonus Magic Resist)) max Health physical damage.

spells.name: Ntofo Strikes
spells.summary: K'Sante strikes, damaging and slowing enemies in a short line. On hit, grants a stack of Ntofo Strikes. At 2 stacks, K'Sante fires a shockwave that pulls enemies in. When All Out, cooldown is reduced.
spells.text: K'Sante slams his weapon, dealing (70/100/130/160/190 + (40% bonus Armor) + (40% bonus Magic Resist)) physical damage and Slowing enemies by 80% for 0.5s. If he hits, he gains a stack of Ntofo Strikes for 6 seconds. At 2 stacks, he instead fires a shockwave that Stuns and Pulls enemies for 1 second. All Out: Cooldown is reduced by 33%. Cooldown & cast time reduced by Bonus Armor and Magic Resist: ? / 120.

spells.name: Path Maker
spells.summary: K'Sante charges up, taking reduced damage, then dashes, knocking back and stunning enemies. When All Out, deals increased damage and no longer knocks back or stuns.
spells.text: K'Sante raises his weapons defensively for 0.4-1.0s, becoming Unstoppable and reducing incoming damage by 30%. Then, he rams forward, dealing 45/75/105/135/165 + (8% + (2% per 100 bonus Armor) + (2% per 100 bonus Magic Resist)) max Health physical damage. Enemies hit are Knocked Back and Stunned for 0.5-1.75s (based on charge time). All Out: Cooldown is refreshed. Deals an additional 10-80% damage as true damage (based on charge time), damage reduction is increased to 75% and dash speed is increased, but no longer Knocks Back or Stuns. Maximum effect is reached at 90% charge time. Maximum of 180/260/340/420/500 damage against monsters.

spells.name: Footwork
spells.summary: K'Sante dashes and gains a shield. If targeting an ally, K'Sante dashes to the ally with increased range and both gain a shield. When All Out, cooldown is reduced and speed is increased.
spells.text: K'Sante dashes, gaining (70/112.5/155/197.5/240 + (13.5% bonus Health)) Shield for 2 seconds. If dashing to an ally, the distance of the dash is significantly increased and the ally is also Shielded. All Out: Cooldown is decreased by 50% and dash speed is increased.

spells.name: All Out
spells.summary: K'Sante knocks an enemy back, launching them through any wall in their path. Then, K'Sante goes All Out and dashes after them, gaining increased damage, healing, and transformed abilities at the cost of reduced defenses.
spells.text: K'Sante shatters his ntofos to Knock Back an enemy champion, dealing 80/115/150 physical damage, then dashes behind them and goes All Out for 15s. If the enemy would hit a wall, they are Knocked Back through the wall and K'Sante strikes them again for (80/115/150 + (5% bonus Health)) physical damage. While All Out, K'Sante's Abilities are upgraded and he gains 40/60/80% Attack Speed, 50% Bonus Armor Penetration, and 20% Omnivamp, but loses 35% max Health, 85% Bonus Armor, and 85% Bonus Magic Resistance. K'Sante is Unstoppable and Roots his target while casting this Ability.

spells.name: Second Skin
spells.summary: Kai'Sa's basic attacks stack Plasma, dealing increasing bonus magic damage. Allies' immobilizing effects help stack Plasma. Additionally, Kai'Sa's item purchases upgrade her basic spells to have more powerful properties.
spells.text: Kai'Sa's Attacks stack Plasma for 4 seconds and deal an additional ((4 ~ 30) + (12% Ability Power)) plus ((1 ~ 8) + (3% Ability Power)) per stack magic damage. Attacking an enemy with 4 stacks consumes the Plasma, dealing (15% + (6% per 100 Ability Power)) missing Health magic damage. Nearby allies apply 1 stack to champions they Immobilize. Kai'Sa's suit evolves her basic Abilities based on her stats. Icathian Rain: ?/100 Bonus Attack Damage Void Seeker: ?/100 Ability Power Supercharge: ?%/100% Bonus Attack Speed

spells.name: Icathian Rain
spells.summary: Kai'Sa shoots a swarm of missiles that seek out nearby targets. Living Weapon: Icathian Rain is upgraded to shoot more missiles.
spells.text: Kai'Sa launches 6 missiles that split among nearby enemies, each dealing (40/55/70/85/100 + (55% bonus Attack Damage) + (20% Ability Power)) physical damage, up to a maximum of (90/123.75/157.5/191.25/225 + (123.75% bonus Attack Damage) + (45% Ability Power)). Additional missile hits on champions or monsters deal 25% damage. Evolved: Kai'Sa instead fires 12 missiles. Current: ?/100 Bonus Attack Damage Minions below 35% Health take 200% damage.

spells.name: Void Seeker
spells.summary: Kai'Sa shoots a long range missile, marking enemies with her passive. Living Weapon: Void Seeker is upgraded to apply more passive marks and reduce cooldown on champion hit.
spells.text: Kai'Sa fires a void blast that deals (30/55/80/105/130 + (130% Attack Damage) + (45% Ability Power)) magic damage, applies 2 stacks of Plasma, and grants True Sight of the first enemy hit for 4 seconds. Evolved: Kai'Sa instead applies 3 stacks of Plasma and hitting a champion reduces the Cooldown by 75%. Current: ?/100 Ability Power Plasma applied by this Ability deals the damage from Second Skin.

spells.name: Supercharge
spells.summary: Kai'Sa briefly increases her Move Speed, then increases her Attack Speed. Living Weapon: Supercharge is upgraded to briefly grant Invisibility.
spells.text: Kai'Sa supercharges her void energy, gaining 55/60/65/70/75% Move Speed and becoming Ghosted while charging, then gaining 40/50/60/70/80% Attack Speed for 4 seconds. Attacks reduce this Ability's Cooldown by 0.5 seconds. Evolved: Kai'Sa also becomes Invisible for 0.5 seconds. Current: ?%/100% Bonus Attack Speed Ghosted units can pass through other units. Invisible units cannot be revealed except by turrets or True Sight. The charge time scales down with Attack Speed (Current: 1.2)

spells.name: Killer Instinct
spells.summary: Kai'Sa dashes near an enemy champion.
spells.text: Kai'Sa warps near an enemy champion affected by Plasma and gains (100/150/200 + (90/135/180% Attack Damage) + (120% Ability Power)) Shield for 2 seconds.

spells.name: Martial Poise
spells.summary: Enter a movement command while winding up Kalista's basic attack or Pierce to lunge a short distance when she launches her attack.
spells.text: Martial PoiseEnter a movement command while winding up Kalista's basic attack or Pierce to lunge a short distance when she launches her attack. Lunge distance scales with boot tier. Kalista's basic attacks have unique drawbacks. They:Cannot be cancelled;Miss if her target leaves vision;Deal only 90% of her total attack damage.

spells.name: Pierce
spells.summary: Throw a fast moving spear that passes through enemies it kills.
spells.text: Kalista hurls a spear, dealing (10/75/140/205/270 + (105% Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first target hit. If this kills the target, the spear continues onward, carrying any Rend stacks to the next target hit. Kalista can dash after using this Ability using Martial Poise.

spells.name: Sentinel
spells.summary: Gain bonus damage when Kalista and her Oathsworn strike the same target. Activate to send a soul to scout out the path, revealing the area in front of it.
spells.text: Passive: When Kalista and her Oathsworn both Attack the same target, she deals 10/12/14/16/18% max Health magic damage. This effect has a 10 second Cooldown per target and a cap of 100/125/150/175/200 to non-champions. Active: Kalista sends a ghost to patrol an area for three laps. Champions spotted are revealed for 4 seconds. This ability has 2 charges (90/80/70/60/50 second refresh).

spells.name: Rend
spells.summary: Attacks impale their targets with spears. Activate to rip the spears out, slowing and dealing escalating damage.
spells.text: Passive: Kalista's spears linger in their target for 4 seconds, stacking any number of times. Active: Kalista rips the spears from nearby enemies, dealing (5/15/25/35/45 + (70% Attack Damage) + (65% Ability Power)) plus (7/14/21/28/35 + (20/27.5/35/42.5/50% Attack Damage) + (50% Ability Power)) physical damage per spear beyond the first. Slows enemies hit by (10/18/26/34/42% + (5% per 100 Ability Power)) for 2 seconds. If this Ability kills at least one target, its Cooldown is refreshed and it refunds 10/15/20/25/30 Mana. This Ability deals 50% damage to epic jungle monsters.

spells.name: Fate's Call
spells.summary: Kalista teleports the Oathsworn ally to herself. They gain the ability to dash toward a position, knocking enemy champions back.
spells.text: Kalista puts her Oathsworn into Stasis and draws them to herself for up to 4 seconds. The Oathsworn can click to launch themselves, stopping at the first champion hit and Knocking Back all nearby enemies. If the Oathsworn hits a champion, they are placed at their maximum attack range from it.

spells.name: Gathering Fire
spells.summary: Karma's damaging abilities will reduce the cooldown of Mantra.
spells.text: Karma begins the game with a point in Mantra. She reduces the Cooldown of Mantra by 4 seconds when she damages a champion with an Ability.

spells.name: Inner Flame
spells.summary: Karma sends forth a ball of spirit energy that explodes and deals damage upon hitting an enemy unit. Mantra Bonus: In addition to the explosion, Mantra increases the destructive power of her Inner Flame, creating a cataclysm which deals damage after a short delay.
spells.text: Karma fires a blast of energy, dealing (60/110/160/210/260 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage to the first target hit and surrounding enemies, and Slowing them by 40% for 1.5 seconds.

spells.name: Focused Resolve
spells.summary: Karma creates a tether between herself and a targeted enemy, dealing damage and revealing them. If the tether is not broken, the enemy will be rooted and damaged again. Mantra Bonus: Karma strengthens the link, healing herself and extending the root duration.
spells.text: Karma tethers herself to a champion or jungle monster, dealing (40/65/90/115/140 + (45% Ability Power)) magic damage and revealing them for 2s. If the tether remains unbroken, the target takes (40/65/90/115/140 + (45% Ability Power)) magic damage again and is Rooted for 1.6/1.7/1.8/1.9/2s.

spells.name: Inspire
spells.summary: Karma summons a protective shield that absorbs incoming damage and increases the Move Speed of the protected ally. Mantra Bonus: Energy radiates out from her target, strengthening the initial shield and applying Inspire to nearby allied champions.
spells.text: Karma grants an allied champion (80/130/180/230/280 + (60% Ability Power)) Shield for 2.5s and 40% Move Speed for 2s.

spells.name: Mantra
spells.summary: Karma empowers her next ability to do an additional effect. Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point.
spells.text: Karma empowers her next Ability used within 8 seconds. Inner Flame: Deals an additional (40/100/160/220 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage and leaves behind a circle of flame, Slowing enemies and dealing an additional (40/130/220/310 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage.Focused Resolve: Karma will restore (17% + (1% per 100 Ability Power)) missing Health at the beginning and end of the tether, and Root for 0.5/0.75/1/1.25s longer.Inspire: Karma shields her target for (45/85/125/165 + (45% Ability Power)) more Shield, and also shields allies near her target, granting them (45/85/125/165 + (45% Ability Power)) Shield and 15% Move Speed.

spells.name: Death Defied
spells.summary: Upon dying, Karthus enters a spirit form that allows him to continue casting spells.
spells.text: When Karthus dies he can use his Abilities for free for 7 seconds.

spells.name: Lay Waste
spells.summary: Karthus unleashes a delayed blast at a location, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Deals increased damage to isolated enemies.
spells.text: Karthus creates a blast of magic, dealing (40/59/78/97/116 + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage. If the blast hits only one enemy, it instead deals (80/118/156/194/232 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Wall of Pain
spells.summary: Karthus creates a passable screen of leeching energy. Any enemy units that walk through the screen have their Move Speed and Magic Resist reduced for a period.
spells.text: Karthus creates a wall that lasts for 5 seconds. Enemies that pass through lose 25% Magic Resist for 5 seconds and are Slowed by 40/50/60/70/80% decaying over the duration.

spells.name: Defile
spells.summary: Karthus passively steals energy from his victims, gaining Mana on each kill. Alternatively, Karthus can surround himself in the souls of his prey, dealing damage to nearby enemies, but quickly draining his own Mana.
spells.text: Passive: When Karthus kills a unit, he restores 10/20/30/40/50 Mana. Toggle: Karthus creates a necrotic aura, dealing (30/50/70/90/110 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage per second to nearby enemies.

spells.name: Requiem
spells.summary: After channeling for 3 seconds, Karthus deals damage to all enemy champions.
spells.text: Karthus channels for 3 seconds, then deals (200/350/500 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemy champions, regardless of distance.

spells.name: Void Stone
spells.summary: Kassadin takes reduced magic damage and ignores unit collision.
spells.text: Kassadin takes 10% reduced magic damage and is Ghosted.

spells.name: Null Sphere
spells.summary: Kassadin fires an orb of void energy at a target, dealing damage and interrupting channels. The excess energy forms around himself, granting a temporary shield that absorbs magic damage.
spells.text: Kassadin fires an orb of void energy, dealing (65/95/125/155/185 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage and interrupting channels. Kassadin also gains (80/110/140/170/200 + (30% Ability Power)) Magic Shield for 1.5 seconds.

spells.name: Nether Blade
spells.summary: Passive: Kassadin's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage. Active: Kassadin's next basic attack deals significant bonus magic damage and restores Mana.
spells.text: Passive: Kassadin's Attacks deal an additional (25 + (10% Ability Power)) magic damage. Active: Kassadin charges his blade, causing his next Attack to deal (50/75/100/125/150 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage and restore 4/4.5/5/5.5/6% missing Mana, increased to 20/22.5/25/27.5/30% against champions.

spells.name: Force Pulse
spells.summary: Kassadin draws energy from spells cast in his vicinity. Upon charging up, Kassadin can use Force Pulse to damage and slow enemies in a cone in front of him.
spells.text: Passive: Force Pulse's Cooldown is reduced by 0.75 second whenever any Ability is used near Kassadin. Active: Kassadin unleashes a void pulse, dealing (70/100/130/160/190 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing by 50/55/60/65/70% for 1 second.

spells.name: Riftwalk
spells.summary: Kassadin teleports to a nearby location dealing damage to nearby enemy units. Multiple Riftwalks in a short period of time cost additional Mana but also deal additional damage.
spells.text: Kassadin teleports to a nearby location, dealing (80/95/110 + (50% Ability Power) + (2% Mana)) magic damage. Each subsequent use of this Ability within the next 15 seconds doubles the Mana cost and deals an additional (35/45/55 + (7% Ability Power) + (1% Mana)) magic damage. The cost and damage increases can stack up to 4 times.

spells.name: Voracity
spells.summary: Whenever an enemy champion dies that Katarina has damaged recently, her remaining ability cooldowns are dramatically reduced. If Katarina picks up a Dagger, she uses it to slash through all nearby enemies, dealing magic damage.
spells.text: Whenever an enemy champion dies that Katarina has damaged in the last 3 seconds, her Ability Cooldowns are reduced by 15 seconds. If Katarina picks up a Dagger, she uses it to slash through all nearby enemies, dealing ((0 ~ 223.754) + (60% bonus Attack Damage) + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Bouncing Blade
spells.summary: Katarina throws a Dagger at the target that then bounces to nearby enemies before ricocheting onto the ground.
spells.text: Katarina throws a Dagger, dealing (80/115/150/185/220 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage to the target and 2 nearby enemies. The Dagger then ricochets onto the ground behind the primary target.

spells.name: Preparation
spells.summary: Katarina gains a burst of Move Speed, tossing a Dagger into the air directly above herself.
spells.text: Katarina tosses a Dagger into the air and gains 50/60/70/80/90% Move Speed decaying over 1.25 seconds.

spells.name: Shunpo
spells.summary: Katarina blinks to the target, striking it if its an enemy, or striking the nearest enemy otherwise.
spells.text: Katarina blinks in the wink of an eye to the target ally, enemy, or Dagger. If it is an enemy, Katarina strikes for (20/30/40/50/60 + (25% Ability Power) + (40% Attack Damage)) magic damage - otherwise she strikes the nearest enemy in range. Picking up a Dagger will reduce this Ability's Cooldown by 11.52/10.56/9.6/8.64/7.68 seconds (96%). Katarina can blink to any location near the target. The strike Applies On-Hit Effects.

spells.name: Death Lotus
spells.summary: Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, dealing massive magic damage while she channels to the 3 nearest enemy champions.
spells.text: Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, rapidly attacking the three nearest enemy champions with a flurry of knives. Each knife deals (25/37.5/50 + (19% Ability Power)) magic damage and (16% bonus Attack Damage) physical damage, and applies 40% Grievous Wounds for 3 seconds. Total over 2.5 seconds to each enemy: (375/562.5/750 + (285% Ability Power)) magic damage and (240% bonus Attack Damage) physical damage. This Ability applies On-Hit and On-Attack effects at 25/30/35% damage, and does not Critically Strike or apply Life Steal. The physical damage additionally increases with Attack Speed.

spells.name: Divine Ascent
spells.summary: Kayle's attacks are empowered by the heavens as she levels up and spends skill points. Her wings are lit aflame as she progressively gains Attack Speed, Move Speed, Attack Range, and waves of fire on her attacks.
spells.text: Kayle's attacks rank up as she gains levels and spends skill points. Level 1 - Zealous: Attacks grant 6% Attack Speed for 5 seconds (max 5 stacks). At max stacks Kayle becomes Exalted, gaining 10% Move Speed. Level 6 - Arisen: Attack range is increased to 525. Level 11 - Aflame: Exalted attacks launch fire waves that deal ((20 ~ 41) + (25% Ability Power) + (10% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage. Level 16 - Transcendent: Become permanently Exalted. Attack range is increased to 625.

spells.name: Radiant Blast
spells.summary: Kayle conjures a portal, summoning a celestial sword that pierces through enemies, slowing, damaging, and reducing the resistances of all hit.
spells.text: Kayle fires a celestial sword that stops on the first enemy hit, dealing (60/90/120/150/180 + (50% Ability Power) + (60% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage, Slowing by 25/30/35/40/45% for 2 seconds, and removing 15% Armor and Magic Resist for 4 seconds from the target and enemies behind them.

spells.name: Celestial Blessing
spells.summary: Blessed by the divine, Kayle heals and grants Move Speed to herself and the nearest ally.
spells.text: Kayle infuses herself and an allied champion with light, restoring (55/80/105/130/155 + (25% Ability Power)) Health and granting (24/28/32/36/40% + (8% per 100 Ability Power)) Move Speed for 2 seconds. If cast without a target, this Ability will heal the most wounded ally in range.

spells.name: Starfire Spellblade
spells.summary: Passive: Kayle's celestial sword, Virtue, deals bonus magic damage to enemies she attacks. Active: Kayle's next attack smites her target with celestial fire, dealing bonus damage proportionate to their missing health.
spells.text: Passive: Attacks deal an additional (15/20/25/30/35 + (20% Ability Power) + (10% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage. Active: Kayle's next attack becomes ranged and deals an additional (8/8.5/9/9.5/10% + (1.5% per 100 Ability Power)) missing Health magic damage. This attack upgrades when Kayle reaches Level 11, causing it to explode when it hits the target, dealing damage to nearby enemies. This Ability applies on-hit and spell effects. Max 400 bonus damage vs. jungle monsters.

spells.name: Divine Judgment
spells.summary: Kayle makes an ally invulnerable and calls upon former Aspects of Justice to purify the area around her target with a holy rain of swords.
spells.text: Kayle makes an allied champion Invulnerable for 2.5 seconds and then purifies the area around them, dealing (200/300/400 + (70% Ability Power) + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage to nearby enemies.

spells.name: The Darkin Scythe
spells.summary: Kayn wields an ancient weapon and fights Rhaast, the darkin within it, for control. Either the Darkin will triumph, or Kayn will master Rhaast and become the Shadow Assassin. Darkin: Heal for a percentage of spell damage dealt to champions. Shadow Assassin: For the first few seconds in combat with enemy champions, deal bonus damage.
spells.text: Kayn the Shadow Assassin fights Rhaast the Darkin Slayer for control. One will win, the other will die. Damaging ranged champions charges the Shadow Assassin, and damaging melee champions charges the Darkin Slayer. At full charge, Kayn can permanently transform at his fountain. Shadow Assassin: After entering combat Kayn's Attacks and Abilities deal an additional (20% ~ 40%) damage dealt magic damage for 3 seconds. This only occurs if Kayn has been out of combat for 8 seconds or used Umbral Trespass. Darkin Slayer: Kayn heals for (25% + (0.5% per 100 bonus Health)) of physical damage dealt to champions.

spells.name: Reaping Slash
spells.summary: Kayn dashes, then slashes. Both deal damage.
spells.text: Kayn dashes then spins his scythe, dealing (75/105/135/165/195 + (85% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to enemies he passes through, then deals the damage again to nearby enemies. Kayn dashes then spins his scythe, dealing (75/105/135/165/195 + (85% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to enemies he passes through, then deals the damage again to nearby enemies. Darkin Slayer: Instead deal (65% Attack Damage) plus (6% + (3.5% per 100 bonus Attack Damage)) max Health physical damage. Deals an additional 40 physical damage to minions and jungle monsters (max: 200/250/300/350/400).

spells.name: Blade's Reach
spells.summary: Kayn damages and slows targets in a line.
spells.text: Kayn swipes his scythe upward, dealing (85/130/175/220/265 + (110% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and Slowing enemies hit by 90%, decaying over 1.5 seconds. Shadow Assassin: Kayn can move while using this Ability and increases its range. Kayn swipes his scythe upward, dealing (85/130/175/220/265 + (110% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and Slowing enemies hit by 90%, decaying over 1.5 seconds. Darkin Slayer: Additionally Knocks Up enemies hit for 1 second.

spells.name: Shadow Step
spells.summary: Kayn can walk through terrain.
spells.text: Kayn gains 40% Move Speed, becomes Ghosted, and can move through Terrain for 7/7.5/8/8.5/9 seconds. When he first enters terrain, he restores (90/100/110/120/130 + (45% bonus Attack Damage)) Health. Being Immobilized and spending more than 1.5 consecutive seconds outside of Terrain ends this Ability early. Shadow Assassin: Gain 70% Move Speed, Slow immunity, and reduce the Cooldown to 10 seconds. Kayn gains 40% Move Speed, becomes Ghosted, and can move through Terrain for 7/7.5/8/8.5/9 seconds. When he first enters terrain, he restores (90/100/110/120/130 + (45% bonus Attack Damage)) Health. Being Immobilized and spending more than 1.5 consecutive seconds outside of Terrain ends this Ability early. Ghosted units can pass through other units. Maximum duration in combat with enemy champions is 1.5 seconds.

spells.name: Umbral Trespass
spells.summary: Kayn hides in an enemy's body, dealing massive damage when he bursts out.
spells.text: Passive: Champions damaged by Kayn are marked for 3.15 seconds. Kayn infests a marked enemy, becoming Untargetable. After 2.5 seconds or after Recasting, Kayn bursts out, dealing (150/250/350 + (150% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to the enemy. Shadow Assassin: Increases this Ability's range, the distance Kayn exits, and refreshes The Darkin Scythe's Cooldown on exit. Passive: Champions damaged by Kayn are marked for 3.15 seconds. Kayn infests a marked enemy, becoming Untargetable. After 2.5 seconds or after Recasting, Kayn bursts out, dealing (150/250/350 + (150% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to the enemy. Darkin Slayer: Instead deals (15% + (0.1% bonus Attack Damage)) max Health physical damage and restores (11.25% + (7.5% per 100 bonus Attack Damage)) Health (75% damage amount). Untargetable units won't be affected by enemy Attacks or Abilities unless they've already been hit by them.

spells.name: Mark of the Storm
spells.summary: Kennen stuns enemies he hits 3 times with his abilities.
spells.text: Kennen's abilities apply a stack for 6 seconds. At 3 stacks, enemies are Stunned for 1.25 seconds and Kennen gains 25 Energy.

spells.name: Thundering Shuriken
spells.summary: Kennen throws a fast moving shuriken towards a location, causing damage and adding a Mark of the Storm to any opponent that it hits.
spells.text: Kennen throws a shuriken, dealing (75/125/175/225/275 + (75% Ability Power)) magic damage to the first enemy hit.

spells.name: Electrical Surge
spells.summary: Kennen passively deals extra damage and adds a Mark of the Storm to his target every few attacks, and he can activate this ability to damage and add another Mark of the Storm to targets who are already marked.
spells.text: Passive: Every 5th Attack deals an additional (35/45/55/65/75 + (35% Ability Power) + (80/90/100/110/120% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage On-Hit. Active: Kennen sends out a blast of electricity, dealing (70/95/120/145/170 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage to nearby enemies affected by Mark of the Storm. The passive also applies Mark of the Storm and can critically strike for (35/45/55/65/75 + (35% Ability Power) + (80/90/100/110/120% bonus Attack Damage)) × (1.4 + 40% bonus Critical Strike Damage) instead. Attacking structures will stack the passive, but not expend it. The active automatically hits enemies inside of Slicing Maelstrom.

spells.name: Lightning Rush
spells.summary: Kennen morphs into a lightning form, enabling him to pass through units and apply a Mark of the Storm. Kennen gains Move Speed when entering this form, and attack speed when leaving it.
spells.text: Kennen turns into a ball of lightning, gaining 100% Move Speed, dealing (80/120/160/200/240 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies he passes through, and becoming Ghosted for 2 seconds. If Kennen damages at least one enemy, he gains 40 Energy. After this ability ends, Kennen gains 40/50/60/70/80% Attack Speed for 4 seconds. Critical Strikes extend this duration by 1 second(s). Kennen can Recast to end this Ability early. Ghosted units can pass through other units. Deals 65% damage to minions and jungle monsters. Duration cannot be extended beyond its initial value.

spells.name: Slicing Maelstrom
spells.summary: Kennen summons a storm that strikes at nearby enemy champions for magical damage.
spells.text: Kennen unleashes a magical storm, dealing (40/80/120 + (25% Ability Power)) magic damage to all nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds, and gaining 25/50/75 Armor and 25/50/75 Magic Resist for 3 seconds. Successive hits deal 10% increased damage for each hit the enemy has already suffered. Enemies can only receive 3 stacks of Mark of the Storm from this ability.

spells.name: Unseen Threat
spells.summary: Nearby enemies that are Isolated from their allies are marked. Kha'Zix's abilities have interactions with Isolated targets. When Kha'Zix is not visible to the enemy team, he gains Unseen Threat, causing his next basic attack against an enemy champion to deal bonus magic damage and slow them for a few seconds.
spells.text: When Kha'Zix is not visible to the enemy team, his next Attack against a champion deals an additional ((15 ~ 134) + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage and Slows by 25% for 2 seconds. Enemies with no nearby allies become Isolated.

spells.name: Taste Their Fear
spells.summary: Deals physical damage to the target. Damage increased on Isolated targets. If he chooses to Evolve Reaper Claws, this refunds a percent of it's cooldown against Isolated targets. Kha'Zix also gains increased range on his basic attacks and Taste Their Fear.
spells.text: Kha'Zix slashes a nearby enemy, dealing (80/105/130/155/180 + (105% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. This deals (168/220.5/273/325.5/378 + (220.5% bonus Attack Damage)) damage instead to enemies Isolated from their allies.

spells.name: Void Spike
spells.summary: Kha'Zix fires exploding spikes that deal physical damage to enemies hit. Kha'Zix is healed if he is also within the explosion radius. If he chooses to Evolve Spike Racks, Void Spike now fires three spikes in a cone, slow enemies hit, and reveals enemy champions hit for 2 seconds. Isolated targets are slowed for extra.
spells.text: Kha'Zix fires a spike dealing (75/105/135/165/195 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first enemy hit in a small area. If Kha'Zix is inside the area, he restores (55/75/95/115/135 + (50% Ability Power)) Health

spells.name: Leap
spells.summary: Kha'Zix leaps to an area, dealing physical damage upon landing. If he chooses to Evolve Wings, Leap's range increases by 200 and the cooldown resets on champion kill or assist.
spells.text: Kha'Zix leaps, dealing (65/100/135/170/205 + (40% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage upon landing.

spells.name: Void Assault
spells.summary: Each rank allows Kha'Zix to evolve one of his abilities, giving it a unique additional effect. When activated, Kha'Zix becomes Invisible, triggering Unseen Threat and increasing Move Speed. If he chooses to Evolve Adaptive Cloaking, Void Assault gains increased Invisibility duration, and an additional use.
spells.text: Active: Kha'Zix becomes Invisible for 1.25 seconds and gains 40% Move Speed. Kha'zix may Recast this Ability once within 12 seconds. Passive: Leveling up this Ability allows Kha'zix to Evolve one of his Abilities, granting it additional effects.Taste Their Fear: Gain Ability range, Attack range, and lowers Cooldown by 45% against Isolated targets.Void Spike: Fires 3 spikes and Slows by 40%, increased against Isolated targets.Leap: Increased range and refreshes Cooldown on champion takedown.Void Assault: Invisibility duration lasts 2 seconds and gains second Recast. Invisible units cannot be revealed except by turrets or True Sight.

spells.name: Mark of the Kindred
spells.summary: Kindred can mark targets to Hunt. Successfully completing a Hunt permanently empowers Kindred's basic abilities. Every 4 hunts completed also increases Kindred's basic attack range.
spells.text: Kindred can designate a champion to hunt by clicking their portrait above their inventory. They also designate certain jungle monsters to hunt with an icon on the minimap automatically. Getting a takedown on a hunted target grants Kindred a Mark, empowering them. After 4 Marks, Kindred gains 75 Attack Range. Every 3 Marks after the fourth grants a further 25 Attack Range. Marks empower Kindred's basic Abilities:Dance of Arrows grants an additional 5% Attack SpeedWolf's Frenzy deal an additional 1% current Health damage.Mounting Dread deal an additional 0.5% missing Health damage.

spells.name: Dance of Arrows
spells.summary: Kindred tumbles and shoots up to three arrows at nearby targets.
spells.text: Kindred vaults, firing an arrow at up to 3 enemies, dealing (40/65/90/115/140 + (75% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and gaining 40% Attack Speed for 4 seconds. While inside of Wolf's Frenzy, this Ability's Cooldown is reduced to 4/3.5/3/2.5/2 seconds. Attack Speed scales with Marks taken.

spells.name: Wolf's Frenzy
spells.summary: Wolf enrages and attacks enemies around him. Lamb passively gains stacks by moving and attacking. When fully charged, Lamb's next attack restores health.
spells.text: Passive: Kindred gains stacks as they move and attack. At 100 stacks, Kindred's next Attack restores up to 47 Health based on their missing Health. Active: Kindred claims a territory, ordering Wolf to bite at the last enemy Lamb Attacked. Wolf's bites deal (25/30/35/40/45 + (20% bonus Attack Damage) + (20% Ability Power)) plus 2.5% current Health magic damage. Wolf strikes faster based on Kindred's Attack Speed. Against jungle monsters, Wolf deals 50% increased damage and Slows them by 50% for 2 seconds.

spells.name: Mounting Dread
spells.summary: Lamb fires a carefully placed shot, slowing the target. If Lamb attacks the target two more times, her third attack instead directs Wolf to pounce on the enemy, savaging them for massive damage.
spells.text: Kindred weakens an enemy, Slowing them by (30 + (5% Ability Power))for 1 second. Kindred's third Attack against the target within 4 seconds of each other directs Wolf to pounce on the enemy, dealing an additional (80/110/140/170/200 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) plus 5.5% missing Health physical damage. Damage is increased by Critical Strike Chance and Damage at 50% effectiveness. Missing health damage is capped at 200 against jungle monsters.

spells.name: Lamb's Respite
spells.summary: Lamb grants all living things inside a zone a respite from death. Until the effect ends, nothing can die. At the end, units are healed.
spells.text: Kindred blesses the ground for 4 seconds, allowing no unit, ally, enemy, or neutral to die while inside. Upon reaching 10% Health, units can't be damaged or healed while still inside the zone. When the blessing ends, all units inside heal for 225/300/375 Health.

spells.name: Skaarl, the Cowardly Lizard
spells.summary: Kled rides his trusty steed, Skaarl, who takes damage for him. When Skaarl's health depletes, Kled dismounts. While dismounted, Kled's abilities change and he deals less damage to champions. Kled can restore Skaarl's courage by fighting enemies. At maximum courage, Kled remounts with a portion of Skaarl's health.
spells.text: Mounted: Kled's mount Skaarl takes damage instead of Kled. When his Health depletes, Kled dismounts. Dismounted: Kled replaces Bear Trap on a Rope, gains 70 Move Speed toward enemy champions, and he gains (4 + (1% bonus Health)) bonus Armor and Magic Resist, increased by 30% for each nearby enemy Champion, up to (10 + (2.5% bonus Health)). While dismounted, Kled's attacks deal 0% reduced damage to Champions. Kled gains 15 Courage by Attacking champions, 5 Courage by Attacking epic monsters and structures, and 5 Courage by killing minions. At max Courage Kled remounts with 70% of Skaarl's Health, once every 30 seconds.

spells.name: Bear Trap on a Rope
spells.summary: Kled throws a bear trap that damages and hooks an enemy champion. If shackled for a short duration, the target takes additional physical damage and is yanked toward Kled. When dismounted, this ability is replaced by Pocket Pistol, a ranged gun blast that knocks back Kled and restores courage.
spells.text: Mounted: Kled throws a bear trap that deals (30/55/80/105/130 + (60% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and hooks onto the first enemy champion or large jungle monster hit. If Kled stays near a hooked enemy for 1.75 seconds, he yanks out the trap, dealing (60/110/160/210/260 + (120% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage, Pulling them, and Slowing by 30/35/40/45/50% for 2.5 seconds. While hooked, Kled has True Sight to the enemy. Deals 150% damage to minions.

spells.name: Violent Tendencies
spells.summary: Kled gains massive attack speed for four attacks. The fourth attack deals more damage.
spells.text: Passive: Kled's next Attack grants 150% Attack Speed for four Attacks or 4 seconds. The fourth hit deals an additional 20/30/40/50/60 plus (4.5/5/5.5/6/6.5% + (2% per 100 bonus Attack Damage) + (0.4% per 100 bonus Health)) max Health physical damage. Max Health damage is capped at 200 physical damage against monsters. While on Cooldown, Attacks reduce this Ability's Cooldown by 0.5 second(s). Against Champions, this Cooldown reduction is increased to 1.5 second(s).

spells.name: Jousting
spells.summary: Kled dashes, dealing physical damage and gaining a short burst of speed. Kled can cast this ability again to dash back through his initial target, dealing the same damage.
spells.text: Kled dashes, dealing (35/60/85/110/135 + (55% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to enemies he passes through, pulling minions and small monsters towards him. If this Ability hits an enemy champion or large jungle monster, Kled gains 50% Move Speed for 1 second(s) and can Recast within 3 seconds to dash back through the same target. Kled gains True Sight to enemies he passes through.

spells.name: Chaaaaaaaarge!!!
spells.summary: Kled and Skaarl charge to a location, leaving a speed-granting trail behind them and gaining a shield. Skaarl locks onto and rams the first enemy champion encountered.
spells.text: Kled charges toward an area, leaving a trail that grants allies increasing Move Speed. While charging and for 2 seconds after Kled gains up to (200/300/400 + (300% bonus Attack Damage)) Shield. Skaarl rams the first enemy champion encountered, dealing (4/6/8% + (3% per 100 bonus Attack Damage)) to (12/18/24% + (9% per 100 bonus Attack Damage)) max Health magic damage (based on distance travelled) and briefly Knocking Back. The damage, Move Speed, and Shield reach their max values after 3 second(s) of charging.

spells.name: Icathian Surprise
spells.summary: 4 seconds after dying, Kogmaw explodes, dealing true damage to surrounding enemies.
spells.text: For 4 seconds after dying, Kog'Maw can continue to move, can move through units, and gains 10% Move Speed, increasing to 50% Move Speed over the duration. At the end of the duration, he explodes and deals (140 ~ 650) true damage to nearby enemies.

spells.name: Caustic Spittle
spells.summary: Kog'Maw launches a corrosive projectile which deals magic damage and corrodes the target's armor and magic resist for a short time. Kog'Maw also gains additional attack speed.
spells.text: Passive: Kog'Maw gains 5/10/15/20/25% Attack Speed. Active: Kog'Maw vomits a corrosive projectile that deals (80/125/170/215/260 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage to the first enemy hit and shreds 16/20/24/28/32% Armor and Magic Resist for 4 seconds.

spells.name: Bio-Arcane Barrage
spells.summary: Kog'Maw's attacks gain range and deal a percent of the target's maximum health as magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit.
spells.text: Kog'Maw gains 130/150/170/190/210 Attack Range and his Attacks deal an additional (3/3.75/4.5/5.25/6% + (1.5% per 100 Ability Power)) max Health magic damage On-Hit for 8 seconds. Deals a maximum of 100 magic damage to Monsters.

spells.name: Void Ooze
spells.summary: Kog'Maw launches a peculiar ooze which damages all enemies it passes through and leaves a trail which slows enemies who stand on it.
spells.text: Kog'Maw spits bile, dealing (70/110/150/190/230 + (65% Ability Power)) magic damage and leaving a trail of ooze for 3 seconds. Enemies in the ooze are Slowed by 40/45/50/55/60%.

spells.name: Living Artillery
spells.summary: Kog'Maw fires an artillery shell at a great distance dealing magic damage (increased significantly on low health enemies) and revealing non-stealthed targets. Additionally, multiple Living Artilleries in a short period of time cause them to cost additional Mana.
spells.text: Kog'Maw shoots acid at an area, dealing (100/140/180 + (35/40/45% Ability Power) + (75% bonus Attack Damage)) plus 0.833% per 1% missing Health magic damage and revealing enemies hit for 2 seconds. Enemies below 40% Health instead take (200/280/360 + (70/80/90% Ability Power) + (150% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage. Subsequent shots within 8 seconds cost an additional 40 Mana (max: 400 Mana).

spells.name: Mirror Image
spells.summary: When LeBlanc drops below 40% Health, she becomes invisible for 1 second and creates a Mirror Image that deals no damage and lasts for up to 8 seconds.
spells.text: When LeBlanc drops below 40% Health, she becomes Invisible for 1 second and creates a harmless clone for 8 seconds. LeBlanc can move the clone with the "Alt" key.

spells.name: Sigil of Malice
spells.summary: LeBlanc projects a sigil, dealing damage and marking the target for 3.5 seconds. Damaging the marked target with an ability detonates the sigil, dealing additional damage. If either part kills the target, Leblanc refunds the Mana cost and part of this spell's remaining Cooldown.
spells.text: LeBlanc projects a sigil to an enemy, dealing (65/90/115/140/165 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage and marking them for 3.5 seconds. Damaging the marked enemy with an Ability detonates the sigil, dealing (65/90/115/140/165 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage. If either part kills the target, Leblanc refunds 100% of the Mana cost and 30% of this spell's remaining Cooldown. The initial sigil deals an additional 10 damage to minions.

spells.name: Distortion
spells.summary: LeBlanc dashes to a location, dealing damage to enemies near her destination. For the next 4 seconds, activate Distortion again to return LeBlanc to her starting location.
spells.text: LeBlanc dashes then deals (75/115/155/195/235 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage to nearby enemies. For 4 seconds after dashing, LeBlanc can Recast. Recast: LeBlanc returns to her starting location.

spells.name: Ethereal Chains
spells.summary: LeBlanc launches a chain that shackles the first enemy hit. If the target remains shackled for 1.5 seconds, LeBlanc roots them and deals additional damage.
spells.text: LeBlanc launches a chain that shackles the first enemy hit, dealing (50/70/90/110/130 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage and granting True Sight. If they remain shackled for 1.5 seconds, LeBlanc Roots them for 1.5 seconds and deals an additional (80/120/160/200/240 + (85% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Mimic
spells.summary: LeBlanc casts a mimicked version of one of her basic spells.
spells.text: LeBlanc mimics her most recent Ability, using it again. The mimicked Ability deals increased damage. Mimicked Sigil of Malice deals (70/150/230 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage when applied, and (140/300/460 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage when consumed. Mimicked Distortion deals (150/315/480 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage. Mimicked Ethereal Chains deals (70/150/230 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage when shackled and (140/300/460 + (85% Ability Power)) magic damage when Rooting.

spells.name: Flurry
spells.summary: After Lee Sin uses an ability, his next 2 basic attacks gain Attack Speed and return Energy.
spells.text: Lee Sin's Abilities grant him 40% Attack Speed for two Attacks. The first Attack restores (20 ~ 40) Energy and the second restores (10 ~ 20) Energy.

spells.name: Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike
spells.summary: Sonic Wave: Lee Sin projects a discordant wave of sound to locate his enemies, dealing physical damage to the first enemy it encounters. If Sonic Wave hits, Lee Sin can cast Resonating Strike for the next 3 seconds. Resonating Strike: Lee Sin dashes to the enemy hit by Sonic Wave, dealing physical damage based on the target's missing Health.
spells.text: Lee Sin projects a discordant wave of sound, dealing (60/90/120/150/180 + (90% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first enemy hit, granting True Sight of them, and allows Lee Sin to Recast for the next 3 seconds. Recast: Lee Sin dashes to the enemy hit by the sound wave, dealing between (60/90/120/150/180 + (90% bonus Attack Damage)) to (120/180/240/300/360 + (180% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage scaling with the target's missing Health.

spells.name: Safeguard / Iron Will
spells.summary: Safeguard: Lee Sin rushes to target ally, shielding himself from damage. If the ally is a champion, they are also shielded. After using Safeguard, Lee Sin can cast Iron Will. Iron Will: Lee Sin's intense training allows him to thrive in battle. Lee Sin gains Omnivamp.
spells.text: Lee Sin dashes to an ally or ward. If the target is a champion, Lee Sin grants them and himself (60/105/150/195/240 + (80% Ability Power)) Shield for 2 seconds. Lee Sin may Recast for the next 3 seconds. Recast: Lee Sin gains 10/14/18/22/26% Omnivamp for 4 seconds.

spells.name: Tempest / Cripple
spells.summary: Tempest: Lee Sin smashes the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage and reveals enemy units hit. If Tempest hits an enemy, Lee Sin can cast cripple. Cripple: Lee Sin cripples nearby enemies damaged by Tempest, reducing their Move Speed. Move Speed recovers gradually over the duration.
spells.text: Lee Sin smashes the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals (35/60/85/110/135 + (90% Attack Damage)) magic damage and reveals them for 4 seconds. If this hits an enemy, Lee Sin can Recast for the next 3 seconds. Recast: Lee Sin Slows nearby enemies struck by the shockwave by 35/45/55/65/75% decaying over 4 seconds.

spells.name: Dragon's Rage
spells.summary: Lee Sin performs a powerful roundhouse kick launching his target back, dealing physical damage to the target and any enemies they collide with. Enemies the target collides with are knocked into the air for a short duration. This technique was taught to him by Jesse Perring, although Lee Sin does not kick players off the map.
spells.text: Lee Sin performs a powerful roundhouse kick Knocking Back an enemy champion and dealing (175/400/625 + (200% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. Enemies the target collides with are briefly Knocked Up and take (175/400/625 + (200% bonus Attack Damage)) plus 12/15/18% of the kicked enemy's bonus Health as physical damage. The target is Rooted during the cast time.

spells.name: Sunlight
spells.summary: Damaging spells afflict enemies with Sunlight for 1.5 seconds. When allied Champions deal damage to those targets, they consume the Sunlight to deal additional magic damage.
spells.text: Leona's abilities mark enemies for 2.5 seconds. Other allied champions consume the mark when they damage the marked enemy, dealing an additional (25 ~ 144) magic damage.

spells.name: Shield of Daybreak
spells.summary: Leona uses her shield to perform her next basic attack, dealing bonus magic damage and stunning the target.
spells.text: Leona's next Attack Stuns for 1 seconds and deals an additional (10/35/60/85/110 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage. The Attack must be used within 6 seconds or it is lost.

spells.name: Eclipse
spells.summary: Leona raises her shield to gain Damage Reduction, Armor, and Magic Resist. When the duration first ends, if there are nearby enemies, she will deal magic damage to them and prolong the duration of the effect.
spells.text: Leona raises her shield, reducing incoming damage by 8/12/16/20/24 and gaining (20/27.5/35/42.5/50 + (20% bonus Armor)) Armor and (20/27.5/35/42.5/50 + (20% bonus Magic Resist)) Magic Resist for 3 seconds. Afterwards, her shield detonates, dealing (55/85/115/145/175 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage to nearby enemies. If she hits at least one, she retains the Armor and Magic Resist bonuses for an additional 3 seconds. Damage reduction effect can't reduce the damage below 50%.

spells.name: Zenith Blade
spells.summary: Leona projects a solar image of her sword, dealing magic damage to all enemies in a line. When the image fades, the last enemy champion struck will be briefly immobilized and Leona will dash to them.
spells.text: Leona thrusts with a sword of light, dealing (50/90/130/170/210 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage. The last champion struck will be Rooted for 0.5 seconds and Leona will dash to them.

spells.name: Solar Flare
spells.summary: Leona calls down a beam of solar energy, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Enemies in the center of the area are stunned, while enemies on the outside are slowed.
spells.text: Leona calls down a radiant beam of solar energy dealing (150/225/300 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing by 80% for 1.75 seconds. Enemies in the center of the flare are Stunned instead of Slowed.

spells.name: Dream-Laden Bough
spells.summary: Hitting a champion or monster with a skill will deal additional max Health damage over time.
spells.text: Lillia's Abilities apply Dream Dust, dealing (5% + (1.25% per 100 Ability Power)) max Health magic damage over 3 seconds. Lillia restores (39 + (15% Ability Power)) Health over the duration against large jungle monsters, and restores ((6 ~ 90) + (30% Ability Power)) Health against champions.

spells.name: Blooming Blows
spells.summary: Passively, Lillia gains stacking Move Speed when hitting enemies with spells. She can activate this to deal magic damage to nearby enemies, dealing extra true damage on the edge.
spells.text: Passive: Lillia's Ability hits grant (3/4/5/6/7% + (3% per 100 Ability Power)) Move Speed for 6.5 seconds, stacking up to 4 times. Active: Lillia whirls her censer, dealing (35/45/55/65/75 + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage, plus an additional (35/45/55/65/75 + (35% Ability Power)) true damage at the outer edge.

spells.name: Watch Out! Eep!
spells.summary: Lillia deals damage in a nearby area, dealing heavy damage in the center.
spells.text: Lillia winds up a huge strike, dealing (80/100/120/140/160 + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage. Enemies in the center take (240/300/360/420/480 + (105% Ability Power)) damage instead. Lillia does not dash over terrain with this ability. Deals 50% less damage to minions.

spells.name: Swirlseed
spells.summary: Lillia hurls a seed that damages and slows those it lands on. If it doesn't hit anything, it will continue rolling until it hits a wall or target.
spells.text: Lillia lobs a swirlseed overhead, dealing (60/85/110/135/160 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage where it lands and revealing and Slowing them by 40% for 3 seconds. If no enemies are hit, the seed rolls until it hits an enemy or collides with terrain.

spells.name: Lilting Lullaby
spells.summary: Lillia causes all enemies with Dream Dust on them to become Drowsy before falling asleep. Those enemies will take extra damage on being forcibly woken up.
spells.text: Lillia causes all enemy champions with Dream Dust to become Drowsy for 1.5 seconds. Afterward, they fall Asleep for 2.5 seconds. When awakened by damage, they take an additional (100/150/200 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage. Drowsy units are slowed over the duration, and fall Asleep afterwards. Asleep units can't move or act until damaged by an enemy with non-periodic damage.

spells.name: Iceborn Subjugation
spells.summary: When an enemy champion dies near Lissandra they become a Frozen Thrall. Frozen Thralls slow nearby enemies and then, after a delay, shatter from the intense cold, dealing magic damage to nearby targets.
spells.text: When an enemy champion dies near Lissandra they become a frozen zombie that seeks out living enemies. Enemies near these zombies are Slowed by 25%. After 4 seconds, frozen zombies shatter, dealing ((120 ~ 300) + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Ice Shard
spells.summary: Throws a spear of ice that shatters when it hits an enemy, dealing magic damage and slowing Move Speed. Shards pass through the target, dealing the same damage to other enemies hit.
spells.text: Lissandra throws a spear of ice that shatters on the first enemy hit, dealing (80/115/150/185/220 + (75% Ability Power)) magic damage, Slowing them by 20/24/28/32/36% for 1.5 seconds, and also damaging and slowing the enemies behind them.

spells.name: Ring of Frost
spells.summary: Freezes nearby enemies in ice, dealing magic damage and rooting them.
spells.text: Lissandra creates an ice field, Rooting nearby enemies for 1.25/1.35/1.45/1.55/1.65 seconds and dealing (70/105/140/175/210 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Glacial Path
spells.summary: Lissandra creates an ice claw that deals magic damage. Reactivating this ability transports Lissandra to the claw's current location.
spells.text: Lissandra casts forth an ice claw that deals (70/105/140/175/210 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. Lissandra can Recast while the claw travels to teleport to its location.

spells.name: Frozen Tomb
spells.summary: If cast on an enemy champion, the target is frozen solid, stunning it. If cast on Lissandra, she encases herself in dark ice, healing herself while becoming untargetable and invulnerable. Dark ice then emanates from the target dealing magic damage to enemies and slowing Move Speed.
spells.text: Lissandra encases herself or an enemy champion in ice. Enemies are Stunned for 1.5 seconds. When self cast, Lissandra enters Stasis for 2.5 seconds and restores (100/150/200 + (55% Ability Power)) Health, increased by 1% for each 1% missing Health. In either case, dark ice eminates from the target, dealing (150/250/350 + (75% Ability Power)) magic damage. The ice persists for 3 seconds, Slowing enemies by 45/60/75%. Units in Stasis cannot move or act, and are invulnerable and Untargetable. This Ability Knocks Down enemies.

spells.name: Silver Stake
spells.summary: Locke's attacks deal additional magic damage On-Hit, increased based on enemy missing Health.
spells.text: Locke's Attacks deal an additional ((5 ~ 40) + (10% Ability Power)) magic damage on-hit, increased up to ((10 ~ 80) + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage based on the target's missing Health.

spells.name: Ritual Nails
spells.summary: Locke readies a set of Soul Nails to throw, dealing damage to and marking enemies hit. Locke can consume the marks to deal bonus damage with his attacks.
spells.text: Locke readies a set of Soul Nails to throw, dealing (40/48/56/64/72 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage and marking enemies hit. Nails apply a 25/25/60% Slow for 1/1/2 seconds, stacking with the amount of nails hit. Attacking the enemy consumes the Soul Nails, dealing (18/26/34/42/50 + (25/27.5/30/32.5/35% Ability Power)) magic damage per stack, increased by 20% and 40% for two and three nails respectively. Each remaining nail refunds (20% ~ 35%) of Ability's Cooldown and Mana cost when this effect ends.

spells.name: Soul Ignition
spells.summary: Locke ignites his soul, gaining Attack Speed and Move Speed, and dealing damage to himself. At the end of the duration, Locke will heal back a portion of the damage he takes during the effect.
spells.text: Locke ignites his own soul, gaining (40% ~ 70%) Attack Speed and (40% + (2% per 100 Ability Power)) Move Speed that decays over 2 seconds. For 6 seconds, he suffers 2% current Health true damage per second but Heals back the last (40/60/80/100/120 + (100% Ability Power)) damage taken, and an additional ((40 ~ 200) + (20% Ability Power)) Health based on missing Health and time passed, up to a maximum of ((150 ~ 450) + (60% Ability Power)) Health remaining. Can be Recast to end early. This Ability can be used while Disabled. Locke is Ghosted for the duration. Ghosted units can pass through other units.

spells.name: Ashen Pursuit
spells.summary: Locke teleports to a location before dashing to attack his next target, dealing damage to enemies passed through.
spells.text: Locke teleports to a location, dealing (40/50/60/70/80 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage to nearby enemies on arrival. On his next Attack, he dashes to his target, dealing (40/60/80/100/120 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage to all enemies in his path. Each hit consumes Soul Nails. If Locke scores a takedown, the Cooldown of this Ability is reset.

spells.name: Purgatory
spells.summary: Locke throws a binding artifact that deals damage and potentially executes enemies hit. Locke gains additional power for sealing away enemy champions.
spells.text: Locke throws a binding artifact to a location, dealing (150/225/300 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing enemies in the area by 99%, decaying over 2 seconds. The artifact marks enemies hit for 5 seconds, sealing away marked enemy champions brought below 10.5/11.5/12.5%, and resetting the duration of the mark on other affected champions. After the duration ends, if at least one champion was sealed, the artifact lands on the ground. Locke can pick up the artifact to permanently increase its execution threshold by 0.5%, and refund 20% of his total Cooldown, for each champion sealed. The artifact will linger on the ground for this Ability's current Cooldown at the time of sealing.

spells.name: Lightslinger
spells.summary: Whenever Lucian uses an ability, his next attack becomes a double-shot. When Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally, or when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks will deal bonus magic damage.
spells.text: After using an Ability, Lucian's next Attack within 3.5 seconds will fire two shots. The second shot deals (60% Attack Damage) physical damage to the target, increased to (100% Attack Damage) against minions. Vigilance: When Lucian is directly healed or shielded by an ally, or when a nearby enemy Champion is Immobilized, his pistols become Overcharged with energy, causing his next 2 basic attacks to deal an additional (5 + (15% Attack Damage)) magic damage.

spells.name: Piercing Light
spells.summary: Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light through a target.
spells.text: Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light, dealing (90/130/170/210/250 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. This Ability's cast time decreases with Lucian's level.

spells.name: Ardent Blaze
spells.summary: Lucian shoots a missile that explodes in a star shape, marking and briefly revealing enemies. Lucian gains Move Speed for attacking marked enemies.
spells.text: Lucian fires a shot that explodes at the end of its range or on the first enemy hit, dealing (75/110/145/180/215 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage, briefly revealing enemies and marking them for 6 seconds. When Lucian or an ally damages a marked enemy, Lucian gains 60/65/70/75/80 Move Speed for 1 second. Allies triggering this effect will also grant Lucian Vigilance.

spells.name: Relentless Pursuit
spells.summary: Lucian quickly dashes a short distance. Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown.
spells.text: Lucian dashes. Cooldown is reduced by 1 second whenever Lucian hits an enemy with Lightslinger (2 seconds for champions). Lucian can use other Abilities while dashing.

spells.name: The Culling
spells.summary: Lucian unleashes a torrent of shots from his weapons.
spells.text: Lucian rapidly fires 22 shots in a direction for 3 seconds or until he Recasts. Each shot deals (15/30/45 + (25% Attack Damage) + (15% Ability Power)) physical damage to the first enemy hit. While firing, Lucian may use Relentless Pursuit. Total Damage: 22 × (15/30/45 + 25% Attack Damage + 15% Ability Power) physical damage Number of shots scales with Lucian's Critical Strike chance and Critical Strike damage at 100% effectiveness. Deals 200% damage to minions.

spells.name: Pix, Faerie Companion
spells.summary: Pix fires magical bolts of energy whenever the champion he's following attacks another enemy unit. These bolts are homing, but can be intercepted by other units.
spells.text: Lulu is assisted by Pix the faerie. When Lulu Attacks, Pix fires 3 bolts at her target, dealing ((15 ~ 117) + (15% Ability Power)) magic damage to the first enemy hit.

spells.name: Glitterlance
spells.summary: Pix and Lulu each fire a bolt of magical energy that damages and heavily slows all enemies it hits.
spells.text: Lulu and Pix each fire a piercing bolt dealing (60/95/130/165/200 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing by 80%, decaying over 2 seconds. Enemies take (30/47.5/65/82.5/100 + (25% Ability Power)) magic damage from additional bolts. Deals 70% damage to Minions.

spells.name: Whimsy
spells.summary: If cast on an ally, grants them Attack Speed and Move Speed for a short time. If cast on an enemy, turns them into an adorable critter that can't attack or cast spells.
spells.text: When used on an ally, Lulu grants (25% + (5% per 100 Ability Power)) Move Speed and 20/22.5/25/27.5/30% Attack Speed for 3/3.25/3.5/3.75/4 seconds. When used on an enemy, Lulu Polymorphs them for 1.2/1.4/1.6/1.8/2 seconds. Polymorphed targets are Silenced, Disarmed, and Slowed by 60.

spells.name: Help, Pix!
spells.summary: If cast on an ally, commands Pix to jump to an ally and shield them. He then follows them and aids their attacks. If cast on an enemy, commands Pix to jump to an enemy and damage them. He then follows them and grants you vision of that enemy.
spells.text: When used on an ally, Pix jumps to them and grants Pix, Faerie Companion for 6 seconds. If the ally is a champion, Pix also grants (70/110/150/190/230 + (50% Ability Power)) Shield for 2.5 seconds. When used on an enemy champion, Pix hampers them, dealing (70/110/150/190/230 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage and granting True Sight of them for 4 seconds.

spells.name: Wild Growth
spells.summary: Lulu enlarges an ally, knocking nearby enemies into the air and granting the ally a large amount of bonus health. For the next few seconds, that ally gains an aura that slows nearby enemies.
spells.text: Lulu enlarges an ally, Knocking Up surrounding enemies for 1 second. The enlarged ally gains (275/425/575 + (55% Ability Power)) max Health and Slows surrounding enemies by 30/45/60% for 7 seconds.

spells.name: Illumination
spells.summary: Lux's damaging spells charge the target with energy for a few seconds. Lux's next attack ignites the energy, dealing bonus magic damage (depending on Lux's level) to the target.
spells.text: Lux's damaging Abilities mark enemies for 6 seconds. Lux's Attacks consume the mark, dealing ((20 ~ 190) + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage. Final Spark will consume marks on enemies it hits and refresh them.

spells.name: Light Binding
spells.summary: Lux releases a sphere of light that binds and deals damage to up to two enemy units.
spells.text: Lux fires a ball of light, Rooting the first two enemies for 2 seconds and dealing (80/120/160/200/240 + (75% Ability Power)) magic damage to each.

spells.name: Prismatic Barrier
spells.summary: Lux throws her wand and bends the light around any friendly target it touches, protecting them from enemy damage.
spells.text: Lux throws her wand, granting (40/55/70/85/100 + (40% Ability Power)) Shield for 2.5 seconds to allies it passes through. Then it returns, granting the same Shield on its return. Both instances of Shield can stack.

spells.name: Lucent Singularity
spells.summary: Fires an anomaly of twisted light to an area, which slows nearby enemies. Lux can detonate it to damage enemies in the area of effect.
spells.text: Lux creates a light zone that Slows by 25/30/35/40/45% and reveals the area. After 5 seconds or on Recasting this Ability, it detonates, dealing (65/115/165/215/265 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing for an additional 1 second.

spells.name: Final Spark
spells.summary: After gathering energy, Lux fires a beam of light that deals damage to all targets in the area. In addition, triggers Lux's passive ability and refreshes the Illumination debuff duration.
spells.text: Lux fires a dazzling ray of light, dealing (300/400/500 + (120% Ability Power)) magic damage to all enemies in a line.

spells.name: Granite Shield
spells.summary: Malphite is shielded by a layer of rock which absorbs damage up to 10% of his maximum Health. If Malphite has not been hit for a few seconds, this effect recharges.
spells.text: Malphite grants himself (10% Health) Shield after not taking damage for (8 ~ 6) seconds.

spells.name: Seismic Shard
spells.summary: Malphite sends a shard of the earth through the ground at his foe, dealing damage upon impact and stealing Move Speed for 3 seconds.
spells.text: Malphite launches a shard of earth at an enemy, dealing (70/120/170/220/270 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing them by 20/25/30/35/40% for 3 seconds. Malphite also steals the amount Slowed, gaining it as Move Speed for 3 seconds.

spells.name: Thunderclap
spells.summary: Malphite attacks with such force that it creates a sonic boom. For the next few seconds, his attacks create aftershocks in front of him.
spells.text: Passive: Malphite gains 10/15/20/25/30% Armor. This effect is increased to 30/45/60/75/90% while Granite Shield is active. Active: Malphite's next Attack deals an additional (30/40/50/60/70 + (20% Ability Power) + (15% Armor)) physical damage and creates an aftershock which deals (15/25/35/45/55 + (30% Ability Power) + (15% Armor)) physical damage On-Hit in their direction. His Attacks continue to create aftershocks On-Hit for the next 5 seconds. Deals 180% damage to jungle monsters.

spells.name: Ground Slam
spells.summary: Malphite slams the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage based on his Armor and reduces the Attack Speed of enemies for a short duration.
spells.text: Malphite slams the ground, dealing (60/95/130/165/200 + (40% Armor) + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage and reducing Attack Speed by 30/35/40/45/50% for 3 seconds.

spells.name: Unstoppable Force
spells.summary: Malphite launches himself to a location at high speed, damaging enemies and knocking them into the air.
spells.text: Malphite charges with the force of a landslide, dashing Unstoppably. At the end of the dash, Malphite Knocks Up for 1.5 seconds and deals (200/300/400 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Void Shift
spells.summary: When he hasn't recently taken damage or been crowd controlled, Malzahar gains massive damage reduction and crowd control immunity, lingering for a short period after taking damage.
spells.text: Malzahar gains 90% damage reduction and immunity from Disabling and Immobilizing effects, lingering for 0.25 seconds after taking damage or blocking one of those effects. This effect has a 12 second Cooldown.

spells.name: Call of the Void
spells.summary: Malzahar opens up two portals to the Void. After a short delay, they fire projectiles that deal Magic Damage and silence enemy champions.
spells.text: Malzahar opens two portals to the Void that fire projectiles inward, dealing (70/105/140/175/210 + (55% Ability Power)) magic damage and Silencing for 1/1.25/1.5/1.75/2 second(s).

spells.name: Void Swarm
spells.summary: Malzahar summons Voidlings to attack nearby enemies.
spells.text: Passive: Malzahar's other Abilities give him a stack when cast (max 2). Active: Malzahar summons a Voidling plus an additional Voidling per stack. Voidlings last 8/8/9/9/10 seconds and deal (12/14/16/18/20 + (5 ~ 64.5) + (40% bonus Attack Damage) + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage each hit. Voidlings deal 300% damage to lane minions affected by Malefic Visions. Voidlings deal 50% damage to epic monsters.

spells.name: Malefic Visions
spells.summary: Malzahar infects his target's mind with cruel visions of their demise, dealing damage over time. Using Malzahar's other spells on the target will refresh the visions. If the target dies while afflicted by the visions, they pass on to a nearby enemy unit and Malzahar gains Mana. Malzahar's Voidlings are attracted to affected units.
spells.text: Malzahar inflicts terrible visions, dealing (80/115/150/185/220 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage over 4 seconds. Applying Call of the Void or Nether Grasp to the victim during this time refreshes the visions. If the victim dies, Malzahar gains (2% Mana) Mana and the visions spread to the nearest enemy. Malefic Visions executes minions below 10 Health.

spells.name: Nether Grasp
spells.summary: Malzahar channels the essence of the Void to suppress an enemy champion over a zone of damaging negative energy.
spells.text: Malzahar Suppresses an enemy champion and deals (125/200/275 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage over 2.5 seconds. A zone of negative energy is created around his target dealing (10/15/20% + (2.5% per 100 Ability Power)) max Health magic damage over 5 seconds. This Ability Knocks Down enemies.

spells.name: Sap Magic
spells.summary: Maokai's basic attack also heals him and deals additional damage on a moderate cooldown. Each time Maokai casts a spell or is struck by an enemy's spell, this cooldown is reduced.
spells.text: Maokai's next Attack restores (4/11.8% Health) Health. Using an Ability or being hit by an enemy champion's Ability reduces the Cooldown by 4 seconds. Being hit by large or epic monster's Attacks or Abilities reduces the Cooldown by 1.5 second.

spells.name: Bramble Smash
spells.summary: Maokai knocks back nearby enemies with a shockwave, dealing magic damage and slowing them.
spells.text: Maokai smashes his fist into the ground, dealing (75/120/165/210/255 + (50% Ability Power)) plus 2/2.5/3/3.5/4% max Health magic damage and briefly Slowing. Nearby enemies are also Knocked Back. This Ability deals an additional 150/160/170/180/190 magic damage to jungle monsters.

spells.name: Twisted Advance
spells.summary: Maokai contorts into a mass of moving roots, becoming untargetable and dashing to the target. Upon arrival, he roots the target.
spells.text: Maokai transforms into a moving mass of roots, becoming Untargetable and dashing to an enemy. Upon arrival, he Roots the enemy for 1/1.1/1.2/1.3/1.4 second(s) and deals (60/85/110/135/160 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Sapling Toss
spells.summary: Maokai flings a sapling to the target area to stand guard. More effective in brush.
spells.text: Maokai flings a sapling, which stands watch for 30 seconds. Saplings chase nearby enemies, detonating on arrival to deal (50/75/100/125/150 + (25% Ability Power) + (5% bonus Health)) magic damage and Slow surrounding enemies by 45% for 2 seconds. Sap Magic's Cooldown is reduced by an additional 4 seconds if the sapling hits an enemy champion or epic monster. If placed in brush, Saplings instead last for (30 + (1.5% bonus Health)) seconds and cause a larger explosion, dealing (100/150/200/250/300 + (50% Ability Power) + (10% bonus Health)) magic damage over 2 seconds and Slowing enemies by (45% + (1% per 100 Ability Power) + (1% per 100 bonus Health)). Saplings run at 400 Move Speed. Brush saplings do not deal the increased damage to minions.

spells.name: Nature's Grasp
spells.summary: Maokai summons a colossal wall of brambles and thorns that slowly advances forwards, damaging and rooting any enemies in the path.
spells.text: Maokai summons a colossal wave of brambles and thorns, Rooting enemies for 0.75 to 2.25 seconds, increasing with distance travelled, and dealing (150/225/300 + (75% Ability Power)) magic damage. Hitting a champion gives Maokai 40/50/60% Move Speed, decaying over 2 seconds.

spells.name: Double Strike
spells.summary: Every few consecutive basic attack, Master Yi strikes twice.
spells.text: Every 4th Attack, Master Yi strikes twice. The second Attack deals (50% Attack Damage) physical damage.

spells.name: Alpha Strike
spells.summary: Master Yi teleports across the battlefield with blinding speed, dealing physical damage to multiple units in his path, while simultaneously becoming untargetable. Alpha Strike can critically strike and deals bonus physical damage to monsters. Basic attacks reduce Alpha Strike's cooldown.
spells.text: Master Yi becomes Untargetable and teleports to rapidly strike enemies near his target, dealing (20/40/60/80/100 + (70% Attack Damage)) physical damage to all enemies hit after 4 hits. This Ability can strike the same enemy repeatedly if there are no other targets, dealing 25% damage for subsequent hits ((5/10/15/20/25 + (17.5% Attack Damage))), for a maximum single target total of (35/70/105/140/175 + (122.5% Attack Damage)) physical damage. Applies On-Hit effects at 75% damage. Subsequent hits are reduced to 25% of this. Can critically strike for an additional (20/40/60/80/100 + (70% Attack Damage)) × (-1 + 100% Critical Strike Damage) physical damage. Subsequent hits are reduced to 25% of this, for a maximum single target total of (35/70/105/140/175 + (122.5% Attack Damage)) × (100% Critical Strike Damage). Jungle monsters take 60/85/110/135/160 bonus damage per strike. Attacks reduce this Ability's Cooldown by 1 second. Alpha Strike does not reduce its own cooldown or stack Double Strike On-Hit. Master Yi will reappear near the initial target.

spells.name: Meditate
spells.summary: Master Yi rejuvenates his body by focus of mind, restoring Health and taking reduced damage for a short time. In addition, Master Yi will gain stacks of Double Strike and pause the remaining duration on Wuju Style and Highlander for each second he channels.
spells.text: Master Yi channels, restoring (120/200/280/360/440 + (100% Ability Power)) Health over 4 seconds. This healing is increased by up to 100% based on Master Yi's missing Health. While channeling and for 0.5 seconds afterwards, he takes 70/70/70/70/70% reduced damage, decreased to 45/47.5/50/52.5/55% after the first 0.5 seconds. Master Yi will gain stacks of Double Strike. Damage reduction is halved against turrets.

spells.name: Wuju Style
spells.summary: Grants bonus true damage on basic attacks.
spells.text: Master Yi's Attacks deal an additional (20/25/30/35/40 + (35% bonus Attack Damage)) true damage for 5 seconds. The duration of Wuju Style is paused during Alpha Strike and Meditate

spells.name: Highlander
spells.summary: Master Yi moves with unparalleled agility, temporarily increasing his Move Speed and Attack Speed as well as making him immune to all slowing effects. While active, Champion kills or assists extend Highlander's duration. Passively reduces cooldown for his other abilities on a kill or assist.
spells.text: Passive: Champion takedowns reduce the remaining Cooldown of Master Yi's basic Abilities by 70%. Active: Master Yi enters a trance, gaining 40/50/60% Move Speed, 25/45/65% Attack Speed, and immunity to Slows for 7 seconds. Champion takedowns extend the duration of this Ability by 7 seconds. The duration of Highlander is paused during Alpha Strike and Meditate

spells.name: Searing Brilliance
spells.summary: Whenever Mel uses an ability, she gains three bonus projectiles (up to nine maximum) on her next attack. When Mel deals damage through an ability or attack, she applies Overwhelm, which can stack infinitely. If the enemy is hit by Mel with enough Overwhelm damage, the stacks are consumed to execute the target.
spells.text: Mel's Attacks and Abilities apply and refresh stacks of Overwhelm for 5 seconds each time they deal damage, storing (60 + (10% Ability Power)) plus (3 + (0.75% Ability Power)) damage per stack of magic damage. When applied, if the stored amount exceeds the enemy's combined shields and Health, they are executed. When an Ability is cast, Mel's next Attack fires 3 extra projectiles, each dealing ((8 ~ 30) + (4% Ability Power)) magic damage. This effect can stack up to 9 extra projectiles.

spells.name: Radiant Volley
spells.summary: Mel fires a barrage of projectiles that explode around a target location, dealing damage repeatedly to enemies within the area.
spells.text: Mel unleashes a barrage of 6/7/8/9/10 projectiles that explode in the area around a target location. The first explosion hit deals (60/85/110/135/160 + (55% Ability Power)) magic damage and each subsequent explosion deals (5/7/9/11/13 + (5% Ability Power)) magic damage, adding up to (85/127/173/223/277 + (55% Ability Power) + (25/30/35/40/45% Ability Power)) magic damage total.

spells.name: Rebuttal
spells.summary: Mel forms a barrier around herself that reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker, prevents her from taking damage, and grants her movement speed.
spells.text: Mel forms a barrier around herself that reflects projectiles from enemy champions, gaining (80/110/140/170/200 + (70% Ability Power)) Shields for 0.75 seconds and 40% decaying Move Speed for 0.75 seconds. Reflected projectiles deal (40/45/50/55/60% + (5% per 100 Ability Power)) original damage as magic damage. Reflected projectile damage is calculated using the original caster's attributes before damage adjustments and magic penetration. Physical damage is reduced by 30% when converted to magic damage. Does not apply item effects from the original caster. Projectiles targeting each enemy in an area are destroyed instead of reflected.

spells.name: Solar Snare
spells.summary: Mel fires a radiant orb forward, rooting those at its center while the area around it slows enemies and deals damage over time.
spells.text: Mel fires a radiating orb, Rooting enemies at its center for 1.5 seconds and dealing (60/105/150/195/240 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage. The orb builds up a hostile area around it that Slows enemies by 30% and deals (16/28/40/52/64 + (8% Ability Power)) magic damage per second. The Slow and damage-over-time effects linger on enemies for a short duration after they've left the area created by the orb. Deals 50% reduced damage when used against minions.

spells.name: Golden Eclipse
spells.summary: Mel strikes all enemies marked with Overwhelm regardless of their distance from her, dealing additional damage for each stack of Overwhelm. Ranks of Golden Eclipse increase Overwhelm's damage.
spells.text: Passive: Overwhelm damage is increased to (60/70/80 + (10% Ability Power)) magic damage plus (3/4/5 + (0.75% Ability Power)) magic damage per stack. Active: Mel unleashes her power on all enemies affected by Overwhelm, dealing (125/200/275 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage plus (4/7/10 + (4% Ability Power)) magic damage per Overwhelm stack. Can only be cast when an enemy champion is affected by Overwhelm.

spells.name: Fired Up!
spells.summary: Milio's abilities enchant allies on touch, making their next damage deal a burst of extra damage and burn the target.
spells.text: When Milio's Abilities touch ally champions, their next Attack or Ability deals 15% ally Attack Damage as additional magic damage, plus ((10 ~ 50) + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage over 1.5 seconds.

spells.name: Ultra Mega Fire Kick
spells.summary: Kick a ball that knocks back an enemy. The ball launches upward on hit and falls toward the enemy, damaging and slowing enemies in the area upon impact.
spells.text: Milio kicks a fireball, Knocking Back the first enemy hit.
