If it hits, the ball bounces past them and explodes, dealing (80/140/200/260/320 + (120% Ability Power)) magic damage to surrounding enemies and Slowing them by (40/45/50/55/60% + (5% per 100 Ability Power)) for 1.5 seconds. Hitting at least one enemy champion with Ultra Mega Fire Kick refunds 50% of it's Mana cost. Minions and monsters are knocked further and create a larger explosion.

spells.name: Cozy Campfire
spells.summary: Create an empowering zone that heals allies and increases attack range to those inside. The zone follows the ally nearest to the cast point.
spells.text: Milio creates a hearth that follows ally champions for 6 seconds. Ally champions nearby gain 10/12.5/15/17.5/20% Attack Range and restore (70/90/110/130/150 + (15% Ability Power)) Health over the duration. The hearth also applies Fired Up! every 3 seconds. Recast: Change the hearth's follow ally.

spells.name: Warm Hugs
spells.summary: Milio tosses a shield to an ally, temporarily increasing their movement speed. This ability has 2 charges.
spells.text: Milio wraps an ally champion in protective flames, granting (45/75/105/135/165 + (45% Ability Power)) Shield and 12/14/16/18/20% Move Speed for 2.5 seconds. This ability has 2 charges and the effects stack on repeat targets.

spells.name: Breath of Life
spells.summary: Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames that heal and remove crowd control effects from allies in range.
spells.text: Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames on nearby ally champions, cleansing Disabling and Immobilizing effects, restoring (150/250/350 + (50% Ability Power)) Health, and granting 65% Tenacity for 3 seconds. Does not cleanse Airborne.

spells.name: Love Tap
spells.summary: Miss Fortune deals bonus physical damage whenever she basic attacks a new target.
spells.text: Miss Fortune's Attacks deal an additional (100% Attack Damage) physical damage when she attacks a new target. Triggering Love Tap reduces the cooldown of Strut by 2 seconds.

spells.name: Double Up
spells.summary: Miss Fortune fires a bullet at an enemy, damaging them and a target behind them. Both strikes can also apply Love Tap.
spells.text: Miss Fortune fires a bouncing shot, dealing (20/45/70/95/120 + (100% Attack Damage) + (35% Ability Power)) physical damage to an enemy and to another one behind them. The second shot can critically strike for (20/45/70/95/120 + (100% Attack Damage) + (35% Ability Power)) × (0.5 + 50% Critical Strike Damage) physical damage. It always critically strikes if the first shot kills its target. Both strikes apply on-hit effects.

spells.name: Strut
spells.summary: Miss Fortune passively gains Move Speed when not attacked. This ability can be activated to grant bonus Attack Speed for a short duration. While it's on cooldown, Love Taps reduce the remaining cooldown of Strut.
spells.text: Passive: After 4 seconds of not taking damage, Miss Fortune gains 30/35/40/45/50 Move Speed. After another 3 seconds, this increases to 60/70/80/90/100. Active: Gain the passive effect's full Move Speed bonus and 40/55/70/85/100% Attack Speed for 4 seconds. Love Taps reduce the Cooldown of this Ability by 2 seconds.

spells.name: Make It Rain
spells.summary: Miss Fortune reveals an area with a flurry of bullets, dealing waves of damage to opponents and slowing them.
spells.text: Miss Fortune rains bullets, revealing an area, Slowing by (40% + (6% per 100 Ability Power)) and dealing (35/50/65/80/95 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage per second for 2 seconds (total (70/100/130/160/190 + (120% Ability Power)) magic damage).

spells.name: Bullet Time
spells.summary: Miss Fortune channels a barrage of bullets into a cone in front of her, dealing large amounts of damage to enemies. Each wave of Bullet Time can critically strike
spells.text: Miss Fortune channels a barrage of bullets, firing 14/16/18 waves over 3 seconds, dealing (20/30/40 + (60% Attack Damage) + (25% Ability Power)) physical damage per wave (total (280/480/720 + (840/960/1080% Attack Damage) + (350/400/450% Ability Power)) physical damage). Each wave can critically strike for (20/30/40 + (60% Attack Damage) + (25% Ability Power)) × (0.7 + 30% Critical Strike Damage) physical damage.

spells.name: Stone Skin
spells.summary: Wukong gains stacking armor and max health regeneration while fighting champions and monsters.
spells.text: Wukong gains (6 ~ 10) Armor and regenerates 0.35% max Health per 5 seconds. These bonuses are increased by 100% for 5 seconds every time he or his Clone hit an enemy champion or jungle monster with an Attack or Ability, stacking up to 5 times.

spells.name: Crushing Blow
spells.summary: Wukong's next attack gains attack range, deals bonus damage, and reduces the target's armor for a few seconds.
spells.text: Wukong and his Clone's next Attack gains 135/145/155/165/175 range, deals an additional (20/45/70/95/120 + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage, and removes 10/15/20/25/30% Armor for 3 seconds. This Ability's cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds every time Wukong or his Clone hit an enemy with an Attack or Ability. This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.

spells.name: Warrior Trickster
spells.summary: Wukong becomes Invisible and dashes in a direction, leaving behind a clone that will attack nearby enemies.
spells.text: Wukong dashes and becomes Invisible for 1 second, leaving behind a stationary Clone for 4 seconds. The Clone Attacks nearby enemies Wukong has recently damaged and will mimic his ultimate, each dealing 40/45/50/55/60% of normal damage. Invisible units cannot be revealed except by turrets or true sight.

spells.name: Nimbus Strike
spells.summary: Wukong dashes to a targeted enemy and sends out images to attack enemies near his target, dealing damage to each enemy struck.
spells.text: Wukong dashes to an enemy, sending out Clones that mimic the dash to up to 2 additional enemies nearby. Each enemy struck takes (80/120/160/200/240 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage. He and his Clone gain 40/45/50/55/60% Attack Speed for 5 seconds.

spells.name: Cyclone
spells.summary: Wukong's extends his staff and spins it around repeatedly, gaining Move Speed. Enemies struck take damage and are knocked up.
spells.text: Wukong gains 20% Move Speed and spins his staff, Knocking Up nearby enemies for 0.6 seconds and take (275% Attack Damage) plus 8/12/16% max Health physical damage over 2 seconds. This Ability can be cast a second time within 8 seconds before going on cooldown. Damage to jungle monsters is capped at 1200 damage over 2 seconds.

spells.name: Darkness Rise
spells.summary: Mordekaiser gains a powerful damage aura and Move Speed after landing 3 attacks or spells against champions or monsters.
spells.text: Mordekaiser's Attacks deal an additional (40% Ability Power) magic damage. Mordekaiser cloaks himself in negative energy after hitting 3 basic Abilities or Attacks against champions or jungle monsters. This cloak deals (5 + (30% Ability Power)) plus (1 ~ 5)max Health magic damage per second and grants him 9% Move Speed.

spells.name: Obliterate
spells.summary: Mordekaiser smashes the ground with his mace dealing damage to each enemy struck. Damage is increased when hitting a single enemy.
spells.text: Mordekaiser smashes the ground with Nightfall dealing (80/115/150/185/220 + (0 ~ 45) + (120% bonus Attack Damage) + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage, increased to (104/155.25/210/268.25/330 + (0 ~ 45) + (156/162/168/174/180% bonus Attack Damage) + (91/94.5/98/101.5/105% Ability Power)) if it hits only a single enemy.

spells.name: Indestructible
spells.summary: Mordekaiser stores damage he deals and takes to create a shield. He may consume the shield to heal.
spells.text: Passive: Mordekaiser stores 45% of the damage he deals and 7.5% of the damage he takes. Active: Mordekaiser gains the stored damage as Shield. He may Recast this Ability to restore 35/37.5/40/42.5/45% of the remaining Shield as Health. Minimum Shield: (5% Health) Maximum Shield: (30% Health) Shield decays over time. Damage stored from non-champion sources reduced by 75%.

spells.name: Death's Grasp
spells.summary: Mordekaiser pulls all enemies in an area.
spells.text: Passive: Mordekaiser gains 5/7.5/10/12.5/15% Magic Penetration. Active: Pulls enemies in his direction, dealing (60/80/100/120/140 + (45% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Realm of Death
spells.summary: Mordekaiser drags his victim to a different dimension with him and steals a portion of their stats. If he kills them, he keeps the stats until the victim respawns.
spells.text: Mordekaiser banishes a champion to the Death Realm with him for 7s, stealing 10% of their core stats for the duration. If Mordekaiser kills that enemy in the Death Realm he consumes their soul, keeping the stats he stole until the target respawns. Core stats stolen include: Ability Power, Attack Damage, Attack Speed, Armor, Magic Resist, and Maximum Health.

spells.name: Soul Siphon
spells.summary: Morgana drains spirit from her enemies, healing as she deals damage to champions, large minions, and medium and larger jungler monsters.
spells.text: Morgana Heals for 18% of the damage dealt by her Abilities to champions, large minions, and medium and larger jungle monsters.

spells.name: Dark Binding
spells.summary: Morgana binds an enemy in place with dark magic, forcing them to feel the pain they've caused and dealing magic damage.
spells.text: Morgana hurls a blast of starfire that Roots the first enemy hit for 2/2.25/2.5/2.75/3 seconds and deals (80/135/190/245/300 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Tormented Shadow
spells.summary: Morgana casts a cursed shadow on an area, damaging enemies who dare stand in her dark circle. They receive magic damage over time, which increases the lower health they are.
spells.text: Morgana ignites the ground for 5 seconds, dealing (18/31/44/57/70 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage per second, increased by up to (36/62/88/114/140 + (40% Ability Power)) based on the targets' missing Health. This Ability's Cooldown is reduced by 5% every time Morgana is healed by Soul Siphon. This Ability deals 170% damage to jungle monsters.

spells.name: Black Shield
spells.summary: Morgana anoints an ally with a protective barrier of starfire, which absorbs magical damage and disabling effects until it is broken.
spells.text: Morgana grants an ally champion (100/155/210/265/320 + (70% Ability Power)) Magic Shield for 5 seconds. The shield prevents Disabling and Immobilizing effects until it breaks.

spells.name: Soul Shackles
spells.summary: Morgana unleashes the full force of her Celestial power as she unbinds her wings and hovers above the ground. She lashes chains of dark pain onto nearby enemy champions, gaining Move Speed. The chains slow and deal initial damage and, after a delay, stun those who are unable to break them.
spells.text: Morgana chains herself to nearby enemy Champions, dealing (200/275/350 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing them by 20%. After 3 seconds, enemies unable to break the chains take an additional (200/275/350 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage and are Stunned for 1.5/1.75/2 seconds. While casting this Ability, Morgana gains 20/40/60% Move Speed. Morgana gains True Sight of all enemies affected by this Ability.

cards.name: Naafiri
cards.title: the Hound of a Hundred Bites

spells.name: We Are More
spells.summary: Naafiri spawns packmates that attack the targets of her attacks and abilities.
spells.text: Naafiri creates a Packmate every 10 seconds that will Attack enemies that she targets for ((10 ~ 20) + (4% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage, increased to ((13 ~ 26) + (5.2% bonus Attack Damage)) after she uses an Ability. Hitting champions and large monsters with Abilities reduces this Ability's Cooldown by 4 seconds. Killing enemies reduces it by 1 seconds. Max Packmates: 5

spells.name: Darkin Daggers
spells.summary: Naafiri hurls up to two daggers, each inflicting bleed, or each inflicting bonus damage if the target is already bleeding. Packmates leap to attack the first champion or monster hit by this skill.
spells.text: Naafiri hurls Darkin-tainted blades, dealing (35/40/45/50/55 + (20% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and inflicting a bleed, dealing (35/60/85/110/135 + (80% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage over 5 seconds. Naafiri can Recast this Ability. If enemies hit are already bleeding from this Ability, it instead deals the remaining bleed damage plus between (30/42.5/55/67.5/80 + (40% bonus Attack Damage)) and (60/85/110/135/160 + (140% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage, based on their missing Health. If that target was a champion or large monster, Naafiri restores (45/60/75/90/105 + (40% bonus Attack Damage)) Health. Packmates will leap at the first champion or monster hit and attack them for 2 seconds. Executes lane minions and non-epic monsters below 30 health.

spells.name: The Call of the Pack
spells.summary: Naafiri becomes Untargetable and empowers her pack, spawning additional packmates and gaining increased Move Speed and Attack Damage.
spells.text: Naafiri becomes Untargetable for 1 second and prepares to hunt, spawning 2 additional Packmates and gaining (20% Attack Damage) Attack Damage and 20/22.5/25/27.5/30% Move Speed for 5 seconds. Packmates become Untargetable and are recalled to Naafiri.

spells.name: Eviscerate
spells.summary: Naafiri dashes and damages enemies in an area around her, recalling her packmates and fully healing them.
spells.text: Naafiri surges forward, dealing (15/25/35/45/55 + (40% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage, then explodes in a flurry of blades, dealing (60/85/110/135/160 + (80% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. Packmates become Untargetable and are recalled to Naafiri restoring 100% Health.

spells.name: Hounds' Pursuit
spells.summary: Naafiri and her packmates dash at a champion, dealing damage. Naafiri reveals nearby enemies if she scores a takedown and can recast this Ability once. The second cast grants a shield.
spells.text: Naafiri dashes at an enemy champion, dealing (125/200/275 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and briefly Slowing them. Packmates become Untargetable and dash alongside Naafiri, dealing (12.5/20/27.5 + (10% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage per Packmate. If Naafiri scores a Takedown within 7 seconds she reveals nearby enemies and can recast this Ability once. The second cast grants (100/150/200 + (150% bonus Attack Damage)) Shield for 3 seconds. Briefly extends The Call of the Pack.

spells.name: Surging Tides
spells.summary: When Nami's Abilities hit allied champions they gain Move Speed for a short duration.
spells.text: When Nami's Abilities hit allied champions, they gain (100 + (25% Ability Power)) Move Speed, decaying over 1.5 seconds.

spells.name: Aqua Prison
spells.summary: Sends a bubble to a target area, dealing damage and stunning all enemies on impact.
spells.text: Nami hurls a bubble, Stunning for 1.5 seconds and dealing (90/145/200/255/310 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Ebb and Flow
spells.summary: Unleashes a stream of water that bounces back and forth between allied and enemy champions, healing allies and damaging enemies.
spells.text: Nami unleashes a stream of water that bounces between allied and enemy champions. Each champion can only be hit once, and it hits up to 3 targets.Restores (55/80/105/130/155 + (40% Ability Power)) Health to allies and will bounce to a nearby enemy champion. Deals (60/95/130/165/200 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies and will bounce to a nearby allied champion. The damage and healing value is modified by (-20% + (0.15% Ability Power)) each bounce. Can only bounce to visible enemies.

spells.name: Tidecaller's Blessing
spells.summary: Empowers an allied champion for a short duration. The ally's basic attacks and spells deal bonus magic damage and slow the target.
spells.text: Nami empowers an allied champion's next 3 Attacks and Abilities for 6 seconds, causing them to Slow their targets by (15/20/25/30/35% + (5% per 100 Ability Power)) for 1s and deal an additional (20/35/50/65/80 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage. Deals (33% ~ 66%) damage to non-champions when empowering area of effect Abilities.

spells.name: Tidal Wave
spells.summary: Summons a massive Tidal Wave that knocks up, slows, and damages enemies. Allies hit gain double the effect of Surging Tides.
spells.text: Nami summons a tidal wave, Knocking Up for 0.5 seconds, Slowing by 70%, and dealing (150/250/350 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. The duration of the Slow increases based on distance the wave traveled, up to 4 seconds. Allies hit by the wave gain double the effect of Surging Tides. The Slow has a minimum duration of 2 seconds.

spells.name: Soul Eater
spells.summary: Nasus drains his foe's spiritual energy, giving him bonus Life Steal.
spells.text: Nasus has an additional 20% Life Steal.

spells.name: Siphoning Strike
spells.summary: Nasus strikes his foe, dealing damage and increasing the power of his future Siphoning Strikes if he slays his target.
spells.text: Nasus' next Attack deals (31/51/71/91/111 + (100% Attack Damage)) physical damage. Killing an enemy with this Attack permanently increases its damage by 4, increased to 10 against champions, large minions and large jungle monsters. This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage. This Ability can critically strike for 1 physical damage.

spells.name: Wither
spells.summary: Nasus ages an enemy champion, decelerating their Move Speed and Attack Speed over time.
spells.text: Nasus ages a champion, Slowing them by 35%, increasing to 47/59/71/83/95% over 5 seconds. Their Attack Speed is also reduced by 75% of the Slow.

spells.name: Spirit Fire
spells.summary: Nasus unleashes a spirit flame at a location, dealing damage and reducing the Armor of enemies who stand on it.
spells.text: Nasus ignites a spirit flame, dealing (50/80/110/140/170 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. Enemies in the area lose 30/35/40/45/50% Armor and take (50/80/110/140/170 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage over 5 seconds.

spells.name: Fury of the Sands
spells.summary: Nasus unleashes a mighty sandstorm that batters nearby enemies. While the storm rages, he gains increased Health, Attack Range, damages nearby enemies, has a reduced cooldown on Siphoning Strike, and gains bonus Armor and Magic Resistance.
spells.text: Nasus becomes empowered in the sandstorm for 15 seconds, increasing his maximum Health by 300/450/600 and Armor and Magic Resistance by 40/55/70. While the storm rages, nearby enemies take (3/4/5% + (1% per 100 Ability Power)) of their maximum Health as magic damage each second and Siphoning Strike has a 50% reduced Cooldown. The storm deals a max of 240 damage per second.

spells.name: Staggering Blow
spells.summary: Nautilus' first Attack against a target deals increased physical damage and roots them briefly.
spells.text: Nautilus' first Attack against a target deals ((8 ~ 110) + (100% Attack Damage)) physical damage and Roots them for (0.75 ~ 2) seconds.

spells.name: Dredge Line
spells.summary: Nautilus hurls his anchor forward. Colliding with an enemy pulls them and Nautilus together, dealing magic damage. Colliding with terrain pulls Nautilus towards it.
spells.text: Nautilus hurls his anchor forward. If it hits an enemy, Nautilus drags himself and the target together, dealing (85/125/165/205/245 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage and Stunning them briefly. If the anchor hits terrain, Nautilus will drag himself towards it. If Nautilus's hook hits terrain, this Ability's Cooldown is reduced by 50%, and 50% of the Mana cost is refunded.

spells.name: Titan's Wrath
spells.summary: Nautilus gains a temporary Shield. While it persists, his Attacks deal damage over time to his target and surrounding enemies.
spells.text: Nautilus gains a (50/60/70/80/90 + (8/9/10/11/12% Health)) Shield for 6 seconds. While the Shield persists, Nautilus' Attacks deal an additional (30/40/50/60/70 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage over 2 seconds to his target and all surrounding enemies.

spells.name: Riptide
spells.summary: Nautilus creates three exploding waves around himself. Each explosion damages and slows enemies.
spells.text: Nautilus creates three exploding waves around himself, each dealing (55/90/125/160/195 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies in the area and Slows them by 30/35/40/45/50% decaying over 1.25 seconds. Waves deal 50% less damage after the first. This Ability deals (125/165/205/245/285 + (50% Ability Power)) bonus damage to jungle monsters the first time it hits.

spells.name: Depth Charge
spells.summary: Nautilus fires a shockwave into the earth that chases an opponent. This shockwave rips up the earth above it, knocking enemies into the air. When it reaches the opponent, the shockwave erupts, knocking his target into the air and stunning them.
spells.text: Nautilus fires a shockwave that chases an enemy champion, dealing (150/275/400 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage, Knocking them Up and Stunning them for 1/1.5/2 seconds. Other enemies hit by the shockwave are also Knocked Up and Stunned and take (125/175/225 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Inherent Glamour
spells.summary: Neeko can look like an ally champion or as other units on the map. Receiving immobilizing crowd control, casting damaging spells, damaging enemy towers as a non-champion, or your disguise taking damage equal to its healthbar breaks the disguise.
spells.text: Neeko can disguise herself as other units on the map. At any time she can disguise as an allied champion, or Neeko can stand next to any allied or neutral unit to store their Sho'ma and be able to transform into it. Your disguise will break upon receiving immobilizing crowd control, casting a damaging spell, damaging enemy towers as a non-champion, or your disguise taking damage equal to its healthbar. Neeko gains many of the properties of the units she turns into, negative and positive.

spells.name: Blooming Burst
spells.summary: Neeko throws a seed dealing magic damage. The seed blooms again on hitting champions or killing units.
spells.text: Neeko throws a seed that blooms to deal (60/110/160/210/260 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. If it kills a unit or hits a champion or large monster, it will bloom again, dealing (35/60/85/110/135 + (25% Ability Power)) magic damage. Max 2 extra blooms. Each bloom deals an additional 35/50/65/80/95 magic damage to monsters.

spells.name: Shapesplitter
spells.summary: Neeko passively deals bonus magic damage every third attack, briefly increasing her move speed. Neeko can activate to send a clone in a direction and recast to change the direction of the clone.
spells.text: Passive: Every 3rd Attack deals an additional (30/65/100/135/170 + (60% Ability Power)) bonus magic damage and increases Neeko's Move Speed by 10/17.5/25/32.5/40% for 1 second. Active: Neeko becomes invisible for 0.5 seconds and projects a clone that lasts 3 seconds. Neeko and the clone gain 20/25/30/35/40% Move Speed for 3 seconds. The clone can be controlled using the Move Pet Click hotkey or by Recasting this Ability. The clone mirrors her spellcasts, emotes, and recall. The clone is untargetable while stealthed. Empowered Attacks deal 75 bonus magic damage to monsters.

spells.name: Tangle-Barbs
spells.summary: Neeko slings a tangle that damages and roots everything it passes through. If the tangle kills an enemy or passes through a champion, it becomes larger, faster, and roots for longer.
spells.text: Neeko slings a tangle that deals (70/105/140/175/210 + (65% Ability Power)) magic damage and Roots for 0.7/0.9/1.1/1.3/1.5 seconds. The tangle becomes empowered after hitting an enemy, growing larger, moving faster, and Rooting for 1.8/2.1/2.4/2.7/3 seconds.

spells.name: Pop Blossom
spells.summary: After a short preparation, Neeko leaps into the air, knocking up all nearby enemies. Upon landing, nearby enemies are damaged and stunned. The preparation is hidden if Neeko is disguised.
spells.text: After a delay Neeko leaps into the air, Knocking Up all nearby enemies for 0.6 seconds. She then crashes down, dealing (150/350/550 + (120% Ability Power)) magic damage to all nearby enemies and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds. This Ability can be prepared in secret if Neeko is disguised. 0.5 seconds after casting this ability Neeko breaks her disguise.

spells.name: Prowl
spells.summary: Moving through brush increases Nidalee's Move Speed by 10% for 2 seconds, increased to 30% toward visible enemy champions within 1400 range. Hitting champions or monsters with Javelin Toss or Bushwhack triggers a Hunt, granting True Sight of them for 4 seconds. During this time, Nidalee gains 10% Move Speed (increased to 30% toward the Hunted target) and her Takedown and Pounce are enhanced against them.
spells.text: Nidalee starts with a rank in Aspect of the Cougar. Nidalee gains 10% Move Speed for 2 seconds when entering Brush, increased to 30% Move Speed while moving toward enemy champions. Hitting champions or jungle monsters with Javelin Toss or Bushwhack marks them as Hunted for 4 seconds. While an enemy is Hunted, they are revealed with True Sight and Nidalee gains 10% Move Speed, increased to 30% Move Speed toward the Hunted enemy.

spells.name: Javelin Toss / Takedown
spells.summary: In human form, Nidalee throws a spiked javelin at her target that gains damage as it flies. As a cougar, her next attack will attempt to fatally wound her target, dealing more damage the less life they have.
spells.text: Human Form: Nidalee throws her javelin, dealing (70/90/110/130/150 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage, increased up to (227.5/292.5/357.5/422.5/487.5 + (162.5% Ability Power)) magic damage based on distance flown.

spells.name: Bushwhack / Pounce
spells.summary: In human form, Nidalee lays a trap for unwary opponents that, when sprung, damages and reveals its target. As a cougar, she jumps in a direction, dealing damage in an area where she lands.
spells.text: Human Form: Nidalee places an invisible trap for 2 minutes. When an enemy walks over it, they are dealt (10/20/30/40/50 + (5% Ability Power)) magic damage per second for 4 seconds. 10 traps may be active at once.

spells.name: Primal Surge / Swipe
spells.summary: In human form, Nidalee channels the spirit of the cougar to heal her allies and imbue them with Attack Speed for a short duration. As a cougar, she claws in a direction, dealing damage to enemies in front of her.
spells.text: Human Form: Nidalee restores (50/75/100/125/150 + (35% Ability Power)) Health increased up to (100/150/200/250/300 + (70% Ability Power)) based on missing Health and grants them 30/40/50/60/70% Attack Speed for 7 seconds.

spells.name: Aspect Of The Cougar
spells.summary: Nidalee transforms into a cougar, gaining new abilities.
spells.text: Passive: While in Human Form, applying Hunted refreshes this Ability's Cooldown. Human Form: Nidalee transforms into Cougar Form, gaining melee Attacks and replacing her Active Abilities. Cougar Form: Nidalee transforms into Human Form, gaining ranged Attacks and replacing her Active Abilities.

spells.name: Joy Unending
spells.summary: Nilah gains increased experience from last-hitting minions along with the ability to enhance and share nearby healing and shielding from her allies.
spells.text: When Nilah kills a minion, she and her nearest ally gain 50% of the experience they would have normally lost from sharing the kill. Nilah gains 7.5% increased effectiveness from healing and 15% from shielding given to her by allied champions abilities. If an ally heals or shields her, they will also gain the increased amount of the shield or heal themselves. If an ally shields or heals themself, Nilah will also gain that additional effect.

spells.name: Formless Blade
spells.summary: With a snap of her whip-blade, Nilah damages any enemies she hits in a straight line in her chosen direction. This action extends her attack range for a short duration.
spells.text: Passive: Nilah gains (30% Critical Strike Chance) Armor Penetration, and her Attacks against champions restore (20% Critical Strike Chance) damage dealt as Health. Overhealing from this is converted into a Shield for 4 seconds. Active: Nilah cracks her whip-blade, dealing (0/10/20/30/40 + (100% Attack Damage)) physical damage. If an enemy unit or structure is hit, Nilah gains 125 Attack Range and (10 ~ 60)Attack Speed, and her Attacks hit in a cone for 4 seconds. Damage is increased by her Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage at 70% effectiveness. If cast during Slipstream, Nilah creates a wave of water striking all enemies along Nilah's path. Area attacks deal 33% damage to minions and 100% damage to monsters. This ability executes low Health minions.

spells.name: Jubilant Veil
spells.summary: Nilah envelops herself in mist, increasing her movement speed and allowing her to gracefully dodge all incoming attacks. Any allies she touches during the mist's duration will also gain this effect.
spells.text: Nilah envelops herself in mist for 2.25 seconds, becoming Ghosted, gaining 15/17.5/20/22.5/25% Move Speed, dodging Attacks, and reducing magic damage taken by 25%. While active, touching allied champions envelops them in mist, granting the same benefits for 1.5 seconds. Ghosted units can pass through other units.

spells.name: Slipstream
spells.summary: Nilah enthusiastically dashes toward her target, dealing damage to any enemies she passes through on the way.
spells.text: Nilah dashes through a unit, dealing (60/70/80/90/100 + (20% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to any enemies she passes through.

spells.name: Apotheosis
spells.summary: Twirling her whip-blade in joyful exuberance, Nilah deals damage to enemies around her before pulling them closer with her weapon.
spells.text: Nilah whirls her whip-blade, dealing (60/100/140 + (40% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage over 1 second, then finishes with a burst of (125/225/325 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage that also Pulls nearby enemies toward her. Apotheosis heals Nilah and her nearby allies for (20% + (10% Critical Strike Chance)) ( + (20% Critical Strike Chance) Formless Blade) of the damage dealt to enemy champions, converting any overhealing into a Shield for 6 seconds. Healing is reduced to 10% against non-champions

spells.name: Umbra Blades
spells.summary: Every few seconds, Nocturne's next attack strikes surrounding enemies for bonus physical damage and heals himself. Nocturne's basic attacks reduce this cooldown.
spells.text: Every 12 seconds, Nocturne's next Attack strikes all nearby enemies for (120% Attack Damage) physical damage and restores ((13 ~ 32) + (30% Ability Power)) Health per target hit. Nocturne's Attacks reduce this Ability's Cooldown by 1 second, increased to 3 against champions and jungle monsters.

spells.name: Duskbringer
spells.summary: Nocturne throws a shadow blade that deals damage, leaves a Dusk Trail, and causes champions to leave a Dusk Trail. While on the trail, Nocturne can move through units and has increased Move Speed and Attack Damage.
spells.text: Nocturne throws a shadow blade, dealing (65/105/145/185/225 + (85% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and leaving a dusk trail for 5 seconds. Enemy champions hit also leave a trail. While on the trail, Nocturne is Ghosted and gains 20/25/30/35/40% Move Speed and 15/25/35/45/55 Attack Damage. Ghosted units can pass through other units.

spells.name: Shroud of Darkness
spells.summary: Nocturne empowers his blades, passively gaining Attack Speed. Activating Shroud of Darkness allows Nocturne to fade into the shadows, creating a magical barrier which blocks a single enemy ability and doubles his passive Attack Speed if successful.
spells.text: Passive: Nocturne gains 30/35/40/45/50% Attack Speed. Active: Nocturne creates a shadow barrier for 1.5 seconds that blocks the next enemy Ability. If an Ability is blocked, this Ability's passive effect is increased to 60/70/80/90/100% Attack Speed for 5 seconds. This Ability will remain active during Paranoia's flight.

spells.name: Unspeakable Horror
spells.summary: Nocturne plants a nightmare into his target's mind, dealing damage each second and applying fear to the target if they do not get out of range by the end of the duration.
spells.text: Passive: Nocturne gains 90% Move Speed toward Feared enemies. Active: Nocturne plants a nightmare tether into his target, dealing (80/125/170/215/260 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage over 2 seconds. If the tether remains unbroken, the target is Feared for 1.25/1.5/1.75/2/2.25 second(s).

spells.name: Paranoia
spells.summary: Nocturne reduces the sight radius of all enemy champions and removes their ally vision in the process. He can then launch himself at a nearby enemy champion.
spells.text: Nocturne darkens the map, reducing the sight radius of all enemy champions and removing their vision of allies for 6 seconds. Nocturne can Recast this Ability during the duration to launch himself at an enemy champion dealing (150/275/400 + (120% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage.

spells.name: Call of the Freljord
spells.summary: Nunu increases the attack speed and Move Speed of Willump and a nearby ally, and causes Willump's basic attacks to damage enemies around the target.
spells.text: When Nunu and Willump deal damage to champions, large jungle monsters, or structures, they and a nearby ally gain 20% Attack Speed and 10% Move Speed for 4 seconds. Willump's Attacks deal an additional (30% Attack Damage) physical damage to other nearby enemies while he has this buff.

spells.name: Consume
spells.summary: Willump takes a bite out of a minion, monster, or enemy champion, dealing damage and healing himself.
spells.text: Nunu asks Willump to take a bite of an enemy, dealing 400/600/800/1000/1200 true damage and restoring (65/95/125/155/185 + (10% bonus Health) + (90% Ability Power)) Health when used against a minion or jungle monster. Against a champion, it instead deals (60/100/140/180/220 + (5% bonus Health) + (65% Ability Power)) magic damage and restores (39/57/75/93/111 + (6% bonus Health) + (54% Ability Power)) Health. The healing is increased by 50% when Nunu and Willump are below 50% Health.

spells.name: Biggest Snowball Ever!
spells.summary: Willump creates a snowball that grows in size and speed as he rolls it. The snowball damages and knocks up enemies.
spells.text: Nunu and Willump create a snowball that grows in size and speed as they roll it. They turn slower while rolling it, but can increase turning speed by holding the turn. The snowball does between (59.94/74.925/89.91/104.895/119.88 + (49.95% Ability Power)) and (180/225/270/315/360 + (150% Ability Power)) magic damage, and Knocks Up for between 0.5 and 1.25 seconds when it collides with a champion, large monster or wall. These values scale up with distance rolled. Nunu and Willump can Recast to let the snowball go early.

spells.name: Snowball Barrage
spells.summary: Nunu throws multiple snowballs that damage enemies. When he's finished, Willump roots any champions or large monsters that were hit by a snowball.
spells.text: Nunu throws three snowballs, dealing (15/22.5/30/37.5/45 + (12% Ability Power)) magic damage per snowball and Slowing enemies hit by all three by 30/35/40/45/50% for 1 second. Nunu can Recast this up to twice more. After 3 seconds, Nunu Roots all nearby enemies that had been Slowed by the snowballs for (0.5 ~ 1.5) seconds and deals an additional (20/30/40/50/60 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage. Nunu can only Slow each enemy once with this Ability.

spells.name: Absolute Zero
spells.summary: Nunu & Willump create a powerful blizzard in an area that slows enemies and deals massive damage at the end.
spells.text: Nunu and Willump channel a powerful blizzard for up to 3 seconds. Enemies inside are Slowed by 50%, increasing to 95% over the duration. Nunu and Willump also gain (65/75/85 + (30/40/50% bonus Health) + (150% Ability Power)) Shield for the duration before decaying over 3 seconds afterwards. When the blizzard ends, it detonates, dealing up to (625/925/1275 + (300% Ability Power)) magic damage based on channel time. Nunu and Willump can Recast to end the blizzard early.

spells.name: Berserker Rage
spells.summary: Olaf gains Attack Speed and Life Steal based on his missing Health.
spells.text: Olaf gains up to (50% ~ 100%) Attack Speed and (8% ~ 25%) Life Steal, based on his missing Health.

spells.name: Undertow
spells.summary: Olaf throws an axe into the ground at a target location, dealing damage to enemies it passes through and reducing their Armor and Move Speed. If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reset.
spells.text: Olaf throws an axe, dealing (70/120/170/220/270 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and Slowing by 30/35/40/45/50% for up to 3 seconds (based on distance travelled). Champions hit lose 20% Armor for 4 seconds. If Olaf picks up the axe, this Ability's Cooldown is reduced to 2.5 seconds, or fully refunded if 2.5 seconds has elapsed. Deals 20/45/70/95/120 bonus damage to monsters.

spells.name: Tough It Out
spells.summary: Olaf's Attack Speed is increased and he gains a Shield.
spells.text: Olaf gains 40/50/60/70/80% Attack Speed for 5 seconds, and 10/40/70/100/130 plus 17.5% missing Health Shield (up to a maximum of (10/40/70/100/130 + (12.25% Health)) Shield below 30% Health) for 2.5 seconds.

spells.name: Reckless Swing
spells.summary: Olaf attacks with such force that it deals true damage to his target and himself, refunding the Health cost if he destroys the target.
spells.text: Olaf ferociously swings his axes, dealing (70/115/160/205/250 + (50% Attack Damage)) true damage. If the enemy dies, the cost is refunded. Attacks lower the Cooldown of this Ability by 1 second, increased to 2 seconds when attacking monsters. Cast time scales based on bonus Attack Speed.

spells.name: Ragnarok
spells.summary: Olaf passively gains increased armor and magic resist. He can activate this ability to become immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking.
spells.text: Passive: Olaf gains 10/15/20 Armor and 10/15/20 Magic Resist. Active: Olaf cleanses all Immobilizing and Disabling effects on himself and becomes immune to them for 3 seconds. While active, Olaf gains (10/20/30 + (25% Attack Damage)) Attack Damage. Hitting a champion with an Attack or Reckless Swing extends the duration by 2.5 seconds. Additionally, Olaf gains 20/45/70% Move Speed towards enemy champions for 1 second.

spells.name: Clockwork Windup
spells.summary: Orianna's Attacks deal additional magic damage. This damage increases the more Orianna Attacks the same target.
spells.text: Orianna's Abilities originate from her Ball. Orianna's Ball automatically returns to her if she is too far away from it. Orianna's Attacks deal an additional ((10 ~ 50) + (15% Ability Power)) magic damage. Subsequent Attacks against the same target within 4 seconds deal an additional ((1.5 ~ 7.5) + (2.25% Ability Power)) magic damage (max of ((3 ~ 15) + (4.5% Ability Power)) damage).

spells.name: Command: Attack
spells.summary: Orianna commands her Ball to fire toward a target location, dealing magic damage to targets along the way (deals less damage to subsequent targets). Her Ball remains at the target location after.
spells.text: Orianna commands her Ball to move to an area, dealing (60/90/120/150/180 + (55% Ability Power)) magic damage to surrounding enemies and to enemies it passes through. Deals 30% less damage to all enemies after the first.

spells.name: Command: Dissonance
spells.summary: Orianna commands her Ball to release a pulse of energy, dealing magic damage around it. This leaves a field behind that speeds up allies and slows enemies.
spells.text: Orianna commands her Ball to release an electric pulse, dealing (70/110/150/190/230 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage to surrounding enemies. The pulse leaves behind an energy field for 3 seconds, Slowing enemies by 20/25/30/35/40% and granting allies 20/25/30/35/40% Move Speed, decaying over 2 seconds.

spells.name: Command: Protect
spells.summary: Orianna commands her Ball to attach to an allied champion, Shielding them and dealing magic damage to any enemies it passes through on the way. Additionally, the Ball grants additional Armor and Magic Resist to the champion it is attached to.
spells.text: Passive: The Ball adds 6/12/18/24/30 Armor and 6/12/18/24/30 Magic Resist to the allied champion it is attached to. Active: Orianna commands her Ball to attach to an allied champion, granting them (55/90/125/160/195 + (45% Ability Power)) Shield for 2.5 seconds. Enemies the Ball passes through take (60/90/120/150/180 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Command: Shockwave
spells.summary: Orianna commands her Ball to unleash a shockwave, dealing magic damage and launching nearby enemies towards the Ball after a short delay.
spells.text: Orianna commands her Ball to unleash a shockwave, dealing (225/350/475 + (110% Ability Power)) magic damage to nearby enemies and Knocking them in the direction of the Ball.

spells.name: Living Forge
spells.summary: Ornn gains an additional bonus Armor and Magic Resist from all sources. Ornn can spend gold to forge non-consumable items anywhere. Additionally, he can create masterwork items for himself and for his allies.
spells.text: Ornn can spend gold to forge non-consumable items anywhere. When Ornn reaches level 13, he will upgrade one of his Legendary items into a Masterwork Item. For each level after 13, Ornn can upgrade an ally's Legendary Item by clicking on them while nearby. Ornn gains an additional 10% bonus Health, Armor, and Magic Resist from all sources. This value increases by 4% of these bonus stats per Legendary item Ornn upgrades.

spells.name: Volcanic Rupture
spells.summary: Ornn slams the ground, sending out a fissure dealing damage and slowing enemies hit. After a small delay, a magma pillar forms at the end location.
spells.text: Ornn slams the ground, creating a fissure dealing (20/45/70/95/120 + (110% Attack Damage)) physical damage and Slowing by 40% for 2 seconds. A pillar of rock forms at the fissure's end for 4 seconds. The fissure stops shortly after hitting an enemy champion.

spells.name: Bellows Breath
spells.summary: Ornn advances, breathing fire. Enemies hit by the final gout of flame become Brittle.
spells.text: Ornn stomps forward Unstoppably while breathing fire, dealing 12/13/14/15/16% max Health magic damage over 0.75 seconds. Enemies hit by the final bout of flame become Brittle for 3 seconds. Immobilizing effects on Brittle targets have their duration increased by 30% and deal an additional (9% ~ 17%) max Health magic damage. Ornn's Attacks against Brittle targets Knock them Back, dealing the additional damage. Deals a minimum of 80/130/180/230/280 magic damage to champions and minions, and a max of 260/320/380/440/500 magic damage to jungle monsters.

spells.name: Searing Charge
spells.summary: Ornn charges, dealing damage to enemies he passes through. If Ornn collides with terrain while charging, the impact creates a shockwave around him which deals damage and knocks up enemies.
spells.text: Ornn charges, dealing (80/125/170/215/260 + (40% bonus Armor) + (40% bonus Magic Resist)) physical damage. If Ornn rams into terrain, he creates a shockwave that Knocks Up enemies for 1.25 seconds and applies the same damage to those not hit by the charge. Ornn's charge destroys magma pillars and terrain created by enemies.

spells.name: Call of the Forge God
spells.summary: Ornn summons a massive elemental at a location which travels toward him with increasing speed. Enemies run over by the elemental take damage, are slowed and are made Brittle. Ornn can recast the ability to charge into the elemental, redirecting it in the direction he hits it, causing the elemental to affect any enemies it runs over to be knocked up, dealing the same damage and re-applying Brittle.
spells.text: Ornn summons a massive lava elemental, which stampedes towards him, dealing (125/175/225 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage, applying Brittle to, and Slowing enemies hit by 40/50/60% for 3 seconds. Ornn can Recast to dash with a headbutt. If he dashes into the elemental, he redirects and empowers it, causing it to Knock Up the first champion for 1 second and subsequent champions for 0.5 seconds. The elemental also deals (125/175/225 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage and reapplies Brittle.

spells.name: Mortal Will
spells.summary: Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered.
spells.text: After using 5 Abilities or Attacks, Pantheon empowers his next basic Ability.

spells.name: Comet Spear
spells.summary: Pantheon either thrusts his spear or throws his spear in the chosen direction.
spells.text: Tap: Pantheon thrusts his spear, dealing (70/100/130/160/190 + (115% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to enemies hit. Refunds 60% of this Ability's Cooldown. Hold: Pantheon hurls his spear, dealing (70/100/130/160/190 + (115% bonus Attack Damage) + (50% Ability Power)) physical damage to the first enemy hit and 50% less to further targets. This Ability is enhanced against enemies below 20% Health to deal (155/230/305/380/455 + (230% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage instead. Mortal Will Bonus: Deals an additional ((20 ~ 240) + (115% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. Deals 80% damage to monsters. Deals 70% damage to minions.

spells.name: Shield Vault
spells.summary: Pantheon dashes to a target, damaging and stunning them.
spells.text: Pantheon leaps on his target, Stunning for 1 second and dealing (6/6.5/7/7.5/8% + (0.4% per 100 bonus Health) + (1.5% per 100 Ability Power)) max Health physical damage. Mortal Will Bonus: Pantheon's next Attack strikes 3 times, dealing a total of (120/165% Attack Damage) physical damage. Deals a minimum of 60 and a maximum of 150 damage to Minions and Monsters.

spells.name: Aegis Assault
spells.summary: Pantheon sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front and striking repeatedly with his spear.
spells.text: Pantheon braces his shield and engages enemies in a chosen direction for 1.5 seconds, becoming immune to non-tower damage from that direction and dealing (100% Attack Damage) physical damage over the duration. After channeling Pantheon slams with his shield, dealing (55/105/155/205/255 + (150% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. Mortal Will Bonus: When Pantheon slams his shield he gains ((5 ~ 30) + (2.5% bonus Health)) Armor and ((5 ~ 30) + (2.5% bonus Health)) Magic Resist for 4 seconds, and 60% Move Speed for 1.5 seconds. Recast to end early (Pantheon still slams with his shield as the last hit). Damage to minions is reduced by 50%.

spells.name: Grand Starfall
spells.summary: Pantheon composes himself and then leaps into the air, landing at a chosen location as a comet.
spells.text: Passive: Pantheon gains 10/20/30% Armor Penetration. Active: Pantheon gathers his strength to leap high into the air. He throws his spear from above which in a small area deals (70/100/130 + (115% bonus Attack Damage) + (50% Ability Power)) physical damage and Slows by 50% for 2 seconds. Pantheon then crashes down as a meteor at the target area. Deals up to (300/500/700 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies in a line (decreased by up to 50% at the edges of the area). This Ability instantly readies Mortal Will.

spells.name: Iron Ambassador
spells.summary: Poppy throws her buckler that bounces off the target. Poppy can pick it up to gain a temporary shield.
spells.text: Every 8 seconds, Poppy's next Attack throws her buckler, gaining 350 range and dealing an additional (20 ~ 180) magic damage. The buckler ricochets off the target, landing nearby. Poppy can pick it up to gain (11/20% Health) Shield, and enemies can step on it to destroy it. The buckler automatically returns to Poppy if it kills the target.

spells.name: Hammer Shock
spells.summary: Poppy swings her hammer, dealing damage and creating a zone that will slow enemies and explode after a delay.
spells.text: Poppy smashes the ground, dealing (30/55/80/105/130 + (75% bonus Attack Damage)) plus 7/7.5/8/8.5/9% max Health physical damage and making the ground unstable. The unstable area Slows enemies by (20/23/26/29/32% + (0.8% per 100 bonus Health)) and erupts after 1 second, dealing (30/55/80/105/130 + (75% bonus Attack Damage)) plus 7/7.5/8/8.5/9% max Health physical damage again. Percent Health damage deals a max of 70/105/140/175/210 damage to minions and jungle monsters per hit.

spells.name: Steadfast Presence
spells.summary: Poppy passively gains Armor and Magic Resist. This bonus increases when she is low on Health. Poppy can activate Steadfast Presence to gain Move Speed and stop enemy dashes around her. If a dash is stopped, the enemy is slowed and grounded.
spells.text: Passive: Poppy gains (16% Armor) Armor and (16% Magic Resist) Magic Resist. This bonus is doubled if Poppy is below 40% Health. Active: Poppy gains 40% Move Speed and projects a field around her for 2 seconds that stops enemy dashes. Enemies who are stopped by the field are Grounded and Slowed by 25% for 2 seconds and take (70/110/150/190/230 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Heroic Charge
spells.summary: Poppy dashes to the target and pushes it back. If the target is pushed into a wall, it is stunned.
spells.text: Poppy tackles an enemy, dealing (40/60/80/100/120 + (60% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and carrying them forward. If Poppy tackles them into terrain, the enemy is Stunned for 1.6/1.7/1.8/1.9/2 seconds and take an additional (40/60/80/100/120 + (60% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage.

spells.name: Keeper's Verdict
spells.summary: Poppy channels a hammer strike that knocks enemies very far away.
spells.text: Begin Casting: Poppy begins charging her hammer for up to 4 seconds, Slowing herself by 15%. Release: Poppy smashes the ground, creating a shockwave that deals (200/300/400 + (90% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first champion hit and surrounding enemies, Knocks them Back towards their Nexus, and makes them Untargetable while they fly. The range and Knock Back distance increase with charge duration. An uncharged swing deals (100/150/200 + (45% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and Knocks Up for 1 seconds. Untargetable units won't be affected by enemy Attacks or Abilities unless they've already been hit by them.

spells.name: Gift of the Drowned Ones
spells.summary: When Pyke is hidden from enemies, he regenerates damage that he has recently taken from champions. Pyke also cannot gain extra Maximum Health from any source, and instead gains Bonus AD.
spells.text: Pyke stores (9% + (0.2% Lethality)) of damage taken from champions, increased to (40% + (0.4% Lethality)) when there's more than one enemy nearby. Pyke can store up to (80 + (800% bonus Attack Damage)) damage. While unseen by enemies, he rapidly regenerates this stored damage. Additionally, Pyke converts all Maximum Health increases to Attack Damage instead at a rate of 14 Health to 1 Attack Damage.

spells.name: Bone Skewer
spells.summary: Pyke either stabs an enemy in front of him or pulls an enemy towards him.
spells.text: Tap: Pyke stabs, dealing (100/150/200/250/300 + (75% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first enemy hit, preferring champions. They are then Slowed by 90% for 1 second. Hold: Pyke throws his harpoon, dealing (100/150/200/250/300 + (75% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first enemy hit and Pulling them towards him. They are then Slowed by 90% for 1 second. If Pyke successfully hits an enemy champion or the channel does not complete successfully, 75% of the Mana cost is refunded.

spells.name: Ghostwater Dive
spells.summary: Pyke enters Camouflage and gains significant Move Speed that decays over time.
spells.text: Pyke gains Camouflage and (45 + (200% Lethality))Move Speed decaying over 5 seconds. Move Speed scales with Lethality. Camouflaged units cannot be seen unless an enemy champion is inside their detection radius.

spells.name: Phantom Undertow
spells.summary: Pyke dashes and leaves behind a phantom that will return to him, stunning enemy champions along its path.
spells.text: Pyke dashes, leaving a drowned phantom behind him that returns to him shortly. The phantom Stuns for (1.25 + (1% Lethality)) seconds and deals (100/150/200/250/300 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to champions. Stun duration scales with Lethality.

spells.name: Death From Below
spells.summary: Pyke blinks to and executes low health enemies, allowing him to cast this spell again and granting additional gold to an ally who assists.
spells.text: Pyke strikes all enemy champions in an X, teleporting to and executing targets below ((250 ~ 550) + (80% bonus Attack Damage) + (150% Lethality)) Health. Champions above the threshold and non-champions instead take physical damage equal to 50% of that amount (((125 ~ 275) + (40% bonus Attack Damage) + (75% Lethality))). When an enemy champion dies inside the X, Pyke can Recast this Ability for free within 20 seconds. If he executed that champion, the last assisting ally will also get kill gold. If he did not, he will still get kill gold as if he did.

spells.name: Royal Privilege
spells.summary: Qiyana's first basic attack or ability against each enemy deals bonus damage.
spells.text: Qiyana's Attacks and Abilities deal an additional ((15 ~ 67) + (25% bonus Attack Damage) + (30% Ability Power)) bonus physical damage. This effect has a 25 second per-target Cooldown. Using Terrashape to gain a different weapon Enchantment resets this effect's Cooldown on all targets.

spells.name: Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal
spells.summary: Qiyana swings her weapon, dealing damage with a bonus effect based on her element.
spells.text: If Qiyana does not have an Enchantment, she slashes, dealing (80/110/140/170/200 + (90% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to enemies in a small area. If she does, this Ability gains extra range and an additional effect based on the type of Enchantment:Ice Enchantment: Briefly Roots, then Slows by 20% for 1 second.Rock Enchantment: Deals an additional (48/66/84/102/120 + (54% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to units below 50% Health.Wild Enchantment: Leaves a trail that turns Qiyana Invisible and grants 20% Move Speed. Enemies beyond the first take 75% physical damage instead. This Ability deals 160% damage to jungle monsters. Invisible units cannot be revealed except by turrets or True Sight.

spells.name: Terrashape
spells.summary: Qiyana dashes to a location and enchants her weapon with an element. Her attacks and abilities deal bonus damage while her weapon is enchanted.
spells.text: Passive: While Qiyana's weapon is Enchanted, she gains 15/20/25/30/35% Attack Speed and her Attacks deal an additional (8/16/24/32/40 + (45% Ability Power) + (20% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage. She also gains 3/5/7/9/11% Move Speed while out of combat near the corresponding terrain type. Active: Qiyana dashes towards a nearby brush, terrain, or river and Enchants her weapon with that particular terrain type. This refreshes Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal's Cooldown.

spells.name: Audacity
spells.summary: Qiyana dashes to an enemy, damaging them.
spells.text: Qiyana dashes through an enemy and deals (50/90/130/170/210 + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to them. If Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal is cast while this Ability is targeting a champion, Qiyana will automatically aim it at her target.

spells.name: Supreme Display of Talent
spells.summary: Qiyana sends out a shockwave that detonates whatever elements she hits with it, stunning and damaging nearby enemies.
spells.text: Qiyana launches a shockwave that Knocks Back enemies and detonates when it hits terrain. The explosion follows the entire edge of the terrain, Stunning for between 0.5 and 1 seconds and dealing (100/200/300 + (125% bonus Attack Damage)) plus 10% max Health physical damage. Stun duration scales down with distance the shockwave has travelled. Any river or brush the shockwave passes through also explode after a delay for the same damage and Stun.

spells.name: Harrier
spells.summary: Valor, Quinn's Demacian eagle, periodically marks enemies with Harrier. Quinn's first basic attack against Harrier targets will deal bonus physical damage.
spells.text: Every ? seconds, Valor marks a nearby enemy with Harrier, revealing it for 4 seconds and causing Quinn's next Attack On-Hit against them to deal ((15 ~ 120) + (40% bonus Attack Damage)) bonus physical damage.

spells.name: Blinding Assault
spells.summary: Quinn calls Valor to mark an enemy and hinder its vision before damaging all enemies in the immediate area.
spells.text: Quinn orders Valor to dive, making the first enemy hit with Harrier, reducing their vision radius for 1.75 seconds and dealing (65/100/135/170/205 + (80/85/90/95/100% bonus Attack Damage) + (50% Ability Power)) physical damage to all surrounding enemies. If the first enemy struck is not a champion, it is Disarmed for 1.75 seconds. Deals 100% increased damage to Monsters ((130/200/270/340/410 + (160/170/180/190/200% bonus Attack Damage) + (100% Ability Power))).

spells.name: Heightened Senses
spells.summary: Passively grants Quinn Attack Speed and Move Speed after she attacks a Harrier target. Activate to have Valor reveal a large area nearby.
spells.text: Passive: Attacking a Harrier target grants Quinn 28/41/54/67/80% Attack Speed and 20/25/30/35/40% Move Speed for 2 seconds. Active: Valor reveals a large area nearby for 2 seconds.

spells.name: Vault
spells.summary: Quinn dashes to an enemy, dealing physical damage and slowing the target's Move Speed. Upon reaching the target, she leaps off the target, briefly interrupting it, and lands near her maximum Attack Range away from the target.
spells.text: Quinn dashes to an enemy, dealing (40/65/90/115/140 + (20% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and marking them with Harrier. Quinn then leaps backwards from the target, slightly Knocking them Back and Slowing them by 50%, decaying over 1.5 seconds.

spells.name: Behind Enemy Lines
spells.summary: Quinn and Valor team up to fly around at great speed. Ending the ability casts Skystrike, which deals damage to nearby enemies and marks champions with Harrier.
spells.text: Quinn calls to Valor, pairing up after channeling for 2 seconds gaining 70/100/130% Move Speed and allowing her to Recast this Ability. Attacking or using Blinding Assault or Vault automatically Recasts this Ability. Recast: Quinn and Valor perform an aerial maneuver, dealing (60/90/120 + (35% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage, marking champions with Harrier, and ending this Ability. Being damaged by non-minions removes the Move Speed bonus for 3 seconds.

spells.name: Fey Feathers
spells.summary: Rakan periodically gains a shield.
spells.text: Every 40 seconds, Rakan gains ((30 ~ 225) + (95% Ability Power)) Shield. Rakan's Attacks and Abilities against enemy champions reduce this Cooldown by 1 second. Lover's Leap - Xayah and Rakan can recall together.

spells.name: Gleaming Quill
spells.summary: Flings a magical feather that deals magic damage. Striking a champion or epic monster enables Rakan to heal his allies.
spells.text: Rakan flings a magical feather that deals (70/115/160/205/250 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage to the first enemy hit. If the feather hits a champion or epic jungle monster, Rakan restores ((40 ~ 210) + (55% Ability Power)) Health to himself and nearby allies after 3 seconds or when he touches an allied champion.

spells.name: Grand Entrance
spells.summary: Dashes to a location, knocking up nearby enemies on arrival.
spells.text: Rakan dashes, then spirals into the air, Knocking Up for 1 second and dealing (70/120/170/220/270 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Battle Dance
spells.summary: Flies to an allied champion granting them a shield. Can be re-cast for free for a short duration.
spells.text: Rakan dashes to an allied champion, granting them (50/75/100/125/150 + (70% Ability Power)) Shield for 3 seconds. Rakan can Recast this Ability once within 5 seconds. Cast range is increased when cast on Xayah.

spells.name: The Quickness
spells.summary: Gains Move Speed, charming and dealing magic damage to enemies touched.
spells.text: Rakan gains 75% Move Speed for 4 seconds. Rakan deals (100/200/300 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage and Charms enemies for 1/1.25/1.5 second(s) the first time he touches them. The first champion touched grants Rakan 150% decaying Move Speed.

spells.name: Spiked Shell
spells.summary: Rammus gains bonus Attack Damage scaling with his Armor and Magic Resistance.
spells.text: Rammus gains ((15% Armor) + (15% Magic Resist)) Attack Damage.

spells.name: Powerball
spells.summary: Rammus accelerates in a ball towards his enemies, dealing damage and slowing targets affected by the impact.
spells.text: Rammus curls into a ball, gaining (25% ~ 39.1%) Move Speed, accelerating up to (150% ~ 234.6%) Move Speed over 6 seconds. Rammus stops after colliding with an enemy, dealing (80/120/160/200/240 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage, Knocking Back, and Slowing nearby enemies by 40/50/60/70/80% for 1 second. Recast: Rammus ends this Ability early.

spells.name: Defensive Ball Curl
spells.summary: Rammus goes into a defensive formation, vastly increasing his Armor and Magic Resistance, and returning damage to enemies that attack him.
spells.text: Rammus enters a defensive formation for 7 seconds, gaining (35.1/44/53.65/64.05/75.2 + (30/37.5/45/52.5/60% Armor)) Armor and (26/34.375/43.5/53.375/64 + (30/37.5/45/52.5/60% Magic Resist)) Magic Resist and dealing (15 + (10% Armor) + (10% Magic Resist)) magic damage to enemies that Attack him. Recast: Rammus ends this Ability early.

spells.name: Frenzying Taunt
spells.summary: Rammus taunts an enemy champion or monster into a reckless assault against him.
spells.text: Rammus Taunts an enemy champion or monster for 1.2/1.4/1.6/1.8/2 seconds. Monsters are dealt (80/100/120/140/160 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Soaring Slam
spells.summary: Rammus hops into the air and slams down at a target area, dealing magic damage and slowing enemies. If cast while Rammus is in Powerball, Rammus knocks up enemies near the center as well.
spells.text: Rammus hops into the air and slams down in an area, dealing (150/250/350 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing by 30/40/50% for 1.5 seconds. If used during Powerball, enemies in the center take an additional (80/120/160 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage and are Knocked Up for 0.75 seconds. Rammus then creates 3 aftershocks in the area over 3.5 seconds, repeating the Slow. The range of this Ability is increased by Rammus's Move Speed. This Ability deals 200% damage to turrets.

spells.name: Fury of the Xer'Sai
spells.summary: Rek'Sai generates Fury by Attacking and hitting with basic Abilities. She consumes this Fury while Burrowed to restore health.
spells.text: Rek'Sai generates 25 Fury when she Attacks and 25 Fury from Abilities. While Burrowed, she consumes her Fury to restore up to (9/20% Health) Health over 3 seconds, increasing with level.

spells.name: Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker
spells.summary: Rek'Sai's next 3 basic attacks deal bonus Physical Damage to nearby enemies. While Burrowed, Rek'Sai launches a burst of void-charged earth that damages and reveals enemies hit.
spells.text: Unburrowed: Rek'Sai's next 3 Attacks within 3 seconds gain 35% Attack Speed and deal an additional (30/35/40/45/50% Attack Damage) physical damage to nearby enemies. Attacks refresh the duration of this Ability. The bonus damage can critically strike the primary target.

spells.name: Burrow / Un-burrow
spells.summary: Rek'Sai burrows into the ground, gaining new abilities and increased Move Speed. Her vision range is reduced and she cannot use basic attacks. While Burrowed, Rek'Sai may cast Unburrow to knock up and damage nearby enemies.
spells.text: Unburrowed: Rek'Sai burrows into the ground, gaining access to new Abilities but cannot Attack. She gains 5/10/15/20/25 Move Speed, 65% reduced vision range, and nearby enemies that move and are otherwise unseen will have their positions revealed to Rek'sai and her allies.

spells.name: Furious Bite / Tunnel
spells.summary: Rek'Sai bites her target, dealing physical damage, or bonus true damage if she has max Fury. While Burrowed, Rek'Sai creates a re-usable, long lasting tunnel. Enemies can destroy it by standing on top of either entrance.
spells.text: Unburrowed: Rek'Sai bites a target, dealing (70/95/120/145/170 + (60% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. At max Fury, the bite deals (84/114/144/174/204 + (72% bonus Attack Damage)) true damage instead.

spells.name: Void Rush
spells.summary: Rek'Sai passively marks targets by damaging them. She can activate this ability to become briefly untargetable and lunge at a marked target for heavy damage based on their maximum health.
spells.text: Rek'Sai targets an enemy damaged by her in the last 5 seconds and then dives underground, becoming Untargetable. Moments later, she leaps unstoppably at her target, dealing (150/250/350 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) plus 15/20/25% max Health physical damage and resets the cooldown of Burrow / Un-burrow.

spells.name: Break the Mold
spells.summary: Rell's Attacks and Abilities deal additional magic damage and steal Armor and Magic Resist on hit.
spells.text: Rell's Attacks and Abilities steal 3% Armor and 3% Magic Resist for 5 seconds. Max: 15%. Basic attacks deal ((5% Armor) + (5% Magic Resist)) magic damage on-hit.

spells.name: Shattering Strike
spells.summary: Rell deals magic damage to units in a line, breaking their shields and stunning them.
spells.text: Rell thrusts her lance, Stunning targets for 0.65 seconds, destroying all Shields, and dealing (60/100/140/180/220 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. Does not break Shields on monsters.

spells.name: Ferromancy: Crash Down
spells.summary: Mounted: Rell Dismounts, crashing down in her armor, Knocking enemies up and gaining a large Shield. While dismounted, she gains Armor, Magic Resist, Attack Speed, and Attack Range, but is Slowed. Dismounted: Rell forms her Mount, gaining a burst of speed and Knocking Up the next enemy she attacks.
spells.text: Passive - Mounted Alacrity: Rell gains 20/25/30/35/40 Move Speed while mounted. Active - Ferromancy: Crash Down: Rell leaps off her mount, Knocking Up enemies and dealing (60/90/120/150/180 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. Rell gains (20/40/60/80/100 + (11% Health)) Shield, which lasts until she remounts. Rell then enters her armored form, gaining 15% increased Armor and Magic Resist, 20% Attack Speed and 75 Attack Range. In this armored form, she can use Ferromancy: Mount Up.

spells.name: Full Tilt
spells.summary: Passive: Rell gains out of combat Move Speed. Active: Rell and an ally gain ramping Move Speed, doubled toward enemies and each other. Her next Attack explodes, dealing magic damage.
spells.text: Rell and an ally charge, gaining 15% Move Speed, increased to 30% when facing enemy champions or each other for 3 seconds. Rell's next Attack or Shattering Strike explodes in an area for (5/5.5/6/6.5/7% + (3% per 100 Ability Power)) max Health magic damage. Damage capped at (150 ~ 300) against jungle monsters and structures.

spells.name: Magnet Storm
spells.summary: Rell explodes in a magnetic fury, violently Pulling nearby enemies toward herself. Then Rell constantly Drags nearby enemies toward herself for a short while, dealing magic damage over time.
spells.text: Rell explodes in a magnetic fury, violently Pulling nearby enemies towards herself. Then Rell constantly Drags nearby enemies towards herself and deals (150/250/350 + (110% Ability Power)) magic damage over the next 2 seconds.

spells.name: Leverage
spells.summary: Renata's Attacks deal bonus damage and mark enemies. Renata's allies can damage marked enemies to deal bonus damage.
spells.text: Renata's Attacks mark enemies for 6 seconds and deal an additional ((1% ~ 1.52%) + (2% per 100 Ability Power)) max Health magic damage if they were unmarked. Allied champions' Attacks or Abilities consume the mark, dealing ((1% ~ 1.52%) + (2% per 100 Ability Power)) max Health magic damage. Renata may only have one target marked at a time.

spells.name: Handshake
spells.summary: Renata sends out a missile rooting the first enemy hit, and can recast the ability to throw the unit in a direction.
spells.text: Renata sends out a missile from her arm, Rooting the first enemy hit for 1 second and dealing (80/125/170/215/260 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage. Recast: Renata Pulls the enemy in a direction, dealing (80/125/170/215/260 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies they are thrown into and Stunning for 0.5 seconds if the thrown enemy is a champion.

spells.name: Bailout
spells.summary: Renata buffs an allied champion to fight harder, delaying their death and potentially saving them if they get a takedown.
spells.text: Renata infuses an ally champion, granting (10/15/20/25/30% + (1% per 100 Ability Power)) Attack Speed and (10/12.5/15/17.5/20% + (1% per 100 Ability Power)) Move Speed towards enemies, increasing to (20/30/40/50/60% + (2% per 100 Ability Power)) Attack Speed and (20/25/30/35/40% + (2% per 100 Ability Power)) Move Speed over 5 seconds. Takedowns refresh the duration of the buff. If the ally would die, they instead return to full Health, which then decays over 3 seconds. If they get a Takedown while decaying, they will be set to 20% max Health and stop decaying. The Champion's death can be delayed by healing or similar effects while in the decaying state, but cannot be prevented unless the Champion gets a Takedown. Champions can only delay their death once.

spells.name: Loyalty Program
spells.summary: Renata sends out a pair of chemtech missiles, shielding allies and damaging and slowing enemies hit.
spells.text: Renata sends out a pair of chemtech missiles, dealing (65/95/125/155/185 + (55% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing surrounding enemies and enemies hit by 30% for 2 seconds. Allies hit gain (50/65/80/95/110 + (50% Ability Power)) Shield for 3 seconds.

spells.name: Hostile Takeover
spells.summary: Renata sends out a wave of chemicals, causing any enemies hit to go Berserk.
spells.text: Renata sends out a wave of chemicals, Berserking enemies for 1.25/1.75/2.25 seconds, causing them to Attack the nearest unit, prioritizing their allies. While Berserk, enemies gain 100% Attack Speed.

spells.name: Reign of Anger
spells.summary: Renekton's attacks generate Fury, increased when he is low on life. This Fury can empower his abilities with bonus effects.
spells.text: Renekton gains 5 Fury per Attack. While above 50 Fury, his next Ability spends it to become empowered. Fury decays while out of combat. While below 50% Health, Renekton gains 50% increased Fury.

spells.name: Cull the Meek
spells.summary: Renekton swings his blade, dealing moderate physical damage to all targets around him, and heals for a small portion of the damage dealt. If he has more than 50 Fury, his damage and heal are increased.
spells.text: Renekton swings his blade, dealing (60/90/120/150/180 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and restoring (2/3/4/5/6 + (2% bonus Attack Damage)) Health per non-champion and (12/20/28/36/44 + (17% bonus Attack Damage)) per champion hit. He also generates 2.5 Fury per non-champion and 10 Fury per champion. Fury Bonus: Damage is increased to (90/135/180/225/270 + (140% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and healing is increased to (6/9/12/15/18 + (6% bonus Attack Damage)) Health against non-champions and (36/60/84/108/132 + (51% bonus Attack Damage)) Health against champions. Does not generate any Fury. Max 30 Fury per cast. Restores up to 50/75/100/125/150 Health on basic casts. Restores up to 200/300/400/500/600 Health on empowered casts.

spells.name: Ruthless Predator
spells.summary: Renekton slashes his target twice, dealing moderate physical damage and stuns them for 0.75 seconds. If Renekton has more than 50 Fury, he slashes his target three times, destroying damage shields on the target, dealing high physical damage, and stunning them for 1.5 seconds.
spells.text: Renekton's next Attack strikes twice, Stunning for 0.75 seconds and dealing a total of (10/40/70/100/130 + (150% Attack Damage)) physical damage. Hitting a champion generates an additional 10 Fury. Fury Bonus: Renekton Attacks 3 times instead, destroying Shields before dealing (15/60/105/150/195 + (225% Attack Damage)) physical damage and Stunning for 1.5 seconds. Does not generate any Fury. All Attacks apply On-hit effects separately. Does not break shields on monsters.

spells.name: Slice and Dice
spells.summary: Renekton dashes, dealing damage to units along the way. Empowered, Renekton deals bonus damage and reduces the Armor of units hit.
spells.text: Renekton dashes, dealing (40/70/100/130/160 + (90% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. He generates 2 Fury per non-champion and 10 Fury per champion hit. Hitting at least one enemy allows Renekton to Recast this Ability once for 4 seconds. Fury Bonus: The Recast dash deals (70/115/160/205/250 + (135% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage instead and removes 25/27.5/30/32.5/35% Armor for 4 seconds. Does not generate Fury. Max 30 Fury per cast.

spells.name: Dominus
spells.summary: Renekton transforms into the Tyrant form, gaining bonus Health and dealing damage to enemies around him. While in this form, Renekton gains Fury periodically.
spells.text: Renekton surrounds himself with dark energies for 15 seconds, gaining 300/500/700 max Health and 20 Fury. While active, he deals (60/150/240 + (10% Ability Power) + (10% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage and gains 5 Fury per second.

spells.name: Unseen Predator
spells.summary: While in Brush, Rengar leaps at his target with his basic attack. Rengar generates Ferocity whenever he casts an ability. At Max Ferocity, his next ability is empowered. Killing enemy champions awards trophies on Rengar's Bonetooth Necklace, granting bonus attack damage.
spells.text: While in Brush, Rengar leaps to enemies he Attacks. Rengar generates 1 Ferocity when he uses a non-ultimate Ability. At the start of the leap Unseen Predator will generate 1 Ferocity if none of his current Ferocity was generated this way. At 4 Ferocity, his next non-ultimate Ability is empowered. Casting an empowered Ability grants Rengar 50% Move Speed for 1.5 seconds. Unique takedowns increase Rengar's Attack Damage from Bonetooth Necklace.

spells.name: Savagery
spells.summary: Rengar's next Attack brutally stabs his target for bonus damage. Ferocity effect: deals increased damage and grants Attack Speed.
spells.text: Rengar's next 2 Attacks gain 40% Attack Speed. The first Attack deals (20/55/90/125/160 + (100% Attack Damage) + (5% Attack Damage)) physical damage. Max Ferocity: The first Attack deals ((35 ~ 135) + (100% Attack Damage) + (20% Attack Damage)) physical damage and grants Rengar 50% Attack Speed for 5 seconds.

spells.name: Battle Roar
spells.summary: Rengar lets out a battle roar, damaging enemies and healing for some of the recent damage he has taken. Ferocity effect: additionally breaks crowd control effects.
spells.text: Rengar roars, dealing (50/80/110/140/170 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage to nearby enemies and restoring 50% of the damage taken in the last 1.5 seconds as Health. Max Ferocity: Deals ((0 ~ 210) + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage and additionally cleanses Rengar of crowd control. Deals an additional (65 ~ 130) magic damage to jungle monsters. Restores 100% of damage taken from jungle monsters.

spells.name: Bola Strike
spells.summary: Rengar throws a bola, slowing the first target hit for a short duration. Ferocity effect: roots the target.
spells.text: Rengar throws a bola, dealing (55/100/145/190/235 + (80% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first enemy hit, revealing and Slowing them by 30/45/60/75/90% for 1.75 seconds. Max Ferocity: Deals (50 + (80% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and Roots for 1.75 seconds. Reveals enemies for 2 seconds. Bola Strike has no cast time when leaping.

spells.name: Thrill of the Hunt
spells.summary: Rengar's predatory instincts take over, Camouflaging him and revealing the nearest enemy champion in a large radius around him. During Thrill of the Hunt, Rengar gains Move Speed and he can leap to the tracked enemy without being in brush, reducing their armor.
spells.text: Passive: Rengar will also leap Attack when Camouflaged. Active: Rengar gains 40/50/60% Move Speed and True Sight in a small area around the nearest enemy champion for 12/16/20 seconds. After 2 seconds, Rengar becomes Camouflaged and can leap without being in Brush. Leaping to the nearest champion deals an additional (100% Attack Damage) physical damage, shreds 15/20/25 Armor for 4 seconds, and ends this Ability. Camouflaged units cannot be seen unless an enemy champion is inside their detection radius.

spells.name: Runic Blade
spells.summary: Riven's abilities charge her blade, and her basic attacks expend charges to deal an additional damage.
spells.text: Using an Ability grants Riven a charge for 6 seconds (max 3). Her Attacks spend a charge to deal an additional (30/45% Attack Damage) physical damage.

spells.name: Broken Wings
spells.summary: Riven lashes out in a series of strikes. This ability can be reactivated three times in a short time frame with the third hit knocking back nearby enemies.
spells.text: Riven dashes forward, dealing (45/75/105/135/165 + (60/65/70/75/80% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. She can Recast this Ability twice. The first Recast is the same as the original, but the second has a different effect: Recast: Riven leaps forward and slams, dealing (45/75/105/135/165 + (60/65/70/75/80% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and Knocks Up nearby enemies for 0.75 seconds. Only the last use of this Ability can cross terrain. Riven targets the unit your cursor is on, or dashes forward if there is no target.

spells.name: Ki Burst
spells.summary: Riven emits a Ki Burst, damaging and stunning nearby enemies.
spells.text: Riven's sword emits a burst of runic energy, dealing (65/95/125/155/185 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and Stunning for 0.75 seconds.

spells.name: Valor
spells.summary: Riven steps forward a short distance and blocks incoming damage.
spells.text: Riven quickly dashes and gains (70/95/120/145/170 + (110% bonus Attack Damage)) Shield for 1.5 seconds. This dash cannot go over terrain.

spells.name: Blade of the Exile
spells.summary: Riven empowers her keepsake weapon with energy, and gains Attack Damage and Range. During this time, she also gains the ability to use Wind Slash, a powerful ranged attack, once.
spells.text: Riven's weapon surges with spiritual energy, granting her (20% Attack Damage) Attack Damage and increased range on damaging Abilities and Attacks for 15 seconds. While active, she can Recast. Recast: Riven fires a wind slash that deals between (100/150/200 + (55% bonus Attack Damage)) and (300/450/600 + (165% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage, based on their missing Health. Gains 75 Attack Range

spells.name: Junkyard Titan
spells.summary: Every spell Rumble casts gives him Heat. When he reaches 50% Heat he reaches Danger Zone, granting all his basic abilities bonus effects.
