When he reaches 100% Heat, he starts Overheating, gaining bonus Attack Speed and granting his basic attacks bonus damage, but making him unable to cast spells for a few seconds.
spells.text: Rumble's Abilities generate Heat. While above 50 Heat, he enters the Danger Zone, causing his basic Abilities to gain bonus effects. When he reaches 150 Heat, he overheats for 4 seconds. While overheated, Rumble Silences himself, but gains (30% ~ 100%) Attack Speed and causes his Attacks to deal an additional ((5 ~ 40) + (25% Ability Power)) plus 4% max Health magic damage. Percent damage is limited to (90 ~ 175) damage on Monsters.

spells.name: Flamespitter
spells.summary: Rumble torches opponents in front of him, dealing magic damage in a cone for 3 seconds. While in Danger Zone this damage is increased.
spells.text: Rumble ignites his flamethrower, dealing (50/75/100/125/150 + (105% Ability Power)) plus 6/6.5/7/7.5/8% max Health magic damage over 3 seconds, reduced to 70% against minions. Danger Zone: Damage is increased to (75/112.5/150/187.5/225 + (157.5% Ability Power)) plus 9/9.75/10.5/11.25/12% max Health. Percent damage is limited to (65 ~ 300) damage on Monsters.

spells.name: Scrap Shield
spells.summary: Rumble pulls up a shield, protecting him from damage and granting him a quick burst of speed. While in Danger Zone, the shield strength and speed bonus is increased.
spells.text: Rumble tosses up a barrier, gaining (25/55/85/115/145 + (30% Ability Power) + (4% Health)) Shield for 1.5 seconds and 10/15/20/25/30% Move Speed for 1 second. Danger Zone: The barrier grants (37.5/82.5/127.5/172.5/217.5 + (45% Ability Power) + (6% Health)) Shield and 15/22.5/30/37.5/45% Move Speed instead.

spells.name: Electro Harpoon
spells.summary: Rumble launches a harpoon, electrocuting his target with magic damage, slowing their Move Speed, and reducing their Magic Resist. Rumble can carry 2 harpoons at a time. While in Danger Zone the damage and slow percentage is increased.
spells.text: Rumble launches an electrified harpoon, dealing (55/80/105/130/155 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage, Slowing by 15/20/25/30/35% for 2 seconds, and reducing the enemy's Magic Resist by 10/12/14/16/18% for 4 seconds. Hitting an enemy who's already Slowed by this Ability increases the Slow to 30/40/50/60/70% and reduces the enemy's Magic Resist by 20/24/28/32/36% Danger Zone: The harpoon deals (82.5/120/157.5/195/232.5 + (75% Ability Power)) magic damage instead and the Slow and reduced Magic Resist are increased by 50%.

spells.name: The Equalizer
spells.summary: Rumble fires off a group of rockets, creating a wall of flames that damages and slows enemies.
spells.text: Rumble launches a line of rockets, creating a burning trail that lasts 4.5 seconds, Slowing by 35% and dealing (120/200/280 + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage per second. Rumble can control the direction of the trail by clicking and dragging while casting this Ability.

spells.name: Arcane Mastery
spells.summary: Ryze's spells deal extra damage based on his Bonus Mana, and he gains a percentage increase to his maximum Mana based on his Ability Power.
spells.text: Ryze gains (10% Ability Power)max Mana. His Abilities do additional damage based on his bonus Mana.

spells.name: Overload
spells.summary: Passively, Ryze's other basic abilities reset the cooldown of Overload and charge a rune. When Ryze casts Overload with 2 runes charged, he gains a brief burst of Move Speed. On cast, Ryze throws a charge of pure energy in a line, dealing damage to the first enemy struck. If the target has Flux on it, Overload deals extra damage and bounces to nearby enemies with Flux.
spells.text: Passive: Rune Prison and Spell Flux refresh this Ability's Cooldown and charge a rune for 4 seconds (max 2 runes). Active: Ryze unleashes a blast, dealing (75/95/115/135/155 + (55% Ability Power) + (2% bonus Mana)) magic damage to the first enemy hit. If the target has Flux on it, it is consumed, causing this Ability to deal 40/65/90/115/140% increased damage and bounces to nearby enemies with Flux. Ryze also discharges all runes, granting Ryze 28/32/36/40/44% Move Speed for 2 seconds if 2 runes were charged.

spells.name: Rune Prison
spells.summary: Ryze traps a target in a cage of runes, damaging them and slowing their movement. If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.
spells.text: Ryze deals (60/90/120/150/180 + (60% Ability Power) + (3% bonus Mana)) magic damage and Slows by 50% for 1.5 seconds. If the target has Flux, it is consumed and this Ability Roots instead of Slowing.

spells.name: Spell Flux
spells.summary: Ryze releases an orb of pure magical power that damages an enemy and debuffs all nearby enemies. Ryze's spells have additional effects against the debuffed enemy.
spells.text: Ryze fires an orb, dealing (60/90/120/150/180 + (50% Ability Power) + (2% bonus Mana)) magic damage and applies Flux for 4 seconds to the target and nearby enemies. Enemies already afflicted with Flux will cause it to spread further.

spells.name: Realm Warp
spells.summary: Passively, Overload deals even more damage against targets with Flux. On cast, Ryze creates a portal to a nearby location. After a few seconds, allies standing near the portal are teleported to the target location.
spells.text: Passive: Overload damage bonus against targets with Flux increased to 40/65/90%. Active: Ryze opens a portal to another location. After 2 seconds, all allies near the portal are teleported to that location. If Ryze becomes Immobilized or Disabled, the portal is cancelled.

spells.name: Daredevil Impulse
spells.summary: Samira builds a combo by hitting attacks or abilities unique from the previous hit. Samira's attacks in melee range deal additional magic damage. Samira's attacks against enemies affected by Immobilizing effects will dash her to her attack range. If the enemy is Knocked Up, she also keeps them Knocked Up briefly.
spells.text: Samira builds a combo by dealing damage with Attacks or Abilities against enemy champions unique from the previous one. Each one increases her Style, from "E" to "S" grade (6 total). Samira gains 3.5% Move Speed per grade. Samira's Attacks and Abilities in melee range deal an additional (2 + (3.5/10.5% Attack Damage)) magic damage, increased up to (4 + (7/21% Attack Damage)) based on the target's missing Health. Samira's Attacks against enemies affected by Immobilizing effects will dash her to her Attack Range. If the enemy is Knocked Up, she also keeps them Knocked Up for at least 0.5 seconds.

spells.name: Flair
spells.summary: Samira fires a shot or swings her sword, dealing damage. If cast during Wild Rush, strike all enemies in her path upon completion.
spells.text: Samira fires a shot, dealing (0/5/10/15/20 + (110% Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first enemy hit. If this Ability is cast towards an enemy in melee range, Samira will instead slash with her sword, dealing (0/5/10/15/20 + (110% Attack Damage)) physical damage. Either hit can critically strike for (0/5/10/15/20 + (110% Attack Damage)) × (0.5 + 50% Critical Strike Damage) damage and applies Life Steal at 100% effectiveness. If cast during Wild Rush, Samira will strike all enemies in her path upon completion.

spells.name: Blade Whirl
spells.summary: Samira slashes around her, damaging enemies and destroying enemy missiles.
spells.text: Samira slashes around her for 0.75 seconds, damaging enemies twice for (20/35/50/65/80 + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage each and destroying any enemy missiles that enter the area.

spells.name: Wild Rush
spells.summary: Samira dashes through an enemy (including structures), slashing enemies she passes through and gaining Attack Speed. Killing an enemy champion refreshes this ability's cooldown.
spells.text: Samira dashes through an enemy (including structures), slashing enemies she passes through dealing (50/60/70/80/90 + (20% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage and gaining 20/25/30/35/40% Attack Speed for 5 seconds. If an enemy champion is killed within 3 seconds of Samira damaging them, This Ability's Cooldown is reset.

spells.name: Inferno Trigger
spells.summary: Samira unleashes a torrent of shots from her weapons, wildly shooting all enemies surrounding her.
spells.text: Samira can only use this Ability if her current Style rating is S. Using this Ability consumes all Style rating. Samira unleashes a torrent of shots from her weapons, wildly shooting all enemies surrounding her 10 times over 2 seconds, each shot dealing (20/40/60 + (30% Attack Damage)) physical damage and applying Life Steal at 100% effectiveness. Each shot can also critically strike. This Ability deals 25% damage to minions.

spells.name: Fury of the North
spells.summary: After being out of combat, Sejuani gains Frost Armor which grants Armor and Magic Resist and immunity to slows. Frost Armor persists for a short time after Sejuani takes damage. Sejuani can damage a stunned enemy to shatter it, dealing massive magic damage.
spells.text: Sejuani becomes immune to Slows and gains (10 + (75% bonus Armor)) Armor and (10 + (75% bonus Magic Resist)) Magic Resist after not taking damage from champions or large jungle monsters for (12 ~ 6) seconds. Sejuani's first Attack against enemies she has Stunned deals an additional 10% max Health magic damage.

spells.name: Arctic Assault
spells.summary: Sejuani charges forward, knocking enemies into the air. The charge stops after hitting an enemy champion.
spells.text: Sejuani charges, dealing (90/140/190/240/290 + (75% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies and Knocking them Up for 0.5 seconds. The charge ends after hitting an enemy champion.

spells.name: Winter's Wrath
spells.summary: Sejuani swings her mace twice, dealing damage, slowing enemies and applying Frost stacks.
spells.text: Sejuani swings her flail, dealing (5/15/25/35/45 + (30% Ability Power) + (4% Health)) physical damage and Knocking Back minions and jungle monsters. She then lashes out again, dealing (5/25/45/65/85 + (60% Ability Power) + (8% Health)) physical damage and briefly Slowing targets. Both swings apply stacks of Permafrost.

spells.name: Permafrost
spells.summary: Sejuani freezes and stuns an enemy champion that has maximum Frost stacks.
spells.text: Passive: Nearby melee allied champions' Attacks apply a stack to champions and jungle monsters. Active: Sejuani deals (55/105/155/205/255 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage to target enemy with 4 stacks and Stuns them for 1 second. Champions Stunned by Sejuani can't gain stacks for 8 seconds. Enemies Stunned by this Ability are slightly Knocked Back. Permafrost will target the closest valid enemy to your cursor (prioritizing champions). This Ability Knocks Down enemies.

spells.name: Glacial Prison
spells.summary: Sejuani throws her bola that freezes and stuns the first champion hit and creates an ice storm that slows other enemies.
spells.text: Sejuani throws her True Ice bola, Stunning and revealing the first enemy champion hit for 1 second and dealing (125/150/175 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage. If the bola travels at least 25% of its range, it Stuns and reveals for 1.5 seconds instead. It then also creates an ice storm that Slows surrounding enemies by 80% for 2 seconds. All affected enemies take (200/300/400 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage. The Stunned enemy takes damage immediately, while enemies inside the storm take damage after it ends. Enemies in the storm are also Slowed for an additional 1 second.

spells.name: Absolution
spells.summary: When units die near Senna, their souls are periodically trapped by the Black Mist. Senna can attack these souls to free them, absorbing the Mist that held them in death. Mist fuels her Relic Cannon's power with increased Attack Damage, Attack Range, and Critical Strike Chance. Attacks from Senna's Relic Cannon take longer to fire, deal bonus damage, and briefly grant her a portion of her target's Move Speed.
spells.text: Senna can attack souls that spawn from dead enemies to absorb their Mist. She can also siphon Mist from enemy champions she hits with Attacks or Abilities twice, dealing an additional 1% current Health physical damage. Each stack of Mist grants 0.75 Attack Damage. Every 20 stacks grant 20 Attack Range and 10% Critical Strike Chance but she only has (100% Critical Strike Damage) Critical Strike Damage. 35% of excess Critical Strike Chance is converted into Lifesteal. Senna's Attacks take extra time to fire, deal an additional (20% Attack Damage) physical damage, and briefly grant her 20% of the target's Move Speed.

spells.name: Piercing Darkness
spells.summary: From the twin barrels of her Relic Cannon, Senna fires a unified beam of light and shadow through a target, healing allies and damaging enemies.
spells.text: Senna shoots a bolt of piercing shadow through an ally or enemy, dealing (30/55/80/105/130 + (60% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to enemies and Slowing them by (15% + (7% per 100 Ability Power) + (0.15% bonus Attack Damage)) for 1/1.25/1.5/1.75/2 second(s). Restores (40/60/80/100/120 + (35% Ability Power) + (40% bonus Attack Damage)) Health to allied champions. Attacks reduce this Ability's Cooldown by 1 second. This Ability's cast range matches Senna's attack range and its cast time is improved with Attack Speed. It can target anything and applies on-hit effects to enemy champions.

spells.name: Last Embrace
spells.summary: Senna sends forth a wave of Black Mist. If it hits an enemy it latches onto them hungrily, rooting them and everything nearby after a brief delay.
spells.text: Senna sends forth the Black Mist, dealing (70/110/150/190/230 + (90% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first enemy hit. After a 1 second delay the target and other nearby enemies are Rooted for 1.25/1.5/1.75/2/2.25 second(s).

spells.name: Curse of the Black Mist
spells.summary: Senna draws the Mist she has stored in her weapon into a storm around her, embracing darkness and becoming a wraith within. Allies who enter the area are camouflaged and also appear as wraiths as the Mist shrouds them. Wraiths gain increased Move Speed, are unselectable, and hide their identities.
spells.text: Senna dissolves into a cloud of Black Mist for 6/6.5/7/7.5/8 seconds, becoming a Wraith. Allied champions who enter the Mist are Camouflaged and become Wraiths when they leave. Wraiths gain (20% + (5% per 100 Ability Power)) Move Speed, are Unselectable, and hide their identities as long as no enemy champions are nearby. Enemies can see where Wraiths are, but not who they are. They are otherwise treated as being Camouflaged. Camouflaged units cannot be seen unless an enemy champion is inside their detection radius. Unselectable units cannot be targeted by Attacks or Abilities that require a target.

spells.name: Dawning Shadow
spells.summary: Senna calls upon the relic stones of fallen Sentinels, splitting her relic cannon into a holy array of shadow and light. She then fires a global beam that shields allies from harm, while damaging enemies caught in the center.
spells.text: Senna fires a beam of light that deals (250/400/550 + (70% Ability Power) + (115% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to all enemy champions hit. Allied champions hit in a wider area receive (121.5/161.5/201.5 + (50% Ability Power)) Shield for 3 seconds. The shield's power scales with the amount of Mist Senna has collected.

spells.name: Stage Presence
spells.summary: Every third basic spell will cast twice from Seraphine. Additionally, casting spells near allies grants her bonus magic damage and range on her next basic attack.
spells.text: Every third basic Ability Seraphine casts will echo, automatically casting a second time. Additionally, Seraphine draws inspiration from the music within her allies, creating a Note for each nearby ally whenever she casts an Ability. For each Note, Seraphine's Attacks gain 25 Attack Range and deal an additional ((4 ~ 25) + (4% Ability Power)) magic damage and consume the Notes.

spells.name: High Note
spells.summary: Seraphine deals damage in an area.
spells.text: Seraphine projects a pure note, dealing (60/85/110/135/160 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage, increased against champions and monsters by the target's missing Health percentage up to (105/148.75/192.5/236.25/280 + (70% Ability Power)) damage below 25% Health.

spells.name: Surround Sound
spells.summary: Seraphine Shields and Hastes nearby allies. If she is already Shielded she will Heal nearby allies as well.
spells.text: Seraphine spurs her nearby allied champions in song, granting them (8% + (0.8% per 100 Ability Power)) Move Speed, herself (20% + (2% per 100 Ability Power)) decaying Move Speed and both (60/80/100/120/140 + (20% Ability Power)) Shield for 2.5 seconds. If Seraphine is already Shielded, she calls out to her allies to join her, restoring 8/10/12/14/16% missing Health to them after a 2.5 second delay. This Ability only heals once, even if cast twice.

spells.name: Beat Drop
spells.summary: Seraphine deals damage and impairs the movement of enemies in a line.
spells.text: Seraphine unleashes a heavy soundwave, dealing (70/100/130/160/190 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies in a line and Slowing them by 99% for 1.1/1.2/1.3/1.4/1.5 seconds. Enemies that are already Slowed are Rooted instead, and Immobilized enemies are Stunned. Deals 70% damage against minions.

spells.name: Encore
spells.summary: Seraphine deals damage and charms enemies hit, refreshing the range with every allied or enemy champion hit.
spells.text: Seraphine takes the stage, projecting a captivating force that Charms for 1.25/1.5/1.75 seconds and deals (150/200/250 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage. Any champions struck (including allies) become part of the performance, extending the range of this Ability. Allied champions gain maximum Notes.

spells.name: Pit Grit
spells.summary: Sett's basic attacks alternate between left and right punch. Right punch is slightly stronger and faster. Sett also hates losing, gaining additional health regeneration based off of his missing health.
spells.text: Sett's Attacks alternate between left and right punches. Right punches follow the left quickly and deal an additional ((0 ~ 85) + (55% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. Sett gains (0.15 ~ 2) Health Regeneration for each 5% missing Health.

spells.name: Knuckle Down
spells.summary: Sett's next two attacks deal additional damage based off of the target's max health. Sett also gains Move Speed while moving towards enemy champions.
spells.text: Sett itches for a fight, gaining 30% Move Speed towards enemy champions for 1.5 seconds. Additionally Sett's next two Attacks deal an additional 10/20/30/40/50 plus (1% + (1/1.5/2/2.5/3% per 100 Attack Damage)) max Health physical damage. The Attacks are always a left and right punch. Deals a max of 400 damage to monsters per punch.

spells.name: Haymaker
spells.summary: Sett passively stores damage he takes as Grit. On cast, Sett expends all stored Grit to gain a shield and punch an area, dealing true damage in the center and physical damage on the sides.
spells.text: Passive: Sett stores 100% of damage taken as Grit, up to (50% Health). Grit decays quickly 4 seconds after the damage was taken. Active: Sett consumes all Grit, gaining a 100% Grit consumed Shield decaying over 3 seconds. Sett then delivers a massive punch, dealing 80/100/120/140/160 plus (25% + (0.25% bonus Attack Damage)) Grit consumed true damage to enemies in the center (max (50% Health) × (25% + 0.25% bonus Attack Damage) damage). Enemies not in the center instead take physical damage.

spells.name: Facebreaker
spells.summary: Sett pulls in all enemies on opposite sides of him, dealing damage and stunning them. If enemies were only on one side, they are slowed instead of stunned.
spells.text: Sett smashes enemies on either side of him into each other, dealing (50/70/90/110/130 + (60% Attack Damage)) physical damage and Slowing them by 70% for 0.5 seconds. If Sett grabbed at least one enemy on each side, all enemies are Stunned for 1 second. Deals (125 ~ 250) bonus damage against monsters.

spells.name: The Show Stopper
spells.summary: Sett carries an enemy champion through the air and slams them into the ground, dealing damage and slowing all enemies near where they land.
spells.text: Sett grabs an enemy champion and Suppresses them as he carries them forward, then slams them into the ground, dealing (200/300/400 + (120% bonus Attack Damage)) plus 40/50/60% of the grabbed enemy's bonus Health physical damage to surrounding enemies and Slowing them by 99% for 1 second. Enemies take less damage the further they are from where Sett lands.

spells.name: Backstab
spells.summary: Shaco's basic attacks and Two-Shiv Poison deal additional damage when striking from behind.
spells.text: When striking enemies that are facing away from him:Shaco's Attacks deal an additional ((20 ~ 35) + (20% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage that can critically strike.Two-Shiv Poison deals an additional ((15 ~ 50) + (10% Ability Power)) magic damage, increased to ((22.5 ~ 75) + (15% Ability Power)) magic damage if the target is below 30% Health.

spells.name: Deceive
spells.summary: Shaco becomes Invisible and teleports to target location. His first attack while Invisible is empowered, dealing bonus damage and critically striking if he attacks from behind.
spells.text: Shaco teleports and becomes Invisible for 2.5/2.75/3/3.25/3.5 seconds. Using Jack In The Box or Hallucinate does not break Invisibility. Shaco's next Attack while Invisible deals an additional (25/35/45/55/65 + (60% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. If striking from behind, this Attack critically strikes for (40% + (60% Critical Strike Damage)) damage. The bonus damage on Attack can critically strike. Invisible units cannot be revealed except by turrets or True Sight.

spells.name: Jack In The Box
spells.summary: Shaco creates a hidden animated Jack-in-the-Box. When triggered, it will fear and attack nearby enemies.
spells.text: Shaco creates a trap that stealths itself after 2 seconds and lasts for (40 + (10% Ability Power)) seconds. It activates when an enemy comes near or when revealed, Fearing nearby enemy Champions for 0.5/0.75/1/1.25/1.5 seconds, or 2 seconds for minions and jungle monsters. Once activated, the trap fires at all nearby enemies for 5 seconds, dealing (10/15/20/25/30 + (12% Ability Power)) magic damage, or (25/40/55/70/85 + (18% Ability Power)) damage if focused on a single target. Jack in the Box's attacks deal an additional 20/35/50/65/80 damage to monsters.

spells.name: Two-Shiv Poison
spells.summary: Shaco's Shivs passively poison targets on hit, slowing their Move Speed. He can throw his Shivs to deal damage and poison the target. The thrown Shiv deals bonus damage if the target is below 30% health.
spells.text: Passive: While this Ability is off Cooldown, Shaco's Attacks Slow the target by 20/22.5/25/27.5/30% for 2 seconds. Active: Shaco throws a shiv, dealing (70/95/120/145/170 + (80% bonus Attack Damage) + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing by 20/22.5/25/27.5/30% for 3 seconds. If the target has less than 30% Health, the shiv deals (105/142.5/180/217.5/255 + (120% bonus Attack Damage) + (90% Ability Power)) damage instead.

spells.name: Hallucinate
spells.summary: Shaco creates an illusion of himself near him, which can attack nearby enemies (Deals reduced damage to turrets). Upon death, it explodes, spawning three mini Jack in the Boxes and dealing damage to nearby enemies.
spells.text: Shaco briefly disappears, then reappears with a clone that lasts 18 seconds and detonates when it dies, dealing (150/225/300 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage and spawning three mini Jack in the Boxes that trigger immediately. The clone deals 60% of Shaco's damage and receives 50% increased damage. Mini Jack in the Boxes deal (10/20/30 + (10% Ability Power)) magic damage, or (25/50/75 + (15% Ability Power)) magic damage if firing at only one enemy, and Fear for 1 second. The clone can be controlled using the Alt key and right click, or by Recasting this Ability.

spells.name: Ki Barrier
spells.summary: After casting a spell, Shen gets a shield. Affecting other champions reduces the cooldown of this effect.
spells.text: Shen gains ((47 ~ 120) + (13% bonus Health)) Shield for 2.5 seconds after using an Ability. This effect has a 11 second Cooldown, reduced by 4 seconds when one of Shen's Abilities successfully affects an ally or enemy. Shen has a Spirit Blade that his other Abilities use.

spells.name: Twilight Assault
spells.summary: Shen recalls his spirit blade to attack with it, dealing damage based on the target's max health. The attacks are greatly empowered if it collides with an enemy champion, and all collided enemies are slowed while running away from Shen.
spells.text: Shen recalls his Spirit Blade. Enemies hit by the pull are Slowed by 25/30/35/40/45% while moving away from Shen for the next 2 seconds. Additionally, Shen's next 3 Attacks deal an additional 40 plus (2/2.5/3/3.5/4% + (1.5% per 100 Ability Power)) max Health magic damage. If Shen hit an enemy champion with the Spirit Blade, the damage is increased to 40 plus (5/5.5/6/6.5/7% + (2% per 100 Ability Power)) max Health magic damage and he gains 50% Attack Speed for those Attacks. Each Attack deals 100% increased damage to jungle monsters (max 100/125/150/175/200 damage). Attacks against structures deal 40 damage.

spells.name: Spirit's Refuge
spells.summary: Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.
spells.text: Shen creates a defensive zone at his Spirit Blade for 1.75 seconds. Attacks against allied champions in the zone are blocked. If there are no champions to protect in the zone when it starts, it will wait for up to 2 seconds.

spells.name: Shadow Dash
spells.summary: Shen dashes in a direction, taunting enemies in his path.
spells.text: Passive: Dealing damage with Twilight Assault or this Ability recovers 50 Energy. Active: Shen dashes, Taunting champions and jungle monsters for 1.5 seconds and dealing (60/85/110/135/160 + (11% bonus Health)) physical damage.

spells.name: Stand United
spells.summary: Shen shields target allied champion from incoming damage, and soon after teleports to their location.
spells.text: Shen grants an allied champion anywhere on the map between (120/220/320 + (15% bonus Health) + (135% Ability Power)) and (192/352/512 + (24% bonus Health) + (216% Ability Power)) Shield based on their missing Health for 5 seconds (max Shield at 60% missing Health). After channeling for 3 seconds, Shen teleports to his ally's location with his Spirit Blade.

spells.name: Scalemail
spells.summary: Takedowns on enemy champions, large minions, and large monsters grant Shyvana Scalemail stacks, improving her defenses.
spells.text: Takedowns on champions, large minions, and monsters earn Shyvana stacks of Scalemail, each stack grants Shyvana permanent 0.3 Armor and 0.3 Magic Resist. Bonus Armor: 0.3 Bonus Magic Resist: 0.3

spells.name: Emberstrike
spells.summary: Shyvana's next attack strikes both the target and the surrounding area. This Ability can be recast. While in Dragon Form, it gains an additional recast, dealing massive damage to a single target.
spells.text: Passive: Shyvana's Attacks deal (1% + (1.1% per 100 bonus Attack Damage)) max Health magic damage On-Hit and reduce this Ability's Cooldown by 0.5 seconds. Active: Shyvana's next Attack strikes the target and the surrounding area dealing (10/15/20/25/30 + (110% Attack Damage) + (30% Ability Power)) physical damage. This Ability may be Recast after an Attack or short delay within the next 4 seconds. Dragon Form: Shyvana gains an additional Recast, causing her to bite the target of her next Attack dealing (15/22.5/30/37.5/45 + (165% Attack Damage) + (45% Ability Power)) true damage. Deals 10 additional damage to monsters. Maximum health damage does not affect structures and against non-champions has a minimum of 10 and maximum of 200. Dragon Form's final Recast cannot critically strike.

spells.name: Inferno Aegis
spells.summary: Shyvana gains a shield, movement speed, and after a short delay, the area around her detonates. While in Dragon Form, the explosion will heal her if it strikes an enemy champion.
spells.text: Shyvana wraps herself in flames for 2.5 seconds, gaining (60/80/100/120/140 + (12% bonus Health)) Shield, increased by (18/24/30/36/42 + (3.6% bonus Health)) per nearby enemy champion and 25% Move Speed, increased to 43.75% when moving towards enemy champions. When the effect ends, the Shield is broken, or upon Recast the area around her detonates, dealing (80/100/120/140/160 + (65% Ability Power)) magic damage. Dragon Form: If the detonation hits an enemy champion Shyvana heals for (60 ~ 100) + (4% ~ 8%) Missing Health.

spells.name: Molten Burst
spells.summary: Shyvana launches a fireball that explodes upon striking a large target and slows them. In Dragon Form, it passes through and explodes upon striking large enemies, leaving behind a trail of fire.
spells.text: Shyvana launches a fireball at the target location dealing (50/65/80/95/110 + (60/65/70/75/80% Ability Power)) + 5% Max health magic damage and Slowing by 30% for 2 seconds. It explodes upon striking an enemy or reaching its terminus. Dragon Form: Shyvana's fireball is larger and pierces through enemies. Upon striking a champion, large monster, or reaching its terminus it triggers a pulse of fire that deals (62.5/81.25/100/118.75/137.5 + (75/81.25/87.5/93.75/100% Ability Power)) + 6.25% Max Health magic damage and Slows by 30% for 2 seconds. The fireball leaves behind a trail for 2 seconds that deals (25 + (5% Ability Power)) magic damage per second. Overlapping Dragon Form explosions deal 40% damage.

spells.name: Dragon's Descent
spells.summary: Shyvana transforms into a Dragon and leaps forward causing enemies along her path to flee. While in Dragon form she becomes larger and her basic abilities are empowered.
spells.text: Passive: Shyvana generates 1.25 Dragon Fury by striking enemies with Attacks and Abilities, increased by 200% while in Dragon Form, and reduced 75% by when striking in an area against non-champions. Active: Shyvana transforms into her Dragon Form, becoming Unstoppable, and flying to the target location breathing fire on enemies below dealing (150/250/350 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage and causing them Flee for 0.75 seconds. While transformed, Shyvana's basic Abilities are upgraded, she gains 150/250/350 bonus Health, size, and Attack Range. Shyvana loses Dragon Fury over time and her transformation ends when she has no Dragon Fury remaining. Shyvana gains 1% increased Fury from all sources per 1 Ultimate Ability Haste. Ultimate Haste acquired while dead does not take effect until Shyvana revives.

spells.name: Noxious Slipstream
spells.summary: Singed drafts off nearby champions, gaining a burst of Move Speed when passing them.
spells.text: Singed drafts off of nearby allied or enemy champions, gaining 25% Move Speed for 2 seconds. This effect has an 8 second Cooldown per champion.

spells.name: Poison Trail
spells.summary: Leaves a trail of poison behind Singed, dealing damage to enemies caught in the path.
spells.text: Toggle: Singed lays a poisonous trail that deals (20/30/40/50/60 + (42.5% Ability Power)) magic damage per second. Cloud duration: 3.25 seconds. Poison duration: 2 seconds. Approximate total damage: (95/142.5/190/237.5/285 + (201.875% Ability Power)) magic damage. If a minion would be killed by minion damage while under the effects of Poison Trail, Singed claims the kill credit instead.

spells.name: Mega Adhesive
spells.summary: Throws a vial of mega adhesive on the ground, slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it.
spells.text: Singed hurls a cask of sticky liquid, Grounding and Slowing enemies in the area by 50/55/60/65/70% for 3 seconds.

spells.name: Fling
spells.summary: Damages target enemy unit and flings them into the air behind Singed. If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.
spells.text: Singed flings an enemy over his shoulder, dealing (50/60/70/80/90 + (55% Ability Power)) plus 6/6.5/7/7.5/8% max Health magic damage. If Singed flings a target into his Mega Adhesive, they are Rooted for 1/1.25/1.5/1.75/2 seconds. Max Health damage is capped at 300 against minions and jungle monsters.

spells.name: Insanity Potion
spells.summary: Singed drinks a potent brew of chemicals, granting him increased combat stats, and making his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds.
spells.text: Singed drinks a potent brew of chemicals, granting him 25/55/85 Ability Power, Armor, Magic Resist, Move Speed, Health Regen, and Mana Regen for 25 seconds. During this effect, Singed's Poison Trail also applies 40% Grievous Wounds for 1 second.

spells.name: Glory in Death
spells.summary: After being killed, Sion will temporarily reanimate with rapidly decaying Health. His attacks become very rapid, heal him, and deal bonus damage based on his target's maximum Health.
spells.text: After being killed Sion will reanimate himself allowing him to move and Attack, but his Health rapidly decays while he is reanimated. He also gains 100% Lifesteal, attacks extremely fast, and his Attacks deal an additional 10% max Health physical damage. All of his Abilities are replaced with Death Surge, which grants him a burst of Move Speed.

spells.name: Decimating Smash
spells.summary: Sion charges a powerful swing in an area in front of himself that will deal damage to enemies when released. If he charges for enough time, enemies hit by the swing will also be knocked up and stunned.
spells.text: Begin Charging: Sion charges a heavy blow for up to 2 seconds. Release: Sion slams his axe down, briefly Slowing and dealing between (30/45/60/75/90 + (40/50/60/70/80% Attack Damage)) and (90/155/220/285/350 + (120/150/180/210/240% Attack Damage)) physical damage based on charge time. If Sion charged for at least 1 second, enemies are Knocked Up and Stunned for between 1.25 and 2.25 seconds based on charge time. Deals 165% damage to jungle monsters and 60% damage to minions.

spells.name: Soul Furnace
spells.summary: Sion shields himself and can reactivate after 3 seconds to deal Magic Damage to enemies nearby. When Sion kills enemies, he passively gains maximum Health.
spells.text: Passive: Sion gains 4 max Health when he kills a unit, or 15 for champion takedowns, large minions and large monsters. Active: Sion gains (60/75/90/105/120 + (40% Ability Power) + (8/10/12/14/16% Health)) Shield for 6 seconds. After 3 seconds if the shield still holds, Sion can Recast to detonate the shield to deal (40/65/90/115/140 + (40% Ability Power)) plus 14% max Health magic damage. Max 400 bonus damage to minions and monsters.

spells.name: Roar of the Slayer
spells.summary: Sion fires a short range shockwave that damages and slows and reduces the Armor of the first enemy hit. If the shockwave hits a minion or monster, it will be knocked back, damaging, slowing, and reducing the Armor of all enemies that it passes through.
spells.text: Sion fires a shockwave, dealing (65/100/135/170/205 + (55% Ability Power)) magic damage, Slowing them by 40/45/50/55/60% for 2.5 seconds and removing 25% Armor for 4 seconds. Non-champions hit are Knocked Back. Enemies hit by a Knocked Back unit take the same damage and effects.

spells.name: Unstoppable Onslaught
spells.summary: Sion charges in a direction, ramping up speed over time. He can steer his charge slightly with the mouse cursor location. When he collides with an enemy he deals damage and knocks them up based on the distance he has charged.
spells.text: Sion charges Unstoppably in a direction for 8 seconds, turning towards the mouse cursor. Sion stops on colliding with an enemy champion or wall or on Recasting this Ability. At the end of the charge, Sion deals between (150/300/450 + (60% bonus Attack Damage)) and (400/800/1200 + (120% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage based on distance travelled. Enemies close to Sion are Stunned for between 0.75 and 1.75 seconds based on distance travelled. Enemies in a larger area are Slowed by 40/45/50% for 3 seconds.

spells.name: Fleet of Foot
spells.summary: Sivir gains a short burst of Move Speed when she attacks an enemy champion.
spells.text: Sivir's Attacks and Abilities grant her a burst of (55 ~ 85) Decaying Move Speed for 1.5 seconds when they damage enemy champions.

spells.name: Boomerang Blade
spells.summary: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing damage each way.
spells.text: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing (60/85/110/135/160 + (70% bonus Attack Damage) + (60% Ability Power)) to all enemies it cuts through. Hitting non-champions reduces the damage to subsequent targets, down to a minimum of 40%. The damage falloff resets upon beginning its return. Damage scales with Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage at 40% effectiveness. Cast time scales down with Attack Speed

spells.name: Ricochet
spells.summary: Sivir's next few basic attacks gain additional attack speed and bounce to nearby targets, dealing reduced damage while bouncing.
spells.text: For the next 4 seconds, Sivir gains 20/25/30/35/40% Attack Speed and her auto attacks are empowered to bounce to additional surrounding enemies dealing (40/42.5/45/47.5/50% Attack Damage) physical damage each bounce for up to 8 bounces. These bounces critically strike if the attack generating them does. Bounces will prioritize new targets before returning to targets that have already been struck. Can only hit each target a maximum of two times. Bounces deal 65% damage to minions. This ability executes low Health minions.

spells.name: Spell Shield
spells.summary: Creates a magical barrier that blocks a single enemy ability cast on Sivir. She receives health and a burst of movement speed if a spell is blocked.
spells.text: Sivir creates a magical barrier for 1.5 seconds that blocks the next incoming enemy Ability. If an ability is blocked, Sivir restores ((60/65/70/75/80% Attack Damage) + (50% Ability Power)) health and triggers Fleet of Foot. This shield blocks both champion and item Abilities.

spells.name: On The Hunt
spells.summary: Sivir leads her allies in battle, granting them a surge of Move Speed for a period of time. In addition, Sivir's attacks reduce her spell cooldowns.
spells.text: Sivir rallies her nearby allies, granting them 20/25/30% Move Speed for 8/10/12 seconds. Sivir's attacks against champions while On The Hunt reduce the cooldown of her basic abilities by 0.5 seconds. Takedowns on recently damaged enemies refreshes the duration of the hunt.

spells.name: Threads of Vibration
spells.summary: Skarner's Attacks, Shattered Earth, Upheaval, and Impale, apply Quaking. At max stacks of Quaking, enemies take max Health magic damage over its duration.
spells.text: Skarner's Attacks, Shattered Earth, Upheaval, and Impale, apply Quaking for 4s. At 3 stacks of Quaking, enemies take (500% ~ 900%) max Health magic damage over its duration.

spells.name: Shattered Earth / Upheaval
spells.summary: Skarner rips a boulder from the earth that empowers his attacks and can be thrown as a powerful projectile.
spells.text: Skarner rips a boulder from the ground, empowering his next 3 Attacks with 20/25/30/35/40% Attack Speed and dealing (10/20/30/40/50 + (90% bonus Attack Damage) + (3% bonus Health)) physical damage to surrounding enemies. His final Attack will deal an additional 11% max Health physical damage and Slow affected foes by 40% for 1s. Recast: Skarner ends this Ability and throws his boulder, dealing (10/20/30/40/50 + (90% bonus Attack Damage) + (3% bonus Health)) + 11% max Health physical damage, and additionally Slowing the first enemy hit — and any other surrounding enemies — by 40% for 1s. Percent Health Damage to monsters is capped at 150/200/250/300/350. This Ability deals 100% to structures.

spells.name: Seismic Bastion
spells.summary: Skarner gains a shield and creates an earthquake whose shockwave damages and slows foes.
spells.text: Skarner gains (8% Health) Shield for 2.5s and triggers an earthquake that deals (50/70/90/110/130 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slows nearby enemies by 20% for 1s.

spells.name: Ixtal's Impact
spells.summary: Skarner charges forward and passes through terrain. If he collides with a champion or large monster, he'll slam them into the next wall he hits to damage and stun them.
spells.text: Skarner charges forward, steering toward the chosen direction and ignoring terrain. If he runs into a champion or large monster, Skarner drags them along for the rest of his charge. Colliding into a wall with an enemy in tow deals (30/60/90/120/150 + (120% bonus Attack Damage) + (6% Health)) physical damage to the enemy and Stuns them for 1.1s. Skarner can Recast this Ability to end his charge early. Successful wall collisions reduce this Ability's cooldown to 65%.

spells.name: Impale
spells.summary: Skarner's tails lash forward to suppress enemy champions. Once suppressed, the victims will be dragged along by Skarner as he moves around.
spells.text: Skarner's tails lash forward, dealing (150/250/350 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage and Suppressing the first 3 champions he hits for 1.5s. Those hit are dragged along by Skarner for the duration of this Ability. If Skarner hits at least one champion he gains 40% Move Speed for 1.5 seconds. If Shattered Earth is active, Skarner will cast Upheaval first.

spells.name: Dragon Practice
spells.summary: Hitting champions with Abilities and killing enemies with Super Scorcher Breath grants a stack of Dragon Practice. Stacks increase the damage of Smolders basic Abilities.
spells.text: Hitting champions with Abilities and killing enemies with Super Scorcher Breath grants a stack of Dragon Practice, which improves Smolder's basic Abilities. Super Scorcher Breath: Deal an additional 0.25 magic damage and gain new effects at 25, 125, and 225 stacks.Achooo!: Explosions deal an additional 0.55 magic damage.Flap, Flap, Flap: Each hit deals an additional 0.08 magic damage and gain an extra bolt every 100 stacks.

spells.name: Super Scorcher Breath
spells.summary: Smolder breathes fire on an enemy. As he gains more stacks, this ability becomes more powerful.
spells.text: Smolder belches flame, dealing (60/70/80/90/100 + (130% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage + 0.25 magic damage. If the target dies, Smolder refunds 15 Mana, once per cast. Based on stacks of Dragon Practice, this Ability evolves to gain the following effects:25 Stacks: Damages all enemies surrounding the target.125 Stacks: Sends 2.008 explosions beyond the target that deal 50% of this Ability's damage.225 Stacks: Burns the target, dealing (0% + (2.5% per 100 bonus Attack Damage)) max Health true damage over 3 seconds. Enemy champions that drop below 6.5% total health while burning are killed instantly. Super Scorcher Breath is considered a basic Attack, applies On-Hit effects, and applies Life Steal at 50% effectiveness. Damage is increased by Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage at 75% effectiveness. This Ability can only damage each target one time per cast.

spells.name: Achooo!
spells.summary: Smolder lets out an adorable flaming sneeze that explodes when hitting enemy champions.
spells.text: Smolder lets out an adorable flaming sneeze, dealing (60/70/80/90/100 + (60% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and Slowing by 35% for 1.5 seconds. Hitting champions causes an explosion, dealing (10/35/60/85/110 + (50% bonus Attack Damage) + (80% Ability Power)) physical + 0.55 magic damage. Each consecutive explosion does 75% damage. Smolder can only gain one Dragon Practice stack per champion hit.

spells.name: Flap, Flap, Flap
spells.summary: Smolder takes flight ignoring terrain and bombarding the lowest health enemy.
spells.text: Smolder takes flight, gaining 75% Move Speed and ignoring terrain for 1.25 seconds. While flying, Smolder bombards the lowest Health enemy 5.01 (rounded down) times for (10/15/20/25/30 + (30% Attack Damage)) physical damage + 0.08 magic damage per hit. This Ability prioritizes champions. While flying, Smolder gains expanded vision.

spells.name: MMOOOMMMM!
spells.summary: Smolder calls his mom to breath fire from above, dealing extra damage and slowing enemies in the center of her fire.
spells.text: Smolder's mom breathes fire from above, dealing (150/250/350 + (100% bonus Attack Damage) + (100% Ability Power)) physical damage. Enemies in the center take (225/375/525 + (150% bonus Attack Damage) + (150% Ability Power)) physical damage instead and are Slowed by 40% for 2 seconds. Smolder's mom heals her son for (100/135/170 + (50% bonus Attack Damage) + (75% Ability Power)) Health if she hits him. Deals 50% damage to minions and monsters.

spells.name: Power Chord
spells.summary: Accelerando: Sona gains non-Ultimate ability haste permanently for her basic abilities as she uses her abilities well, up to a cap. Beyond that cap, further successful uses reduce her ultimate's remaining cooldown instead. Power Chord: Every few spell casts, Sona's next attack will deal bonus magic damage in addition to an additional effect based on what basic Ability Sona last activated.
spells.text: Accelerando: Sona gains Accelerando stacks from using her Basic Abilities well. She gains +0.5 Basic Ability Haste permanently per stack, up to 60 Basic Ability Haste. When she reaches 60 Basic Ability Haste, instead of gaining further stacks her current Ultimate Ability's cooldown is reduced by 1.5 seconds. Power Chord: After using 3 basic Abilities, Sona's next Attack deals an additional ((20 ~ 170) + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage and may have an additional effect based on the song Sona last activated. Hymn of Valor: The Attack deals ((30 ~ 255) + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage instead.Aria of Perseverance: The target deals (25% + (4% per 100 Ability Power)) less damage for 3 seconds.Song of Celerity: The target is Slowed by (50% + (4% per 100 Ability Power)) for 2 seconds.

spells.name: Hymn of Valor
spells.summary: Sona plays the Hymn of Valor, sends out bolts of sound, dealing magic damage to two nearby enemies, prioritizing champions and monsters. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allies tagged by the zone bonus damage on their next attack against enemies.
spells.text: Sona deals (50/85/120/155/190 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage to the nearest two enemies, prioritizing champions. She then begins a new Melody. Gain a stack of Accelerando for every champion you damage with this. Melody: Sona gains an aura for 3 seconds, granting allied champions an additional (10/15/20/25/30 + (10% Ability Power)) magic damage on their next Attack within 5 seconds. Power Chord - Staccato: Power Chord bonus damage (((30 ~ 255) + (30% Ability Power)) total magic damage).

spells.name: Aria of Perseverance
spells.summary: Sona plays the Aria of Perseverance, sending out protective melodies, healing Sona and a nearby wounded ally. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allies tagged by the zone a temporary shield.
spells.text: Active: Sona restores (30/45/60/75/90 + (30% Ability Power)) Health to herself and a nearby allied champion, prioritizing the most wounded. She then begins a new Melody. Melody: Sona gains an aura for 3 seconds, granting allied champions (25/45/65/85/105 + (25% Ability Power)) Shield for 1.5 seconds. Gain a stack of Accelerando whenever you heal another injured ally and every time you protect another ally from at least 25/45/65/85/105 damage with this shield. Power Chord - Diminuendo: Power Chord also reduces physical and magic damage dealt by the target by (25% + (4% per 100 Ability Power)) for 3 seconds.

spells.name: Song of Celerity
spells.summary: Sona plays the Song of Celerity, granting nearby allies bonus Move Speed. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allied champions tagged by the zone bonus Move Speed.
spells.text: Active: She begins a new Melody and grants herself (20% + (2% per 100 Ability Power)) Move Speed for 3 seconds, extended to up to 7 seconds if she doesn't take damage. Melody: Sona gains an aura for 3 seconds that grants allied champions (10/12/14/16/18% + (2% per 100 Ability Power)) Move Speed for 3 seconds. Power Chord - Tempo: Power Chord also Slows the target by (50% + (4% per 100 Ability Power)) for 2 seconds.

spells.name: Crescendo
spells.summary: Sona plays her ultimate chord, stunning enemy champions and forcing them to dance and dealing magic damage to them.
spells.text: Sona strikes an irresistible chord, Stunning enemy for 1.5 seconds and dealing (150/250/350 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage. Enemies that know how to dance, will dance during the stun.

spells.name: Salvation
spells.summary: Soraka runs faster towards nearby low health allies.
spells.text: Soraka gains 90% Move Speed while moving towards allied champions who are below 40% Health.

spells.name: Starcall
spells.summary: A star falls from the sky at the target location dealing magic damage and slowing enemies. If an enemy champion is hit by Starcall, Soraka recovers Health.
spells.text: Soraka calls down a star, dealing (85/120/155/190/225 + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing by 30% for 1.5 seconds. Hitting an enemy champion grants Soraka Rejuvenation, which restores (60/75/90/105/120 + (30% Ability Power)) Health over 2.5 seconds and grants 20/22.5/25/27.5/30% Move Speed decaying over the same duration.

spells.name: Astral Infusion
spells.summary: Soraka sacrifices a portion of her own health to heal another friendly champion.
spells.text: Soraka restores (90/110/130/150/170 + (50% Ability Power)) Health to another allied champion. If Soraka is affected by Rejuvenation, the Health cost will be reduced by 80/85/90/95/100%, and the target will gain Rejuvenation for 2.5 seconds. This Ability cannot be used if Soraka is below (5% Health) Health .

spells.name: Equinox
spells.summary: Creates a zone at a location that silences all enemies inside. When the zone expires, all enemies still inside are rooted.
spells.text: Soraka creates a starfield that deals (70/95/120/145/170 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage to champions. The field lingers for 1.5 seconds, Silencing enemies inside. When the zone disappears, champions inside the zone are Rooted for 1/1.25/1.5/1.75/2 second(s) and take (70/95/120/145/170 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Wish
spells.summary: Soraka fills her allies with hope, instantly restoring health to herself and all allied champions.
spells.text: Soraka calls upon divine powers, restoring (150/250/350 + (50% Ability Power)) Health to all allied champions, regardless of distance. Healing is increased to (225/375/525 + (75% Ability Power)) on targets below 40% Health.

spells.name: Ravenous Flock
spells.summary: Swain's ravens collect Soul Fragments that heal him and permanently increase his maximum health.
spells.text: Swain collects Soul Fragments from Vision of Empire, Nevermove, and enemy champion deaths. Soul Fragments restore (6% ~ 6%) maximum Health and permanently grant Swain 15 max Health. Total Health gained: 15

spells.name: Death's Hand
spells.summary: Swain unleashes several bolts of eldritch power that pierce through enemies. Enemies hit take more damage for each bolt they are struck by.
spells.text: Swain unleashes 5 eldritch bolts, dealing (60/90/120/150/180 + (45% Ability Power)) magic damage plus (15/22.5/30/37.5/45 + (11.25% Ability Power)) magic damage per bolt past the first (max (120/180/240/300/360 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage).

spells.name: Vision of Empire
spells.summary: Swain opens a demon eye that deals damage and slows enemies. Champions hit are revealed and also grant Swain a Soul Fragment.
spells.text: Swain opens a demon eye, revealing a location for 1.5 seconds, then deals (70/105/140/175/210 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slows by 50% for 1.5 seconds. Champions hit grant Swain a Soul Fragment and are revealed for 6 seconds. Deals (35/52.5/70/87.5/105 + (30% Ability Power)) damage instead to minions.

spells.name: Nevermove
spells.summary: Swain launches a wave of demonic power forward. It then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits. Swain can then choose to pull all rooted champions closer. This ability has a shorter cooldown during Demonic Ascension.
spells.text: Swain launches a wave of demonic power that returns, detonating on the first enemy hit to deal (90/130/170/210/250 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage and Root enemies in the area for 1.5 seconds. Rooting a champion allows Swain to reactivate this ability to pull all champions Rooted by Nevermove toward him, gaining a Soul Fragment for each. Nevermove temporarily grants vision of rooted champions.

spells.name: Demonic Ascension
spells.summary: Swain transforms into a demon and drains health from nearby enemy champions, minions, and neutral monsters. Swain can cast Demonflare to decimate and slow nearby enemies with a nova of soulfire. This form is indefinite as long as Swain drains enemy champions.
spells.text: Swain frees the demon, which deals (15/25/35 + (4% Ability Power)) magic damage and drains (15/30/45 + (5% Ability Power) + (1.5% bonus Health)) Health per second from nearby enemies. His Demonic Energy depletes over time but can be recharged indefinitely by draining enemy Champions and is fully restored on Champion takedowns. After 2 seconds and every 8 seconds thereafter, Swain can cast Demonflare while transformed, which deals (150/250/350 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slows enemies by 50%, decaying over 1.5s. Healing is reduced to 10% against non-champions. Depletes 10 Demonic Energy per second. After 5 seconds, this increases to 15. Regenerates 20 Demonic Energy per second while draining from champions.

spells.name: Petricite Burst
spells.summary: After casting a spell, Sylas stores a charge of Petricite Burst. Sylas's basic attacks will expend a charge and whirl his energized chains around him dealing bonus magic damage to enemies hit. While Sylas has a charge of Petricite Burst, he gains attack speed.
spells.text: After using an Ability, Sylas gains a charge (max 3 charges). Sylas' Attacks expend a charge to whirl his chains, dealing ((130% Attack Damage) + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage to the main target and ((40% Attack Damage) + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage to other surrounding enemies. While he has at least one charge, Sylas gains 125% Attack Speed.

spells.name: Chain Lash
spells.summary: Sylas lashes his chains out, intersecting at his targeted location dealing damage to and slowing enemies. After a delay, magical energy explodes from the intersection point dealing damage.
spells.text: Sylas lashes his chains out, dealing (40/60/80/100/120 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing by 15/20/25/30/35% for 1.5 seconds. The place where the chains intersect explodes, dealing a further (60/115/170/225/280 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage. The explosion deals 40% damage to minions.

spells.name: Kingslayer
spells.summary: Sylas lunges at an enemy with magical force dealing damage and healing himself against enemy champions.
spells.text: Sylas lunges at an enemy with magical force dealing (75/110/145/180/215 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. Against champions, Sylas restores between (20/40/60/80/100 + (30% Ability Power) + (5% bonus Health)) and (40/80/120/160/200 + (60% Ability Power) + (10% bonus Health)) Health based on his missing Health (max healing at or below 40% Health).

spells.name: Abscond / Abduct
spells.summary: Sylas dashes to a location. Sylas can recast the ability to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits.
spells.text: Sylas quickly dashes, and prepares a Recast for 3.5 seconds. Recast: Sylas throws his chains, pulling himself to the first enemy hit, dealing (80/130/180/230/280 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage, and Knocking Up for 0.5 seconds.

spells.name: Hijack
spells.summary: Sylas steals the enemy's ultimate ability and can cast it freely.
spells.text: Sylas hijacks an enemy champion, allowing him to cast a copy of their ultimate Ability, based on his Ultimate level and using his stats. Hijacking an enemy places a Cooldown on them for 200% (modified by Sylas' Ability Haste) of the enemy's ultimate's Cooldown, with a minimum of 40 seconds, during which time Sylas cannot hijack them again. Sylas converts non-hybrid AD ratios into AP ratios, granting him .4 AP: 1 Bonus AD and .6 AP: 1 Total AD respectively.

spells.name: Transcendent
spells.summary: Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath from gaining levels and damaging enemies which upgrade her abilities. Dark Sphere: Syndra can hold an additional charge Force of Will: Bonus true damage. Scatter the Weak: Increased width and slows all targets Unleashed Power: Executes low health targets
spells.text: Syndra can collect up to 120 Splinters of Wrath. These enhance Syndra's Abilities and restore (20 ~ 179) Mana each time she claims one from an enemy. Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath from the following:3 Splinter(s) when damaging enemy champions with two Abilities within 4 seconds (8s Cooldown)5 Splinters upon spending Ability points1 Splinter on killing large minions At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra increases her Ability Power by 15%.

spells.name: Dark Sphere
spells.summary: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere dealing magic damage. The sphere remains and can be manipulated by her other powers.
spells.text: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere, dealing (90/125/160/195/230 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage. The Dark Sphere remains for 6 seconds and can be manipulated by Syndra's other Abilities. 40 Splinters of Wrath: Syndra can store 2 charges of Dark Sphere. This Ability can be cast while moving.

spells.name: Force of Will
spells.summary: Syndra picks up and throws a Dark Sphere or enemy minion dealing magic damage and slowing the Move Speed of enemies.
spells.text: Syndra grabs a Dark Sphere, enemy minion, or non-epic monster. She drags it with her and can Recast for up to 5 seconds. Recast: Syndra hurls the object, dealing (70/100/130/160/190 + (65% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing by 25% for 1.5 seconds. 60 Splinters of Wrath: This Ability deals an additional (12% + (2% per 100 Ability Power)) true damage. If no target is selected, grabs nearest Dark Sphere. This Ability can be cast while moving.

spells.name: Scatter the Weak
spells.summary: Syndra knocks enemies and Dark Spheres back dealing magic damage. Enemies hit by Dark Spheres become stunned.
spells.text: Syndra projects a wave of force, Knocking Back enemies and Dark Spheres and dealing (60/95/130/165/200 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. Dark Spheres that are pushed Stun enemies for 1.25 seconds and deal (60/95/130/165/200 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. 80 Splinters of Wrath: This Ability's width is increased and Slows enemies by 70% for 1.25 seconds. Enemies can only take damage and be Knocked Back from this Ability once per cast.

spells.name: Unleashed Power
spells.summary: Syndra bombards an enemy Champion with all of her Dark Spheres.
spells.text: Passive: Dark Sphere gains an additional 10 Ability Haste for each rank of Unleashed Power. Syndra draws on her full cataclysmic power, launching the 3 Dark Spheres orbiting her plus up to 4 more nearby at an enemy champion. Each Dark Sphere deals (80/120/160 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage (max (560/840/1120 + (140% Ability Power)) magic damage). 100 Splinters of Wrath: This Ability executes enemies below 15% Health.

spells.name: An Acquired Taste
spells.summary: Tahm Kench puts the heft of his immense body behind his attacks, gaining extra damage based on his total health. Damaging enemy champions builds stacks of An Acquired Taste. At three stacks, he can use Devour on an enemy champion.
spells.text: Attacks deal (10 + (4% bonus Health) + (0% Ability Power)) bonus magic damage. Against champions, they add a stack of An Acquired Taste for 5 seconds, up to 3 times. At 3 stacks, Tongue Lash and Devour become empowered against that champion.

spells.name: Tongue Lash
spells.summary: Tahm Kench lashes out with his tongue, damaging and slowing the first unit hit and healing himself if he strikes an enemy champion. Applies a stack of An Acquired Taste to enemy champions. If the champion already has 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, they are stunned and the stacks are consumed.
spells.text: Deals (75/120/165/210/255 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage to the first enemy hit and Slows them by 50% for 2 seconds. On champion hit, heals Tahm for 10/15/20/25/30 + 5/5.5/6/6.5/7% of his missing Health and applies a stack of An Acquired Taste dealing (10 + (4% bonus Health) + (0% Ability Power)) extra magic damage. If that champion already had 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, they will also be Stunned for 1.5 seconds, consuming the stacks. Activate Devour while your tongue is in midair to devour enemy champions who already have 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste from a distance when you hit them. Tongue Lash's range increases with Tahm Kench's size

spells.name: Abyssal Dive
spells.summary: Dive down and then re-appear at target location, damaging and knocking up all enemies in an area.
spells.text: Dive down and then re-appear at target location, dealing (100/135/170/205/240 + (150% Ability Power)) magic damage and Knock Up all enemies in an area for 1 second. Hitting at least one enemy champion refunds 40/42.5/45/47.5/50% of the Cooldown and Mana cost. Devoured allies can be taken along for the ride (but can always hop out early). Enemies cannot see where you are headed to until 0.75 seconds into the channel. 'Boy, the world's one river, and I'm its king. Ain't no place I ain't been; ain't no place I can't go again.'

spells.name: Thick Skin
spells.summary: Passive: Tahm Kench stores a percent of the damage he takes and heals based on it while out of combat. Active: Convert all stored damage into a temporary shield.
spells.text: Passive: 15/23/31/39/47% of damage Tahm Kench takes is stored by his Thick Skin, increased to 42/44/46/48/50% if there are at least 2 nearby enemy champions. If Kench has not taken damage within 4 seconds, Thick Skin will rapidly be consumed to heal Tahm for (60% ~ 100%) of its value. Active: Convert all your stored Thick Skin into a Shield, lasting 2.5 seconds. Grey Health is capped at (300% Health)

spells.name: Devour
spells.summary: Tahm Kench devours a champion for a few seconds, dealing magic damage if they are an enemy, or shielding them if they are an ally.
spells.text: Tahm Kench devours a champion for a few seconds. He can Recast to spit them out. Enemy Champions: Require 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste. Are devoured for up to 3 seconds and take 100/250/400 ( + (15% + (7% per 100 Ability Power)) of their Max Health) magic damage. Tahm Kench is Slowed by 40% and Grounded during this effect. Ally Champions: Are devoured for up to 3 seconds and are granted (650/800/950 + (100% Ability Power)) Shield which decays gradually after being spit out. Allies can also choose to exit early. Tahm Kench is Grounded during this effect, but can cast Abyssal Dive and gains 60% Move Speed for 3 seconds. Allies can see when this spell is available next to your health bar (enemies cannot). Shield decays by 200 per second.

spells.name: Rock Surfing
spells.summary: Taliyah gains Move Speed near walls.
spells.text: Taliyah gains 40% Move Speed while out of combat if she has been near a wall within the last 3 seconds.

spells.name: Threaded Volley
spells.summary: Taliyah throws a volley of rocks in a target direction, moving freely as she casts. This creates Worked Ground below her. If Taliyah casts Threaded Volley on Worked Ground, she consumes the ground to throw a stronger boulder that slows enemies.
spells.text: Taliyah hurls 5 rocks, each dealing (55/72.5/90/107.5/125 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage in an area around the first enemy hit while creating Worked Ground at that area. Subsequent hits against the same enemy deal 60% less damage. Casts on worked ground cost 10 Mana and have 50% less Cooldown, consume the Worked Ground, and hurl a boulder that Slows enemies it hits by 20/25/30/35/40% for 1.5 seconds, dealing (99/130.5/162/193.5/225 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage to the primary target. Monsters hit by the boulder are Stunned for 3 seconds. Taliyah can move and use other Abilities while hurling rocks. Casting this Ability on Worked Ground cannot reduce its Cooldown to less than 0.75 seconds. Total damage to a single target: (143/188.5/234/279.5/325 + (130% Ability Power)) Each rock deals 20/25/30/35/40 additional damage to monsters.

spells.name: Seismic Shove
spells.summary: Taliyah causes an area of ground to erupt and throws enemies within it in a direction of her choosing.
spells.text: Taliyah quakes the earth, Knocking enemies in an area in the chosen direction.

spells.name: Unraveled Earth
spells.summary: Taliyah creates a slowing minefield. If enemies dash through it or are knocked through it, the mines explode and stun them.
spells.text: Taliyah scatters loose stones in an area, Slowing enemies hit by 20% and dealing (60/105/150/195/240 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. The stones detonate when enemies dash or are Knocked through them, Stunning for the remaining movement duration + 0.75 seconds and dealing (25/40/55/70/85 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage. The stun's duration cannot exceed 2 seconds. Each enemy can only be stunned once per cast. Monsters are always stunned for the maximum duration. Stones beyond the first one deal 25% less damage. Max detonation damage: (62.5/100/137.5/175/212.5 + (75% Ability Power)) This ability deals 225% damage to monsters.

spells.name: Weaver's Wall
spells.summary: Taliyah creates a very long wall and then surfs it.
spells.text: Taliyah creates a massive earthen wall for 4 seconds. If she immediately Recasts, she will ride along the wall as it unravels. Moving or being immobilized will end the ride. This ability cannot be cast if Taliyah has taken damage from Champions or structures within the last 3 seconds. Once the wall is fully formed, Taliyah can Recast to destroy it early.

spells.name: Blade's End
spells.summary: Talon's spells Wound champions and large monsters, stacking up to 3 times. When Talon attacks a champion with 3 stacks of Wound, they bleed for heavy damage over time.
spells.text: Talon's Abilities apply a stack to champions and large jungle monsters they damage for 6 seconds (max 3 stacks). When Talon Attacks a target with 3 stacks, he deals an additional ((80 ~ 280) + (210% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage over 2 seconds.

spells.name: Noxian Diplomacy
spells.summary: Talon stabs the target unit. If they are within melee range, this attack deals critical damage. If they are outside melee range, Talon will leap at his target before stabbing them. Talon refunds some health and cooldown if this ability kills the target.
spells.text: Talon leaps to a target and deals (65/85/105/125/145 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. If used in melee range, this Ability instead critically strikes for (65/85/105/125/145 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) × (1.5 + 100% bonus Critical Strike Damage) physical damage. If this Ability kills the target, Talon restores (9 ~ 55) Health and refunds 50% of its Cooldown. Melee damage is affected by Critical Strike Damage increase.

spells.name: Rake
spells.summary: Talon sends out a volley of daggers that then return back to him, dealing physical damage every time it passes through an enemy. The returning blades deal bonus damage and slow units hit.
spells.text: Talon tosses a volley of blades, dealing (50/60/70/80/90 + (40% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. The blades then return to him, dealing (60/90/120/150/180 + (90% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and Slowing by 40/45/50/55/60% for 1 second.

spells.name: Assassin's Path
spells.summary: Talon vaults over any terrain or structure, up to a max distance. This ability has a low cooldown, but puts the used terrain on a long cooldown.
spells.text: Talon vaults over the nearest terrain or structure. Talon cannot dash over the same terrain more than once every 160/135/110/85/60 seconds.

spells.name: Shadow Assault
spells.summary: Talon disperses a ring of blades and becomes Invisible while gaining additional Move Speed. When Talon emerges from Invisibility, the blades converge on his location. Each time the blades move, Shadow Assault deals physical damage to enemies hit by at least one blade.
spells.text: Talon disperses a ring of blades that deal (90/135/180 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage, gains 40/55/70% Move Speed, and becomes Invisible for 2.5 seconds. When the Invisibility ends, the blades return to Talon, dealing (90/135/180 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage again. If Talon cancels the Invisibility with an Attack or with Noxian Diplomacy, the blades return to the target instead. Invisible units cannot be revealed except by turrets or True Sight.

spells.name: Bravado
spells.summary: Spellcasts empower Taric's next 2 basic attacks to deal bonus magic damage, reduce his spell cooldowns, and attack in quick succession.
spells.text: After using an Ability, Taric's next 2 Attacks within 5 seconds gain 100% Attack Speed, deal an additional (25/93 + (15% bonus Armor)) magic damage, and reduce his basic Ability Cooldowns by 1 second.

spells.name: Starlight's Touch
spells.summary: Heals nearby allied champions based on charges stored. Bravado-empowered attacks grant a charge of Starlight's Touch.
spells.text: Passive: Gain a stack (max 1/2/3/4/5) every 15 seconds and when hitting a Bravado Attack. Active: Consume all stacks to restore (25 + (15% Ability Power) + (1% Health)) Health per stack to nearby ally champions ((25/50/75/100/125 + (15/30/45/60/75% Ability Power) + (1/2/3/4/5% Health)) at 1/2/3/4/5 stacks).

spells.name: Bastion
spells.summary: Passively increase the Armor of Taric and any allied champion with Bastion. Actively shields an ally and grants them Bastion for as long as they remain near Taric. Taric's spells also cast off the ally with Bastion.
spells.text: Passive: Taric gains (6/7/8/9/10% Armor) Armor and forms a tether between him and the ally bound by this Ability. As long as they are near each other, the ally gains (6/7/8/9/10% Armor) Armor and Taric casts all his Abilities from both himself and his linked ally. Active: Taric binds to an ally champion, granting a 7/8/9/10/11% max Health Shield for 2.5 seconds. Mimicked spell effects do not stack. Only one ally can be bound at a time.

spells.name: Dazzle
spells.summary: Taric readies a beam of starlight that, after a brief delay, deals magic damage and stuns enemies.
spells.text: Taric projects a beam of starlight, bursting after 1 second to deal (90/130/170/210/250 + (50% Ability Power) + (50% bonus Armor)) magic damage and Stun enemies for 1.5 seconds.

spells.name: Cosmic Radiance
spells.summary: Pulses cosmic energy onto nearby allied champions after a delay, making them invulnerable for a short duration.
spells.text: Taric calls down protection from the heavens. After 2.5 seconds, nearby ally champions become invulnerable for 2.5 seconds.

spells.name: Guerrilla Warfare
spells.summary: If Teemo stands still and takes no actions for a short duration, he becomes Invisible indefinitely. If he's in brush, Teemo can enter and maintain his Invisibility while moving. After leaving Invisibility, Teemo gains the Element of Surprise, increasing his Attack Speed for a few seconds.
spells.text: If Teemo stands still for 1.5 seconds without being damaged, he becomes Invisible until he moves. While in a brush, he can maintain Invisibility while moving. Upon exiting this Invisibility, Teemo gains 80% Attack Speed for 5 seconds.

spells.name: Blinding Dart
spells.summary: Obscures an enemy's vision with a powerful venom, dealing damage to the target unit and blinding it for the duration.
spells.text: Teemo fires a dart, Blinding the target for 2/2.25/2.5/2.75/3 seconds and dealing (80/125/170/215/260 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage. Minions and jungle monsters are Blinded for 200% longer.

spells.name: Move Quick
spells.summary: Teemo scampers around, passively increasing his Move Speed until he is struck by an enemy champion or turret. Teemo can sprint to gain bonus Move Speed that isn't stopped by being struck for a short time.
spells.text: Passive: Teemo gains 12/16/20/24/28% Move Speed while he hasn't been damaged by a champion or turret in the last 5 seconds. Active: Teemo sprints, gaining 24/32/40/48/56% Move Speed that is not lost when struck for 3 seconds.

spells.name: Toxic Shot
spells.summary: Each of Teemo's attacks will poison the target %i:OnHit% On-Hit, dealing damage on impact and each second after for 4 seconds.
spells.text: Passive: Teemo's Attacks apply poison On-Hit, dealing an additional (9/23/37/51/65 + (30% Ability Power) + (5% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage plus (24/48/72/96/120 + (40% Ability Power) + (10% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage over 4 seconds. This poison deals 160% damage to jungle monsters.

spells.name: Noxious Trap
spells.summary: Teemo throws an explosive poisonous trap using one of the mushrooms stored in his pack. If an enemy steps on the trap, it will release a poisonous cloud, slowing enemies and damaging them over time. If Teemo throws a mushroom onto another mushroom it will bounce, gaining additional range.
spells.text: Teemo tosses a mushroom trap that detonates when stepped on. The traps Slow by 30/40/50% and deal (200/325/450 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage over 4 seconds. Enemies are revealed for the same duration. Traps last 5 minutes and are stealthed. A mushroom tossed onto another mushroom bounces before landing at its position. This Ability has 3 charges (35/30/25 second refresh).

spells.name: Damnation
spells.summary: Thresh can harvest the souls of enemies that die near him, permanently granting him Armor and Ability Power.
spells.text: Thresh collects the Souls of dead enemies by walking near them. Each Soul grants him 1 Armor and 1 Ability Power.

spells.name: Death Sentence
spells.summary: Thresh binds an enemy in chains and pulls them toward him. Activating this ability a second time pulls Thresh to the enemy.
spells.text: Thresh throws out his scythe, Stunning the first unit hit and Pulling them towards Thresh for 1.5 seconds. The scythe does (100/150/200/250/300 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage and also grants True Sight for the duration. Thresh can Recast this Ability to pull himself to the enemy. If this Ability hits, its Cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds.

spells.name: Dark Passage
spells.summary: Thresh throws out a lantern that shields nearby allied Champions from damage. Allies can click the lantern to dash to Thresh.
spells.text: Thresh throws his lantern, allowing an ally to click on it to dash to Thresh. The lantern also grants 52/72/92/112/132 Shield for 4 seconds to Thresh and the first ally champion to come in contact with it. The Shield scales with number of Souls collected. Thresh can use his lantern to pick up Souls.

spells.name: Flay
spells.summary: Thresh's attacks wind up, dealing more damage the longer he waits between attacks. When activated, Thresh sweeps his chain, knocking all enemies hit in the direction of the blow.
spells.text: Passive: Thresh's Attacks deal additional damage based on how long since he last Attacked. They deal between 1.7 and (1.7 + (90/120/150/180/210% Attack Damage)) magic damage. Active: Thresh whips his chains, Pulling or Pushing enemies in the direction of the swing. Enemies hit are also Slowed by 20/25/30/35/40% for 1 second and take (65/110/155/200/245 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. Passive damage scales with number of Souls collected.

spells.name: The Box
spells.summary: A prison of walls that slow and deal damage if broken.
spells.text: Thresh creates a prison of spectral walls, Slowing champions by 99% for 2 seconds and dealing (250/400/550 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage. Walls break after one collision, and after one is broken, the rest deal no damage and Slow for half duration.

spells.name: Draw a Bead
spells.summary: Increases Tristana's Attack Range as she levels.
spells.text: Tristana's Attack Range and the range of Explosive Charge and Buster Shot are increased by (0 ~ 150).

spells.name: Rapid Fire
spells.summary: Tristana fires her weapon rapidly, increasing her Attack Speed for a short time.
spells.text: Tristana goes full-auto, gaining 60/75/90/105/120% Attack Speed for 7 seconds.

spells.name: Rocket Jump
spells.summary: Tristana fires at the ground to propel her to a distant location, dealing damage and slowing surrounding units for a brief period where she lands.
spells.text: Tristana launches herself, dealing (70/105/140/175/210 + (100% bonus Attack Damage) + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing by 40% for 2 seconds upon landing. Champion takedowns and max stack Explosive Charge detonations on champions refresh this Ability's Cooldown.

spells.name: Explosive Charge
spells.summary: When Tristana kills a unit, her cannonballs burst into shrapnel, dealing damage to surrounding enemies. Can be activated to place a bomb on a target enemy that explodes after a short duration dealing damage to surrounding units.
spells.text: Passive: Tristana's Attacks that kill enemies deal (45/60/75/90/105 + (25% Ability Power)) magic damage to surrounding enemies. Active: Tristana attaches a bomb to an enemy or turret that deals (60/85/110/135/160 + (80% bonus Attack Damage) + (50% Ability Power)) physical damage to surrounding enemies after 4 seconds. The damage is increased by 25% each time Tristana hits an Attack or Ability (max 4 stacks). At 4 stacks, the bomb explodes immediately (max (120/170/220/270/320 + (160% bonus Attack Damage) + (100% Ability Power)) physical damage). Active damage is increased by Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage at 40% effectiveness. The detonation radius is twice as large if used on a turret.

spells.name: Buster Shot
spells.summary: Tristana loads a massive cannonball into her weapon and fires it at an enemy unit. This deals Magic Damage and knocks the target back. If the target is carrying the Explosive Charge bomb, the bomb detonation radius is doubled.
spells.text: Tristana fires a massive cannonball, dealing (225/275/325 + (70% bonus Attack Damage) + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage to the target, Knocking Back and Stunning them and surrounding enemies for 0.4/0.55/0.7 seconds. If this Ability applies the final stack of Explosive Charge, it explodes after the unit is Knocked Back.

spells.name: King's Tribute
spells.summary: When an enemy unit dies near Trundle, he heals for a percent of its maximum Health.
spells.text: When an enemy dies near Trundle, he restores (1.8% ~ 5.5%) of its max Health.

spells.name: Chomp
spells.summary: Trundle bites his opponent, dealing damage, briefly slowing and sapping some of their Attack Damage.
spells.text: Trundle's next Attack deals (10/30/50/70/90 + (115/125/135/145/155% Attack Damage)) physical damage and briefly Slows by 75%, then Trundle gains 20/25/30/35/40 Attack Damage for 5 seconds and the enemy loses 10/12.5/15/17.5/20 Attack Damage for the same duration. This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage. Trundle gains 25 attack range for this attack.

spells.name: Frozen Domain
spells.summary: Trundle turns target location into his domain, gaining Attack Speed, Move Speed, and increased healing from all sources while on it.
