spells.text: Trundle freezes an area for 8 seconds. While inside he gains 20/28/36/44/52% Move Speed, 30/50/70/90/110% Attack Speed, and 25% increased healing.

spells.name: Pillar of Ice
spells.summary: Trundle creates an ice pillar at target location, becoming impassable terrain and slowing all nearby enemy units.
spells.text: Trundle creates an icy pillar for 6 seconds, briefly Knocking Back enemies directly over it and Slowing nearby enemies by 34/38/42/46/50%.

spells.name: Subjugate
spells.summary: Trundle immediately steals a percent of his target's Health, Armor and Magic Resistance. Over the next 4 seconds the amount of Health, Armor, and Magic Resistance stolen is doubled.
spells.text: Trundle drains the lifeforce of an enemy champion, dealing (20/25/30% + (2% per 100 Ability Power)) max Health magic damage and stealing 40% Armor and Magic Resist over 5 seconds. Half of the damage and shred happen immediately and the other half happens over the duration. The shred lasts for 4 seconds after the drain ends.

spells.name: Battle Fury
spells.summary: Tryndamere gains Fury for each attack, critical strike, and killing blow he makes. Fury passively increases his Critical Strike Chance and can be consumed with his Bloodlust spell.
spells.text: Tryndamere's Attacks grant him 5 Fury or 10 Fury for a critical strike, and 10 Fury for killing a unit. After 8 seconds of being out of combat, Tryndamere loses 5 Fury every second. Each point of Fury grants 0.5% Critical Strike Chance.

spells.name: Bloodlust
spells.summary: Tryndamere thrives on the thrills of combat, increasing his Attack Damage as he is more and more wounded. He can cast Bloodlust to consume his Fury and heal himself.
spells.text: Passive: Tryndamere thirsts for blood, gaining up to 20/35/50/65/80 Attack Damage based on his missing Health. Active: Tryndamere consumes his Fury, restoring (30/40/50/60/70 + (30% Ability Power)) plus (0.5/0.95/1.4/1.85/2.3 + (1.2% Ability Power)) Health per Fury (max: (30/40/50/60/70 + (30% Ability Power))). Maximum Attack Damage gained at 10% remaining Health.

spells.name: Mocking Shout
spells.summary: Tryndamere lets out an insulting cry, decreasing surrounding champions' Attack Damage. Enemies with their backs turned to Tryndamere also have their Move Speed reduced.
spells.text: Tryndamere hurls insults, reducing champions' Attack Damage by 20/35/50/65/80 for 4 seconds and Slowing by 30/35/40/45/50% while cowering from him for 3.25 seconds.

spells.name: Spinning Slash
spells.summary: Tryndamere slices toward a target unit, dealing damage to enemies in his path.
spells.text: Tryndamere spins through his enemies, dealing (80/120/160/200/240 + (100% bonus Attack Damage) + (80% Ability Power)) physical damage and generating 2 Fury per enemy hit, increased to 5 Fury against enemy champions. This Ability's Cooldown is reduced by 0.75 seconds when Tryndamere critically strikes, and reduced by 1.5 seconds when critically striking a champion.

spells.name: Undying Rage
spells.summary: Tryndamere's lust for battle becomes so strong that he is unable to die, no matter how wounded he becomes.
spells.text: Tryndamere becomes completely immune to death for 5 seconds, refusing to be reduced below 30/50/70 Health, and instantly gains 50/75/100 Fury. This Ability can be used while Disabled.

spells.name: Loaded Dice
spells.summary: Upon killing a unit, Twisted Fate rolls his 'lucky' dice receiving 1 to 6 bonus gold.
spells.text: Upon killing a unit, Twisted Fate rolls his 'lucky' dice receiving 1 to 6 bonus gold.

spells.name: Wild Cards
spells.summary: Twisted Fate throws three cards, dealing damage to each enemy unit they pass through.
spells.text: Twisted Fate throws three cards that deal (60/105/150/195/240 + (50% bonus Attack Damage) + (85% Ability Power)) magic damage each. Enemies can only be damaged by one of the cards.

spells.name: Pick a Card
spells.summary: Twisted Fate chooses a magic card from his deck, and uses that for his next attack, causing bonus effects.
spells.text: Twisted Fate begins shuffling his deck, allowing him to Recast to lock in one of three cards and enhance his next Attack. The Blue Card deals (40/60/80/100/120 + (100% Attack Damage) + (100% Ability Power) + (2300/3450/4600/5750/6900% Critical Strike Chance)) magic damage and restores 70/90/110/130/150 Mana.The Red Card deals (30/45/60/75/90 + (100% Attack Damage) + (70% Ability Power) + (1050/1575/2100/2625/3150% Critical Strike Chance)) to nearby enemies and Slows by 30/35/40/45/50% for 2.5 seconds.The Gold Card deals (15/22.5/30/37.5/45 + (100% Attack Damage) + (50% Ability Power) + (375/562.5/750/937.5/1125% Critical Strike Chance)) and Stuns for 1/1.25/1.5/1.75/2 seconds.

spells.name: Stacked Deck
spells.summary: Every 4 attacks, Twisted Fate deals bonus damage. In addition, his Attack Speed is increased.
spells.text: Passive: Twisted Fate gains 15/25/35/45/55% Attack Speed and every 4th Attack deals an additional (65/90/115/140/165 + (20% bonus Attack Damage) + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage. 50% effective against structures.

spells.name: Destiny
spells.summary: Twisted Fate predicts the fortunes of his foes, revealing all enemy champions and enabling the use of Gate, which teleports Twisted Fate to any target location in 1.5 seconds.
spells.text: Twisted Fate focuses on his cards, granting True Sight of all enemy champions on the map for 6/8/10 seconds and allowing him to Recast. Recast: Twisted Fate teleports up to 5500 units away. Disabling effects will interrupt the teleport.

spells.name: Deadly Venom
spells.summary: Twitch's basic attacks infect the target %i:OnHit% On-Hit, dealing true damage each second.
spells.text: Twitch's Attacks infect his target On-Hit, dealing (5 + (3% Ability Power)) true damage per second for 6 seconds, stacking up to 6 times. Max Damage Per Second: (30 + (18% Ability Power))

spells.name: Ambush
spells.summary: Twitch becomes Camouflaged for a short duration and gains Move Speed. When leaving Camouflage, Twitch gains Attack Speed for a short duration. When an enemy champion with Deadly Venom dies, Ambush's cooldown is reset.
spells.text: Twitch Camouflages and gains 10% Move Speed for 10/11/12/13/14 seconds. The Move Speed increases to 30% while near an enemy champion that can't see him. After exiting Camouflage, Twitch gains 40/45/50/55/60% Attack Speed for 6 seconds. When an enemy champion dies while afflicted with Venom, this Ability's Cooldown is refreshed. Camouflaged units cannot be seen unless an enemy champion is inside their detection radius.

spells.name: Venom Cask
spells.summary: Twitch hurls a cask of venom that explodes in an area, slowing targets and applying deadly venom to the target.
spells.text: Twitch hurls a cask that adds a stack of Deadly Venom to all enemies struck and leaves behind a toxic cloud that persists for 3 seconds. Enemies that remain within the cloud are Slowed by (30/35/40/45/50 + (6% Ability Power))and receive an additional stack of Deadly Venom each second.

spells.name: Contaminate
spells.summary: Twitch wreaks further havoc on poisoned enemies with a blast of his vile diseases.
spells.text: Deals 20/30/40/50/60 physical damage to all nearby enemies affected by Deadly Venom, plus an additional (15/20/25/30/35 + (35% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and (35% Ability Power) magical damage per stack of Deadly Venom. Max Damage: (110/150/190/230/270 + (210% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and (210% Ability Power) magical damage.

spells.name: Spray and Pray
spells.summary: Twitch unleashes the full power of his crossbow, shooting bolts over a great distance that pierce all enemies caught in their path.
spells.text: Twitch unleashes his crossbow, gaining 300 Attack Range and 30/45/60 Attack Damage, and causing his Attacks to become piercing bolts for 6 seconds. These bolts hit all enemies they pass through, but deal 10% less damage to subsequent targets, down to a minimum of 60% damage. Using this Ability does not break Camouflage, but Attacking still does.

spells.name: Bridge Between
spells.summary: Udyr has four basic Abilities that swap between Stances and can Recast an Ability to renew it with Ultimate benefits. Additionally, after using an Ability, Udyr's next two Attacks gain Attack Speed.
spells.text: Awakened Spirit: Udyr has four basic Abilities that swap between Stances. Udyr can Recast an Ability that is on Cooldown to gain its bonuses again with Ultimate benefits. (20 second Cooldown). Monk Training: After using an Ability, Udyr's next two Attacks within 4 seconds gain 30% Attack Speed and refund 5% of Awaken's Cooldown.

spells.name: Wilding Claw
spells.summary: Udyr gains attack speed and his next two attacks deal bonus physical damage. Recast: Gain even more attack speed, and the next two attacks call lightning to strike the target.
spells.text: Claw Stance: Udyr gains 20/32/44/56/68/80% Attack Speed and his Attacks deal (6/12/18/24/30/36 + (20% bonus Attack Damage) + (1/1.2/1.4/1.6/1.8/2% bonus Health)) physical damage On-Hit for 4 seconds. Additionally, Udyr's next two Attacks in this stance deal a bonus (3/4/5/6/7/8% + (3.5% per 100 bonus Attack Damage)) max Health physical damage and gain 50 range. Awaken: Increase bonus Attack Speed to (20/32/44/56/68/80% + (20% ~ 70%)) and max Health damage to (3/4/5/6/7/8% + (2% ~ 4%) + (5% per 100 bonus Attack Damage) + (0.1% per 100 bonus Health)). Additionally, Udyr's next two Attacks call lightning six times, dealing a total of (9/18% + (3.6% per 100 Ability Power)) max Health magic damage to isolated targets (strikes bounce to other nearby targets when possible). Claw Stance Max Health damage is capped at (15 + (50% Ability Power) + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) to monsters. Each lightning strike deals ((1.5% ~ 3%) + (0.6% per 100 Ability Power)) max Health magic damage Minimum damage to minions: (40 ~ 160)).

spells.name: Iron Mantle
spells.summary: Udyr gains a shield and his next two attacks heal him. Recast: Gain an even bigger shield and heal based on max health over the next couple seconds.
spells.text: Mantle Stance: Udyr gains (45/65/85/105/125/145 + (2/2.3/2.6/2.9/3.2/3.5% Health) + (40% Ability Power) + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) Shield for 4 seconds. Additionally, Udyr's next two Attacks gain 15/16/17/18/19/20% Life Steal and restore ((1.2% Health) + (8% Ability Power)) Health. Awaken: Gain ((20 ~ 150) + (65% Ability Power) + (8% Health) + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) Shield, restore ((10 ~ 75) + (32.5% Ability Power) + (4% Health) + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) Health over 4 seconds, and Udyr's next two Attacks instead have 30/32/34/36/38/40% Life Steal and restore ((2.4% Health) + (16% Ability Power)) Health. The Shield granted by an Awaken cast will stack with any remaining Shield from the original cast. Life on hit reduced by 40% against minions.

spells.name: Blazing Stampede
spells.summary: Udyr gains movement speed and his first attack against each target will Stun them. Recast: Gain even more movement speed and immunity to immobilizing effects for a couple seconds.
spells.text: Stampede Stance: Udyr gains (25/31/37/43/49/55% + (5% per 100 bonus Attack Damage)) Move Speed, decaying over 4 seconds. Additionally, Udyr's Attacks dash him to the target and Stun for 0.75 seconds (6/5.6/5.2/4.8/4.4/4 second Cooldown per target). Awaken: Grants immunity to Immobilizing and Disabling effects and an additional ((30% ~ 40%) + (0.1% bonus Attack Damage)) Move Speed for 1.5 seconds. Udyr moves through units during the Move Speed boost, and his Attacks in this Stance can't be cancelled.

spells.name: Wingborne Storm
spells.summary: Udyr surrounds himself in a glacial storm, damaging and slowing nearby enemies. Recast: Empower and unleash the storm, causing it to track enemies and deal additional damage.
spells.text: Storm Stance: Udyr surrounds himself in a glacial storm for 4 seconds, dealing (20/36/52/68/84/100 + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage per second to nearby enemies and Slowing them by 15/18/21/24/27/30%. Additionally, Udyr's next two Attacks in this stance deal ((10 ~ 40) + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies in the storm. Awaken: Unleash the storm, causing it to follow Udyr's last Attacked enemy, deal an additional ((8% ~ 14%) + (3.5% per 100 Ability Power)) max Health magic damage over the duration, and Slow by an additional 5%. Storm deals 80% damage to minions. Awakened deals a minimum of (40 ~ 280) to monsters.

spells.name: Echoing Flames
spells.summary: Urgot's basic attacks and Purge periodically trigger blasts of flame from his legs, dealing physical damage.
spells.text: Urgot has a cannon on each of his 6 legs. Attacks and Purge will fire the leg cannon that is facing his target for (100% Attack Damage) plus 6% max Health physical damage. This effect has a 2.5 second Cooldown per leg.

spells.name: Corrosive Charge
spells.summary: Fires an explosive charge at the target location, dealing physical damage and slowing enemies caught in the explosion.
spells.text: Urgot fires an explosive charge, dealing (25/70/115/160/205 + (70% Attack Damage)) physical damage and Slowing by 45/50/55/60/65% for 1.25 seconds.

spells.name: Purge
spells.summary: Urgot slows himself while he unloads his weapon on nearby enemies. Prioritizes enemy champions Urgot has recently struck with other abilities and triggers Echoing Flames.
spells.text: Passive: Urgot's other Abilities mark the last champion hit for 5 seconds. Active: Urgot begins firing his chain gun at the closest enemy, prioritizing marked enemies. He Attacks them 3 times a second dealing (12 + (20/23.5/27/30.5/34% Attack Damage)) physical damage per shot. Urgot can move while firing and has 40% Slow resistance, but loses 125 Move Speed. At max rank, this Ability lasts indefinitely and can be Toggled on and off. The shots apply On-Hit effects at 50% damage. They cannot critically strike. Shots deal a minimum of 50 damage to minions and jungle monsters. Urgot can move through minions and non-epic jungle monsters while firing.

spells.name: Disdain
spells.summary: Urgot charges in a direction, shielding himself and trampling non-champion enemies. If he catches an enemy champion, he will stop and hurl them out of his way.
spells.text: Urgot charges forward, gaining (55/75/95/115/135 + (135% bonus Attack Damage) + (13.5% bonus Health)) Shield for 4 seconds. The first champion hit is Stunned for 1.5 seconds and thrown behind Urgot. All enemies Urgot collides with take (90/120/150/180/210 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. Cannot cross terrain.

spells.name: Fear Beyond Death
spells.summary: Urgot fires a chem-drill that impales the first enemy champion hit. If that champion falls below a health threshold, Urgot judges them weak and can execute them.
spells.text: Urgot fires a chem-drill, impaling the first champion hit, dealing (100/225/350 + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and Slowing for 4 seconds by 1% per 1% missing Health, up to 75%. If the impaled victim falls below 25% Health, Urgot can Recast this Ability, Suppressing the victim and dragging them to himself. On reaching Urgot, they are killed and nearby enemies are Feared for 1.5 seconds. This Ability will automatically Recast at the end of the duration if the victim is under the execution threshold.

spells.name: Living Vengeance
spells.summary: On kill or assist, Varus temporarily gains Attack Damage and Ability Power. This bonus is larger if the enemy is a champion.
spells.text: When Varus kills an enemy, he gains 20% Attack Speed, (1100% bonus Attack Speed) Attack Damage, and (1100% bonus Attack Speed) Ability Power for 11 seconds. Champion takedowns grant 30% Attack Speed that can bypass the Attack Speed cap, (3300% bonus Attack Speed) Attack Damage, and (3300% bonus Attack Speed) Ability Power instead.

spells.name: Piercing Arrow
spells.summary: Varus readies and then fires a powerful shot that gains extra range and damage the longer he spends preparing to fire.
spells.text: Begin Charging: Varus draws back his next shot, Slowing himself by 20%. After 4 seconds, if not fired, Varus will cancel the Ability and refund 50% of its Mana cost. Release: Varus releases the arrow, dealing (53.334/100.001/146.667/193.334/240.001 + (80% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage, reduced by 15% per enemy hit (minimum 33%). Damage and Blight detonation effects are increased by up to 50% based on charge time (maximum (80/150/220/290/360 + (120% bonus Attack Damage))) .

spells.name: Blighted Quiver
spells.summary: Passive: Varus' basic attacks deal bonus magic damage and apply Blight. Varus' other abilities detonate Blight, dealing magic damage based on the target's maximum Health. Active: Varus empowers his next Piercing Arrow.
spells.text: Passive: Varus' Attacks deal an additional (4/13/22/31/40 + (25% Ability Power) + (15% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage and apply a Blight stack for 6 seconds (max 3 stacks). Varus' other Abilities detonate Blight stacks dealing (3/3.5/4/4.5/5% + (1.3% per 100 Ability Power)) max Health magic damage per stack (max (9/10.5/12/13.5/15% + (3.9% per 100 Ability Power)) max Health damage). Detonating Blight on champions and epic monsters also reduces his basic Abilities' Cooldowns by 13% of their Maximum per stack. Active: Varus' next Piercing Arrow deals an additional 6/8/10/12/14% missing Health magic damage, increased up to 9/12/15/18/21% missing Health damage based on charge time. Passive damage from Blight detonations is capped at 120 damage per stack against jungle monsters.

spells.name: Hail of Arrows
spells.summary: Varus fires a hail of arrows that deal physical damage and desecrate the ground. Desecrated ground slows enemies' Move Speed and reduces their self healing and regeneration.
spells.text: Varus fires a hail of arrows that deals (60/90/120/150/180 + (90% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and desecrates the ground for 4 seconds, Slowing enemies by 30/35/40/45/50% and applying 40% Grievous Wounds. Grievous Wounds reduces the effectiveness of healing and regeneration effects.

spells.name: Chain of Corruption
spells.summary: Varus flings out a damaging tendril of corruption that immobilizes the first enemy champion hit and then spreads towards nearby uninfected champions, immobilizing them too on contact.
spells.text: Varus flings out a tendril of corruption, Rooting the first champion hit for 2 seconds and dealing (150/250/350 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage. Rooted enemies gain 3 Blight stacks over the duration. The corruption spreads from its target to uninfected enemy champions. If it reaches them, they take the same damage and Root.

spells.name: Night Hunter
spells.summary: Vayne ruthlessly hunts evil-doers, gaining Move Speed when moving toward nearby enemy champions.
spells.text: Vayne ruthlessly hunts evil-doers, gaining 30 Move Speed when moving toward nearby enemy champions.

spells.name: Tumble
spells.summary: Vayne tumbles, maneuvering to carefully place her next shot. Her next attack deals bonus damage.
spells.text: Vayne rolls a short distance, and deals an additional ((75/85/95/105/115% Attack Damage) + (50% Ability Power)) physical damage on her next Attack. This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.

spells.name: Silver Bolts
spells.summary: Vayne tips her bolts with a rare metal, toxic to evil things. The third consecutive attack or ability against the same target deals a percentage of the target's max health as bonus true damage.
spells.text: Passive: Every third consecutive Attack or Ability against an enemy deals an additional 4/5.5/7/8.5/10% max Health true damage. Deals a minimum of 40/55/70/85/100 damage. Deals 140/155/170/185/200 damage against jungle monsters.

spells.name: Condemn
spells.summary: Vayne draws a heavy crossbow from her back, and fires a huge bolt at her target, knocking them back and dealing damage. If they collide with terrain, they are impaled, dealing bonus damage and stunning them.
spells.text: Vayne fires a bolt that Knocks Back and deals (50/85/120/155/190 + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. If the target collides with terrain, they take (75/127.5/180/232.5/285 + (75% bonus Attack Damage)) bonus physical damage and become Stunned for 1.5 seconds.

spells.name: Final Hour
spells.summary: Readying herself for an epic confrontation, Vayne gains increased Attack Damage, Invisibility during Tumble, reduced Tumble cooldown, and more bonus Move Speed from Night Hunter
spells.text: Vayne gains 35/50/65 Attack Damage for 8/10/12 seconds, extended by 4 seconds whenever a champion damaged by Vayne dies within 3 seconds. Additionally, during the duration:Night Hunter instead grants 90 Move Speed.The Cooldown of Tumble is reduced by 30/40/50%, and grants Invisibility for 1 second. Invisible units cannot be revealed except by turrets or True Sight. This Ability's duration can't be increased past its maximum duration

spells.name: Phenomenal Evil Power
spells.summary: Veigar is the greatest Evil to ever strike at the hearts of Runeterra - and he's only getting bigger! Striking an enemy Champion with a spell or scoring a takedown grants Veigar permanently increased Ability Power.
spells.text: Veigar's Abilities grant him 1 stack of Phenomenal Evil when they strike enemy champions. Takedowns on champions grant an additional 5 stacks. Each stack of Phenomenal Evil grants Veigar 1 Ability Power.

spells.name: Baleful Strike
spells.summary: Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy that deals magic damage to the first two enemies hit. Units killed by this bolt grant Veigar some ability power permanently.
spells.text: Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy, dealing (80/120/160/200/240 + (50/55/60/65/70% Ability Power)) magic damage to the first two enemies hit. If Veigar kills an enemy with this Ability, he gains 1 stack of Phenomenal Evil. Large minions and large monsters grant 3 stacks instead.

spells.name: Dark Matter
spells.summary: Veigar calls a great mass of dark matter to fall from the sky to the target location, dealing magic damage when it lands. Stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce Dark Matter's cooldown.
spells.text: Veigar summons dark matter from the sky, dealing (85/140/195/250/305 + (70/80/90/100/110% Ability Power)) magic damage. Every 50 stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce this Ability's Cooldown by 10%.

spells.name: Event Horizon
spells.summary: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through.
spells.text: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through for 1.5/1.75/2/2.25/2.5 seconds. The cage lasts for 3 seconds. This Ability Knocks Down enemies.

spells.name: Primordial Burst
spells.summary: Blasts target enemy champion, dealing a large amount of magic damage, increasing based on the target's missing health.
spells.text: Veigar blasts an enemy champion with primal magic to deal between (175/250/325 + (65/70/75% Ability Power)) and (350/500/650 + (130/140/150% Ability Power)) magic damage, increasing with the target's missing Health. Damage is maximized against enemies below 33% Health.

spells.name: Organic Deconstruction
spells.summary: Vel'Koz's abilities apply Organic Deconstruction to enemies on hit. If 3 stacks are accumulated, the enemy will take a burst of true damage.
spells.text: Vel'Koz's Abilities apply a stack of Deconstruction for 7 seconds. Enemies with 3 stacks consume them and take ((35 ~ 180) + (60% Ability Power)) true damage. Vel'Koz's Attacks refresh the duration of Deconstruction, but won't add new stacks.

spells.name: Plasma Fission
spells.summary: Vel'Koz shoots a bolt of plasma that splits in two on reactivation or upon hitting an enemy. The bolt slows and damages on hit.
spells.text: Vel'Koz shoots a plasma bolt that deals (80/120/160/200/240 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slows by 70% decaying over 1/1.4/1.8/2.2/2.6 second(s). At the end of its range, on hitting a target, or on Recasting, the bolt splits and fires two new bolts at a 90 degree angle. Killing a unit with this restores 20/22.5/25/27.5/30 Mana.

spells.name: Void Rift
spells.summary: Vel'Koz opens a rift to the void that deals an initial burst of damage, then explodes for a second burst of damage after a delay.
spells.text: Vel'Koz opens a rift to the void, dealing (30/50/70/90/110 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage. The rift then erupts, dealing (45/75/105/135/165 + (25% Ability Power)) magic damage. This Ability has 2 charges (18/17/16/15/14 second refresh).

spells.name: Tectonic Disruption
spells.summary: Vel'Koz causes an area to explode, knocking up enemies, and knocking close enemies slightly away.
spells.text: Vel'Koz disrupts a nearby area, causing it to explode, Knocking Up for 0.75 seconds and dealing (70/100/130/160/190 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage. Enemies close to Vel'Koz will be Knocked Back instead of Knocked Up.

spells.name: Life Form Disintegration Ray
spells.summary: Vel'Koz unleashes a channelled beam that follows the cursor for 2.5 seconds that deals magic damage. Organic Deconstruction Researches enemy champions causing them to take true damage instead.
spells.text: Vel'Koz channels a ray of energy that follows the cursor, dealing a total of (450/700/925 + (125% Ability Power)) magic damage over 2.5 seconds and Slowing by 20%. Deals true damage instead to enemies recently damaged by Organic Deconstruction. Enemies gain stacks of Deconstruction periodically while in the beam.

spells.name: Doom 'n Gloom
spells.summary: Vex periodically becomes empowered, causing her next basic Ability to fear enemies and interrupt dashes. Whenever a nearby enemy dashes, Vex applies a mark that can be consumed for bonus damage that also reduces the cooldown of her empowered state.
spells.text: Every 16 seconds Vex becomes afflicted with Doom, causing her next basic Ability to Knock Down and Fear enemies for 1.5 seconds. Whenever a nearby enemy dashes or blinks, Vex marks them with Gloom for 6 seconds. Vex's next Attack against a Gloomed enemy deals an additional ((40 ~ 150) + (25% Ability Power)) magic damage and reduces this Ability's Cooldown by 25%.

spells.name: Mistral Bolt
spells.summary: Launch a damaging missile that accelerates mid-flight.
spells.text: Vex launches a wave of mist that deals (70/115/160/205/250 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage. After a delay, the wave becomes smaller and faster. Consumes Gloom on enemies hit.

spells.name: Personal Space
spells.summary: Gain a shield and damage nearby enemies.
spells.text: Vex gains (50/75/100/125/150 + (75% Ability Power)) Shield for 2.5 seconds and emits a shockwave that deals (80/120/160/200/240 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage. Consumes Gloom on enemies hit.

spells.name: Looming Darkness
spells.summary: Summon a damaging and slowing zone that applies Gloom to enemies.
spells.text: Vex commands Shadow to fly to a location, increasing in size as it travels. Upon arriving, it deals (50/70/90/110/130 + (40/45/50/55/60% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slows by 30/35/40/45/50% for 2 seconds. Killing an enemy with this ability reduces Doom'n Gloom's Cooldown by 10%. Applies Gloom to enemies hit.

spells.name: Shadow Surge
spells.summary: Fire a missile that marks an enemy champion. Recast to dash to them and deal damage.
spells.text: Shadow excitedly surges forward, dealing (75/125/175 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage and marking the first enemy champion hit for 4 seconds. Recast: Dash to the marked champion, dealing (150/250/350 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage on arrival. If the marked champion dies within 8 seconds of taking damage from this Ability, its Cooldown is temporarily reset.

spells.name: Blast Shield
spells.summary: Vi charges a shield over time. The shield can be activated by hitting an enemy with an ability.
spells.text: Vi gains (10% Health) Shield for 3 seconds after hitting an enemy or structure with an activated Ability.

spells.name: Vault Breaker
spells.summary: Vi charges her gauntlets and unleashes a vault shattering punch, carrying her forward. Enemies she hits are knocked back and receive a stack of Denting Blows.
spells.text: Begin Charging: Vi begins charging a powerful punch, Slowing herself by 15%. Release: Vi dashes forward dealing between (40/60/80/100/120 + (60% bonus Attack Damage)) and (100/150/200/250/300 + (150% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage based on charge time and applying Denting Blows to all enemies hit. Vi stops upon colliding with an enemy champion, and Knocks them Back. Non-champions hit are pulled towards Vi. If the charge is interrupted, this Ability goes on a 3 second Cooldown.

spells.name: Denting Blows
spells.summary: Vi's punches break her opponent's Armor, dealing bonus damage and granting her Attack Speed.
spells.text: Passive: Every 3rd Attack on the same target deals an additional (4/5/6/7/8% + (3.5% per 100 bonus Attack Damage)) max Health physical damage, removes 20% Armor and grants Vi 30/35/40/45/50% Attack Speed for 4 seconds. It also reduces the remaining Cooldown of Blast Shield by 4 seconds. Deals a maximum of 300 damage against jungle monsters.

spells.name: Relentless Force
spells.summary: Vi's next attack blasts through her target, dealing damage to enemies behind it.
spells.text: Vi's next Attack deals (10/30/50/70/90 + (110% Attack Damage) + (100% Ability Power)) physical damage to the target and enemies behind them. This Ability has 2 charges (12/11/10/9/8 second refresh).

spells.name: Cease and Desist
spells.summary: Vi runs down an enemy, knocking aside anyone in the way. When she reaches her target she knocks it into the air, jumps after it, and slams it back into the ground.
spells.text: Vi singles out an enemy champion, revealing them and dashing unstoppably towards them. Upon reaching them, Vi Knocks them Up for 1.3 seconds and deals (150/250/350 + (90% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage. Any other enemies Vi collides with are dealt damage, knocked aside, and Stunned for 0.75 seconds.

spells.name: Sovereign's Domination
spells.summary: Enemies who fall before Viego become wraiths. By attacking a wraith, Viego temporarily seizes control of the dead enemy's body, healing for a percentage of his target's max health and gaining access to their basic abilities and items. He replaces their Ultimate with a free cast of his own.
spells.text: The souls of enemy champions that die within 3 seconds of being hit by Viego become wraiths. Viego can Attack wraiths to Possess them, restoring (2 + (2.5% bonus Attack Damage) + (2% Ability Power) + (500% bonus Attack Speed) + (0.4% bonus Health))of enemy's max Health and gaining access to their non-ultimate Abilities, Attacks, and items for 10 seconds. During this time he replaces their Ultimate with a free cast of his own and gains 10% Move Speed towards enemy champions.

spells.name: Blade of the Ruined King
spells.summary: Viego's spectral blade passively deals bonus percent current Health damage On-Hit and strikes twice vs. enemies he recently hit with an Ability, stealing Health. Viego can activate this Ability to thrust his zweihander forward, impaling enemies in front of him.
spells.text: Passive: Viego's Attacks deal an additional 2/3/4/5/6% current Health physical damage. His first Attack against an enemy he has recently damaged with an Ability hits a second time, dealing ((20% Attack Damage) + (15% Ability Power)) physical damage and restoring 150% of damage dealt as Health. These bonuses are kept during Possession. Active: Viego stabs forward, dealing (25/40/55/70/85 + (70% Attack Damage)) physical damage. The second strike can Critically Strike and applies On-Hit effects while not Possessing an enemy. Its healing is decreased to 125% vs. jungle monsters and 100% vs. minions. The bonus On-Hit damage can critically strike for (0.6/0.9/1.2/1.5/1.8% + (1.4/2.1/2.8/3.5/4.2% Critical Strike Damage)) current Health and deals a minimum of 10/15/20/25/30 damage. It deals a max of 80 damage vs. jungle monsters. This Ability's cast time is reduced with Attack Speed. Its damage scales with Critical Strike Chance and Damage at 60% effectiveness.

spells.name: Spectral Maw
spells.summary: Viego charges up before dashing forward, releasing a ball of concentrated Black Mist that stuns the first enemy hit.
spells.text: Begin Charging: Viego begins gathering Mist, Slowing himself by 10%. Release: Viego dashes forward and hurls the gathered Mist. Deals (80/135/190/245/300 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage and Stuns the first enemy hit for 0.25 to 1.25 seconds based on charge time. This Ability's Cooldown is set to 3 seconds when interrupted.

spells.name: Harrowed Path
spells.summary: Viego commands the Black Mist to haunt and surround a piece of terrain. Viego can hide in the Mist as a wraith, gaining camouflage, Move Speed, and Attack Speed.
spells.text: Viego sends forth a spectre to haunt the first terrain hit, surrounding it with Mist for 8 seconds. Viego gains Camouflage, (25/27.5/30/32.5/35% + (4% per 100 Ability Power)) Move Speed, and 30/35/40/45/50% Attack Speed while inside the Mist. Camouflaged units cannot be seen unless an enemy champion is inside their detection radius. Viego reveals himself for 0.6 seconds whenever he attacks or uses an Ability.

spells.name: Heartbreaker
spells.summary: Viego teleports to a nearby location and executes an enemy champion on arrival, piercing their heart and causing a destructive shockwave around them that knocks away their allies.
spells.text: Viego discards any souls he is currently Possessing and teleports. On arrival he Attacks the champion with the lowest percent Health, briefly Slowing them by 99% and dealing (120% Attack Damage) + (12/16/20 + (5% bonus Attack Damage))missing Health physical damage. Other nearby enemies are Knocked Back and take (120% Attack Damage) physical damage. This Ability applies on-hit effects to the primary target and spell effects to everything else. Damage scales with Critical Strike Chance and Damage at 70% effectiveness.

spells.name: Glorious Evolution
spells.summary: Viktor gains Hex Fragments whenever he kills an enemy. With every 100 Hex Fragments he obtains, Viktor permanently augments an active ability. After upgrading all of his basic abilities, he can gather 100 Hex Fragments to augment his ultimate ability.
spells.text: Viktor gains Hex Fragments whenever he kills an enemy. Every 100 Hex Fragments Viktor obtains will permanently upgrade an active Ability. After upgrading all of his basic Abilities, Viktor can upgrade his Ultimate Ability. Killing minions grants 1 Hex Fragment. Killing cannon minions grants 10 Hex Fragments. Champion takedowns grant 20 Hex Fragments.

spells.name: Siphon Power
spells.summary: Viktor blasts an enemy unit with magic damage, which grants him a shield and empowers his next basic attack. Augment: Siphon Power's shield is increased by 60% and Viktor gains bonus move speed after casting the Ability.
spells.text: Viktor blasts an enemy, dealing (60/75/90/105/120 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage and granting Viktor ((40 ~ 140) + (25% Ability Power)) Shield for 2.5 seconds. Viktor's next Attack within 4 seconds deals (20/45/70/95/120 + (50% Ability Power) + (100% Attack Damage)) magic damage. Upgraded: Grants ((64 ~ 224) + (40% Ability Power)) Shield and Viktor additionally gains 30% Move Speed for 2.5 seconds.

spells.name: Gravity Field
spells.summary: Viktor conjures a heavy gravitational field that slows enemies caught within its radius. Enemies who stay in the field for too long become stunned. Augment: Viktor's spells apply a slow to enemies.
spells.text: Viktor deploys a gravitational imprisonment device for 4 seconds, Slowing enemies inside it by 33/36/39/42/45%. Enemies who remain within its radius for 1.25 seconds are Stunned for 1.5 seconds. Upgraded Passive: Viktor's Abilities Slow by 20% for 1 second. Enemies that are Stunned by this Ability are also Knocked Down.

spells.name: Hextech Ray
spells.summary: Viktor uses his biomechanical arm to fire a Hextech Ray that cuts across the field in a line, dealing damage to all enemies in its path. Augment: An explosion follows in the Hextech Ray's wake, dealing magic damage.
spells.text: Viktor fires a hextech ray in a chosen direction, dealing (70/110/150/190/230 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage to any enemies it hits. Upgraded: An aftershock follows Hextech Ray, dealing (20/50/80/110/140 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Arcane Storm
spells.summary: Viktor conjures an Arcane Storm on the field, dealing magic damage and interrupting enemy channels. The storm periodically does magic damage to all nearby enemies and can be redirected by Viktor. Augment: The Arcane Storm moves 25% faster, and whenever champions die after taking damage from it, the storm grows and increases in its duration.
spells.text: Viktor conjures an Arcane Storm in an area for 6.5 seconds, which instantly deals (100/175/250 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage followed by (65/105/145 + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage per second to surrounding enemies. The storm automatically follows champions it has recently damaged. Recast: Viktor can manually move the storm. Upgraded: The storm moves 25% faster. If a champion that the storm has damaged dies, the storm increases its size and its duration by 3 seconds (up to 6 times). When the storm appears it interrupts channeled Abilities. The farther the storm is from Viktor, the slower it moves.

spells.name: Crimson Pact
spells.summary: Every 30 points of bonus Health gives Vladimir 1 Ability Power and every 1 point of Ability Power gives Vladimir 1.6 bonus Health (does not stack with itself).
spells.text: Vladimir gains 1 Ability Power for every 30 bonus Health. He also gains 1.6 max Health per 1 Ability Power. Bonus Ability Power: ((3.533% bonus Health) + (-5.653% Ability Power)) Bonus Health: ((169.6% bonus Ability Power) + (-5.653% bonus Health))

spells.name: Transfusion
spells.summary: Vladimir steals life from the target enemy. When Vladimir's resource is full, Transfusion will benefit from massively increased damage and healing for a brief time.
spells.text: Vladimir drains his target's lifeforce, dealing (80/100/120/140/160 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage and restoring (20/25/30/35/40 + (35% Ability Power)) Health. After using this Ability twice, Vladimir gains 40% Move Speed for 0.5 seconds and empowers the next use of this Ability for 2.5 seconds. The empowered version of this Ability deals (148/185/222/259/296 + (111% Ability Power)) magic damage instead and restores an additional (30 ~ 200) plus (5% + (4% per 100 Ability Power)) missing Health. Empowered healing reduced to 30% against minions.

spells.name: Sanguine Pool
spells.summary: Vladimir sinks into a pool of blood, becoming untargetable for 2 seconds. Additionally, enemies on the pool are slowed and Vladimir siphons life from them.
spells.text: Vladimir sinks into a pool of blood for 2 seconds, gaining 37.5% decaying Move Speed for 1 second and becoming Untargetable and Ghosted while Slowing enemies in the pool by 40%. Vladimir deals (80/135/190/245/300 + (15% bonus Health)) magic damage and restores (24/40.5/57/73.5/90 + (4.5% bonus Health)) Health per enemy over the duration. This Ability can be used while charging Tides of Blood. Vladimir can't Attack or use other Abilities while inside the pool. Healing is 60% effective against minions. Untargetable units won't be affected by enemy Attacks or Abilities unless they've already been hit by them. Ghosted units can pass through other units.

spells.name: Tides of Blood
spells.summary: Vladimir pays his own health to charge up a reservoir of blood which, when released, deals damage in the area around him but can be blocked by enemy units.
spells.text: Begin Charging: Vladimir charges up a reservoir of blood, spending up to (8% Health) Health. While at full charge, Vladimir is Slowed by 20%. Release: Vladimir unleashes a torrent of blood missiles at surrounding enemies, dealing between (30/45/60/75/90 + (1.5% Health) + (35% Ability Power)) and (60/90/120/150/180 + (6% Health) + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage based on charge time. If this Ability was charged for at least 1 second, it also Slows targets by 40/45/50/55/60% for 0.5 seconds. This Ability releases automatically after 1.5 seconds. Enemies can be hit by multiple blood missiles, but take no damage after the first.

spells.name: Hemoplague
spells.summary: Vladimir infects an area with a virulent plague. Affected enemies take increased damage for the duration. After a few seconds, Hemoplague deals magic damage to infected enemies and heals Vladimir for each enemy Champion hit.
spells.text: Vladimir creates a virulent plague, causing its victims to take 10% increased damage from all sources for 4 seconds. After it expires, Vladimir deals (150/250/350 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage to all infected targets. Vladimir restores (150/250/350 + (70% Ability Power)) Health if he hits a champion, and restores an additional (60/100/140 + (28% Ability Power)) Health for each champion beyond the first.

spells.name: The Relentless Storm
spells.summary: Volibear's Attacks and abilities grant Attack Speed, and eventually cause his Attacks to deal bonus magic damage to nearby enemies.
spells.text: Volibear gains (5% + (4% per 100 Ability Power)) Attack Speed for 6 seconds whenever he deals damage with an Ability or Attack, stacking up to 5 times. At 5 stacks, Volibear's claws ignite with lightning, causing his Attacks to deal an additional ((11 ~ 58) + (45% Ability Power) + (20% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage to the target and 4 closest enemies.

spells.name: Thundering Smash
spells.summary: Volibear gains speed towards enemies, Stunning and damaging the first one he Attacks.
spells.text: Volibear gains 12/15.5/19/22.5/26% Move Speed, doubled to 24/31/38/45/52% towards enemy champions for the next 4 seconds. While active, Volibear's next Attack deals (10/20/30/40/50 + (100% Attack Damage) + (160% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and Stuns the target for 1 second. Volibear becomes enraged if an enemy Immobilizes him before he Stuns a target, ending the Ability early but refreshing its Cooldown. Volibear gains 25 attack range for this attack.

spells.name: Frenzied Maul
spells.summary: Volibear damages an enemy, applying on-hit effects and marking them. Casting this ability again on the same target deals bonus damage and Heals Volibear.
spells.text: Volibear mauls an enemy, dealing (5/30/55/80/105 + (110% Attack Damage) + (6% bonus Health)) physical damage and marking them for 8 seconds. If this Ability is used on a marked target, its damage is increased to (5/30/55/80/105 + (110% Attack Damage) + (6% bonus Health)) × (1.5 + 0.25% bonus Attack Damage) and Volibear restores 20/35/50/65/80 plus 8/11/14/17/20% missing Health. Empowered damage scales with (Damage multiplier: 150% + 25%) This Ability applies on-hit effects. Healing is 50% effective against minions.

spells.name: Sky Splitter
spells.summary: Volibear summons a lightning bolt at a location, dealing damage and Slowing enemies while granting Volibear a Shield if he's inside the blast radius.
spells.text: Volibear summons a thundercloud that fires a lightning bolt, dealing (80/110/140/170/200 + (70% Ability Power)) plus 11/12/13/14/15% max Health magic damage and Slowing by 40% for 2 seconds. If Volibear is inside the blast zone, he gains a (75% Ability Power) plus 14% max Health Shield for 3 seconds. Damage against non-champions is capped at (150/265/380/495/610 + (70% Ability Power)).

spells.name: Stormbringer
spells.summary: Volibear leaps to a target location, Slowing and damaging enemies beneath him while gaining bonus Health. Enemy towers near his landing location become temporarily disabled.
spells.text: Volibear transforms and leaps, gaining 175/350/525 Health and 50 Attack Range for the next 12 seconds. Upon landing, Volibear cracks the earth, Disabling nearby towers for 2/3/4 seconds and dealing (300/500/700 + (125% Ability Power) + (250% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to them. Nearby enemies are Slowed by 50%, decaying over 1 second. Enemies directly underneath Volibear suffer (300/500/700 + (125% Ability Power) + (250% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage.

spells.name: Eternal Hunger
spells.summary: Warwick's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage. If Warwick is below 50% health, he heals the same amount. If Warwick is below 25% health, this healing triples.
spells.text: Warwick's Attacks deal an additional ((6 ~ 55) + (15% bonus Attack Damage) + (10% Ability Power)) magic damage On-Hit. If Warwick is below 50% Health, he also heals for 100% of the damage dealt by Eternal Hunger. If Warwick is below 25% health, the healing is increased to 250% of the damage dealt.

spells.name: Jaws of the Beast
spells.summary: Warwick lunges forward and bites his target, dealing damage based on their maximum health and healing for damage dealt.
spells.text: Tap: Warwick lunges forward and bites, dealing ((120% Attack Damage) + (100% Ability Power)) plus 6/7/8/9/10% max Health magic damage and healing for 25/37.5/50/62.5/75% of the damage dealt. Hold: Warwick lunges and clamps his jaws on the target, leaping behind them. While clamped, Warwick follows all movement of the target. After releasing his hold, he does the same damage and healing. This Ability applies On-Hit and On-Attack effects, and does not Critically Strike. While clamped, Warwick is immune to displacement.

spells.name: Blood Hunt
spells.summary: Warwick senses enemies below 50% health, gaining Move Speed toward and attack speed against them. When they fall below 25% health, he frenzies and these bonuses triple.
spells.text: Passive: Warwick can sense champions below 50% Health, gaining 35/42.5/50/57.5/65% Move Speed towards them. Spells and attacks against enemies below 50% Health grant 70/80/90/100/110% Attack Speed. These effects are increased by 200% against enemies below 25% Health. Active: Warwick can briefly sense all enemies, and gains this Ability's passive effect against the closest champion for 8 seconds, regardless of Health. If no champions are found, this Ability's cooldown is reduced by 30%. Warwick can only passively sense enemies who were brought below 50% Health by allies.

spells.name: Primal Howl
spells.summary: Warwick gains damage reduction for 2.5 seconds. At the end, or if re-activated, he howls, causing nearby enemies to flee for 1 second.
spells.text: Warwick gains 35/40/45/50/55% damage reduction for 2.75 seconds. After it ends, Warwick howls, Fearing nearby enemies for 1 second. Warwick can Recast to end the Ability early.

spells.name: Infinite Duress
spells.summary: Warwick leaps in a direction (scaling with his bonus Move Speed), suppressing the first champion he collides with for 1.5 seconds.
spells.text: Warwick leaps a huge distance that scales with his Move Speed, Suppressing the first champion he collides with while he channels for 1.5 seconds. He attacks that champion 3 times over the duration, dealing (175/350/525 + (167% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage. Warwick heals for 100% of all damage dealt during the channel. This Ability applies On-Hit and On-Attack effects 3 distinct times over its duration, and does not Critically Strike. This Ability Knocks Down enemies.

spells.name: Clean Cuts
spells.summary: After using an ability, Xayah's next basic attacks will hit all targets along their path and leave a Feather.
spells.text: After using an Ability, Xayah's next 3 Attacks will deal ?% damage to all other targets along their path and leave a Feather for 6 seconds. Lover's Leap: Xayah and Rakan can recall together.

spells.name: Double Daggers
spells.summary: Xayah throws two damaging daggers that also drop Feathers she can recall.
spells.text: Xayah throws two daggers, dealing (45/60/75/90/105 + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage each and leaving two Feathers. Targets hit after the first take (22.5/30/37.5/45/52.5 + (25% bonus Attack Damage)) damage from each dagger.

spells.name: Deadly Plumage
spells.summary: Xayah creates a storm of blades that increase her Attack Speed and damage while also granting her Move Speed if she attacks a champion.
spells.text: Xayah creates a storm of blades for 4 seconds that grants her 35/40/45/50/55% Attack Speed and cause her Attacks to fire a secondary blade that deals 25% damage. When the secondary blade hits a champion, she grants herself 30% Move Speed for 1.5 seconds. If Rakan is nearby he will also gain the effects of this Ability, except he gains Move Speed when Xayah strikes a target.

spells.name: Bladecaller
spells.summary: Xayah calls back all her dropped Feathers dealing damage and rooting enemies.
spells.text: Xayah calls all Feathers back to her, dealing (50/65/80/95/110 + (40% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage each. If 3 or more Feathers hit an enemy, they are Rooted for 1.25 seconds. Damage scales with Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage at 50% effectiveness. Minions take 50% damage from this Ability. Enemies take 5% less damage per feather hit, to a minimum of 10% damage.

spells.name: Featherstorm
spells.summary: Xayah leaps into the air becoming untargetable and throwing out a fan of daggers, dropping Feathers she can recall.
spells.text: Xayah leaps into the air becoming Untargetable and Ghosted for 1.5 seconds before raining down daggers that deal (200/300/400 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and leave behind a line of Feathers. Untargetable units won't be affected by enemy Attacks or Abilities unless they've already been affected by them. Ghosted units ignore collision with other units. Xayah can move while in the air.

spells.name: Mana Surge
spells.summary: Xerath's basic attacks periodically restore Mana. Whenever Xerath kills a unit, this cooldown is reduced.
spells.text: Every 16 seconds Xerath's next Attack against a champion restores (60 ~ 378) Mana. It restores (30 ~ 189) Mana if attacking minions, jungle monsters or structures. Whenever Xerath kills a unit, this cooldown is reduced by 3.5 seconds.

spells.name: Arcanopulse
spells.summary: Fires a long-range beam of energy, dealing magic damage to all targets hit.
spells.text: Begin Charging: Xerath begins charging an arcane beam, Slowing himself gradually up to 50%. Release: Xerath fires the beam, dealing (70/110/150/190/230 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage. The range increases with time charged. If Xerath does not release the beam, half the cost is refunded.

spells.name: Eye of Destruction
spells.summary: Calls down a barrage of arcane energy, slowing and dealing magic damage to all enemies in an area. Targets in the middle receive additional damage and a stronger slow.
spells.text: Xerath calls down a blast of arcane energy, dealing (50/85/120/155/190 + (65% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowing them by 25% for 2.5 seconds. Enemies in the center take (83.35/141.695/200.04/258.385/316.73 + (108.355% Ability Power)) magic damage instead and are Slowed by 60/65/70/75/80%, decaying over 2.5 seconds. Empowered Slow decays down to 25%.

spells.name: Shocking Orb
spells.summary: Deals magic damage to an enemy and stuns them.
spells.text: Xerath fires an orb of raw magic, Stunning the first enemy hit for up to 2.25 seconds based on distance travelled, and dealing (70/100/130/160/190 + (45% Ability Power)) magic damage. Minimum Stun duration is 0.75 seconds.

spells.name: Rite of the Arcane
spells.summary: Xerath immobilizes himself and gains numerous long-range barrages.
spells.text: Xerath ascends to his true form and channels for 10 seconds. During this time he may Recast up to 4/5/6 times. Recast: Xerath launches a magical artillery, dealing (170/220/270 + (45% Ability Power)) magic damage. For each champion hit, the artillery deals an additional (20/25/30 + (5% Ability Power)) magic damage. If Xerath does not Recast at all, this Ability's Cooldown is reduced by 50%.

spells.name: Determination
spells.summary: Every third attack deals bonus damage and heals Xin Zhao.
spells.text: Every third Attack or strike with Wind Becomes Lightning deals an additional ((60% Attack Damage) + (20% Ability Power)) physical damage and restores ((5% Health) + (70% Ability Power)) Health.

spells.name: Three Talon Strike
spells.summary: Xin Zhao's next 3 standard attacks deal increased damage with the third attack knocking an opponent into the air.
spells.text: Xin Zhao's next 3 Attacks deal an additional (15/30/45/60/75 + (40% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and reduces his other Ability's Cooldowns by 1 second. The third Attack also Knocks Up for 0.75 seconds.

spells.name: Wind Becomes Lightning
spells.summary: Xin Zhao slashes in front of himself with his spear, then thrusts it forward, slowing affected enemies and marking them as Challenged.
spells.text: Xin Zhao slashes, dealing (30/40/50/60/70 + (30% Attack Damage)) physical damage, then thrusts, dealing (50/85/120/155/190 + (90% Attack Damage) + (65% Ability Power)) × (1 + 33.3% Critical Strike Chance). Enemies hit by the thrust are Slowed by 50% for (1.5 + (0.5% Ability Power)) seconds. Champions and Large Monsters hit by the thrust are marked as Challenged for 3 seconds and revealed unless Stealthed. The thrust's damage is increased by up to 33.3% based on Xin Zhao's Critical Strike Chance. Deals 53.34% damage to minions. Applies Lifesteal at 33% effectiveness on both attacks.

spells.name: Audacious Charge
spells.summary: Xin Zhao charges to an enemy, gaining increased Attack Speed and dealing damage to all enemies in the area, slowing them briefly. This Ability gains increased range against Challenged targets.
spells.text: Xin Zhao charges an enemy, dealing (50/75/100/125/150 + (120% Ability Power)) magic damage to nearby enemies and Slowing them by 30% for 0.5 seconds. Xin Zhao grants himself 38/46/54/62/70% Attack Speed for 5 seconds. This Ability's range is increased on enemies that are Challenged.

spells.name: Crescent Guard
spells.summary: Xin Zhao passively challenges an enemy he damaged recently. When activated, Xin Zhao deals damage to nearby enemies based on their current Health and knocks non-challenged targets back, becoming impervious to damage dealt by champions outside of the circle created.
spells.text: Passive: The last champion Xin Zhao damaged with an Attack or Audacious Charge is Challenged for 3 seconds. Active: Xin Zhao unleashes a sweep around him that deals (75/175/275 + (100% bonus Attack Damage) + (110% Ability Power)) plus 15% current Health physical damage and Knocks Back all non-Challenged enemies. Afterwards, Xin Zhao becomes immune to damage from enemies outside the sweep range for 4 seconds. Deals a max of 600 damage to jungle monsters and minions.

spells.name: Way of the Wanderer
spells.summary: Yasuo's Critical Strike Chance is increased. Additionally, Yasuo builds toward a shield whenever he is moving. The shield triggers when he takes damage from a champion or monster.
spells.text: Resolve: Moving grants Flow, which is tracked on Yasuo's resource bar. Moving faster grants more Flow. At maximum Flow, damage from a champion or monster briefly grants (125 ~ 600) Shield. Intent: Yasuo's Critical Strike Chance is increased by 100% but his Critical Strike Damage is reduced to (100% Critical Strike Damage). Gain 0.5 Bonus Attack Damage for every 1% Critical Strike Chance above 100%.

spells.name: Steel Tempest
spells.summary: Thrusts forward, damaging all enemies in a line. On hit, grants a stack of Gathering Storm for a few seconds. At 2 stacks, Steel Tempest fires a whirlwind that knocks Airborne. Steel Tempest is treated as a basic attack and scales with all the same things.
spells.text: Yasuo thrusts, dealing (20/45/70/95/120 + (105% Attack Damage)) physical damage. If he hits, he gains a stack for 6 seconds. While he has 2 stacks, his next use of this Ability fires a whirlwind from range, dealing the same damage and Knocking Up for 1 second. If used while dashing, this Ability strikes in a circle rather than a stab. This Ability acts like an Attack: it can critically strike for (20/45/70/95/120 + (0% Attack Damage)) physical damage, it applies On-hit effects and lifesteal to the first enemy struck, is interruptible by crowd control, and its cooldown and cast time are reduced with Attack Speed.

spells.name: Wind Wall
spells.summary: Creates a moving wall that blocks all enemy projectiles for 4 seconds.
spells.text: Yasuo creates a drifting wall of wind that blocks all enemy projectiles for 4 seconds. Tower shots and beams are not blocked.

spells.name: Sweeping Blade
spells.summary: Dashes through target enemy, dealing magic damage. Each cast increases subsequent dash's damage, up to a max amount. Cannot be re-cast on the same enemy for a few seconds. If Steel Tempest is cast while dashing, it will strike as a circle.
spells.text: Yasuo dashes through a target, dealing (70/85/100/115/130 + (20% bonus Attack Damage) + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. Each use of this Ability grants (17.5/21.25/25/28.75/32.5 + (5% bonus Attack Damage) + (15% Ability Power)) bonus damage to subsequent uses for 5 seconds, stacking up to 4 times. This Ability has a 10/9/8/7/6 second per-target Cooldown.

spells.name: Last Breath
spells.summary: Blinks to an Airborne enemy champion, dealing physical damage and holding all Airborne enemies in the area in the air. Grants maximum Flow but resets all stacks of Gathering Storm. For a moderate time afterwards, Yasuo's critical strikes gain significant Bonus Armor Penetration.
spells.text: Yasuo teleports to an Airborne enemy champion, dealing (200/350/500 + (150% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and holding all nearby Airborne enemies up for an additional 1 second. Yasuo also gains maximum Flow, but loses all Steel Tempest stacks. Afterwards, Yasuo's critical strikes ignore 60% bonus Armor for 15 seconds.

spells.name: Way of the Hunter
spells.summary: Yone deals magic damage with every second Attack. In addition, his critical strike chance is increased.
spells.text: Steel and Spirit: Yone uses two blades, causing every second Attack to deal 50% magic damage. Intent: Yone's Critical Strike Chance is increased by 100% but his Critical Strike Damage is reduced to (100% Critical Strike Damage). Gain 0.5 Bonus AD for every 1% Critical Strike Chance above 100%.

spells.name: Mortal Steel
spells.summary: Thrusts forward, damaging all enemies in a line. On hit, grants a stack of Gathering Storm for a few seconds. At 2 stacks, Mortal Steel dashes Yone forward with a gust of wind knocking enemies Airborne.
spells.text: Yone thrusts forward, dealing (25/50/75/100/125 + (110% Attack Damage)) physical damage. On hit, grants a stack for 6 seconds. At 2 stacks, this ability causes Yone to dash forward with a wave of wind that Knocks Up for 0.75 seconds and deals (25/50/75/100/125 + (110% Attack Damage)) physical damage. This Ability acts like an Attack: it can critically strike for (25/50/75/100/125 + (0% Attack Damage)) physical damage, it applies On-hit effects and lifesteal to the first enemy struck, is interruptible by crowd control, and its cooldown and cast time are reduced with Attack Speed.

spells.name: Spirit Cleave
spells.summary: Cleaves forward, damaging all enemies in a cone. Grants a shield to Yone, the value is increased by the number of champions hit by the swipe. Spirit Cleave's cooldown and cast time scale with attack speed.
spells.text: Yone cleaves forward, dealing 5/10/15/20/25 + 4/4.5/5/5.5/6% max Health physical damage and 5/10/15/20/25 + 4/4.5/5/5.5/6% max Health magic damage. If Yone hits, he gains ((40 ~ 90) + (65% bonus Attack Damage)) Shield for 1.5 seconds. The amount of Shield increases for each champion struck. Shield increased by 100% for the first champion hit and 50% for all subsequent champions. This abilities cooldown and cast time are reduced by Attack Speed. Minimum (30 ~ 30) total damage against minions.

spells.name: Soul Unbound
spells.summary: Yone's spirit leaves his body behind, gaining Move Speed. When this ability ends, Yone's spirit is forced back to his body and he repeats a portion of the damage he dealt as a spirit.
spells.text: Yone enters a spirit form for 5 seconds, leaving his body behind for the duration and gaining 10% to 30% ramping Move Speed. When the spirit form ends, Yone snaps back to his body and repeats 25/27.5/30/32.5/35% of all Attack and Ability damage he dealt to champions during this time. You may Recast this ability during spirit form. Recast: End spirit form early. Yone cannot snap back while affected by hard crowd control.

spells.name: Fate Sealed
spells.summary: Yone blinks behind the last champion in a line with a slash so powerful it pulls all enemies hit towards him.
spells.text: Yone strikes all enemies along a path for (100/200/300 + (40% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and (100/200/300 + (40% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage, teleporting behind the last champion hit and Knocking Up victims towards Yone. If no enemy champion is struck, Yone will instead blink to maximum range.

spells.name: Shepherd of Souls
spells.summary: The Cursed Horde: Yorick can summon Mist Walkers to swarm and attack nearby enemies.
spells.text: Yorick raises a grave for every 2 enemies that die near him. Champions and large monsters always leave a grave. These graves can be used to Awaken Mist Walkers with ((100 ~ 300) + (15% bonus Health)) Health and ((15 ~ 100) + (20% bonus Attack Damage)) Attack Damage, up to 4 in an area.

spells.name: Last Rites
spells.summary: Yorick deals bonus damage on his next attack and heals himself. If the target is a champion or large monster or if the target dies, a grave will be dug.
spells.text: Yorick's next Attack deals an additional (30/50/70/90/110 + (50% Attack Damage)) physical damage and restores (10 ~ 58) plus 6/7/8/9/10% of his missing Health, reduced by 50% against non-Champions. If this Attack hits a Champion or large Monster or kills the target, it leaves a grave. When there are 3 or more graves nearby and this Ability has already been used, Yorick can Recast to raise Mist Walkers from all nearby graves. This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.

spells.name: Dark Procession
spells.summary: Yorick summons a destructible wall at target location that will block enemy movement.
spells.text: Yorick summons a wall of spirits blocking enemies' path, but not allies'. The wall has 2/2/3/3/4 Health and disappears after 4 seconds.

spells.name: Mourning Mist
spells.summary: Yorick throws a globule of Black Mist that reduces armor, damages, slows and marks enemies. Summoned units gain move speed when moving towards marked targets.
spells.text: Yorick throws a globule of Black Mist that deals (6/6.5/7/7.5/8% + (3% per 100 Ability Power)) max Health magic damage, Slows by 30% for 1.5 seconds and marks champions and monsters for 4 seconds. Marked enemies continuously Awaken nearby graves (but not exceeding the maximum of 4) and suffer 13/16/19/22/25% reduced Armor. Yorick and his summoned units gain 18/21/24/27/30% Move Speed toward the mark. Mist Walkers will leap once at marked enemies that get away from them. Deals a minimum of (70/105/140/175/210 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage to lane Minions. Deals a maximum of (50/75/100/125/150 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage to jungle Monsters.

spells.name: Eulogy of the Isles
spells.summary: Yorick summons the Maiden of the Mist that causes Yorick's attacks against the Maiden's target to deal bonus damage. The Maiden will also automatically raise Walkers from dead enemies.
spells.text: Yorick summons the Maiden of the Mist with ((1050 ~ 3200) + (60% bonus Health)) Health and (50/75/100 + (30% bonus Attack Damage)) Magic Attack Damage plus 2/3/4 Mist Walkers. The Maiden automatically raises Mist Walkers from nearby enemy deaths and marks enemy Champions with her attacks. When Yorick damages the Maiden's target, he deals 2/2.5/3% max Health magic damage. After 10 seconds, Yorick can Recast this Ability to free the Maiden, sending her down the nearest lane. Maiden of the Mist (30 ~ 90) Armor (30 ~ 90) Magic Resist Takes 30% damage from lane minions

spells.name: Vow of the First Lands
spells.summary: Yunara's Critical Strikes deal bonus magic damage.
spells.text: Yunara's Critical Strikes deal an additional (10% + (0.1% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Cultivation of Spirit
spells.summary: Yunara gains Attack Speed, bonus damage On-Hit, and her Attacks spread to nearby enemies.
spells.text: Passive: Yunara deal (5/10/15/20/25 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage On-Hit and attacking grants 1 Unleash (2 Unleash for champions). Active: Yunara consumes 8 Unleash and for 5 seconds gains 20/30/40/50/60% Attack Speed and deals an additional (5/10/15/20/25 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage On-Hit. During this time, her Attacks spread to nearby enemies dealing them (30% Attack Damage) physical damage. Transcendent State: This Ability is instantly activated for 15 seconds. Spread Attacks can Strike Critically and apply On-Hit effects at 30% effectiveness. Damage from spread Attacks deal 250% damage to minions below 30% Health.

spells.name: Arc of Judgment | Arc of Ruin
spells.summary: Yunara fires a spinning prayer bead that deals damage and slows enemies. While in her Transcendent State she instead fires off a laser that deals damage and slows enemies.
spells.text: Yunara lets rip a prayer bead that deals (55/95/135/175/215 + (85% bonus Attack Damage) + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slows by 99% decaying over 1.5 seconds. It deals an additional (33/57/81/105/129 + (51% bonus Attack Damage) + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage per second. Transcendent State - Arc of Ruin: Yunara fires a laser that deals (160/320/480/640/800 + (120% bonus Attack Damage) + (75% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slows by 99% decaying over 1 second. Cast time scales with permanent Attack Speed (?% / 100%). Arc of Judgment deals 100% damage to minions and its tick damage executes low health minions. Arc of Ruin gains the benefits of an Ultimate Ability.

spells.name: Kanmei's Steps | Untouchable Shadow
spells.summary: Yunara gains Move Speed and becomes Ghosted. While in her Transcendent State she instead dashes in a direction.
spells.text: Yunara gains 30/35/40/45/50% Move Speed, increased to 45/52.5/60/67.5/75% Move Speed when moving toward an enemy champion, for 1.5 seconds. Transcendent State - Untouchable Shadow: Yunara dashes in a direction. Kanmei's Steps causes Yunara to become Ghosted. Untouchable Shadow gains the benefits of an Ultimate Ability.

spells.name: Transcend One's Self
spells.summary: Yunara enters a Transcendent State that upgrades her basic Abilities.
spells.text: Yunara enters a Transcendent State for 15 seconds upgrading her basic Abilities for the duration.

spells.name: Feline Friendship
spells.summary: Periodically, when Yuumi strikes a champion with an attack or ability, she restores health to herself and the next ally she Attaches to. While Attached, Yuumi generates a special bond with her allies. The ally with the strongest bond enhances Yuumi's abilities while she is Attached to them.
spells.text: When Yuumi's Attacks and Abilities strike champions, she heals herself for ((20 ~ 110) + (30% Ability Power)) health. If Yuumi Attaches to an ally within 4 seconds, they are healed as well. This effect has a 20 second Cooldown. While Attached, Yuumi gains Friendship with her ally whenever they kill a champion or minion. The ally with the most Friendship becomes her Best Friend and grants Yuumi bonus effects to her Abilities while she is Attached to them. The heal will automatically trigger if Yuumi is already Attached to an ally.

spells.name: Prowling Projectile
spells.summary: Yuumi fires a missile, dealing damage and slowing first target hit. It deals bonus damage and an enchanced slow if it takes at least 1.35 seconds to get to its target. While on her Best Friend, the slow is always enhanced and grants bonus On-Hit damage to her ally. While Attached, the missile can be controlled with your cursor for a brief period.
spells.text: Yuumi summons an errant missile that deals (60/95/130/165/200/235 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage to the first enemy and Slows the target for 20%. If cast while Attached, Yuumi can control the missile using her mouse for a short period before it accelerates in a straight line. The accelerated missile deals (80/135/190/245/300/355 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slows the target for 50/53/56/59/62/65% for 2 seconds, instead. Best Friend Bonus: Prowling Projectile's Slow will always be enhanced and hitting an enemy champion also grants them (10/12/14/16/18/20 + (5% Ability Power)) magic damage On-Hit for 5 seconds. The bonus On-Hit damage can be increased by 75% based her ally's Critical Strike Chance.

spells.name: You and Me!
spells.summary: Yuumi dashes to a target ally, becoming untargetable from everything except turrets. While on her Best Friend, she gains Heal & Shield Power and grants her Ally On-Hit healing.
spells.text: Passive: While on her Best Friend, Yuumi gains an additional 4/5/6/7/8% Heal & Shield Power and her ally also restores (3/4/5/6/7 + (3% Ability Power)) health On-Hit. Active: Yuumi dashes to an ally champion and Attaches to them. While Yuumi is Attached, she follows her partner's movement and is Untargetable except from towers. Immobilizing effects on Yuumi place this Ability on a 5 second Cooldown. This Ability has a (10 ~ 0) second Cooldown, but Yuumi can cast it anytime she is already Attached to switch between friends or Unattach. Yuumi's Abilities will use her Attached ally's position instead of hers. Yuumi will Unattach if her ally uses Summoner Teleport.

spells.name: Zoomies
spells.summary: Shields Yuumi and boosts Move Speed and Attack Speed. If she's attached, she passes it to her ally instead.
spells.text: Yuumi shields herself, blocking (65/90/115/140/165 + (40% Ability Power)) damage and gains (25/27.5/30/32.5/35 + (8% Ability Power))Attack Speed for 3 seconds. While the shield persists, the target also gains 20% Move Speed. If Yuumi is Attached, this Ability affects her ally instead and also restores 20/24/28/32/36 Mana to them, increased by up to 100% based on the target's missing Mana.

spells.name: Final Chapter
spells.summary: Yuumi channels five waves that damage enemies and heal allies. Yuumi can move, attach, and cast Zoomies! while channeling. While on her Best Friend, this spell also follows her mouse.
spells.text: Yuumi channels for 3.5 seconds, launching 5 magical waves affecting both teams. If initially cast while Attached, Yuumi can steer the waves to follow her mouse. Enemies struck are dealt (75/125/175 + (25% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slowed by 10% for 1.25 seconds, increased by 10% per wave hit. Ally champions are healed for (30/50/70 + (12% Ability Power)) health per wave. Excess healing is converted to a Shield instead. Best Friend Bonus: For her Best Friend, the heal is increased to (30/50/70 + (12% Ability Power)) health. Casting You and Me! will locks the waves in the current direction. Yuumi can move and cast Zoomies while channeling. Missiles after the first deal (18.75/31.25/43.75 + (6.25% Ability Power)) magic damage. Max possible damage to a single enemy is (150/250/350 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Cultivation of War
spells.summary: Zaahen's attacks and abilities against enemy champions grant him stacks of Determination, gaining bonus Attack Damage per stack. When filled with Determination, Zaahen gains increased Attack Damage and can revive.
spells.text: Zaahen gains a stack of Determination when he hits an enemy champion with an Attack or Ability (max 12). He gains (1.5% ~ 2.8%) increased Attack Damage per stack. When filled with Determination, Zaahen doubles the granted Attack Damage, and if he would die, he instead enters Stasis for 4 seconds then revives with (30% ~ 75%) of his max Health. Zaahen's revive has a 120 second Cooldown.

spells.name: The Darkin Glaive
spells.summary: Zaahen slashes twice on his next attack, dealing bonus damage and healing himself. Zaahen can recast this ability to have his next attack deal bonus damage and knock up his target.
spells.text: Zaahen slashes twice on his next Attack, dealing (15/30/45/60/75 + (20/25/30/35/40% bonus Attack Damage)) bonus physical damage and restoring 5/6/7/8/9% of his max Health. Recast: Zaahen's next Attack deals (30/60/90/120/150 + (20/25/30/35/40% bonus Attack Damage)) bonus physical damage and Knocks the target Up for 0.75 seconds. Healing reduced to 50% against non-champions. Deals an additional 100% bonus damage to monsters.

spells.name: Dreaded Return
spells.summary: Zaahen stabs in a direction, damaging enemies hit, then pulls them toward him.
spells.text: Zaahen stabs in a direction, dealing (40/60/80/100/120 + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to enemies hit, then Pulls them toward him, dealing (30/50/70/90/110 + (30% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage.

spells.name: Aureate Rush
spells.summary: Zaahen dashes to a location and slices around himself.
spells.text: Zaahen dashes then slices around himself, dealing (40/60/80/100/120 + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to nearby enemies. Enemies at the edge of the slice take (60/90/120/150/180 + (75% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage + 4/4.5/5/5.5/6% of their maximum Health as magic damage instead. Deals an additional 50 bonus physical damage to monsters. Additional Maximum Health damage capped to 400 against monsters.

spells.name: Grim Deliverance
spells.summary: Zaahen rises then stabs downward, damaging enemies and healing for a portion of the damage dealt.
spells.text: Passive: Zaahen gains 10/20/30% Armor Penetration. Active: Zaahen rises, gaining 50% Damage Reduction while casting. Zaahen then stabs downward, dealing (250/400/550 + (200% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage and restoring 33% of the damage dealt to enemy champions as Health.

spells.name: Cell Division
spells.summary: Each time Zac hits an enemy with an ability, he sheds a chunk of himself that can be reabsorbed to restore Health. Upon taking fatal damage, Zac splits into 4 bloblets that attempt to recombine. If any bloblets remain, he will revive with an amount of Health depending on the Health of the surviving bloblets. Each bloblet has a percentage of Zac's maximum Health, Armor and Magic Resistance. This ability has a 5 minute cooldown.
spells.text: Each time Zac hits an enemy with an Ability, he sheds a chunk of Goo that can be reabsorbed to restore (4% ~ 8%) Max Health. Upon dying, Zac splits into 4 bloblets that attempt to recombine. If any bloblets remain after 4 seconds, he will revive with 10-50% Health based on the surviving bloblet's Health. This has a 300 second Cooldown.

spells.name: Stretching Strikes
spells.summary: Zac stretches an arm, grabbing an enemy. Attacking a different enemy will cause him to throw both targets towards each other.
spells.text: Zac stretches his arm out, attaching it to the first enemy hit to deal (60/90/120/150/180 + (30% Ability Power) + (3% bonus Health)) magic damage and briefly Slow them. Zac's next Attack gains increased range and applies the same damage and Slow. If Zac hits a different enemy with this Attack, he Knocks Up both towards each other. If they collide, they and surrounding enemies take (60/90/120/150/180 + (30% Ability Power) + (3% bonus Health)) magic damage and are briefly Slowed. Slows by 40%. Maximum magic damage: (120/180/240/300/360 + (60% Ability Power) + (6% bonus Health)).

spells.name: Unstable Matter
spells.summary: Zac explodes outward towards nearby enemies, dealing a percentage of their maximum health as magic damage.
spells.text: Zac's body erupts, dealing 40/50/60/70/80 + (4/5/6/7/8% + (3% per 100 Ability Power)) max Health magic damage to nearby enemies. Absorbing Goo reduces this Ability's Cooldown by 1 second. Percent Health damage against minions and jungle monsters is capped at 200.

spells.name: Elastic Slingshot
spells.summary: Zac attaches his arms to the ground and stretches back, launching himself forward.
spells.text: Begin Charging: Zac pulls himself taut, charging up a dash over 0.9/1/1.1/1.2/1.3 seconds. Release: Zac launches himself and Knocks Up enemies where he lands for up to 1 second (based on charge time), dealing them (60/105/150/195/240 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage. Zac spawns an extra chunk of Goo for each enemy champion hit. Can be cancelled by moving. If cancelled, refunds half of the Ability's Cooldown and cost.

spells.name: Let's Bounce!
spells.summary: Zac bounces four times, knocking up enemies hit and slowing them.
spells.text: Zac bounces 4 times. The first bounce to hit each enemy Knocks them back and deals (120/190/260 + (40% Ability Power)) magic damage. Subsequent bounces deal (60/95/130 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slow by 20% for 1 second. Zac gains up to 50% Move Speed over time and can cast Unstable Matter while bouncing. Total Damage: (300/475/650 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage Move Speed increases from 20% to 50% over the duration. During Let's Bounce!, Zac is Ghosted. Ghosted units ignore collision with other units.

spells.name: Contempt for the Weak
spells.summary: Zed's basic attacks against low health targets deals bonus Magic Damage. This effect can only occur once every few seconds against the same enemy champion.
spells.text: Whenever Zed Attacks an enemy below 50% Health, he deals an additional 10% max Health magic damage. Enemy champions can only be hit once every 10 seconds.

spells.name: Razor Shuriken
spells.summary: Zed and his shadows throw their shurikens. Each shuriken deals damage to every enemy hit.
spells.text: Zed and his Shadows throw their shurikens, each dealing (80/120/160/200/240 + (100% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first enemy they pass through, and (48/72/96/120/144 + (60% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to each additional enemy.

spells.name: Living Shadow
spells.summary: Passive: Zed gains energy whenever he and his shadows strike an enemy with the same ability. Energy can only be gained once per cast ability. Active: Zed's shadow dashes forward, remaining in place for a few seconds. Reactivating Living Shadow will cause Zed to switch positions with this shadow.
spells.text: Passive: Zed gains 30/35/40/45/50 Energy whenever he and his Shadows strike an enemy with the same Ability. Active: Zed's Shadow dashes forward, remaining in place for 5 seconds. Recasting this Ability will cause Zed to switch positions with this Shadow. Energy can only be gained once per Ability usage.

spells.name: Shadow Slash
spells.summary: Zed and his Shadows slash, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Enemies hit by a Shadow's slash are slowed.
spells.text: Zed and his Shadows slash, dealing (70/92.5/115/137.5/160 + (70% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to nearby enemies. Each enemy champion hit by Zed's slash reduces Living Shadow's Cooldown by 3 seconds. Enemies hit by a Shadow's slash are Slowed by 20/25/30/35/40% for 1.5 seconds. Enemies hit by multiple slashes take no additional damage but are Slowed by 30/37.5/45/52.5/60% instead.

spells.name: Death Mark
spells.summary: Zed becomes untargetable and dashes to an enemy champion, marking them. After 3 seconds the mark triggers, repeating a portion of all the damage Zed dealt to the target while they were marked.
spells.text: Zed becomes Untargetable and dashes to an enemy champion, marking them.
