After 3 seconds, the mark triggers, dealing (100% Attack Damage) physical damage and repeating 25/40/55% of all damage dealt to the target by Zed while the mark was active. The dash leaves a Shadow behind for 7.5 seconds. Zed can Recast this Ability to switch positions with this Shadow. Untargetable units won't be affected by enemy Attacks or Abilities unless they've already been hit by them. The Shadow remains for an extra 1.5 seconds after the recast window ends.

spells.name: Living Battery
spells.summary: Zeri's Attacks deal magic damage and are treated as Abilities. Moving and casting Burst Fire stores up energy in Zeri's Sparkpack. When fully charged her next Attack deals bonus damage.
spells.text: Zeri's Attacks are treated as Abilities instead of Attacks and can be charged up by moving and casting Burst Fire. Uncharged Attacks consume a small amount of charge, deal ((10 ~ 25) + (3% Ability Power)) magic damage and execute enemies below ((70 ~ 160) + (20% Ability Power)) Health. A fully charged Attack deals ((75 ~ 160) + (110% Ability Power)) + (1% ~ 11%) max Health magic damage and consumes all charge.

spells.name: Burst Fire
spells.summary: Burst Fire shoots a burst of 7 rounds that deal attack damage to the first enemy hit. This Ability is treated as an Attack.
spells.text: Zeri fires a burst of 7 rounds that deals (22/26/30/34/38 + (102/104/106/108/110% Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first enemy hit. This Ability is treated as an Attack. This Ability can crit, apply on-hit effects once per target, and hit anything that an Attack can. The Cooldown and cast time scale down with Attack Speed (max 1.5 attacks per second). 60% of excess Attack Speed is converted into Attack Damage.

spells.name: Ultrashock Laser
spells.summary: Zeri fires an electric pulse that slows and damages the first enemy hit. If the pulse hits a wall it expands into a long range laser.
spells.text: Zeri fires an electric pulse that deals (30/70/110/150/190 + (100% Attack Damage) + (50% Ability Power)) physical damage and Slows the first enemy hit by 30/35/40/45/50% for 2 seconds. If the pulse hits terrain, it expands into a laser that applies the effects in an area and Critically Strikes champions and monsters for (30/70/110/150/190 + (100% Attack Damage) + (50% Ability Power)) × (0.5 + 50% Critical Strike Damage) physical damage. This Ability's cast time scales down with Attack Speed. Empowered damage scales with Critical Strike Damage at 50% effectiveness.

spells.name: Spark Surge
spells.summary: Zeri dashes a short distance and energizes Burst Fire to pierce through enemies. She will vault and grind over any terrain she touches.
spells.text: Zeri dashes a short distance and vaults over any terrain she touches, greatly extending the dash range. For the next 5 seconds, her shots of Burst Fire pierce dealing 80/85/90/95/100% damage to enemies after the first and an additional (22/24/26/28/30 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage On-Hit to the first target struck. Hitting an enemy with an Attack reduces this Ability's cooldown by 0.5 seconds. Critical strikes reduce the cooldown by 1.5 seconds instead. On-hit damage is increased by Zeri's Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage at 100% effectiveness. Pierce damage can critically strike but does not apply On-Hit effects.

spells.name: Lightning Crash
spells.summary: Zeri discharges a nova of electricity and overcharges herself, gaining increased damage and stacking Move Speed that refreshes and gets stronger every time she hits an enemy champion. While overcharged, Burst fire becomes a faster triple shot that chains lightning between enemies.
spells.text: Zeri discharges a nova of electricity, dealing (150/250/350 + (110% Ability Power) + (60% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage to nearby enemies. If she hits an enemy champion, Zeri gains 30% Attack Speed and 15% Move Speed for 5 seconds. Hitting an enemy champion with an Attack or Ability extends this ability's duration and adds a stack of Overcharge for 2.5 seconds. Critical strikes add 2 additional stacks. Each stack grants 1.5% Move Speed. During this time, Burst Fire becomes a faster triple shot that chains (40% Attack Damage) physical damage to nearby enemies. The Attack Speed also increases Zeri's max Attack Speed. The chain lightning can critically strike but does not apply On-Hit effects. Uncharged Attacks do not stack or refresh this ability. This ability's duration extension cannot exceed its original duration of 5 seconds.

spells.name: Short Fuse
spells.summary: Periodically, Ziggs' next basic attack deals bonus magic damage. This cooldown is reduced whenever Ziggs uses an ability.
spells.text: Every ? seconds, Ziggs' next Attack deals an additional ((20 ~ 140) + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage. It deals ((35 ~ 245) + (87.5% Ability Power)) damage instead to structures. Ziggs' abilities reduce this Cooldown by (4 ~ 6) seconds.

spells.name: Bouncing Bomb
spells.summary: Ziggs throws a bouncing bomb that deals magic damage.
spells.text: Ziggs throws a bouncing bomb that deals (80/130/180/230/280 + (60/65/70/75/80% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Satchel Charge
spells.summary: Ziggs flings an explosive charge that detonates after a delay, or when this ability is activated again. The explosion deals magic damage to enemies, knocking them away. Ziggs is also knocked away, but takes no damage. Ziggs can use the Satchel to hexplode vulnerable enemy turrets.
spells.text: Ziggs flings an explosive charge that detonates after 4 seconds, or when this ability is Recast. It deals (70/105/140/175/210 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies and Knocks them Back. Ziggs is also knocked away, but takes no damage. Satchel Charge will automatically destroy towers below 25/27.5/30/32.5/35% of their Health.

spells.name: Hexplosive Minefield
spells.summary: Ziggs scatters proximity mines that detonate on enemy contact, dealing magic damage and slowing. Successive mine detonations on the same target deal reduced damage.
spells.text: Ziggs scatters proximity mines that detonate on enemy contact, dealing (30/70/110/150/190 + (25/30/35/40/45% Ability Power)) magic damage and Slows by 10/20/30/40/50% for 1.5 seconds. Mines last 10 seconds. Mines beyond the first deal (12/28/44/60/76 + (10/12/14/16/18% Ability Power)) damage.

spells.name: Mega Inferno Bomb
spells.summary: Ziggs deploys his ultimate creation, the Mega Inferno Bomb, hurling it an enormous distance. Enemies in the primary blast zone take more damage than those farther away.
spells.text: Ziggs hurls his ultimate creation, dealing (300/500/700 + (100% Ability Power)) magic damage in the center of the blast radius, or (195/325/455 + (65% Ability Power)) magic damage at the edge.

spells.name: Time In A Bottle
spells.text: Zilean stores time as Experience and can grant it to his allies. When he has enough Experience to finish an ally's level up, he can right-click them to impart it. Zilean receives as much Experience as he gives.

spells.name: Time Bomb
spells.summary: Tosses a bomb to target area that sticks to units that come near it (prioritizes Champions). It detonates after 3 seconds, dealing area of effect damage. If a Time Bomb is detonated early by another Time Bomb, it also stuns enemies.
spells.text: Zilean tosses a time-delayed bomb that sticks to the first unit which comes within a small area around it. After 3 seconds it detonates, dealing (75/115/165/230/300 + (90% Ability Power)) magic damage. Placing a second bomb on a unit that already has one detonates the first bomb immediately and Stuns enemies in the blast for 1.1/1.2/1.3/1.4/1.5 seconds. The bomb will prioritize attaching to champions and units that already have a bomb.

spells.name: Rewind
spells.summary: Zilean can prepare himself for future confrontations, reducing the cooldowns of his other basic abilities.
spells.text: Zilean turns time, reducing his other basic Ability Cooldowns by 10 seconds.

spells.name: Time Warp
spells.summary: Zilean bends time around any unit, decreasing an enemy's Move Speed or increasing an ally's Move Speed for a short time.
spells.text: Zilean Slows an enemy champion by 40/55/70/85/99% or grants an allied champion 40/55/70/85/99% Move Speed for 2.5 seconds.

spells.name: Chronoshift
spells.summary: Zilean places a protective time rune on an allied champion, teleporting the champion back in time if they take lethal damage.
spells.text: Zilean grants a protective time rune to an allied champion for 5 seconds. If the target would die, the rune rewinds their timeline, putting them into Stasis for 3 seconds, then reviving them and restoring (600/850/1100 + (200% Ability Power)) Health. Units in Stasis cannot move or act, and are invulnerable and Untargetable.

spells.name: More Sparkles!
spells.summary: Zoe's next basic attack after casting a spell deals bonus magic damage.
spells.text: After using an Ability, Zoe's next Attack deals an additional ((16 ~ 110) + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Paddle Star!
spells.summary: Zoe fires a missile that she can redirect in flight. Deals more damage the longer it flies in a straight line.
spells.text: Zoe fires a star that deals increasing damage the further it travels to the first enemy hit and surrounding enemies -- between (50/80/110/140/170 + (2 ~ 34) + (60% Ability Power)) to (125/200/275/350/425 + (2 ~ 34) + (150% Ability Power)) magic damage. Zoe can Recast this Ability to redirect the missile to a new position near Zoe.

spells.name: Spell Thief
spells.summary: Zoe can pick up the remnants of enemy summoner spell and active item casts and cast them once herself. Whenever she casts a summoner spell, she gains 3 missiles that fire at the nearest target.
spells.text: Passive: Enemies drop spell shards when casting a Summoner Spell or using an Active Item. Specific minions also drop a spell shard when Zoe or a nearby ally kills them. Zoe can pick up this shard to cast that ability once. Passive: When Zoe casts this Ability or any Summoner Spell, she gains 30/40/50/60/70% Move Speed for 2/2.25/2.5/2.75/3 seconds and tosses 3 missiles at the target she Attacked most recently. These missiles deal (15/25/35/45/55 + (10% Ability Power)) magic damage each. Active: Cast the Ability from a spell shard Zoe has picked up. Spell shards last on the ground for 40 seconds. Each missile can apply More Sparkles!

spells.name: Sleepy Trouble Bubble
spells.summary: Causes the target to become drowsy, then fall asleep. While asleep, the target's Magic Resist is reduced. The first source of damage that breaks the sleep is doubled, up to a cap.
spells.text: Zoe dropkicks a bubble that deals (70/110/150/190/230 + (45% Ability Power)) magic damage, lingering as a trap if it hits nothing. The bubble's range is extended when flying over terrain. If either the bubble or trap hits an enemy champion she refreshes 16/19.5/23/26.5/30% of her cooldown. After a delay, the victim falls Asleep and have their Magic Resist reduced by 30% for 2 seconds. Attacks and Ability hits wake them up but deal double damage, up to (70/110/150/190/230 + (45% Ability Power)) true damage. Before the target falls Asleep, they are Drowsy, becoming increasingly Slowed (up to 10/15/20/25/30%).

spells.name: Portal Jump
spells.summary: Blink to a nearby position for 1 second. Then blink back.
spells.text: Zoe teleports to a nearby position for 1 second. Afterwards, she teleports back. Zoe can use Abilities and Attack, but can't move during this time. Zoe can also see over walls during the teleport.

spells.name: Garden of Thorns
spells.summary: Seeds spawn around Zyra periodically, becoming faster with level. Zyra can cast Deadly Spines or Grasping Roots near seeds to grow plants, who fight for Zyra.
spells.text: Zyra spawns Seeds around herself every (13.6 ~ 9.05) seconds that last 30 seconds. She can have 8 Seeds planted at once. If an enemy champion steps on a Seed, it dies. Zyra will not spawn Seeds while hiding in brush. These Seeds are used by her other Abilities to spawn plants that deal ((15 ~ 75) + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage.

spells.name: Deadly Spines
spells.summary: Thick vines spread through the ground and explode into spines, dealing magic damage to enemies within the area. If cast near a seed, Deadly Spines grows a Thorn Spitter plant, which fires at enemies from afar.
spells.text: Zyra causes thick vines to spread and explode into spines, dealing (60/100/140/180/220 + (65% Ability Power)) magic damage. If this Ability is cast near a Seed, the Seed grows into a Thorn Spitter that deals ((15 ~ 75) + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage and lasts 8 seconds. Thorn Spitters have 575 range.

spells.name: Rampant Growth
spells.summary: Zyra plants a seed, lasting up to 60 seconds. Deadly Spines and Grasping Roots cast near seeds will turn them into plants who fight for Zyra. Zyra can store multiple seeds at once, and killing enemies reduces Rampant Growth's recharge time.
spells.text: Zyra plants a Seed that lasts 60 seconds. These Seeds grant True Sight of enemy champions that step on them for 2 seconds, but are still destroyed. This Ability has 2 charges with a 18/16/14/12/10 second recharge time. Killing an enemy minion or monster reduces the recharge time by 35%. Champion takedowns reduce the recharge time by 100% instead.

spells.name: Grasping Roots
spells.summary: Zyra sends forth vines through the ground to ensnare her target, dealing damage and rooting enemies they come across. If cast near a seed, Grasping Roots grows a Vine Lasher, whose short range attacks reduce enemy Move Speed.
spells.text: Zyra sends vines forward, Rooting for 1/1.25/1.5/1.75/2 second(s) and dealing (60/95/130/165/200 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. If this Ability passes near a Seed, the Seed grows into a Vine Lasher that deals ((15 ~ 75) + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage and lasts 8 seconds. Vine Lashers have 400 range, and their Attacks Slow by 30% for 2 seconds. The Slow from multiple Vine Lashers stacks up to 2 times.

spells.name: Stranglethorns
spells.summary: Zyra summons a twisted thicket at her target location, dealing damage to enemies as it expands and knocking them airborne as it contracts. Plants within the thicket are enraged.
spells.text: Zyra summons the fury of nature, growing a twisted thicket that deals (200/300/400 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage. After 2 seconds, the vines snap upwards, Knocking Up for 1 second. Zyra's plants within the thicket become enraged, resetting their duration, gaining 50% Health and Attacking for 50% bonus damage.
